const cv = document.getElementById('c'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
const W = 400, H = 300;

let state = 'title';
let player = { x: 50, y: 200, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false };
const G = 0.4;

let tents = [];
let platforms = [];
let key = {};
let msg = '';
let msgT = 0;

function init() {
  player = { x: 50, y: 200, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false };
  platforms = [
    { x:0, y:280, w:400, h:20 },
    { x:100, y:220, w:80, h:12 },
    { x:250, y:180, w:80, h:12 },
    { x:320, y:120, w:70, h:12 },
  ];
  tents = [];
  for (let i=0; i<5; i++) {
    tents.push({ x: 80+i*60, y: 260, r: 15, phase: Math.random()*6.28 });
  }
  msg = 'Press arrows to move. Avoid the tentacles!';
  msgT = 180;
}

function showMsg(t) { msg = t; msgT = 150; }

function update() {
  if (state === 'title') return;
  if (state === 'gameover') {
    if (key['r']) { state='playing'; init(); }
    return;
  }
  if (state === 'win') {
    if (key['r']) { state='playing'; init(); }
    return;
  }

  // Player movement
  if (key['ArrowLeft']) player.vx = -2.5;
  else if (key['ArrowRight']) player.vx = 2.5;
  else player.vx *= 0.7;

  player.vy += G;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;

  // Platform collision
  player.onGround = false;
  for (const p of platforms) {
    if (player.x > p.x && player.x < p.x + p.w &&
        player.y + 10 > p.y && player.y + 10 < p.y + p.h + player.vy + 2 &&
        player.vy >= 0) {
      player.y = p.y - 10;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
    }
  }

  // Tentacles
  const t = Date.now() / 500;
  for (const tent of tents) {
    tent.phase += 0.05;
    const reach = Math.sin(tent.phase) * 40 + 30;
    const tx = tent.x;
    const ty = tent.y - reach;

    // Check if player is near tentacle tip
    const dx = player.x - tx;
    const dy = (player.y + 5) - ty;
    if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < 20) {
      state = 'gameover';
      showMsg('Caught by a tentacle!');
      return;
    }
  }

  // Win condition: reach rightmost platform
  if (player.x > 350 && player.y < 130) {
    state = 'win';
    showMsg('You escaped! The Brain is safe!');
  }

  if (msgT > 0) msgT--;
}

function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (state === 'title') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('DAY OF THE', W/2, 100);
    ctx.fillText('TENTACLE', W/2, 130);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('A tiny fan game', W/2, 170);
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to start', W/2, 200);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.font = '12px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Arrow keys to move | R to restart', W/2, 240);
    return;
  }

  // Platforms
  ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
  for (const p of platforms) {
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
  }

  // Tentacles
  const t = Date.now() / 500;
  for (const tent of tents) {
    const reach = Math.sin(tent.phase) * 40 + 30;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tent.x, tent.y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(tent.x + 10, tent.y - reach * 0.5, tent.x, tent.y - reach);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b8a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(tent.x, tent.y - reach, 5, 0, 6.28);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Player (Bernard)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.fillRect(player.x - 5, player.y - 5, 10, 15);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillRect(player.x - 3, player.y - 3, 6, 4);

  // Message
  if (msgT > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '12px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(msg, W/2, 30);
  }

  if (state === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press R to retry', W/2, H/2 + 20);
  }

  if (state === 'win') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('YOU ESCAPED!', W/2, H/2 - 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('The Brain is safe! Press R to play again', W/2, H/2 + 20);
  }
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  key[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' && state === 'title') {
    state = 'playing';
    init();
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { key[e.key] = false; });

init();
state = 'title';
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Rocket League (Mini)</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0b1020;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;}
  canvas{background:#123a2e;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 0 30px #000a;}
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="c" width="900" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=cv.width,H=cv.height;
const field={x:40,y:40,w:W-80,h:H-80};
const goalDepth=34, goalW=140, goalH=120;
const leftGoal={x:field.x,y:field.y+field.h/2-goalH/2,w:goalW,h:goalH,dir:-1};
const rightGoal={x:field.x+field.w,y:field.y+field.h/2-goalH/2,w:goalW,h:goalH,dir:1};

const car={x:field.x+field.w/2,y:field.y+field.h/2,angle:0,vx:0,vy:0,r:22};
const ball={x:field.x+field.w/2,y:field.y+field.h/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:14};
let scoreL=0,scoreR=0,time=120,over=false;
const keys={};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.code]=true;if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space'].includes(e.code))e.preventDefault();});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.code]=false;});

const ACCEL=0.45,MAXV=7,FRICTION=0.985;
function resetPositions(){
  car.x=field.x+field.w/2;car.y=field.y+field.h/2;car.angle=0;car.vx=car.vy=0;
  ball.x=field.x+field.w/2;ball.y=field.y+field.h/2;ball.vx=ball.vy=0;
}
function goal(who){
  if(who==='L')scoreL++;else scoreR++;
  resetPositions();
}

function update(dt){
  if(over)return;
  time-=dt;
  if(time<=0){time=0;over=true;return;}
  const turn=0.06;
  if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['KeyA'])car.angle-=turn;
  if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD'])car.angle+=turn;
  const fx=Math.cos(car.angle),fy=Math.sin(car.angle);
  const boost=keys['ShiftLeft']||keys['ShiftRight'];
  const a=boost?ACCEL*1.4:ACCEL;
  if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW']){car.vx+=fx*a;car.vy+=fy*a;}
  if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['KeyS']){car.vx-=fx*a*0.6;car.vy-=fy*a*0.6;}
  const sp=Math.hypot(car.vx,car.vy),max=boost?MAXV*1.35:MAXV;
  if(sp>max){car.vx=car.vx/sp*max;car.vy=car.vy/sp*max;}
  car.vx*=FRICTION;car.vy*=FRICTION;
  car.x+=car.vx;car.y+=car.vy;

  // car vs walls (field bounds)
  if(car.x<field.x+car.r){car.x=field.x+car.r;car.vx*=-0.5;}
  if(car.x>field.x+field.w-car.r){car.x=field.x+field.w-car.r;car.vx*=-0.5;}
  if(car.y<field.y+car.r){car.y=field.y+car.r;car.vy*=-0.5;}
  if(car.y>field.y+field.h-car.r){car.y=field.y+field.h-car.r;car.vy*=-0.5;}

  // car vs ball
  const dx=ball.x-car.x,dy=ball.y-car.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||0.0001;
  const min=car.r+ball.r;
  if(d<min){
    const nx=dx/d,ny=dy/d;
    ball.x=car.x+nx*min;ball.y=car.y+ny*min;
    // transfer velocity
    const impact=Math.hypot(car.vx,car.vy);
    ball.vx=nx*(impact*1.15)+ball.vx*0.4;
    ball.vy=ny*(impact*1.15)+ball.vy*0.4;
    car.vx*=0.85;car.vy*=0.85;
  }

  // ball move + friction
  ball.x+=ball.vx;ball.y+=ball.vy;
  ball.vx*=0.995;ball.vy*=0.995;
  const bsp=Math.hypot(ball.vx,ball.vy);
  if(bsp>10){ball.vx=ball.vx/bsp*10;ball.vy=ball.vy/bsp*10;}

  // ball vs walls
  if(ball.x<field.x+ball.r){ball.x=field.x+ball.r;ball.vx*=-0.85;}
  if(ball.x>field.x+field.w-ball.r){ball.x=field.x+field.w-ball.r;ball.vx*=-0.85;}
  if(ball.y<field.y+ball.r){ball.y=field.y+ball.r;ball.vy*=-0.85;}
  if(ball.y>field.y+field.h-ball.r){ball.y=field.y+field.h-ball.r;ball.vy*=-0.85;}

  // goals: check if ball fully crossed into goal mouth
  // left goal mouth at x=field.x, opening y from leftGoal.y to leftGoal.y+leftGoal.h
  if(ball.x-ball.r<leftGoal.x && ball.y>leftGoal.y && ball.y<leftGoal.y+leftGoal.h){
    goal('R'); // ball went into left goal -> right scores
  }
  if(ball.x+ball.r>rightGoal.x && ball.y>rightGoal.y && ball.y<rightGoal.y+rightGoal.h){
    goal('L');
  }
}

function drawField(){
  // outer
  ctx.fillStyle='#0d2a22';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // field
  ctx.fillStyle='#1a5e46';
  ctx.fillRect(field.x,field.y,field.w,field.h);
  // stripes
  ctx.fillStyle='#1f6f55';
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    if(i%2===0)ctx.fillRect(field.x+i*field.w/8,field.y,field.w/8,field.h);
  }
  // center line
  ctx.strokeStyle='#ffffffaa';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(field.x+field.w/2,field.y);ctx.lineTo(field.x+field.w/2,field.y+field.h);ctx.stroke();
  // center circle
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(field.x+field.w/2,field.y+field.h/2,40,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  // goals
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff5555';
  ctx.fillRect(leftGoal.x-goalDepth,leftGoal.y,goalDepth,leftGoal.h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#55ff99';
  ctx.fillRect(rightGoal.x,rightGoal.y,goalDepth,rightGoal.h);
}

function drawCar(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(car.x,car.y);
  ctx.rotate(car.angle);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffcf3f';
  ctx.fillRect(-car.r,-car.r*0.7,car.r*2,car.r*1.4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#222';
  ctx.fillRect(-car.r,-car.r*0.7,car.r*0.5,car.r*1.4);
  ctx.fillRect(car.r-car.r*0.5,-car.r*0.7,car.r*0.5,car.r*1.4);

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBall(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#333';ctx.lineWidth=2;

  ctx.moveTo(ball.x,ball.y-ball.r);ctx.lineTo(ball.x,ball.y+ball.r);ctx.stroke();
}

function drawHUD(){

  }
}

function loop(now){

addEventListener('keydown',e=>{

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Left 4 Dead</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; background:#0a0a0a; color:#ccc; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; }
  #game { display:block; margin:0 auto; background:#111; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

  const state = {
    player: { x: W/2, y: H/2, hp: 100, maxHp: 100, speed: 3, angle: 0, ammo: 30, reloading: false },
    zombies: [],
    bullets: [],
    keys: {},
    score: 0,
    wave: 1,
    gameOver: false,
    mouse: { x: W/2, y: 0 },
    shooting: false
  };

  function spawnZombie() {
    const edge = Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
    let x, y;
    if(edge===0){ x=0; y=Math.random()*H; }
    else if(edge===1){ x=W; y=Math.random()*H; }
    else if(edge===2){ x=Math.random()*W; y=0; }
    else { x=Math.random()*W; y=H; }
    const special = Math.random() < 0.15;
    state.zombies.push({
      x, y,
      hp: special ? 60 : 20,
      speed: special ? 1.2 : 0.8,
      size: special ? 22 : 14,
      color: special ? '#ff5555' : '#6a8a4a',
      isSpecial: special
    });
  }

  function shoot() {
    if(state.player.ammo <= 0 || state.player.reloading) return;
    const a = state.player.angle;
    state.bullets.push({ x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, vx: Math.cos(a)*8, vy: Math.sin(a)*8 });
    state.player.ammo--;
    if(state.player.ammo === 0) state.player.reloading = true;
  }

  function update() {
    const p = state.player;
    if(state.gameOver) return;

    if(state.keys['a'] || state.keys['arrowleft']) p.x -= p.speed;
    if(state.keys['d'] || state.keys['arrowright']) p.x += p.speed;
    if(state.keys['w'] || state.keys['arrowup']) p.y -= p.speed;
    if(state.keys['s'] || state.keys['arrowdown']) p.y += p.speed;
    p.x = Math.max(10, Math.min(W-10, p.x));
    p.y = Math.max(10, Math.min(H-10, p.y));

    if(state.keys[' ']) shoot();

    if(p.reloading) {
      if(Math.random() < 0.03) {
        p.ammo = 30;
        p.reloading = false;
      }
    }

    state.bullets = state.bullets.filter(b => {
      b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy;
      if(b.x<0||b.x>W||b.y<0||b.y>H) return false;
      for(let z of state.zombies) {
        const dx = b.x-z.x, dy = b.y-z.y;
        if(Math.hypot(dx,dy) < z.size) {
          z.hp -= 10;
          if(z.hp <= 0) {
            state.zombies.splice(state.zombies.indexOf(z),1);
            state.score += z.isSpecial ? 50 : 10;
          }
          return false;
        }
      }
      return true;
    });

    state.zombies = state.zombies.filter(z => {
      const dx = p.x-z.x, dy = p.y-z.y;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      if(dist > 1) { z.x += dx/dist*z.speed; z.y += dy/dist*z.speed; }
      if(dist < z.size+10) {
        p.hp -= 0.5;
        if(p.hp <= 0) { p.hp = 0; state.gameOver = true; }
      }
      return true;
    });

    if(state.zombies.length < 5 + state.wave) {
      if(Math.random() < 0.02) spawnZombie();
      if(state.zombies.length === 0) {
        state.wave++;
        state.player.hp = Math.min(state.player.maxHp, state.player.hp + 20);
      }
    }
  }

  function render() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    const p = state.player;

    ctx.fillStyle = p.isSpecial ? '' : '#88ccff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 12, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x + Math.cos(p.angle)*20, p.y + Math.sin(p.angle)*20);
    ctx.stroke();

    for(let z of state.zombies) {
      ctx.fillStyle = z.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(z.x, z.y, z.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd00';
    for(let b of state.bullets) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('HP: ' + Math.ceil(p.hp) + '/' + p.maxHp, 10, 20);
    ctx.fillText('Ammo: ' + p.ammo + (p.reloading ? ' (reloading...)' : ''), 10, 40);
    ctx.fillText('Wave: ' + state.wave, 10, 60);
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, 10, 80);
    if(state.gameOver) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      ctx.font = '40px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('YOU DIED', W/2-90, H/2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '16px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Press R to restart', W/2-70, H/2+30);
    }
  }

  function loop() {
    update();
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    state.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if(e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r' && state.gameOver) {
      state.player = { x: W/2, y: H/2, hp: 100, maxHp: 100, speed: 3, angle: 0, ammo: 30, reloading: false };
      state.zombies = [];
      state.bullets = [];
      state.score = 0;
      state.wave = 1;
      state.gameOver = false;
    }
    if(e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { state.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = e.clientX - r.left, my = e.clientY - r.top;
    state.player.angle = Math.atan2(my - state.player.y, mx - state.player.x);
  });

  loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<canvas id="c" width="640" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'), ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=cv.width,H=cv.height;
let key={};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{key[e.key]=true; if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight',' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{key[e.key]=false;});

// Game state
const state={
  x:120,y:220,
  hasKey:false,
  hasGrape:false,
  keyUsed:false,
  won:false
};

// Objects
const keyObj={x:540,y:120,r:16};
const door={x:560,y:280,w:40,h:90};
const grapes={x:300,y:90,r:14};
const monkey={x:450,y:340,r:14,ang:0};

function drawTree(x,y){
  ctx.fillStyle='#6b4423'; ctx.fillRect(x-6,y,12,40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a7d2c';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y-5,26,0,7); ctx.fill();
}

function draw(){
  // Ground
  ctx.fillStyle='#2d5a27'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a7d2c';
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc((i*90+30)%W, 200+((i*47)%180), 40,0,7); ctx.fill(); }

  // Trees
  drawTree(80,140); drawTree(500,180); drawTree(250,320);

  // Grape vine
  ctx.fillStyle='#7a5c3a'; ctx.fillRect(grapes.x-30,grapes.y-40,60,8);
  if(!state.hasGrape){
    ctx.fillStyle='#6a2c91';
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(grapes.x-10+(i%3)*10, grapes.y+((i/3)|0)*10,6,0,7); ctx.fill(); }
  }

  // Key
  if(!state.hasKey){
    ctx.fillStyle='#e0c050';
    ctx.fillRect(keyObj.x-4,keyObj.y-14,8,28);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(keyObj.x,keyObj.y-14,9,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#2d5a27'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(keyObj.x,keyObj.y-14,4,0,7); ctx.fill();
  }

  // Door
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a3a1a'; ctx.fillRect(door.x,door.y,door.w,door.h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8b6f47'; ctx.fillRect(door.x+4,door.y+4,door.w-8,door.h-8);
  ctx.fillStyle='#e0c050'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(door.x+door.w-8,door.y+door.h/2,4,0,7); ctx.fill();

  // Monkey
  monkey.ang+=0.05;
  const mx=monkey.x+Math.cos(monkey.ang)*20, my=monkey.y+Math.sin(monkey.ang)*12;
  ctx.fillStyle='#8b5a2b';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx,my,monkey.r,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx,my-18,8,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a2410';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx-3,my-20,1.5,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx+3,my-20,1.5,0,7); ctx.fill();

  // Player (Guybrush)
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a5a8b'; ctx.fillRect(state.x-10,state.y,20,30);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f0c8a0'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(state.x,state.y-8,10,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#8b5a2b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(state.x,state.y-12,10,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='14px Georgia';
  let hud='';
  if(state.hasKey) hud+='[Key] ';
  if(state.hasGrape) hud+='[Grapes] ';
  ctx.fillText('Guybrush Threepwood  '+hud, 10, 22);
}

function update(){
  if(state.won) return;
  const sp=3;
  if(key['ArrowLeft']||key['a']) state.x-=sp;
  if(key['ArrowRight']||key['d']) state.x+=sp;
  if(key['ArrowUp']||key['w']) state.y-=sp;
  if(key['ArrowDown']||key['s']) state.y+=sp;
  state.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(W-20,state.x));
  state.y=Math.max(40,Math.min(H-20,state.y));

  const near=(o)=>Math.hypot(state.x-o.x,state.y-o.y)<o.r+14;

  if(!state.hasKey && near(keyObj)){
    state.hasKey=true;
  }
  if(!state.hasGrape && near(grapes)){
    state.hasGrape=true;

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Mario Kart 8 - Mini</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; background:#111; color:#fff; font-family:sans-serif; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; }
  canvas { border:2px solid #444; margin-top:8px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

// Track
const track = [
  {x:200,y:100},{x:600,y:100},{x:700,y:200},{x:700,y:350},
  {x:550,y:450},{x:250,y:450},{x:100,y:350},{x:100,y:200}
];
const trackWidth = 80;

// Player
const player = {
  x:200, y:100, angle:0, speed:0, maxSpeed:5, accel:0.2,
  friction:0.95, turnSpeed:0.06, lap:0, lastCheckpoint:0, items:[]
};

// Checkpoints
const checkpoints = track.map(p => ({...p}));

// Input
const keys = {};
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);

function onTrack(x, y) {
  let minDist = Infinity;
  for (const p of track) {
    const d = Math.hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y);
    if (d < minDist) minDist = d;
  }
  return minDist < trackWidth;
}

function update() {
  // Steering
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.angle -= player.turnSpeed * (player.speed / player.maxSpeed + 0.5);
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.angle += player.turnSpeed * (player.speed / player.maxSpeed + 0.5);

  // Acceleration
  if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) player.speed += player.accel;
  if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) player.speed -= player.accel * 0.5;

  player.speed *= player.friction;
  player.speed = Math.max(-2, Math.min(player.maxSpeed, player.speed));

  // Move
  player.x += Math.cos(player.angle) * player.speed;
  player.y += Math.sin(player.angle) * player.speed;

  // Off-track slowdown
  if (!onTrack(player.x, player.y)) player.speed *= 0.9;

  // Checkpoint / lap detection
  let nearest = 0, nd = Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < checkpoints.length; i++) {
    const d = Math.hypot(player.x - checkpoints[i].x, player.y - checkpoints[i].y);
    if (d < nd) { nd = d; nearest = i; }
  }
  if (nd < trackWidth) {
    if (nearest === (player.lastCheckpoint + 1) % checkpoints.length ||
        (player.lastCheckpoint === 0 && nearest === checkpoints.length - 1)) {
      if (nearest === 0 && player.lastCheckpoint === checkpoints.length - 1) {
        player.lap++;
      }
      player.lastCheckpoint = nearest;
    }
  }
}

function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2d5a27';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Draw track
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
  ctx.lineWidth = trackWidth * 2;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(track[0].x, track[0].y);
  for (let i = 1; i < track.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(track[i].x, track[i].y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Track center line
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.setLineDash([20, 20]);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Checkpoints
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  for (const cp of checkpoints) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cp.x, cp.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Player
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
  ctx.rotate(player.angle);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e60012';
  ctx.fillRect(-15, -10, 30, 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillRect(5, -5, 10, 10);
  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`Lap: ${player.lap + 1}/3`, 10, 30);
  ctx.fillText(`Speed: ${Math.abs(player.speed).toFixed(1)}`, 10, 55);
  if (player.lap >= 3) {
    ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('🏆 You Win!', W/2 - 70, H/2);
  }
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>

<title>Shadow Duel</title>

<body>
<canvas id="c" width="640" height="360"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=640,H=360,GROUND=300,GRAV=0.7;
const keys={};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.code]=true;if(['KeyA','KeyD','Space','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.code))e.preventDefault();});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.code]=false;});

class Fighter{
  constructor(x,dir,color,ai){this.x=x;this.y=GROUND;this.vx=0;this.vy=0;this.dir=dir;this.color=color;this.hp=100;this.state='idle';this.t=0;this.ai=ai;this.cool=0;this.hit=0;}
  get onGround(){return this.y>=GROUND-1;}
  update(){
    if(this.cool>0)this.cool--;
    if(this.hit>0)this.hit--;
    this.t++;
    // physics
    this.vy+=GRAV;this.y+=this.vy;this.x+=this.vx;
    if(this.y>GROUND){this.y=GROUND;this.vy=0;}
    this.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(W-20,this.x));
    if(!this.ai){
      // player input
      if(this.state!=='attack'&&this.state!=='hurt'){
        let mv=0;
        if(keys['KeyA'])mv-=1;
        if(keys['KeyD'])mv+=1;
        this.vx=mv*3.2;
        if(mv!==0)this.dir=mv;
        if(this.onGround){
          if(keys['Space']&&this.cool<=0){this.state='attack';this.t=0;this.cool=30;}
          if(keys['KeyW']&&this.onGround){this.vy=-12;this.state='jump';}
        }
        if(this.state==='jump'&&this.onGround)this.state='idle';
        if(this.state==='idle'&&this.vx===0)this.state='idle';
        else if(this.state==='idle')this.state='idle';
      }
      if(this.state==='attack'){
        this.vx*=0.5;
        if(this.t>14)this.state='idle';
      }
    }else{
      // AI
      if(this.state==='attack'){this.vx*=0.5;if(this.t>14)this.state='idle';}
      else if(this.state!=='hurt'){
        const o=other(this);
        const d=o.x-this.x;
        this.dir=d>0?1:-1;
        if(Math.abs(d)>55){this.vx=this.dir*2.6;this.state='walk';}
        else{
          this.vx=0;this.state='idle';
          if(this.cool<=0&&Math.random()<0.04){this.state='attack';this.t=0;this.cool=40;}
        }
        if(Math.random()<0.01&&this.onGround){this.vy=-12;this.state='jump';}
        if(this.state==='jump'&&this.onGround)this.state='idle';
      }
    }
    if(this.state==='hurt'&&this.t>12)this.state='idle';
  }
  attackBox(){
    if(this.state!=='attack'||this.t<4||this.t>10)return null;
    return{x:this.x+this.dir*10,y:this.y-30,w:46,h:34};
  }
  hurtBox(){return{x:this.x-14,y:this.y-52,w:28,h:52};}
  draw(){
    const x=this.x,y=this.y;
    const c=this.color;
    ctx.save();
    if(this.hit>0)ctx.globalAlpha=0.6;
    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,GROUND+4,20,5,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
    // body
    const lean=this.state==='attack'?this.dir*6:0;
    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=6;ctx.lineCap='round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    const step=this.state==='walk'?Math.sin(this.t*0.3)*8:0;
    ctx.moveTo(x-6,y-24);ctx.lineTo(x-8+step,y);
    ctx.moveTo(x+6,y-24);ctx.lineTo(x+8-step,y);
    ctx.stroke();
    // torso
    ctx.fillStyle=c;
    ctx.fillRect(x-10,y-52,20,30);
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle='#e8c9a0';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+lean,y-60,8,0,7);ctx.fill();
    // headband
    ctx.fillStyle=c;
    ctx.fillRect(x-8+lean,y-64,16,3);
    ctx.fillRect(x-8+lean,y-60,3,8);
    ctx.fillRect(x+5+lean,y-60,3,8);
    // arms
    ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if(this.state==='attack'){
      const ext=Math.min(1,(this.t-2)/6);
      ctx.moveTo(x+this.dir*4,y-44);
      ctx.lineTo(x+this.dir*(10+ext*40),y-40);
      // fist
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8c9a0';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+this.dir*(10+ext*40),y-40,5,0,7);ctx.fill();
    }else{
      ctx.moveTo(x-8,y-44);ctx.lineTo(x-12,y-28);
      ctx.moveTo(x+8,y-44);ctx.lineTo(x+12,y-28);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}
function other(f){return f===p1?p2:p1;}
let p1=new Fighter(150,1,'#c0392b',false);
let p2=new Fighter(490,-1,'#2980b9',true);
let winner=null;

function checkHit(a,b){
  const atk=a.attackBox();if(!atk)return;
  const hb=b.hurtBox();
  if(atk.x<hb.x+hb.w&&atk.x+atk.w>hb.x&&atk.y<hb.y+hb.h&&atk.y+atk.h>hb.y){
    if(b.hit<=0){
      b.hp-=12;b.hit=12;b.state='hurt';b.t=0;b.vx=a.dir*5;
      if(b.hp<=0){b.hp=0;winner=a;}
    }
  }
}

function drawBG(){
  // sky gradient
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,GROUND);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#2a0a0a');g.addColorStop(1,'#0d0505');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,GROUND);
  // moon
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd9a0';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(520,70,30,0,7);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a0a0a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(532,62,28,0,7);ctx.fill();
  // distant towers
  ctx.fillStyle='#150808';
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    const tx=i*90+10;
    ctx.fillRect(tx,GROUND-90-Math.sin(i)*20,40,90+Math.sin(i)*20);
    ctx.fillRect(tx+10,GROUND-110-Math.sin(i)*20,20,30);
  }
  // floor
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a2020';ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND,W,H-GROUND);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#5a3535';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  for(let i=0;i<W;i+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i,GROUND);ctx.lineTo(i-20,H);ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,GROUND);ctx.lineTo(W,GROUND);ctx.stroke();
  // floor glow
  const fg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,GROUND,0,GROUND+20);
  fg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,80,40,0.25)');fg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,80,40,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=fg;ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND,W,20);
}

function bar(x,y,w,h,frac,col,flip){
  ctx.fillStyle='#000';ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#331111';ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+2,w-4,h-4);
  const fw=(w-4)*frac;
  ctx.fillStyle=col;
  if(flip)ctx.fillRect(x+2+w-fw,y+2,fw,h-4);
  else ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+2,fw,h-4);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#885533';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(x,y,w,h);
}

function draw(){
  drawBG();
  p1.draw();p2.draw();
  // HUD
  bar(20,18,250,18,p1.hp/100,'#e74c3c',false);
  bar(W-270,18,250,18,p2.hp/100,'#3498db',true);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffcc66';ctx.font='bold 14px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillText('YOU',20,52);
  ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillText('RIVAL',W-20,52);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 22px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('VS',W/2,36);
  if(winner){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd700';ctx.font='bold 40px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(winner===p1?'YOU WIN':'RIVAL WINS',W/2,H/2-10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ccc';ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press R to restart',W/2,H/2+30);
  }
}

function loop(){
  if(!winner){
    p1.update();p2.update();
    checkHit(p1,p2);checkHit(p2,p1);
  }
  if(keys['KeyR']&&winner){
    p1=new Fighter(150,1,'#c0392b',false);
    p2=new Fighter(490,-1,'#2980b9',true);
    winner=null;
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true;if(e.key===' '&&mode==='title')startRace();});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(mode==='title')startRace();});
function startRace(){reset();}

// ---- physics ----
const MAXV=560,ACC=340,BRK=560,DRAG=0.9;
function update(dt){
  if(mode==='count'){time+=dt;if(time>3.2)mode='race';return;}
  if(mode==='over')return;
  // steering
  const steer=(keys['a']||keys['A']||keys['ArrowLeft']?-1:0)+(keys['d']||keys['D']||keys['ArrowRight']?1:0);
  car.steer+= (steer-car.steer)*Math.min(1,dt*10);
  // throttle / brake
  const gas=keys['w']||keys['W']||keys['ArrowUp']?1:0;
  const brk=keys['s']||keys['S']||keys['ArrowDown']?1:0;
  const offF=car.offT>0?0.35:1;
  if(gas)car.v+=ACC*offF*dt;
  if(brk)car.v-=BRK*dt;
  car.v*=Math.pow(DRAG,dt*60/60);
  car.v=Math.max(-120,Math.min(MAXV,car.v));
  // turn (speed sensitive)
  const turn=car.steer*(0.012+0.02*(Math.abs(car.v)/MAXV));
  car.h+=turn*dt*(car.v>=0?1:-1);
  // move
  car.x+=Math.cos(car.h)*car.v*dt;
  car.y+=Math.sin(car.h)*car.v*dt;
  // track proximity
  const d=distToTrack(car.x,car.y);
  const onRoad=d<roadW/2;
  const seg=nearestSeg(car.x,car.y);
  const prev=car.seg;
  car.seg=seg;
  // off-road penalty
  if(!onRoad){
    car.offT=Math.min(1,car.offT+dt*2);
    car.v*=Math.pow(0.985,dt*60/60);
    car.shake=Math.min(1,car.shake+dt*3);
  }else{
    car.offT=Math.max(0,car.offT-dt*2);
    car.shake=Math.max(0,car.shake-dt*3);
  }
  car.off=d;
  // lap detection (crossing start line going forward)
  const a=(prev-1+N)%N,b=seg;
  if(b===0&&a===N-1&&car.v>0){
    const lt=(performance.now()-lapStart)/1000;
    if(lap===1)lapStart=performance.now();
    if(bestLap===null||lt<bestLap)bestLap=lt;
    lap++;
    if(lap>lapCount){mode='over';return;}
    lapStart=performance.now();
  }
}

// ---- helpers ----
function rr(x,y,w,h,r){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);ctx.closePath();}
function speedKmh(){return Math.abs(car.v)*0.55;}

// ---- render ----
function draw(){
  const t=performance.now()/1000;
  // camera shake
  const sh=car.shake*6;
  const ox=(Math.random()-0.5)*sh,oy=(Math.random()-0.5)*sh;
  const cx=car.x, cy=car.y;
  const zoom=Math.max(0.55,Math.min(1.0,1.15-Math.abs(car.v)/MAXV*0.5));
  const scale=zoom*Math.min(W/1400,H/1200);

  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  // sky/ground
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#1a2f22');g.addColorStop(1,'#0d1a12');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W/2+ox,H/2+oy);
  ctx.scale(scale,scale);
  ctx.rotate(-car.h-Math.PI/2); // keep car upright, world rotates
  ctx.translate(-cx,-cy);

  // off-road grass texture (subtle stripes)
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(60,110,60,0.12)';ctx.lineWidth=4;
  for(let i=-4000;i<4000;i+=120){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i,-4000);ctx.lineTo(i,4000);ctx.stroke();
  }

  // road
  ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.strokeStyle='#2b2f36';ctx.lineWidth=roadW;
  pathTrack();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#3a4048';ctx.lineWidth=roadW-14;
  pathTrack();ctx.stroke();
  // edges
  ctx.strokeStyle='#e8e8e8';ctx.lineWidth=4;
  pathTrack();ctx.stroke();
  // center dashed
  ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd23f';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.setLineDash([26,26]);
  pathTrack();ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // start/finish checker
  const sp=track[0];
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(sp[0],sp[1]);ctx.rotate(headingAt(0));
  for(let i=-3;i<3;i++){for(let j=0;j<2;j++){ctx.fillStyle=(i+j)%2?'#fff':'#111';ctx.fillRect(-14+j*14,i*14,14,14);}}
  ctx.restore();

  // car
  drawCar();

  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  drawHUD();
  if(mode==='count')drawCount();
  if(mode==='over')drawOver();
  if(mode==='title')drawTitle();
}
function pathTrack(){ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){const p=track[i%N];if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);else ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);}ctx.closePath();}

function drawCar(){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(car.x,car.y);ctx.rotate(car.h);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';rr(-22,-13,44,26,7);ctx.fill();
  // body
  const bg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-12,0,12);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#ff5a3c');bg.addColorStop(0.5,'#e02b1e');bg.addColorStop(1,'#8f130d');
  ctx.fillStyle=bg;rr(-22,-12,44,24,7);ctx.fill();
  // roof
  ctx.fillStyle='#20242b';rr(-6,-9,18,18,5);ctx.fill();
  // windshield
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,200,255,0.5)';rr(4,-8,6,16,2);ctx.fill();
  // headlights
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff2b0';ctx.fillRect(20,-9,3,5);ctx.fillRect(20,4,3,5);
  // taillights
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff2d2d';ctx.fillRect(-22,-9,3,5);ctx.fillRect(-22,4,3,5);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  // speed
  const kmh=Math.round(speedKmh());
  ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';rr(W-230,H-120,210,100,14);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 54px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(kmh,W-70,H-52);
  ctx.font='18px Arial';ctx.fillStyle='#9fb0c0';ctx.fillText('km/h',W-70,H-30);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  // lap
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';rr(20,20,220,90,14);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 22px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('LAP '+Math.min(lap,lapCount)+' / '+lapCount,40,52);
  ctx.font='16px Arial';ctx.fillStyle='#cfe0f0';
  const cur=(mode==='race')?((performance.now()-lapStart)/1000).toFixed(2)+'s':'--';
  ctx.fillText('Time  '+cur,40,78);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f';
  ctx.fillText('Best  '+(bestLap?bestLap.toFixed(2)+'s':'--'),40,100);
  // offroad warning
  if(car.offT>0.5){
    ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,80,40,'+(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*10))+')';
    ctx.font='bold 30px Arial';ctx.fillText('OFF TRACK',W/2,90);
  }
}
function drawCount(){
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  const n=Math.ceil(3.2-time);
  const frac=1-(time%1);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 120px Arial';
  ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,frac*1.5);
  ctx.fillText(n>0?n:'GO!',W/2,H/2);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawOver(){
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 64px Arial';ctx.fillText('RACE COMPLETE',W/2,H/2-40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f';ctx.font='bold 30px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Best lap: '+(bestLap?bestLap.toFixed(2)+'s':'--'),W/2,H/2+20);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb0c0';ctx.font='20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or tap to restart',W/2,H/2+70);
}
function drawTitle(){
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a3c';ctx.font='bold 90px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('GRAN TURISMO',W/2,H/2-30);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('MINI EDITION',W/2,H/2+15);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb0c0';ctx.font='18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('W/↑ accelerate   S/↓ brake   A/←  D/→ steer',W/2,H/2+70);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f';ctx.font='bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or tap to start',W/2,H/2+120);
}

// restart on space when over
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key===' '&&mode==='over')startRace();});
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(mode==='over')startRace();});

// ---- loop ----
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000;last=now;
  if(dt>0.05)dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Streets of Rage 2 (mini)</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0a0a12;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{background:#111;image-rendering:pixelated;border:2px solid #333;box-shadow:0 0 30px #000;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="800" height="300"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=800,H=300,GROUND=250;
const keys={};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true; if(e.key==='r')reset();});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});

let player, enemies, particles, cam, score, over;

function reset(){
  player={x:80,y:GROUND,vx:0,vy:0,w:28,h:52,face:1,hp:5,atk:0,cool:0,inv:0,anim:0};
  enemies=[];
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++)spawnEnemy(300+i*140);
  particles=[];cam=0;score=0;over=false;
}
function spawnEnemy(x){enemies.push({x,y:GROUND,vx:0,w:28,h:52,hp:2,atk:0,cool:0,anim:0,face:-1});}
function hit(x,y,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++)particles.push({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*6,vy:-Math.random()*5,life:20});}

function update(){
  if(over)return;
  const p=player;
  // movement
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']){p.vx=-3;p.face=-1;}
  else if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']){p.vx=3;p.face=1;}
  else p.vx*=0.7;
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']||keys[' '])p.vy=-8;
  p.vy+=0.5;
  p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
  if(p.y>GROUND){p.y=GROUND;p.vy=0;}
  if(p.x<10)p.x=10;
  p.cool=Math.max(0,p.cool-1);p.inv=Math.max(0,p.inv-1);
  p.anim+=Math.abs(p.vx)>0.5?0.3:0.05;
  if((keys['j']||keys['z'])&&p.cool===0){p.atk=12;p.cool=25;hit(p.x+p.face*20,p.y-20,6);}

  // enemies
  for(let e of enemies){
    const dx=p.x-e.x;
    if(e.hp>0){
      e.face=dx>0?1:-1;
      if(Math.abs(dx)>50)e.vx=e.face*1.5;else e.vx*=0.5;
      e.x+=e.vx;
      e.cool=Math.max(0,e.cool-1);
      if(Math.abs(dx)<45&&Math.abs(p.y-e.y)<30&&e.cool===0){
        e.atk=10;e.cool=50;
        if(p.inv===0){p.hp--;p.inv=40;hit(p.x,p.y-25,10);
          if(p.hp<=0)over=true;}
      }
    }
    e.anim+=0.2;
    if(e.atk>0){e.atk--;
      if(e.atk===5&&p.inv===0&&Math.abs(p.x-e.x)<45&&Math.abs(p.y-e.y)<30){
        p.hp--;p.inv=40;hit(p.x,p.y-25,10);if(p.hp<=0)over=true;
      }
    }
  }
  // player attack hits enemies
  if(p.atk>0&&p.atk===8){
    for(let e of enemies){
      if(e.hp>0&&Math.abs(p.x-e.x)<55&&Math.abs(p.y-e.y)<30){
        e.hp--;e.vx=p.face*5;hit(e.x,e.y-25,8);
        if(e.hp<=0){score+=100;hit(e.x,e.y-20,15);}
      }
    }
  }
  p.atk=Math.max(0,p.atk-1);
  enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0||true);
  // respawn
  if(enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0).length===0){
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++)spawnEnemy(300+i*140);
    score+=500;
  }

  // camera
  const target=p.x-W/2;
  cam+=(target-cam)*0.1;
  cam=Math.max(0,cam);

  // particles
  for(let pt of particles){pt.x+=pt.vx;pt.y+=pt.vy;pt.vy+=0.4;pt.life--;}
  particles=particles.filter(pt=>pt.life>0);
}

function drawChar(x,y,face,hp,anim,atk,inv){
  const x0=x-14;
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,GROUND+2,18,5,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
  const flash=inv>0&&Math.floor(inv/4)%2===0;
  // legs
  const swing=Math.sin(anim)*6;
  ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#fff':'#223';
  ctx.fillRect(x0+4,GROUND-22,8,22);
  ctx.fillRect(x0+16,GROUND-22,8,22);
  ctx.fillRect(x0+4+swing,GROUND-6,8,6);
  ctx.fillRect(x0+16-swing,GROUND-6,8,6);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#fff':'#c0392b';
  ctx.fillRect(x0+2,GROUND-44,24,24);
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#fff':'#f1c27d';
  ctx.fillRect(x0+7,GROUND-58,14,14);
  // hair
  ctx.fillStyle='#222';ctx.fillRect(x0+7,GROUND-60,14,4);
  // arm / punch
  ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#fff':'#f1c27d';
  if(atk>0){
    const ext=atk>6?20:10;
    ctx.fillRect(face>0?x0+24:x0-4-ext,GROUND-40,ext,8);
  }else{
    ctx.fillRect(x0-2,GROUND-40,6,16);
    ctx.fillRect(x0+26,GROUND-40,6,16);
  }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  // sky
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#1a1a3a');g.addColorStop(1,'#3a2a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const sx=(i*97-cam*0.3)%W;if(sx>0)ctx.fillRect(sx,(i*53)%150,2,2);}
  // moon
  ctx.fillStyle='#f5e6b3';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W-120,60,26,0,7);ctx.fill();
  // buildings (parallax)
  for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
    const bx=((i*120)-cam*0.6)%(W+200)-100;
    const bh=120+(i*37)%80;
    ctx.fillStyle='#151525';
    ctx.fillRect(bx,GROUND-bh,100,bh);
    ctx.fillStyle='#3a3a55';
    for(let wy=0;wy<bh-20;wy+=20)for(let wx=0;wx<80;wx+=20)
      if((i+wx+wy)%3===0)ctx.fillRect(bx+10+wx,GROUND-bh+10+wy,10,10);
  }
  // ground
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a2a3a';ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND,W,H-GROUND);
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a3a4a';
  for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const gx=((i*60)-cam)%W;ctx.fillRect(gx,GROUND,30,4);}

  // enemies
  for(let e of enemies)if(e.hp>0)drawChar(e.x,e.y,e.face,e.hp,e.anim,e.atk,0);
  // player
  drawChar(player.x,player.y,player.face,player.hp,player.anim,player.atk,player.inv);

  // particles
  for(let pt of particles){
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,${100+pt.life*5},0,${pt.life/20})`;
    ctx.fillRect(pt.x-cam,pt.y,4,4);
  }

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('STREETS OF RAGE 2',10,22);
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,10,42);
  ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c';
  ctx.fillText('HP '+player.hp,10,62);
  ctx.fillStyle='#888';ctx.font='12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('A/D move  W/space jump  J/Z punch  R restart',10,H-10);

  if(over){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c';ctx.font='bold 40px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H/2-10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press R to restart',W/2,H/2+25);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
}

reset();
function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<title>SNAKE</title>

    background: #000000;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    width: min(94vw, 94vh);
    height: min(94vw, 94vh);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #000000, 0 0 40px rgba(0,255,0,0.15);

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ====== PALETTE (6 solid colors) ======
  const C = {
    black:   "#000000",
    green:   "#00ff00",
    dark:    "#007700",
    white:   "#ffffff",
    orange:  "#ff8800",
    yellow:  "#ffff00"
  };

  // ====== CONSTANTS ======
  const W = 400, H = 400;
  const CELL = 20;
  const COLS = W / CELL;   // 20
  const ROWS = H / CELL;   // 20
  const BASE_SPEED = 8;    // cells per second (starts slow)
  const MAX_SPEED  = 22;

  // ====== CANVAS ======
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  // ====== STATE ======
  let state = "start";     // start | play | gameover
  let snake = [];
  let dir = { x: 1, y: 0 };
  let pendingDir = { x: 1, y: 0 };
  let food = { x: 10, y: 10 };
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let speed = BASE_SPEED;
  let acc = 0;            // time accumulator for the step timer
  let last = performance.now();

  // ====== INIT ======
  function reset() {
    const cx = Math.floor(COLS / 2);
    const cy = Math.floor(ROWS / 2);
    snake = [
      { x: cx - 2, y: cy },
      { x: cx - 1, y: cy },
      { x: cx,     y: cy }
    ];
    dir = { x: 1, y: 0 };
    pendingDir = { x: 1, y: 0 };
    score = 0;
    speed = BASE_SPEED;
    acc = 0;
    placeFood();
  }

  function placeFood() {
    while (true) {
      const x = (Math.random() * COLS) | 0;
      const y = (Math.random() * ROWS) | 0;
      let ok = true;
      for (let i = 0; i < snake.length; i++) {
        if (snake[i].x === x && snake[i].y === y) { ok = false; break; }
      }
      if (ok) { food.x = x; food.y = y; return; }
    }
  }

  // ====== INPUT ======
  function setDir(x, y) {
    // ignore 180-degree reversal
    if (x === -dir.x && y === -dir.y) return;
    pendingDir.x = x;
    pendingDir.y = y;
  }

  function handleKey(e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (state === "play") {
      if (k === "arrowup" || k === "w")    setDir(0, -1);
      else if (k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") setDir(0, 1);
      else if (k === "arrowleft" || k === "a") setDir(-1, 0);
      else if (k === "arrowright" || k === "d") setDir(1, 0);
    } else if (state === "start" || state === "gameover") {
      if (k === "enter" || k === " ") { reset(); state = "play"; }
    }
    // prevent page scroll on arrows/space
    if (["arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"," "].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKey);

  // touch: swipe to steer, tap to start
  let tx = null, ty = null;
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function(e){
    const t = e.touches[0];
    tx = t.clientX; ty = t.clientY;
    if (state !== "play") { reset(); state = "play"; }
  }, {passive:true});
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend", function(e){
    if (tx === null) return;
    const t = e.changedTouches[0];
    const dx = t.clientX - tx, dy = t.clientY - ty;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 20 || Math.abs(dy) > 20) {
      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) setDir(dx > 0 ? 1 : -1, 0);
      else setDir(0, dy > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }
    tx = null; ty = null;
  }, {passive:true});

  // ====== UPDATE ======
  function step() {
    dir.x = pendingDir.x; dir.y = pendingDir.y;
    const head = snake[snake.length - 1];
    const nx = head.x + dir.x;
    const ny = head.y + dir.y;

    // wall collision
    if (nx < 0 || nx >= COLS || ny < 0 || ny >= ROWS) {
      state = "gameover";
      best = Math.max(best, score);
      return;
    }
    // self collision (check against body; tail will move unless eating)
    for (let i = 0; i < snake.length; i++) {
      if (snake[i].x === nx && snake[i].y === ny) {
        state = "gameover";
        best = Math.max(best, score);
        return;
      }
    }

    snake.push({ x: nx, y: ny });

    if (nx === food.x && ny === food.y) {
      score += 10;
      speed = Math.min(MAX_SPEED, speed + 0.6);
      placeFood();
    } else {
      snake.shift();
    }
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    acc += dt;
    const interval = 1 / speed;
    let guard = 0;
    while (acc >= interval && guard < 8) {
      step();
      acc -= interval;
      guard++;
      if (state !== "play") { acc = 0; break; }
    }
  }

  // ====== DRAW HELPERS (chunky pixel style via fillRect) ======
  function px(x, y, w, h, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  }

  // checkerboard play field
  function drawField() {
    for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
        const dark = ((x + y) % 2) === 0;
        px(x * CELL, y * CELL, CELL, CELL, dark ? C.dark : C.green);
      }
    }
  }

  // apple / food
  function drawFood() {
    const x = food.x * CELL, y = food.y * CELL;
    px(x + 3,  y + 6,  CELL - 6, CELL - 8, C.orange);   // body
    px(x + 5,  y + 8,  4,       3,       C.yellow);       // highlight
    px(x + 9,  y + 2,  3,       4,       C.green);        // leaf
    px(x + 10, y + 4,  2,       3,       C.dark);         // stem

  // snake body
  function drawSnake() {
    for (let i = 0; i < snake.length; i++) {
      const s = snake[i];
      const x = s.x * CELL, y = s.y * CELL;
      const isHead = (i === snake.length - 1);

      px(x + 2, y + 2, CELL - 4, CELL - 4, isHead ? C.green : C.dark);

    const c = off.getContext("2d");
    c.font = "bold " + size + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
    c.textBaseline = "middle";
    c.textAlign = "center";
    const cx = off.width / 2, cy = off.height / 2;
    if (outline) {
      c.fillStyle = outline;
      for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++)
        for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++)
          if (dx || dy) c.fillText(text, cx + dx, cy + dy);
    }
    c.fillStyle = color;
    c.fillText(text, cx, cy);
    return off;
  }

  function blitText(img, x, y) {
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    ctx.drawImage(img, x, y);
  }

  // pre-rendered text sprites
  const titleImg   = makeText("SNAKE", 56, C.green, C.black);
  const scoreImg   = makeText("SCORE", 14, C.white, C.black);
  const bestImg    = makeText("BEST", 14, C.yellow, C.black);
  const startImg   = makeText("PRESS ENTER TO START", 16, C.white, C.black);
  const overImg    = makeText("GAME OVER", 40, C.orange, C.black);
  const winImg     = makeText("YOU WIN!", 40, C.yellow, C.black);

  // ====== DRAW ======
  function draw() {
    // background
    px(0, 0, W, H, C.black);

    if (state === "start") {
      drawField();
      // banner
      px(0, 0, W, 64, C.black);
      blitText(titleImg, (W - titleImg.width) / 2, 12);
      blitText(startImg, (W - startImg.width) / 2, 320);
      return;
    }

    drawField();
    drawFood();
    drawSnake();

    // HUD
    px(0, 0, W, 26, C.black);
    blitText(scoreImg, 8, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
    ctx.font = "bold 14px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(String(score).padStart(4, "0"), 70, 13);
    blitText(bestImg, W - 90, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.yellow;
    ctx.fillText(String(best).padStart(4, "0"), W - 30, 13);

    if (state === "gameover") {
      // dim overlay
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      const msg = (score >= 200) ? winImg : overImg;
      blitText(msg, (W - msg.width) / 2, 150);
      ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
      ctx.font = "bold 16px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("SCORE " + score, W / 2, 210);
      ctx.fillStyle = C.yellow;
      ctx.fillText("BEST  " + best, W / 2, 232);
      ctx.fillStyle = C.green;
      ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO RETRY", W / 2, 270);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
    }
  }

  // ====== MAIN LOOP ======
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  reset();
  state = "start";
  requestAnimationFrame(function(t){ last = t; requestAnimationFrame(loop); });
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, user-scalable=no">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: monospace;
  }
  canvas {
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    background: #000;
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

// =====================================================================
//  SETUP
// =====================================================================
var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

var W = 256, H = 224;            // logical (chunky) resolution
var DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
var SCALE = 4;                    // chunk size
canvas.width  = W * SCALE;
canvas.height = H * SCALE;
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

function fit(){
  var pad = 16;
  var maxW = window.innerWidth  - pad;
  var maxH = window.innerHeight - pad;
  var s = Math.min(maxW / W, maxH / H);
  if (s < 0.5) s = 0.5;
  canvas.style.width  = Math.floor(W * s) + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = Math.floor(H * s) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', fit);

// =====================================================================
//  COLORS  (six solid 8-bit colors)
// =====================================================================
var C = {
  bg:      '#000000',   // black
  frame:   '#333333',   // dark grey
  paddle:  '#00ff00',   // green
  ball:    '#ffffff',    // white
  block:   '#00ffff',    // cyan
  accent:  '#ff8800'     // orange
};

// =====================================================================
//  STATE
// =====================================================================
var state = 'start';            // start | play | win | lose
var score = 0;
var lives = 3;
var blocks = [];
var paddle = { x: W/2 - 20, y: H - 20, w: 40, h: 6, speed: 220 };
var ball   = { x: W/2, y: H/2, r: 3, vx: 0, vy: 0, stuck: true };
var keys = { left:false, right:false };
var pointerX = null;
var last = 0;

var BLOCK_W = 22, BLOCK_H = 10, GAP = 4;
var ROWS = 5, COLS = 9;
var gridX = Math.floor((W - COLS*(BLOCK_W+GAP) + GAP) / 2);
var gridY = 30;

function initBlocks(){
  blocks = [];
  for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++){
    for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++){
      blocks.push({
        x: gridX + c*(BLOCK_W+GAP),
        y: gridY + r*(BLOCK_H+GAP),
        w: BLOCK_W, h: BLOCK_H,
        alive: true,
        color: [C.block, C.paddle, C.accent, C.block, C.paddle][r]
      });
    }
  }
}

function resetBall(){
  ball.stuck = true;
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w/2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
}

function newGame(){
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  paddle.x = W/2 - paddle.w/2;
  initBlocks();
  resetBall();
  state = 'play';
}

// =====================================================================
//  INPUT  (addEventListener)
// =====================================================================
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a')  keys.left  = true;
  if (k === 'arrowright'|| k === 'd')  keys.right = true;
  if (state === 'start' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { newGame(); }
  if ((state === 'win' || state === 'lose') && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { newGame(); }
  if (state === 'play' && ball.stuck && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) {
    launch();
  }
  if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'arrowright' || k === ' ') e.preventDefault();
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
  var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a')  keys.left  = false;
  if (k === 'arrowright'|| k === 'd')  keys.right = false;
});

function pointerToGame(clientX){
  var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * W;
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
  pointerX = pointerToGame(e.clientX);
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
  if (e.touches.length){
    pointerX = pointerToGame(e.touches[0].clientX);
    e.preventDefault();
  }
}, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  pointerX = pointerToGame(e.clientX);
  if (state === 'start') { newGame(); }
  else if (state === 'play' && ball.stuck) { launch(); }
  else if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') { newGame(); }
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
  if (e.touches.length){
    pointerX = pointerToGame(e.touches[0].clientX);
    if (state === 'start') { newGame(); }
    else if (state === 'play' && ball.stuck) { launch(); }
    else if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') { newGame(); }
  }
  e.preventDefault();
}, {passive:false});

function launch(){
  ball.stuck = false;
  var speed = 150;
  var angle = (Math.random()*0.6 - 0.3);  // -0.3 .. 0.3 rad
  ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
  ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
}

// =====================================================================
//  UPDATE
// =====================================================================
function movePaddle(dt){
  if (keys.left)  paddle.x -= paddle.speed * dt;
  if (keys.right) paddle.x += paddle.speed * dt;
  if (pointerX !== null){
    paddle.x = pointerX - paddle.w/2;
  }
  paddle.x = Math.max(4, Math.min(W - 4 - paddle.w, paddle.x));
}

function updateBall(dt){
  if (ball.stuck){
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w/2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
    return;
  }

  ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
  ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

  // walls
  if (ball.x < ball.r){ ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x > W - ball.r){ ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y < ball.r){ ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y &&
      ball.y + ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h + 4 &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - ball.r &&
      ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + ball.r){
    var rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w/2)) / (paddle.w/2);
    rel = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, rel));
    var speed = Math.sqrt(ball.vx*ball.vx + ball.vy*ball.vy);
    var maxAngle = 0.9;
    ball.vx = Math.sin(rel * maxAngle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(rel * maxAngle) * speed;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  }

  // blocks
  for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++){
    var b = blocks[i];
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    if (ball.x + ball.r < b.x || ball.x - ball.r > b.x + b.w ||
        ball.y + ball.r < b.y || ball.y - ball.r > b.y + b.h){
      continue;
    }
    // find penetration
    var cx = b.x + b.w/2, cy = b.y + b.h/2;
    var dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    var overlapX = (b.w/2 + ball.r) - Math.abs(dx);
    var overlapY = (b.h/2 + ball.r) - Math.abs(dy);
    if (overlapX < overlapY){
      ball.vx = dx > 0 ? Math.abs(ball.vx) : -Math.abs(ball.vx);
      ball.x += (dx > 0 ? overlapX : -overlapX);
    } else {
      ball.vy = dy > 0 ? Math.abs(ball.vy) : -Math.abs(ball.vy);
      ball.y += (dy > 0 ? overlapY : -overlapY);
    }
    b.alive = false;
    score += 10;
    break;
  }

  // fell below
  if (ball.y - ball.r > H){
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0){
      state = 'lose';
    } else {
      resetBall();
    }
  }

  // win?
  for (var j = 0; j < blocks.length; j++){
    if (blocks[j].alive) return;
  }
  state = 'win';
}

function update(dt){
  if (state === 'play'){
    movePaddle(dt);
    updateBall(dt);
  }
}

// =====================================================================
//  DRAW  (chunky pixel style, fillRect)
// =====================================================================
function drawFrame(){
  ctx.fillStyle = C.frame;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 2);
  ctx.fillRect(0, H-2, W, 2);
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 2, H);
  ctx.fillRect(W-2, 0, 2, H);
}

function drawBlocks(){
  for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++){
    var b = blocks[i];
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    // 8-bit highlight / shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 2, b.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y + b.h - 2, b.w, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + b.w - 2, b.y, 2, b.h);
  }
}

function drawPaddle(){
  ctx.fillStyle = C.paddle;
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, 1);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y + paddle.h - 1, paddle.w, 1);
}

function drawBall(){
  ctx.fillStyle = C.ball;
  ctx.fillRect(Math.round(ball.x - ball.r), Math.round(ball.y - ball.r),
               ball.r*2, ball.r*2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(Math.round(ball.x - ball.r + 1), Math.round(ball.y - ball.r + 1), 1, 1);
}

function drawText(text, x, y, color, size){
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + (size || 10) + 'px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
}

function drawCenterText(text, y, color, size){
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + (size || 10) + 'px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText(text, W/2, y);
}

function drawHUD(){
  drawText('SCORE ' + score, 8, 8, C.accent, 9);
  drawText('LIVES ' + lives, W - 50, 8, C.paddle, 9);
}

function drawScene(){
  ctx.fillStyle = C.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawFrame();
  drawBlocks();
  drawPaddle();
  drawBall();
  drawHUD();
}

function drawStart(){
  drawScene();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawCenterText('BREAKOUT', H/2 - 34, C.accent, 20);
  drawCenterText('8-BIT', H/2 - 18, C.block, 10);
  drawCenterText('ARROWS / A D  -  MOVE', H/2 + 4, C.paddle, 9);
  drawCenterText('SPACE / CLICK  -  LAUNCH', H/2 + 16, C.paddle, 9);
  drawCenterText('PRESS ENTER TO START', H/2 + 34, C.ball, 10);
}

function drawEnd(won){
  drawScene();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawCenterText(won ? 'YOU WIN!' : 'GAME OVER', H/2 - 20, won ? C.paddle : C.accent, 18);
  drawCenterText('SCORE ' + score, H/2 + 2, C.ball, 12);
  drawCenterText('PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN', H/2 + 22, C.block, 9);
}

function draw(){
  if (state === 'start')       drawStart();
  else if (state === 'play')   drawScene();
  else if (state === 'win')    drawEnd(true);
  else if (state === 'lose')   drawEnd(false);
}

// =====================================================================
//  LOOP  (requestAnimationFrame)
// =====================================================================
function loop(t){
  if (!last) last = t;
  var dt = (t - last) / 1000;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  last = t;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// =====================================================================
//  BOOT
// =====================================================================
fit();
initBlocks();
resetBall();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>AMIDAR</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #000000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    background: #000000;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 24px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.25);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="320" height="352"></canvas>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   AMIDAR — a single playable scene
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- 1. CONSTANTS & PIXEL HELPERS ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

const W = canvas.width;   // 320
const H = canvas.height;  // 352
const GRID = 16;          // 20 x 22 grid
const COLS = W / GRID;
const ROWS = H / GRID;
const HEADROOM = 2;       // rows above the playfield for the player

const COLORS = {
  bg:   '#000000',
  bar:  '#00c8ff',   // cyan  — the bars
  node: '#ff2020',   // red   — the nodes
  player:'#00ff00',   // green — the man
  enemy:  '#ff8000',  // orange— the demons
  text:   '#ffffff',
  accent: '#00c8ff',
  danger: '#ff2020'
};

// Draw a solid pixel block at grid (col,row)
function px(c, r, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(c * GRID, r * GRID, GRID, GRID);
}
// Draw a solid pixel block at raw pixels (x,y)
function pxRaw(x, y, w, h, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
}

/* ---------- 2. STATE ---------- */
let state = 'title';       // 'title' | 'play' | 'dead' | 'gameover'
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let enemies = [];
let spawnTimer = 0;
let deathTimer = 0;
let flash = 0;

const player = {
  x: 15, y: 21,           // grid position (center bottom)
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  moving: false
};

/* ---------- 3. INPUT ---------- */
const keys = { left:false, right:false, up:false, down:false };

function handleKey(e, down) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();

  if (down && state === 'title' && (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ')) {
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (down && state === 'gameover' && (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ')) {
    state = 'title';
    return;
  }

  if (k === 'ArrowLeft'  || k === 'a' || k === 'A') keys.left  = down;
  if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'd' || k === 'D') keys.right = down;
  if (k === 'ArrowUp'    || k === 'w' || k === 'W') keys.up    = down;
  if (k === 'ArrowDown'  || k === 's' || k === 'S') keys.down  = down;
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => handleKey(e, true));
document.addEventListener('keyup',   e => handleKey(e, false));

function startGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = 3;
  resetLevel();
  state = 'play';
}

function resetLevel() {
  player.x = 15; player.y = 21;
  player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
  enemies = [];
  spawnTimer = 45;
}

/* ---------- 4. ENEMIES ---------- */
function spawnEnemy() {
  // pick a random node
  const r = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
  const c = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 18);
  const e = {
    x: c, y: r,
    dir: 0,
    type: 'walker',
    speed: 1.6,
    timer: 0,
    life: 0
  };
  // 1 in 4 is a chaser
  if (Math.random() < 0.25) {
    e.type = 'chaser';
    e.speed = 1.2;
  }
  enemies.push(e);
}

/* ---------- 5. UPDATE ---------- */
function update() {
  if (state !== 'play') return;

  /* --- player movement --- */
  player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
  if (keys.left)  player.vx = -1;
  if (keys.right) player.vx =  1;
  if (keys.up)    player.vy = -1;
  if (keys.down)  player.vy =  1;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;
  player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(COLS - 1, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(ROWS - 1, player.y));

  /* --- collect nodes --- */
  if (isNode(player.x, player.y)) {
    collectNode(player.x, player.y);
  }

  /* --- spawn enemies --- */
  spawnTimer--;
  if (spawnTimer <= 0 && enemies.length < 8) {
    spawnEnemy();
    spawnTimer = 120 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 60);
  }

  /* --- update enemies --- */
  for (const e of enemies) {
    e.life++;
    if (e.type === 'walker') {
      e.timer++;
      if (e.timer >= 30) {
        e.timer = 0;
        // pick a random direction along a bar
        const dirs = getBarDirections(e.x, e.y);
        if (dirs.length) {
          const d = dirs[Math.floor(Math.random() * dirs.length)];
          e.dir = d;
        }
      }
      if (e.dir) {
        const dx = e.dir.x, dy = e.dir.y;
        const nx = e.x + dx, ny = e.y + dy;
        // keep on the bar
        if (onBar(nx, ny)) {
          e.x = nx; e.y = ny;
        } else {
          e.dir = 0;
        }
      }
    } else {
      // chaser: move toward player, one step per frame
      const dx = Math.sign(player.x - e.x);
      const dy = Math.sign(player.y - e.y);
      // prefer the axis with larger distance
      if (Math.abs(player.x - e.x) > Math.abs(player.y - e.y)) {
        if (dx) { e.x += dx; }
      } else {
        if (dy) { e.y += dy; }
      }
      e.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(COLS - 1, e.x));
      e.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(ROWS - 1, e.y));
    }

    /* --- collision with player --- */
    if (Math.abs(e.x - player.x) < 1 && Math.abs(e.y - player.y) < 1) {
      killPlayer();
      return;
    }
  }
}

function killPlayer() {
  lives--;
  state = 'dead';
  deathTimer = 60;
  flash = 1;
}

/* ---------- 6. NODE / BAR HELPERS ---------- */
// A node exists at (x,y) if it sits on a bar and is not at a bar endpoint
function isNode(x, y) {
  if (!onBar(x, y)) return false;
  // count how many bar neighbours (up/down/left/right) exist
  let n = 0;
  if (onBar(x, y - 1)) n++;
  if (onBar(x, y + 1)) n++;
  if (onBar(x - 1, y)) n++;
  if (onBar(x + 1, y)) n++;
  return n >= 2;   // a node needs at least two neighbours
}

function onBar(x, y) {
  if (x < 0 || x >= COLS || y < 0 || y >= ROWS) return false;
  // horizontal bar: y is even and 1 <= x <= 18
  if (y % 2 === 0 && x >= 1 && x <= 18) return true;
  // vertical bar: x is even and 1 <= y <= 20
  if (x % 2 === 0 && y >= 1 && y <= 20) return true;
  return false;
}

function getBarDirections(x, y) {
  const dirs = [];
  if (onBar(x, y - 1)) dirs.push({x:0, y:-1});
  if (onBar(x, y + 1)) dirs.push({x:0, y:1});
  if (onBar(x - 1, y)) dirs.push({x:-1, y:0});
  if (onBar(x + 1, y)) dirs.push({x:1, y:0});
  return dirs;
}

function collectNode(x, y) {
  // remove this node by temporarily marking it collected
  collectedNodes.add(x + ',' + y);
  score += 100;
}

const collectedNodes = new Set();

/* ---------- 7. DRAW ---------- */
function draw() {
  // background
  pxRaw(0, 0, W, H, COLORS.bg);

  // bars
  for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
      if (onBar(x, y)) {
        px(x, y, COLORS.bar);
      }
    }
  }

  // nodes
  for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
      if (isNode(x, y) && !collectedNodes.has(x + ',' + y)) {
        px(x, y, COLORS.node);
      }
    }
  }

  // enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    drawEnemy(e);
  }

  // player
  if (state === 'play' || state === 'title') {
    drawPlayer(player.x, player.y);
  }

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // overlays
  if (state === 'title')    drawTitle();
  if (state === 'dead')     drawDead();
  if (state === 'gameover') drawGameOver();

  // flash on death
  if (flash > 0) {
    pxRaw(0, 0, W, H, 'rgba(255,0,0,' + (flash * 0.4) + ')');
    flash -= 0.05;
  }
}

function drawPlayer(x, y) {
  // green man: a simple pixel figure
  const bx = x * GRID, by = y * GRID;
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.player;
  // head
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 5, by + 2, 6, 4);
  // body
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 4, by + 6, 8, 5);
  // legs
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 4, by + 11, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 9, by + 11, 3, 3);
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const bx = e.x * GRID, by = e.y * GRID;
  const color = e.type === 'chaser' ? COLORS.danger : COLORS.enemy;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  // body
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, by + 4, 12, 8);
  // head
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 4, by + 2, 8, 3);
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 5, by + 6, 2, 2);
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 9, by + 6, 2, 2);
  // feet
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 3, by + 12, 3, 2);
  ctx.fillRect(bx + 10, by + 12, 3, 2);
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = '10px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + String(score).padStart(5, '0'), 4, 12);
  // lives
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES ' + lives, W - 4, 12);
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('AMIDAR', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = '11px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Collect all the red nodes.', W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.fillText('Avoid the orange demons.', W / 2, H / 2 + 28);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.node;
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 55);
}

function drawDead() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.danger;
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('OOPS!', W / 2, H / 2);
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.danger;
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 15);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Final score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER FOR TITLE', W / 2, H / 2 + 35);
}

/* ---------- 8. MAIN LOOP ---------- */
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();

  // handle death -> gameover transition
  if (state === 'dead') {
    deathTimer--;
    if (deathTimer <= 0) {
      if (lives <= 0) {
        state = 'gameover';
      } else {
        resetLevel();
        state = 'play';
      }
    }
  }

  // win condition: all nodes collected
  if (state === 'play') {
    let remaining = 0;
    for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
        if (isNode(x, y) && !collectedNodes.has(x + ',' + y)) remaining++;
      }
    }
    if (remaining === 0) {
      // bonus for clearing
      score += 1000;
      collectedNodes.clear();
      resetLevel();
      // small pause via state
      state = 'play';
    }
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
