<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bomberman</title>
<style>
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  html,body { height:100%; }
  body {
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #14324a 0%, #0a1420 70%, #060c14 100%);
    font-family:monospace;
  }
  #game {
    image-rendering:pixelated;
    image-rendering:crisp-edges;
    border:6px solid #2b5a86;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #0c1c2e, 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6), inset 0 0 0 2px #0c1c2e;
    background:#000;
    max-width:96vw; max-height:92vh;
    border-radius:4px;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="640" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ============================ CONSTANTS ============================ */
const COLS=15, ROWS=13, CELL=40;
const W=COLS*CELL, H=ROWS*CELL;
const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;

const C={
  bg:'#2a5fb0',
  brick:'#d87a2a',
  brickDark:'#9c4f14',
  brickLight:'#f0a45a',
  bomb:'#1c1c24',
  bombHi:'#54546a',
  flame:'#ff7a1a',
  flameCore:'#ffd23a',
  flameEdge:'#e8481a',
  skin:'#ffcf9e',
  hair:'#3a2a1a',
  suit:'#e8e8f0',
  suitShade:'#b4b4c8',
  eye:'#1c1c24',
  text:'#ffffff',
  textSh:'#0a1420',
  panel:'#0e2540',
  green:'#3fae5a',
  red:'#e84848',
  yellow:'#ffd23a',
  blue:'#3a7ae0',
  gray:'#9aa0b0'
};

const DIR={ up:[0,-1], down:[0,1], left:[-1,0], right:[1,0] };

/* ============================ STATE ============================ */
let state='title';           // title | playing | gameover | win
let grid=[];                 // 0=empty, 1=brick, 2=wall
let player={ x:1, y:1, px:1*CELL, py:1*CELL, dir:'down', moving:false };
let bombs=[];
let flames=[];              // {x,y,w,h,life}
let particles=[];
let score=0, lives=3, level=1, time=0;
let shake=0;
let flash=0;

function newGrid(){
  grid=[];
  for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++){
    let row=[];
    for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){
      if(x%2===0 || y%2===0) row.push(2);          // wall
      else if(x===1&&y===1) row.push(0);            // safe spawn
      else row.push(1);                              // brick
    }
    grid.push(row);
  }
}

function reset(){
  newGrid();
  player={ x:1, y:1, px:1*CELL, py:1*CELL, dir:'down', moving:false };
  bombs=[]; flames=[]; particles=[];
  score=0; lives=3; level=1; time=0; shake=0; flash=0;
}

function startGame(){ reset(); state='playing'; }

function nextLevel(){
  level++;
  newGrid();
  player={ x:1, y:1, px:1*CELL, py:1*CELL, dir:'down', moving:false };
  bombs=[]; flames=[];
  shake=0; flash=0;
}

/* ============================ INPUT ============================ */
const keys={};
let pressed=new Set();

function keyName(k){
  switch(k){
    case 'ArrowUp': case 'w': case 'W': return 'up';
    case 'ArrowDown': case 's': case 'S': return 'down';
    case 'ArrowLeft': case 'a': case 'A': return 'left';
    case 'ArrowRight': case 'd': case 'D': return 'right';
    case ' ': case 'Enter': case 'x': case 'X': return 'bomb';
    case 'r': case 'R': return 'restart';
    default: return null;
  }
}

window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const n=keyName(e.key);
  if(!n) return;
  if(!keys[n]) pressed.add(n);
  keys[n]=true;
  if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight',' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{
  const n=keyName(e.key);
  if(n) keys[n]=false;
});
canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(state==='title'||state==='gameover') startGame();
});

/* ============================ HELPERS ============================ */
function cellAt(x,y){
  if(x<0||y<0||x>=COLS||y>=ROWS) return 2;
  return grid[y][x];
}
function inBounds(x,y){ return x>=0&&y>=0&&x<COLS&&y<ROWS; }
function blocked(x,y){
  const c=cellAt(x,y);
  if(c!==0) return true;
  for(const b of bombs) if(b.x===x&&b.y===y) return true;
  return false;
}
function bombAt(x,y){
  for(const b of bombs) if(b.x===x&&b.y===y) return true;
  return false;
}
function rand(a,b){ return a+Math.random()*(b-a); }
function randInt(a,b){ return Math.floor(rand(a,b+1)); }

function addFlames(cx,cy,len){
  // center cell
  flames.push({x:cx,y:cy,w:CELL,h:CELL,life:1});
  const dirs=[['up',0,-1],['down',0,1],['left',-1,0],['right',1,0]];
  for(const [name,dx,dy] of dirs){
    for(let i=1;i<=len;i++){
      const nx=cx+dx*i, ny=cy+dy*i;
      if(!inBounds(nx,ny)) break;
      const c=cellAt(nx,ny);
      if(c===2) break;               // wall stops
      if(c===1){
        addFlames(nx,ny,1);          // brick explodes: emit 1 in each direction
        break;
      }
      flames.push({x:nx,y:ny,w:CELL,h:CELL,life:1});
    }
  }
}

function explode(b){
  addFlames(b.x,b.y,3);
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const a=rand(0,Math.PI*2), sp=rand(1,4);
    particles.push({
      x:(b.x+0.5)*CELL, y:(b.y+0.5)*CELL,
      vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,
      life:rand(20,40), size:rand(2,5),
      color: Math.random()<0.5?C.flame:C.flameCore
    });
  }
  shake=Math.max(shake,10);
  flash=6;
}

/* ============================ UPDATE ============================ */
function updatePlayer(dt){
  let dx=0, dy=0;
  if(keys['up'])    dy=-1;
  else if(keys['down']) dy=1;
  else if(keys['left']) dx=-1;
  else if(keys['right']) dx=1;
  player.moving=(dx!==0||dy!==0);
  if(dx<0) player.dir='left';
  else if(dx>0) player.dir='right';
  else if(dy<0) player.dir='up';
  else if(dy>1) {}
  if(dy<0) player.dir='up';
  if(dy>0) player.dir='down';

  const speed=3.4;
  const step=speed*dt;
  let nx=player.x, ny=player.y;
  if(dx!==0) nx+=dx;
  if(dy!==0) ny+=dy;
  if(!blocked(nx,ny)){
    player.x=nx; player.y=ny;
  }
  // smooth pixel position
  player.px += ((player.x*CELL)-player.px)*Math.min(1,0.45);
  player.py += ((player.y*CELL)-player.py)*Math.min(1,0.45);

  if(pressed.has('bomb')){
    if(!bombAt(player.x,player.y) && cellAt(player.x,player.y)===0){
      bombs.push({x:player.x,y:player.y,timer:110,fuse:110});
    }
  }
}

function updateBombs(dt){
  for(let i=bombs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=bombs[i];
    b.timer-=dt;
    if(b.timer<=0){
      bombs.splice(i,1);
      explode(b);
    }
  }
}

function updateFlames(dt){
  for(let i=flames.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    flames[i].life-=dt*0.05;
    if(flames[i].life<=0) flames.splice(i,1);
  }
  // check player death
  for(const f of flames){
    if(f.x===player.x && f.y===player.y){
      die();
      break;
    }
  }
}

function die(){
  lives--;
  shake=16; flash=10;
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    const a=rand(0,Math.PI*2), sp=rand(1,5);
    particles.push({
      x:player.px+CELL/2, y:player.py+CELL/2,
      vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,
      life:rand(20,45), size:rand(2,5), color:Math.random()<0.5?C.red:C.flame
    });
  }
  if(lives<=0){
    state='gameover';
  } else {
    player={ x:1,y:1,px:1*CELL,py:1*CELL,dir:'down',moving:false };
    bombs=[]; flames=[];
  }
}

function updateParticles(dt){
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy;
    p.vy+=0.08;
    p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function update(dt){
  if(state!=='playing') return;
  time+=dt;
  updatePlayer(dt);
  updateBombs(dt);
  updateFlames(dt);
  updateParticles(dt);
  if(shake>0) shake-=dt*0.6;
  if(flash>0) flash-=dt*0.4;
}

/* ============================ DRAW ============================ */
function px(x,y,w,h,color){
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(x),Math.floor(y),w,h);
}

function drawBackground(){
  // sky / floor
  px(0,0,W,H,C.bg);
  // subtle checker shading on empty floor cells
  for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){
      if(cellAt(x,y)===0){
        if((x+y)%2===0){
          ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
          ctx.fillRect(x*CELL,y*CELL,CELL,CELL);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawWall(x,y){
  const X=x*CELL, Y=y*CELL;
  // base
  px(X,Y,CELL,CELL,'#8a5a2a');
  // top highlight
  px(X,Y,CELL,4,'#c89058');
  // brick pattern
  const bh=CELL/4;
  for(let r=0;r<4;r++){
    const yy=Y+r*bh;
    px(X,yy,CELL,2,'#6a4218');
    // vertical mortar offset
    const off=(r%2===0)?0:CELL/2;
    for(let c=0;c<2;c++){
      const xx=X+off+c*(CELL/2);
      if(xx>=X && xx< X+CELL) px(xx,yy,2,bh,'#6a4218');
    }
  }
  // inner bevel
  px(X+2,Y+2,CELL-4,CELL-4,'rgba(0,0,0,0.10)');
}

function drawBrick(x,y){
  const X=x*CELL, Y=y*CELL;
  px(X,Y,CELL,CELL,C.brick);
  px(X,Y,CELL,5,C.brickLight);
  px(X,Y+CELL-5,CELL,5,C.brickDark);
  // brick lines
  const bh=CELL/4;
  for(let r=0;r<4;r++){
    const yy=Y+r*bh;
    px(X,yy,CELL,2,C.brickDark);
    const off=(r%2===0)?CELL/4:CELL/2;
    for(let c=0;c<2;c++){
      const xx=X+off+c*(CELL/2);
      if(xx>=X&&xx<X+CELL) px(xx,yy,2,bh,C.brickDark);
    }
  }
  // top light edge
  px(X+3,Y+3,CELL-6,2,C.brickLight);
}

function drawBomb(x,y,b){
  const cx=x*CELL+CELL/2, cy=y*CELL+CELL/2;
  const r=CELL*0.40;
  const pulse=1+0.05*Math.sin(b.fuse*0.3);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.30)';
  ctx.fillRect(x*CELL+6,y*CELL+CELL-12,CELL-12,6);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle=C.bomb;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r*pulse,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // highlight
  ctx.fillStyle=C.bombHi;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx-r*0.35,cy-r*0.35,r*0.35,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // top cap
  px(cx-4,cy-r-6,8,8,'#6a6a80');
  px(cx-2,cy-r-9,4,4,'#8a8aa0');
  // fuse spark
  const sp=Math.floor((b.fuse%20)/4);
  ctx.fillStyle= sp===0?C.flameCore: sp===1?C.flame : C.yellow;
  ctx.fillRect(cx+3,cy-r-12,4,4);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.flameCore;
  ctx.fillRect(cx+4,cy-r-10,2,2);
}

function drawFlame(f){
  const X=f.x*CELL, Y=f.y*CELL;
  const a=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f.life));
  ctx.globalAlpha=a;
  px(X,Y,CELL,CELL,C.flame);
  px(X+6,Y+6,CELL-12,CELL-12,C.flameCore);
  px(X+12,Y+12,CELL-24,CELL-24,C.yellow);
  // flicker
  if(Math.random()<0.4){
    ctx.fillStyle=C.flameEdge;
    ctx.fillRect(X+randInt(4,CELL-10),Y+randInt(4,CELL-10),4,4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const X=Math.floor(player.px), Y=Math.floor(player.py);
  const bob = player.moving ? Math.floor(Math.sin(time*0.5)*2) : 0;
  const cx=X+CELL/2, cy=Y+CELL/2;
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.30)';
  ctx.fillRect(X+8,Y+CELL-10,CELL-16,5);
  const oy=bob;
  // body (suit)
  px(cx-12, Y+14+oy, 24, 16, C.suit);
  px(cx-12, Y+22+oy, 24, 8, C.suitShade);
  // legs
  px(cx-9, Y+30+oy, 6, 6, C.suitShade);
  px(cx+3, Y+30+oy, 6, 6, C.suitShade);
  // head
  px(cx-11, Y+4+oy, 22, 16, C.skin);
  // hair
  px(cx-11, Y+2+oy, 22, 5, C.hair);
  px(cx-13, Y+4+oy, 3, 8, C.hair);
  px(cx+10, Y+4+oy, 3, 8, C.hair);
  // eyes
  if(player.dir==='up'){
    // back of head
    px(cx-11, Y+4+oy, 22, 16, C.hair);
  } else {
    const ex=player.dir==='left'?-1: player.dir==='right'?1:0;
    px(cx-6+ex, Y+10+oy, 3, 4, C.eye);
    px(cx+3+ex, Y+10+oy, 3, 4, C.eye);
    // mouth
    px(cx-3, Y+15+oy, 6, 2, '#d08a5a');
  }
  // arms
  px(cx-15, Y+16+oy, 4, 10, C.suit);
  px(cx+11, Y+16+oy, 4, 10, C.suit);
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/40);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x),Math.floor(p.y),p.size,p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawHUD(){
  // top bar
  ctx.fillStyle=C.panel;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,30);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,2);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.text;
  ctx.font='bold 16px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+String(score).padStart(4,'0'), 14, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.yellow;
  ctx.fillText('LEVEL '+level, 170, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.red;
  ctx.fillText('TIME '+Math.floor(time), 290, 16);
  // lives
  ctx.fillStyle=C.text;
  ctx.fillText('LIVES', 400, 16);
  for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){
    const lx=470+i*24, ly=10;
    ctx.fillStyle=C.skin;
    ctx.fillRect(lx,ly,12,12);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.hair;
    ctx.fillRect(lx,ly-3,12,4);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.eye;
    ctx.fillRect(lx+3,ly+4,2,3); ctx.fillRect(lx+8,ly+4,2,3);
  }
}

function drawTitle(){
  // animated background scene
  drawBackground();
  for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++) for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){
    const c=cellAt(x,y);
    if(c===2) drawWall(x,y); else if(c===1) drawBrick(x,y);
  }
  // decorative bombs
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const bx=(3+i*3), by=(4+(i%2)*3);
    drawBomb(bx,by,{fuse:time*2+i, timer:0});
  }
  // title
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.font='bold 52px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle=C.flameEdge; ctx.fillText('BOMBERMAN', W/2+3, 150+3);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.flame; ctx.fillText('BOMBERMAN', W/2, 150);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.flameCore; ctx.font='bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('8-BIT CLASSIC', W/2, 190);
  const blink=Math.floor(time*2)%2===0;
  if(blink){
    ctx.fillStyle=C.yellow; ctx.font='bold 24px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER / CLICK TO START', W/2, 300);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=C.gray; ctx.font='15px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD to move   SPACE to drop bomb', W/2, 350);
  ctx.fillText('Avoid your own explosions!', W/2, 375);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

function drawGameOver(){
  drawBackground();
  for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++) for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){
    const c=cellAt(x,y);
    if(c===2) drawWall(x,y); else if(c===1) drawBrick(x,y);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.font='bold 54px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle=C.red; ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, 170);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.text; ctx.font='bold 24px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  '+score, W/2, 240);
  ctx.fillText('LEVEL REACHED  '+level, W/2, 275);
  const blink=Math.floor(time*2)%2===0;
  if(blink){
    ctx.fillStyle=C.yellow; ctx.font='bold 22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER / CLICK TO RETRY', W/2, 350);
  }
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0){
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake),rand(-shake,shake));
  }
  if(state==='title'){ drawTitle(); ctx.restore(); return; }
  if(state==='gameover'){ drawGameOver(); ctx.restore(); return; }

  // playing
  drawBackground();
  for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++) for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){
    const c=cellAt(x,y);
    if(c===2) drawWall(x,y); else if(c===1) drawBrick(x,y);
  }
  for(const f of flames) drawFlame(f);
  for(const b of bombs) drawBomb(b.x,b.y,b);
  drawPlayer();
  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();

  if(flash>0){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,240,200,'+(Math.max(0,flash)/10)+')';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }
  drawHUD();
}

/* ============================ LOOP ============================ */
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/16.6667;   // normalize to ~60fps units
  if(dt>3) dt=3;
  last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  pressed.clear();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

reset();
state='title';
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

<html>
<head>

<title>Robot Attack</title>
<style>

<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
const GROUND = H - 34;
const P = 4; // pixel unit

// ---- 8-bit palette (6 solid colors) ----
const COL = {
  bg:    '#0b0f2a',
  ground: '#39d98a',
  player: '#ff9f1c',
  enemy:  '#37e0ff',
  bullet: '#ff2e4d',
  accent: '#ffffff'
};

// ---------------- STATE ----------------
let state = 'title';
let score = 0;
let hiScore = 0;
let player = { x: W/2 - 14, y: GROUND - 22, w:28, h:22, hp:5, speed:150 };
let bullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let enemyTimer = 0;
let enemyInterval = 2.4;
let fireCooldown = 0;
let shake = 0;
let t = 0;

function resetGame(){
  score = 0;
  player.hp = 5;
  player.x = W/2 - 14;
  player.y = GROUND - 22;
  bullets = []; enemies = []; particles = [];
  enemyTimer = 0; enemyInterval = 2.4; fireCooldown = 0; shake = 0;
}

// ---------------- INPUT ----------------
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if(state==='title' && (k===' '||k==='enter')) { resetGame(); state='play'; }
  else if(state==='over' && (k===' '||k==='enter')) { state='title'; }
  if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ---------------- HELPERS ----------------
function rect(a,b){ return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y; }
function addParticle(x,y,color,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    particles.push({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*90,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*90-20,life:.5,color});
  }
}

function spawnEnemy(){
  const fromLeft = Math.random()<.5;
  const e = {
    x: fromLeft ? -26 : W+2,
    y: 20 + Math.random()*(H-90),
    w:24, h:22,
    vx: (fromLeft?1:-1) * (40 + Math.random()*40),
    vy: 0,
    hp:2
  };
  enemies.push(e);
}

// ---------------- UPDATE ----------------
function update(dt){
  t += dt;
  if(state!=='play') return;

  // player movement
  let dx=0, dy=0;
  if(keys['arrowleft']||keys['a']) dx-=1;
  if(keys['arrowright']||keys['d']) dx+=1;
  if(keys['arrowup']||keys['w']) dy-=1;
  if(keys['arrowdown']||keys['s']) dy+=1;
  if(dx&&dy){ dx*=0.707; dy*=0.707; }
  player.x += dx*player.speed*dt;
  player.y += dy*player.speed*dt;
  player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W-player.w, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(GROUND-player.h, player.y));

  // firing
  fireCooldown -= dt;
  if((keys[' ']||keys['z']||keys['j']) && fireCooldown<=0){
    const cx = player.x + player.w/2, cy = player.y + player.h/2;
    let ax=0, ay=0;
    if(dx||dy){ ax=dx; ay=dy; }
    else { ax=1; ay=0; } // default right
    const len = Math.hypot(ax,ay)||1; ax/=len; ay/=len;
    bullets.push({x:cx, y:cy, vx:ax*260, vy:ay*260, r:3, life:2});
    fireCooldown = 0.22;
  }

  // bullets
  for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt; b.life -= dt;
    if(b.life<=0 || b.x<-10||b.x>W+10||b.y<-10||b.y>H+10){ bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    // hit enemy
    let hit=false;
    for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const e = enemies[j];
      if(b.x>e.x && b.x<e.x+e.w && b.y>e.y && b.y<e.y+e.h){
        e.hp--; addParticle(b.x,b.y,COL.bullet,5);
        if(e.hp<=0){
          addParticle(e.x+e.w/2,e.y+e.h/2,COL.enemy,14);
          enemies.splice(j,1); score += 10;
          enemyInterval = Math.max(0.9, enemyInterval-0.05);
        }
        hit=true; break;
      }
    }
    if(hit) bullets.splice(i,1);
  }

  // enemies
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const e = enemies[i];
    // drift toward player
    const cx = player.x+player.w/2, cy = player.y+player.h/2;
    const ex = e.x+e.w/2, ey = e.y+e.h/2;
    const d = Math.hypot(cx-ex, cy-ey)||1;
    e.vx += ((cx-ex)/d)*18*dt;
    e.vy += ((cy-ey)/d)*18*dt;
    const sp = Math.hypot(e.vx,e.vy);
    const max = 70;
    if(sp>max){ e.vx = e.vx/sp*max; e.vy = e.vy/sp*max; }
    e.x += e.vx*dt; e.y += e.vy*dt;
    if(e.x < -40 || e.x > W+40){ enemies.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(rect(e,player)){
      player.hp--; shake = 8; addParticle(player.x+player.w/2,player.y+player.h/2,COL.player,10);
      enemies.splice(i,1);
      if(player.hp<=0){ hiScore = Math.max(hiScore,score); state='over'; }
    }
  }

  // spawn
  enemyTimer += dt;
  if(enemyTimer>=enemyInterval){ enemyTimer=0; spawnEnemy(); }

  // particles
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vy+=120*dt; p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  if(shake>0) shake = Math.max(0, shake-30*dt);
}

// ---------------- DRAW (chunky pixel style) ----------------
function px(x,y,w,h,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),w,h); }

function drawBackground(){
  px(0,0,W,H,COL.bg);
  // star field
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const sx = (i*53)%W, sy = (i*97)%(GROUND-20);
    const tw = (Math.sin(t*2 + i)>0.3)?1:0;
    px(sx, sy, 2, 2, tw?COL.accent:COL.enemy);
  }
  // ground
  px(0,GROUND,W,H-GROUND,COL.ground);
  px(0,GROUND,W,3,COL.accent);
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const x=player.x, y=player.y;
  // body
  px(x+4,y+2,20,16,COL.player);
  // head
  px(x+8,y,12,6,COL.player);
  // eyes
  px(x+10,y+2,3,3,COL.accent);
  px(x+15,y+2,3,3,COL.accent);
  // legs
  px(x+6,y+18,5,4,COL.player);
  px(x+17,y+18,5,4,COL.player);
  // arm/gun
  px(x+22,y+8,6,4,COL.accent);
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  const x=e.x, y=e.y;
  px(x+2,y+2,20,16,COL.enemy);       // body
  px(x+6,y,12,5,COL.enemy);           // head
  px(x+8,y+6,4,4,COL.bullet);         // eye
  px(x+14,y+6,4,4,COL.bullet);        // eye
  px(x+4,y+18,5,4,COL.enemy);         // legs
  px(x+15,y+18,5,4,COL.enemy);
  px(x+1,y+8,3,6,COL.accent);         // antenna
}

function drawBullet(b){
  px(b.x-3,b.y-3,6,6,COL.bullet);
  px(b.x-1,b.y-1,2,2,COL.accent);
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles) px(p.x,p.y,3,3,p.color);
}

function drawHUD(){
  px(0,0,W,14,COL.bg);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.accent; ctx.font='10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score, 6, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.bullet;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    px(W-8-i*12, 3, 9, 9, i<player.hp ? COL.bullet : COL.bg);
    if(i<player.hp) px(W-8-i*12+2,5,5,5,COL.accent);
  }
}

function drawTitle(){
  drawBackground();
  // a few decorative enemies
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const e={x:40+i*90, y:60+Math.sin(t+i)*10, w:24,h:22};
    drawEnemy(e);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.player; ctx.font='bold 22px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('ROBOT', W/2, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.enemy;
  ctx.fillText('ATTACK', W/2, 62);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.accent; ctx.font='10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD : MOVE', W/2, 110);
  ctx.fillText('SPACE / Z : FIRE', W/2, 124);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.bullet;
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W/2, 150);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

function drawOver(){
  drawBackground();
  drawParticles();
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.bullet; ctx.font='bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, 70);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.accent; ctx.font='12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score, W/2, 95);
  ctx.fillText('HI '+hiScore, W/2, 112);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.enemy;
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE', W/2, 140);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0){ ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*shake,(Math.random()-.5)*shake); }
  if(state==='title'){ drawTitle(); }
  else if(state==='over'){ drawOver(); }
  else {
    drawBackground();
    drawParticles();
    for(const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);
    for(const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
    drawPlayer();
    drawHUD();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------------- LOOP ----------------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now-last)/1000;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Rally-X</title>
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="256" height="224"></canvas>
<script>
// ============================================================
// RALLY-X  (a single playable scene)
// ============================================================
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

// ---------- constants ----------
const TILE = 16;
const COLS = 16, ROWS = 14;
const W = 256, H = 224;
const PLAYER_SPEED = 2.2;

// solid 8-bit palette
const C = {
  black:  '#000000',
  bg:     '#0a0a2e',
  road:   '#3a3a5c',
  road2:  '#2e2e4a',
  wall:   '#7a7aa0',
  white:  '#f0f0f0',
  red:    '#e03030',
  yellow: '#f0c020',
  green:  '#30c060',
  blue:   '#3060d0',
  orange: '#f07020',
  gray:   '#9a9ab0'
};

// ---------- map ----------
// 0 road, 1 wall, 2 start
const MAP = [
  "1111111111111111",
  "1000000000000001",
  "1000000000000001",
  "1001111100000001",
  "1001000000000001",
  "1001000111110001",
  "1001000100000001",
  "1000000100000001",
  "1000000100000001",
  "1001111100000001",
  "1001000000000001",
  "1001000000000001",
  "1000000000000001",
  "1111111111111111"
];
const grid = MAP.map(r => r.split('').map(Number));

// ---------- state ----------
let player, enemies, powerups, score, lives, state, msg, msgTimer;
let invuln = 0;

function reset() {
  player = { x: 8*TILE, y: 8*TILE, w: 12, h: 14, dir: 0, moving: false };
  enemies = [];
  powerups = [];
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  state = 'start';
  msg = 'PRESS START'; msgTimer = 0;
  invuln = 0;
}
reset();

// ---------- input ----------
const keys = {};
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
    if (state === 'start') state = 'play';
    else if (state === 'over') reset();
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ---------- helpers ----------
function isWall(px, py) {
  const c = Math.floor(px / TILE), r = Math.floor(py / TILE);
  if (c < 0 || r < 0 || c >= COLS || r >= ROWS) return true;
  return grid[r][c] === 1;
}
function boxHitsWall(x, y, w, h) {
  const pad = 1;
  return isWall(x+pad, y+pad) || isWall(x+w-pad, y+pad) ||
         isWall(x+pad, y+h-pad) || isWall(x+w-pad, y+h-pad);
}
function circles(a, b) {
  const dx = a.x-b.x, dy = a.y-b.y;
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy) < (a.r + b.r);
}

// ---------- update ----------
function spawnEnemy() {
  // pick a road tile far from player
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 50; tries++) {
    const c = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*(COLS-2));
    const r = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*(ROWS-2));
    if (grid[r][c] !== 0) continue;
    const x = c*TILE + TILE/2, y = r*TILE + TILE/2;
    const dx = x - (player.x+6), dy = y - (player.y+7);
    if (Math.hypot(dx,dy) < 60) continue;
    enemies.push({ x, y, r: 6, dir: Math.floor(Math.random()*4), speed: 0.9 + Math.random()*0.6 });
    return;
  }
}
function spawnPowerup() {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 50; tries++) {
    const c = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*(COLS-2));
    const r = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*(ROWS-2));
    if (grid[r][c] !== 0) continue;
    powerups.push({ x: c*TILE+TILE/2, y: r*TILE+TILE/2, r: 5, type: 'score', t: 0 });
    return;
  }
}

function update() {
  if (state !== 'play') return;

  // player movement
  let dx = 0, dy = 0;
  if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) dx -= PLAYER_SPEED;
  if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) dx += PLAYER_SPEED;
  if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) dy -= PLAYER_SPEED;
  if (keys['arrowdown'] || keys['s']) dy += PLAYER_SPEED;
  player.moving = (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0);
  if (dx < 0) player.dir = 3; else if (dx > 0) player.dir = 1;
  else if (dy < 0) player.dir = 0; else if (dy > 0) player.dir = 2;

  if (dx !== 0 && !boxHitsWall(player.x+dx, player.y, player.w, player.h)) player.x += dx;
  if (dy !== 0 && !boxHitsWall(player.x, player.y+dy, player.w, player.h)) player.y += dy;

  if (invuln > 0) invuln--;

  // enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length-1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    const spd = e.speed;
    let nx = e.x, ny = e.y;
    if (e.dir === 0) ny -= spd;
    if (e.dir === 1) nx += spd;
    if (e.dir === 2) ny += spd;
    if (e.dir === 3) nx -= spd;
    if (isWall(nx, ny)) {
      // turn
      const turns = [1,3,2];
      e.dir = (e.dir + turns[Math.floor(Math.random()*3)] + 4) % 4;
    } else { e.x = nx; e.y = ny; }

    // hit player
    const pcx = player.x + player.w/2, pcy = player.y + player.h/2;
    if (invuln === 0 && Math.hypot(e.x-pcx, e.y-pcy) < 10) {
      lives--; invuln = 60;
      if (lives <= 0) { state = 'over'; msg = 'GAME OVER'; }
      else { // knock enemies away
        enemies.splice(i,1);
      }
      continue;
    }
  }

  // powerups
  for (let i = powerups.length-1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = powerups[i]; p.t++;
    const pcx = player.x + player.w/2, pcy = player.y + player.h/2;
    if (Math.hypot(p.x-pcx, p.y-pcy) < 12) {
      score += 100; powerups.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // scoring over time
  if (player.moving) score += 1;

  // spawns
  if (enemies.length < 5 && Math.random() < 0.02) spawnEnemy();
  if (powerups.length < 2 && Math.random() < 0.015) spawnPowerup();

  if (msgTimer > 0) msgTimer--;
}

// ---------- 8-bit car sprite (chunky pixels) ----------
function drawCar(x, y, dir, color, accent) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x + 6, y + 7);
  const rot = [0, Math.PI/2, Math.PI, -Math.PI/2][dir];
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  // body (12 wide x 14 tall, centered)
  const p = 1; // pixel size
  const body = [
    " 11111111  ",
    " 12222221  ",
    " 12222221  ",
    " 11111111  ",
    " 13333331  ",
    " 13333331  ",
    " 11111111  ",
    " 12222221  ",
    " 12222221  ",
    " 11111111  "
  ];
  const cols = { '1': color, '2': accent, '3': C.black };
  for (let r = 0; r < body.length; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < body[r].length; c++) {
      const ch = body[r][c];
      if (ch === ' ') continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = cols[ch];
      ctx.fillRect(-6 + c*p, -7 + r*p, p, p);
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function draw() {
  // background
  ctx.fillStyle = C.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // tiles
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      const x = c*TILE, y = r*TILE;
      if (grid[r][c] === 1) {
        ctx.fillStyle = C.wall;
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
        ctx.fillStyle = C.gray;
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = C.black;
        ctx.fillRect(x+2, y+6, TILE-4, 2);
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = (r + c) % 2 ? C.road : C.road2;
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
        // center dashes
        ctx.fillStyle = C.yellow;
        if (c % 2 === 0) ctx.fillRect(x + TILE/2 - 1, y + 6, 2, 4);
      }
    }
  }

  // powerups
  for (const p of powerups) {
    const blink = Math.floor(p.t/10) % 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = blink ? C.green : C.yellow;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-5, p.y-5, 10, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.black;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-2, p.y-2, 4, 4);
  }

  // enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    drawCar(e.x-6, e.y-7, e.dir, C.red, C.orange);
  }

  // player
  const show = invuln === 0 || Math.floor(invuln/4) % 2 === 0;
  if (show) drawCar(player.x, player.y, player.dir, C.blue, C.white);

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  ctx.font = '10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 6, 12);
  ctx.fillText('LIVES ' + lives, 6, 224-6);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.yellow;
  for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) ctx.fillRect(120 + i*10, 214, 8, 8);

  // overlays
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'over') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.yellow;
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('RALLY-X', W/2, 90);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
    ctx.font = '11px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(msg, W/2, 120);
    ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD TO DRIVE', W/2, 140);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
}

// ---------- loop ----------
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Cosmic Fighter</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;
    background: #05050f;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

<canvas id="game" width="320" height="180"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ============================ SETUP ============================ */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

/* ---------- 8-bit palette (6 solid colors + black) ---------- */
const C = {
  black : '#000000',
  bg    : '#12122e',   // deep space
  red   : '#ff2f6d',   // enemy / danger
  blue  : '#39c0ff',   // player / good
  yellow: '#ffe14d',   // bullets / energy
  white : '#ffffff',
  green : '#5cff8f'
};

const GROUND = H - 26;   // floor line
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

/* ============================ STATE ============================ */
let state = 'title';   // title | play | win | lose
let score = 0;
let wave = 1;
let shake = 0;
let flash = 0;
let t = 0;

// player
const P = {
  x: 60, y: GROUND, w: 20, h: 30,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  hp: 3, maxHp: 3,
  face: 1,
  onGround: true,
  inv: 0,          // invulnerability timer
  cool: 0,         // fire cooldown
  jumpLock: false
};

let enemies = [];
let bullets = [];
let ebullets = [];
let particles = [];
let stars = [];
let stars2 = [];

/* ============================ HELPERS ============================ */
function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
function clamp(v,a,b){ return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }

function rectHit(a,b){
  return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x &&
         a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

function makeStars(){
  stars = []; stars2 = [];
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++) stars.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,GROUND), s:Math.random()<0.5?1:2, tw:rand(0,TAU)});
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++) stars2.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,GROUND*0.7), s:1, tw:rand(0,TAU)});
}

function spawnWave(){
  const n = Math.min(2 + wave, 6);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    enemies.push({
      x: rand(120, W-40),
      y: rand(24, GROUND-70),
      w: 22, h: 22,
      vx: rand(-0.4,0.4),
      vy: rand(-0.3,0.3),
      hp: 1,
      fire: rand(60, 180),
      phase: rand(0,TAU)
    });
  }
}

function resetGame(){
  score = 0; wave = 1;
  P.x = 60; P.y = GROUND; P.vx = 0; P.vy = 0;
  P.hp = 3; P.face = 1; P.inv = 0; P.cool = 0; P.onGround = true;
  enemies = []; bullets = []; ebullets = []; particles = [];
  makeStars();
  spawnWave();
}

/* ============================ INPUT ============================ */
const keys = {};
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(e.key.toLowerCase())) e.preventDefault();

  if(state === 'title' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { resetGame(); state = 'play'; }
  else if((state === 'win' || state === 'lose') && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { resetGame(); state = 'play'; }
  else if(state === 'play' && (k === 'z' || k === ' ')) { tryFire(); }
  else if(state === 'play' && k === 'x') {
    if(P.onGround && !P.jumpLock){ P.vy = -4.6; P.onGround = false; P.jumpLock = true; }
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = false;
  if(k === 'x') P.jumpLock = false;
});

function tryFire(){
  if(P.cool > 0) return;
  P.cool = 12;
  bullets.push({ x: P.x + (P.face>0? P.w : -6), y: P.y + 10, vx: P.face * 6.5, w: 8, h: 3 });
  // muzzle spark
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++) particles.push({
    x: P.x + (P.face>0? P.w : 0), y: P.y + 11,
    vx: P.face * rand(1,3), vy: rand(-1,1), life: rand(6,12), c: C.yellow, s: 2
  });
}

/* ============================ UPDATE ============================ */
function update(){
  t++;
  if(shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;
  if(flash > 0) flash -= 0.05;

  if(state !== 'play'){
    // idle drift for enemies on title
    for(const e of enemies){ e.x += e.vx; e.y += e.vy;
      if(e.x < 20 || e.x > W-40) e.vx *= -1;
      if(e.y < 20 || e.y > GROUND-30) e.vy *= -1; }
    return;
  }

  // ---- player movement ----
  P.vx = 0;
  if(keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) { P.vx = -2.6; P.face = -1; }
  if(keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) { P.vx = 2.6; P.face = 1; }

  P.x += P.vx;
  P.x = clamp(P.x, 8, W - 8 - P.w);

  // gravity
  P.vy += 0.28;
  P.y += P.vy;
  if(P.y >= GROUND){ P.y = GROUND; P.vy = 0; P.onGround = true; }
  else P.onGround = false;

  if(P.cool > 0) P.cool--;
  if(P.inv > 0) P.inv--;

  // ---- bullets ----
  for(let i = bullets.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const b = bullets[i]; b.x += b.vx;
    if(b.x < -10 || b.x > W+10){ bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    for(let j = enemies.length-1; j>=0; j--){
      const e = enemies[j];
      if(rectHit(b, e)){
        e.hp--;
        bullets.splice(i,1);
        for(let k=0;k<8;k++) particles.push({
          x: e.x + e.w/2, y: e.y + e.h/2,
          vx: rand(-3,3), vy: rand(-3,3), life: rand(8,18), c: C.red, s: 2
        });
        if(e.hp <= 0){
          enemies.splice(j,1);
          score += 10;
          shake = 5;
          for(let k=0;k<16;k++) particles.push({
            x: e.x + e.w/2, y: e.y + e.h/2,
            vx: rand(-4,4), vy: rand(-4,4), life: rand(10,26), c: k%2?C.yellow:C.red, s: 3
          });
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- enemies ----
  for(const e of enemies){
    e.phase += 0.05;
    e.x += e.vx + Math.sin(e.phase)*0.3;
    e.y += e.vy + Math.cos(e.phase)*0.2;
    e.x = clamp(e.x, 20, W-40);
    e.y = clamp(e.y, 20, GROUND-30);
    if(e.x < 20 || e.x > W-40) e.vx *= -1;
    if(e.y < 20 || e.y > GROUND-30) e.vy *= -1;

    // enemy fire
    if(--e.fire <= 0){
      e.fire = rand(90, 200);
      const dx = (P.x + P.w/2) - (e.x + e.w/2);
      const dy = (P.y + P.h/2) - (e.y + e.h/2);
      const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
      ebullets.push({ x: e.x + e.w/2, y: e.y + e.h/2, vx: dx/d * 3.2, vy: dy/d * 3.2, w: 5, h: 5 });
    }
  }

  // ---- enemy bullets ----
  for(let i = ebullets.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const b = ebullets[i]; b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy;
    if(b.x < -10 || b.x > W+10 || b.y < -10 || b.y > H+10){ ebullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(P.inv <= 0 && rectHit(b, P)){
      ebullets.splice(i,1);
      hurt();
    }
  }

  // ---- enemy body collision ----
  if(P.inv <= 0){
    for(const e of enemies){
      if(rectHit(e, P)){ hurt(); break; }
    }
  }

  // ---- particles ----
  for(let i = particles.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vy += 0.12; p.life--;
    if(p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  // ---- wave / win ----
  if(enemies.length === 0){
    wave++;
    if(wave > 5){ state = 'win'; }
    else { P.hp = Math.min(P.maxHp, P.hp + 1); spawnWave(); }
  }

  if(P.hp <= 0){ state = 'lose'; }
}

function hurt(){
  P.hp--;
  P.inv = 70;
  shake = 8;
  flash = 0.6;
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++) particles.push({
    x: P.x + P.w/2, y: P.y + P.h/2,
    vx: rand(-4,4), vy: rand(-4,4), life: rand(10,24), c: C.blue, s: 3
  });
}

/* ============================ DRAW (chunky pixel style) ============================ */
function px(x,y,w,h,c){ ctx.fillStyle = c; ctx.fillRect(x|0, y|0, w, h); }

function drawBackground(){
  // space
  px(0,0,W,H,C.bg);
  // nebula band
  px(0,0,W,40,'rgba(57,192,255,0.06)');
  px(0,40,W,30,'rgba(255,47,109,0.05)');

  // stars (twinkle via alpha)
  for(const s of stars){
    const a = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(t*0.05 + s.tw);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    px(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s, C.white);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  for(const s of stars2){
    const a = 0.3 + 0.4*Math.sin(t*0.03 + s.tw);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    px(s.x, s.y, 2, 2, C.blue);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // distant planet
  px(250, 26, 30, 30, C.red);
  px(254, 30, 22, 22, '#c81f52');
  px(258, 34, 14, 3, C.yellow);
  px(258, 44, 14, 3, C.yellow);

  // ground (pixel floor)
  px(0, GROUND, W, H-GROUND, '#0a0a1c');
  px(0, GROUND, W, 3, C.blue);
  for(let x=0; x<W; x+=8) px(x, GROUND+6, 4, 2, '#1c1c40');
  for(let x=4; x<W; x+=16) px(x, GROUND+12, 4, 2, '#141430');
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const x = P.x|0, y = P.y|0;
  const blink = P.inv > 0 && (Math.floor(t/4) % 2 === 0);
  if(blink) return;
  const f = P.face;
  // body
  px(x+4, y+10, 12, 14, C.blue);
  // head
  px(x+5, y+2, 10, 9, '#2a9fd6');
  // visor
  px(x + (f>0? 9 : 5), y+4, 6, 3, C.white);
  // chest light
  px(x+8, y+14, 4, 4, C.yellow);
  // legs
  const step = P.onGround && P.vx !== 0 ? (Math.floor(t/6)%2 ? 2 : 0) : 0;
  px(x+5, y+24, 4, 6, C.blue);
  px(x+11, y+24, 4, 6, C.blue);
  px(x+5+step, y+28, 4, 2, '#1f7fb0');
  px(x+11-step, y+28, 4, 2, '#1f7fb0');
  // arm / cannon
  if(f>0){ px(x+14, y+13, 7, 4, C.green); px(x+19, y+14, 3, 2, C.white); }
  else    { px(x-1, y+13, 7, 4, C.green);  px(x-2, y+14, 3, 2, C.white); }
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  const x = e.x|0, y = e.y|0;
  // body (rounded alien)
  px(x+4, y+2, 14, 18, C.red);
  px(x+2, y+6, 18, 10, C.red);
  // eye
  px(x+8, y+8, 6, 6, C.yellow);
  px(x+10, y+10, 2, 2, C.black);
  // horns
  px(x+3, y, 3, 4, C.red);
  px(x+16, y, 3, 4, C.red);
  // legs
  px(x+6, y+20, 3, 3, '#c81f52');
  px(x+13, y+20, 3, 3, '#c81f52');
}

function drawBullets(){
  for(const b of bullets){
    px(b.x|0, b.y|0, b.w, b.h, C.yellow);
    px((b.x|0)+2, (b.y|0), 2, b.h, C.white);
  }
  for(const b of ebullets){
    px(b.x|0, b.y|0, b.w, b.h, C.red);
    px((b.x|0)+1, (b.y|0)+1, 2, 2, C.yellow);
  }
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life/20, 0, 1);
    px(p.x|0, p.y|0, p.s, p.s, p.c);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD(){
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  ctx.font = '10px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + String(score).padStart(4,'0'), 8, 8);
  ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + wave + '/5', W-52, 8);
  // lives
  for(let i=0;i<P.maxHp;i++){
    px(8 + i*12, 22, 9, 9, i < P.hp ? C.blue : '#20203a');
    if(i < P.hp) px(10 + i*12, 24, 3, 3, C.white);
  }
}

function panelText(txt, y, c){
  ctx.fillStyle = c; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(txt, W/2, y);
}

function drawTitle(){
  panelText('COSMIC', 54, C.blue);
  panelText('FIGHTER', 78, C.red);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.yellow; ctx.font = '9px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('ARROWS / A D  MOVE', W/2, 104);
  ctx.fillText('X  JUMP    Z  FIRE', W/2, 116);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  const blink = Math.floor(t/30) % 2 === 0;
  if(blink) ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START', W/2, 138);
}

function drawEnd(won){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,5,15,0.7)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  panelText(won ? 'YOU WIN' : 'GAME OVER', 70, won ? C.green : C.red);
  panelText('SCORE ' + score, 96, C.yellow);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white; ctx.font='9px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  if(Math.floor(t/30)%2===0) ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN', W/2, 124);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake > 0.5){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawParticles();
  for(const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  drawBullets();
  if(state !== 'title') drawPlayer();

  ctx.restore();

  if(state === 'play') drawHUD();
  if(state === 'title') drawTitle();
  if(state === 'win') drawEnd(true);
  if(state === 'lose') drawEnd(false);

  // hit flash
  if(flash > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,47,109,' + flash + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }
}

/* ============================ MAIN LOOP ============================ */
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// boot
makeStars();
spawnWave();
for(const e of enemies){ e.x = rand(120, W-40); e.y = rand(24, GROUND-70); }
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

"use strict";

/* ============================================================
   DEFENSE COMMAND — a single playable scene
   8-bit tower defense. Build towers, stop the invasion,
   survive to victory.
   ============================================================ */

// ---------- 1. SETUP ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

const W = canvas.width;   // 320
const H = canvas.height;  // 224
const CELL = 16;
const COLS = W / CELL;    // 20
const ROWS = H / CELL;    // 14
const TOP = 3 * CELL;     // 48
const BOT = 11 * CELL;    // 176
const MID = (TOP + BOT) / 2; // 112
const HP = 100;

// 6 core palette
const COL = {
  dark:   "#0a1f14",
  green:  "#2f9e52",
  bright: "#bfe94a",
  orange: "#ff7a1a",
  blue:   "#3aa0ff",
  white:  "#f4f4f4"
};

// ---------- 2. STATE ----------
let state = "start";      // start | play | win | lose
let score = 0;
let money = 50;
let lives = HP;
let enemies = [];
let towers = [];
let bullets = [];
let parts = [];
let selected = 0;          // 0 none, 1 cannon, 2 laser
let mouse = { x: -100, y: -100 };
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnGap = 1.0;
let elapsed = 0;
let shake = 0;

const TOWER_TYPES = {
  1: { name: "CANNON", cost: 30, range: 52,  rate: 0.55, dmg: 12, color: COL.orange, bullet: COL.white },
  2: { name: "LASER",  cost: 50, range: 70,  rate: 0.20, dmg: 5,  color: COL.blue,   bullet: COL.blue }
};

// ---------- 3. INPUT ----------
function canvasPos(e) {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width),
    y: (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height)
  };
}
function cellOf(p) {
  return { cx: Math.floor(p.x / CELL), cy: Math.floor(p.y / CELL) };
}
function isFree(cx, cy) {
  if (cy < 3 || cy > 10) return false;
  if (cx < 0 || cx >= COLS) return false;
  for (const t of towers) if (t.cx === cx && t.cy === cy) return false;
  return true;
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => { mouse = canvasPos(e); });

canvas.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if (state !== "play") return;
  const p = canvasPos(e);
  const { cx, cy } = cellOf(p);
  if (!isFree(cx, cy)) return;
  const type = selected ? TOWER_TYPES[selected] : null;
  if (!type || money < type.cost) return;
  money -= type.cost;
  towers.push({
    cx, cy,
    x: cx * CELL + CELL / 2,
    y: cy * CELL + CELL / 2,
    type: selected,
    range: type.range,
    rate: type.rate,
    dmg: type.dmg,
    color: type.color,
    bullet: type.bullet,
    cd: 0,
    angle: -Math.PI / 2,
    flash: 0
  });
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const k = e.key;
  if (state === "play") {
    if (k === "1") selected = (selected === 1 ? 0 : 1);
    if (k === "2") selected = (selected === 2 ? 0 : 2);
    if (k === "Escape") selected = 0;
  } else if (state === "start" || state === "win" || state === "lose") {
    if (k === "Enter" || k === " ") startGame();
  }
});

function startGame() {
  state = "play";
  score = 0;
  money = 50;
  lives = HP;
  enemies = [];
  towers = [];
  bullets = [];
  parts = [];
  selected = 0;
  spawnTimer = 0;
  spawnGap = 1.0;
  elapsed = 0;
  shake = 0;
}

// ---------- 4. HELPERS ----------
function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }

function spawnEnemy() {
  const roll = Math.random();
  let type;
  if (roll < 0.55) type = 0;       // grunt
  else if (roll < 0.85) type = 1;   // runner
  else type = 2;                     // tank
  const stats = {
    0: { hp: 26,  spd: 34,  r: 5,  val: 10, color: COL.green },
    1: { hp: 16,  spd: 62,  r: 4,  val: 14, color: COL.bright },
    2: { hp: 78,  spd: 20,  r: 7,  val: 30, color: COL.orange }
  }[type];
  enemies.push({
    x: W + 8,
    y: MID + (Math.random() * 24 - 12),
    hp: stats.hp, maxhp: stats.hp,
    spd: stats.spd, r: stats.r,
    val: stats.val, color: stats.color,
    wob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

function boom(x, y, color, n, spread) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = Math.random() * spread;
    parts.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
      life: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3,
      max: 0.65,
      color
    });
  }
}

// ---------- 5. UPDATE ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (state !== "play") return;
  elapsed += dt;

  // difficulty ramps, and the wave ends at 30s
  if (elapsed < 30) {
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    spawnGap = Math.max(0.35, 1.0 - elapsed * 0.02);
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnEnemy();
      spawnTimer = spawnGap;
    }
  } else if (enemies.length === 0) {
    state = "win";
  }

  // enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    e.x -= e.spd * dt;
    e.wob += dt * 8;
    if (e.x <= 12) {
      lives -= e.val;
      shake = 6;
      boom(14, e.y, COL.orange, 14, 90);
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
      if (lives <= 0) { lives = 0; state = "lose"; }
    }
  }

  // towers fire
  for (const t of towers) {
    if (t.flash > 0) t.flash -= dt * 4;
    t.cd -= dt;
    // find nearest enemy in range
    let target = null, best = 1e9;
    for (const e of enemies) {
      const d = dist(t.x, t.y, e.x, e.y);
      if (d <= t.range && d < best) { best = d; target = e; }
    }
    if (target) {
      t.angle = Math.atan2(target.y - t.y, target.x - t.x);
      if (t.cd <= 0) {
        t.cd = t.rate;
        t.flash = 1;
        const bx = t.x + Math.cos(t.angle) * 8;
        const by = t.y + Math.sin(t.angle) * 8;
        bullets.push({
          x: bx, y: by,
          tx: target.x, ty: target.y,
          target,
          spd: t.type === 2 ? 420 : 300,
          dmg: t.dmg,
          color: t.bullet,
          r: t.type === 2 ? 2 : 3
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    const tx = b.target && enemies.includes(b.target) ? b.target.x : b.tx;
    const ty = b.target && enemies.includes(b.target) ? b.target.y : b.ty;
    const dx = tx - b.x, dy = ty - b.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const step = b.spd * dt;
    if (d <= step + 3) {
      // hit
      if (b.target && enemies.includes(b.target)) {
        b.target.hp -= b.dmg;
        boom(tx, ty, b.color, 6, 60);
        if (b.target.hp <= 0) {
          const idx = enemies.indexOf(b.target);
          score += b.target.val;
          money += Math.floor(b.target.val / 2);
          boom(b.target.x, b.target.y, b.target.color, 12, 110);
          enemies.splice(idx, 1);
        }
      }
      bullets.splice(i, 1);
    } else {
      b.x += (dx / d) * step;
      b.y += (dy / d) * step;
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (let i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = parts[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vx *= 0.9;
    p.vy *= 0.9;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) parts.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (shake > 0) shake -= dt * 30;
}

// ---------- 6. DRAW ----------
function px(x, y, w, h, c) {
  ctx.fillStyle = c;
  ctx.fillRect(x | 0, y | 0, w, h);
}

function drawBackground() {
  // sky band
  px(0, 0, W, TOP, COL.dark);
  px(0, 0, W, 2, COL.green);
  // ground / lane
  px(0, TOP, W, BOT - TOP, "#123322");
  // top and bottom borders
  px(0, TOP, W, 2, COL.green);
  px(0, BOT, W, 2, COL.green);
  // faint grid
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(47,158,82,0.10)";
  for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) ctx.fillRect(c * CELL, TOP, 1, BOT - TOP);
  for (let r = 3; r < 11; r++) ctx.fillRect(0, r * CELL, W, 1);
  // lane center line
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(191,233,74,0.25)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, MID - 1, W, 2);
  // bottom HUD strip
  px(0, BOT, W, H - BOT, "#08140c");
}

function drawBase() {
  const x = 0, y = MID - 22;
  // structure
  px(x, y, 12, 44, COL.green);
  px(x, y, 12, 3, COL.bright);
  px(x, y + 41, 12, 3, COL.bright);
  // windows
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) px(x + 3, y + 8 + i * 8, 5, 4, COL.white);
  // antenna
  px(x + 4, y - 8, 3, 8, COL.green);
  px(x + 3, y - 10, 5, 3, COL.bright);
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const x = e.x, y = e.y + Math.sin(e.wob) * 1.5;
  const r = e.r;
  // shadow
  px(x - r, y + r, r * 2, 2, "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)");
  // body
  px(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2, e.color);
  // darker top
  px(x - r, y - r, r * 2, 2, "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)");
  // eye
  px(x - 1, y - 2, 3, 3, COL.white);
  px(x + 1, y - 1, 1, 1, COL.dark);
  // hp bar
  if (e.hp < e.maxhp) {
    const w = r * 2;
    px(x - r, y - r - 4, w, 2, COL.dark);
    px(x - r, y - r - 4, Math.max(1, w * (e.hp / e.maxhp)), 2, COL.bright);
  }
}

function drawTower(t) {
  const x = t.x, y = t.y;
  // base plate
  px(x - 7, y - 7, 14, 14, "#123322");
  px(x - 7, y - 7, 14, 2, t.color);
  // turret body
  px(x - 5, y - 5, 10, 10, t.color);
  px(x - 5, y - 5, 10, 2, "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)");
  // barrel
  const bl = 9;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(t.angle);
  px(0, -2, bl, 4, COL.dark);
  px(bl - 3, -2, 3, 4, t.color);
  ctx.restore();
  // muzzle flash
  if (t.flash > 0) {
    const mx = x + Math.cos(t.angle) * bl;
    const my = y + Math.sin(t.angle) * bl;
    px(mx - 2, my - 2, 5, 5, COL.white);
    px(mx - 1, my - 1, 3, 3, COL.bright);
  }
}

function drawBullet(b) {
  px(b.x - b.r, b.y - b.r, b.r * 2, b.r * 2, b.color);
  px(b.x - 1, b.y - 1, 2, 2, COL.white);
}

function drawParticle(p) {
  const a = p.life / p.max;
  ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, a));
  px(p.x - 1, p.y - 1, 3, 3, p.color);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawRangePreview() {
  if (state !== "play" || !selected) return;
  const { cx, cy } = cellOf(mouse);
  if (cy < 3 || cy > 10 || cx < 0 || cx >= COLS) return;
  const x = cx * CELL + CELL / 2;
  const y = cy * CELL + CELL / 2;
  const type = TOWER_TYPES[selected];
  const ok = isFree(cx, cy) && money >= type.cost;
  // range circle (pixel ring)
  ctx.strokeStyle = ok ? "rgba(191,233,74,0.6)" : "rgba(255,122,26,0.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, type.range, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  // ghost tower
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
  px(x - 6, y - 6, 12, 12, ok ? type.color : COL.orange);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // lives bar
  px(4, BOT + 4, 120, 8, COL.dark);
  px(5, BOT + 5, Math.max(0, 118 * (lives / HP)), 6, lives > 30 ? COL.green : COL.orange);
  px(4, BOT + 4, 120, 1, COL.green);
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.bright;
  ctx.font = "bold 9px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE " + score, 4, BOT + 22);
  // money
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("$" + money, W - 4, BOT + 22);
  // timer / wave
  const left = Math.max(0, 30 - elapsed);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.fillText("WAVE " + Math.ceil(left) + "s", W / 2, BOT + 22);
}

function drawStartMenu() {
  // dark overlay
  px(0, 0, W, H, "rgba(4,12,8,0.82)");
  // title
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.bright;
  ctx.fillText("DEFENSE", W / 2, 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.orange;
  ctx.fillText("COMMAND", W / 2, 88);
  ctx.font = "bold 10px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.fillText("STOP THE INVASION. SURVIVE 30 SECONDS.", W / 2, 118);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.green;
  ctx.fillText("[1] CANNON  $30        [2] LASER  $50", W / 2, 138);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.fillText("SELECT A TOWER, THEN CLICK THE GRID", W / 2, 152);
  // blinking prompt
  if (Math.floor(performance.now() / 500) % 2 === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bright;
    ctx.font = "bold 12px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO DEPLOY", W / 2, 182);
  }
}

function drawEnd(win) {
  px(0, 0, W, H, "rgba(4,12,8,0.82)");
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = win ? COL.bright : COL.orange;
  ctx.fillText(win ? "VICTORY" : "DEFEAT", W / 2, 80);
  ctx.font = "bold 12px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.fillText("FINAL SCORE: " + score, W / 2, 112);
  if (Math.floor(performance.now() / 500) % 2 === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bright;
    ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN", W / 2, 150);
  }
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawBase();
  for (const t of towers) drawTower(t);
  for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  for (const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);
  for (const p of parts) drawParticle(p);
  drawRangePreview();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  if (state === "start") drawStartMenu();
  else if (state === "win") drawEnd(true);
  else if (state === "lose") drawEnd(false);
}

// ---------- 7. MAIN LOOP ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp for tab-switch spikes
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  player.moveT+=1;
  if(player.moveT>=6){
    player.moveT=0;
    player.frame=(player.frame+1)%2;
    const nx=player.x+dx, ny=player.y+dy;
    if(canMove(nx,ny)){
      player.x=nx; player.y=ny;
      // check key pickup
      for(const k of keys){ if(!k.taken && k.x===player.x && k.y===player.y){ k.taken=true; collected++; score+=100; msg='KEY COLLECTED!'; msgT=60; } }
      // check guard
      if(isGuardAt(player.x,player.y)){ state='lose'; }
    }
  }

  // guard AI: simple patrol + chase if close
  for(const gd of guards){
    gd.frame=(gd.frame+1)%2;
    // distance
    const dist=Math.abs(gd.x-player.x)+Math.abs(gd.y-player.y);
    if(dist<=5){
      // chase
      let cx=0,cy=0;
      if(player.x>gd.x)cx=1; else if(player.x<gd.x)cx=-1;
      if(player.y>gd.y)cy=1; else if(player.y<gd.y)cy=-1;
      if(cx!==0){ if(canMove(gd.x+cx,gd.y)&&!isGuardAt(gd.x+cx,gd.y)){ gd.x+=cx; gd.dir=cx>0?'right':'left'; } }
      else if(cy!==0){ if(canMove(gd.x,gd.y+cy)&&!isGuardAt(gd.x,gd.y+cy)){ gd.y+=cy; gd.dir=cy>0?'down':'up'; } }
      // bump player
      if(gd.x===player.x&&gd.y===player.y){ state='lose'; }
    } else {
      // patrol: move in current direction, turn at wall
      let px=0,py=0;
      if(gd.dir==='up')py=-1; else if(gd.dir==='down')py=1; else if(gd.dir==='left')px=-1; else if(gd.dir==='right')px=1;
      if(tick%10===0){
        const nx=gd.x+px, ny=gd.y+py;
        if(canMove(nx,ny)&&!isGuardAt(nx,ny)){ gd.x=nx; gd.y=ny; }
        else { // turn
          const turns={up:'right',right:'down',down:'left',left:'up'};
          gd.dir=turns[gd.dir];
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // win condition: collect all keys
  if(collected>=5){ state='win'; }
}

// ---------- DRAW HELPERS ----------
function px(x,y,w,h,c){ g.fillStyle=c; g.fillRect(x,y,w,h); }

function drawWallTile(x,y){
  const sx=x*TILE, sy=y*TILE;
  px(sx,sy,8,8,COL.wall);
  // brick lines
  px(sx,sy+3,8,1,COL.shadow);
  px(sx,sy+7,8,1,COL.shadow);
  px(sx+3,sy,1,3,COL.shadow);
  px(sx+5,sy+4,1,3,COL.shadow);
  // highlight
  px(sx,sy,8,1,'#4a3f26');
}

function drawFloorTile(x,y){
  const sx=x*TILE, sy=y*TILE;
  px(sx,sy,8,8,COL.floor);
  if((x+y)%2===0) px(sx,sy,8,8,'#241d12');
  // subtle speckle
  if((x*7+y*13)%5===0) px(sx+2,sy+2,1,1,'#2c2415');
}

function drawDoor(x,y){
  const sx=x*TILE, sy=y*TILE;
  px(sx,sy,8,8,COL.door);
  px(sx+1,sy+1,6,6,COL.doorOpen);
  px(sx+1,sy,6,1,COL.door);
  px(sx,sy+1,1,6,COL.door);
  // handle
  px(sx+5,sy+4,1,1,'#ffd23a');
}

function drawKey(x,y){
  const sx=x*TILE, sy=y*TILE;
  const bob=Math.floor(tick/15)%2;
  const oy=bob?0:1;
  px(sx+2,sy+1+oy,4,2,COL.key);       // head
  px(sx+3,sy+3+oy,2,3,COL.key);        // shaft
  px(sx+3,sy+5+oy,3,1,COL.key);        // teeth
  px(sx+2,sy+1+oy,1,1,COL.keyDark);    // shine
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const sx=player.x*TILE, sy=player.y*TILE;
  const f=player.frame;
  // shadow
  px(sx+1,sy+7,6,1,COL.shadow);
  // body
  px(sx+2,sy+2,4,5,COL.player);
  // head
  px(sx+2,sy+1,4,2,COL.player);
  // face detail by direction
  if(player.dir==='down'){ px(sx+3,sy+2,1,1,'#222'); px(sx+5,sy+2,1,1,'#222'); }
  else if(player.dir==='up'){ px(sx+2,sy+3,4,1,COL.playerDark); }
  else if(player.dir==='left'){ px(sx+2,sy+2,1,2,'#222'); }
  else if(player.dir==='right'){ px(sx+5,sy+2,1,2,'#222'); }
  // arms
  if(f===0){ px(sx+1,sy+3,1,2,COL.playerDark); px(sx+6,sy+3,1,2,COL.playerDark); }
  else { px(sx+1,sy+4,1,2,COL.playerDark); px(sx+6,sy+4,1,2,COL.playerDark); }
  // legs
  if(f===0){ px(sx+2,sy+7,2,1,COL.playerDark); px(sx+5,sy+7,2,1,COL.playerDark); }
  else { px(sx+3,sy+7,2,1,COL.playerDark); px(sx+4,sy+7,2,1,COL.playerDark); }
}

function drawGuard(gd){
  const sx=gd.x*TILE, sy=gd.y*TILE;
  const f=gd.frame;
  px(sx+1,sy+7,6,1,COL.shadow);
  // body
  px(sx+2,sy+2,4,5,COL.guard);
  // head
  px(sx+2,sy+1,4,2,COL.guard);
  // angry eyes
  px(sx+3,sy+2,1,1,COL.eye); px(sx+5,sy+2,1,1,COL.eye);
  // hat
  px(sx+2,sy,4,1,COL.guardDark);
  // arms
  if(f===0){ px(sx+1,sy+3,1,2,COL.guardDark); px(sx+6,sy+3,1,2,COL.guardDark); }
  else { px(sx+1,sy+4,1,2,COL.guardDark); px(sx+6,sy+4,1,2,COL.guardDark); }
  // legs
  if(f===0){ px(sx+2,sy+7,2,1,COL.guardDark); px(sx+5,sy+7,2,1,COL.guardDark); }
  else { px(sx+3,sy+7,2,1,COL.guardDark); px(sx+4,sy+7,2,1,COL.guardDark); }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function draw(){
  g.save();
  if(shake>0){ g.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*shake); }

  // background
  px(0,0,320,240,COL.bg);

  if(state==='title'){
    drawTitle(); g.restore(); return;
  }

  // tiles
  for(let y=0;y<H;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<W;x++){
      const c=MAP[y][x];
      if(c==='1') drawWallTile(x,y);
      else if(c==='2') drawDoor(x,y);
      else drawFloorTile(x,y);
    }
  }
  // keys
  for(const k of keys) if(!k.taken) drawKey(k.x,k.y);
  // guards
  for(const gd of guards) drawGuard(gd);
  // player
  drawPlayer();

  // HUD
  px(0,0,320,10,'#000000aa');
  g.fillStyle=COL.text; g.font='7px monospace';
  g.fillText('KEYS: '+collected+'/5',4,8);
  g.fillText('SCORE: '+score,150,8);
  if(msgT>0){
    g.fillStyle=COL.danger; g.font='8px monospace';
    g.fillText(msg,200,8);
  }

  if(state==='win') drawEnd('YOU ESCAPED!','Press any key to retry',COL.text);
  if(state==='lose') drawEnd('CAUGHT!','Press any key to retry',COL.danger);

  g.restore();
}

function drawTitle(){
  // dark asylum backdrop
  px(0,0,320,240,COL.bg);
  // walls
  for(let y=0;y<H;y++) for(let x=0;x<W;x++) if(MAP[y][x]==='1') drawWallTile(x,y);
  // dim floor
  for(let y=0;y<H;y++) for(let x=0;x<W;x++) if(MAP[y][x]==='0') drawFloorTile(x,y);
  // overlay
  px(0,0,320,240,'#00000099');
  // title
  g.fillStyle=COL.danger; g.font='bold 26px monospace'; g.textAlign='center';
  g.fillText('ASYLUM',160,90);
  g.fillStyle=COL.text; g.font='10px monospace';
  g.fillText('Collect all 5 keys. Avoid the guards.',160,120);
  g.fillStyle=COL.textDim; g.font='9px monospace';
  g.fillText('Move: Arrow keys / WASD',160,140);
  const blink=Math.floor(tick/20)%2;
  if(blink){ g.fillStyle=COL.text; g.fillText('Press any key to start',160,170); }
  g.textAlign='left';
}

function drawEnd(title,sub,color){
  px(0,0,320,240,'#000000cc');
  g.fillStyle=color; g.font='bold 20px monospace'; g.textAlign='center';
  g.fillText(title,160,100);
  g.fillStyle=COL.text; g.font='10px monospace';
  g.fillText('Score: '+score,160,130);
  g.fillStyle=COL.textDim; g.font='9px monospace';
  g.fillText(sub,160,155);
  g.textAlign='left';
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SKYFOX</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #000;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
  const W = 256, H = 240;
  const GROUND_Y = H - 24;
  const PLAYER_SPEED = 3.4;
  const PLAYER_W = 16, PLAYER_H = 14;
  const PLAYER_X = 40;
  const BULLET_SPEED = 9;
  const BULLET_RATE = 14;
  const ENEMY_RATE = 70;
  const ENEMY_SPEED = 3.0;
  const ENEMY_W = 16, ENEMY_H = 14;
  const MAX_LIVES = 3;

  const PAL = {
    skyTop:    "#1c2f6e",
    skyMid:    "#33519c",
    skyLow:    "#5e79b8",
    ground:    "#5a3d24",
    groundHi:  "#7a5330",
    grass:     "#3f8f3f",
    fox:       "#e07b2a",
    foxDark:   "#a8541a",
    foxLight:  "#ffd9a0",
    enemy:     "#7a2f8f",
    enemyDark: "#4a1a5a",
    enemyLight:"#c98fdc",
    bullet:    "#ffe94a",
    bulletHi:  "#fffbe0",
    cloud:     "#eef3ff",
    cloudShad: "#b8c4e0",
    text:      "#ffffff",
    accent:    "#ff5a3c"
  };

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  let state = "title"; // title | play | win | lose
  let score = 0;
  let lives = MAX_LIVES;
  let kills = 0;
  const WIN_KILLS = 12;

  let player = {
    x: PLAYER_X,
    y: H / 2,
    vy: 0,
    invuln: 0,
    thrust: 0
  };

  let bullets = [];
  let enemies = [];
  let particles = [];
  let clouds = [];
  let shootCd = 0;
  let enemyCd = 0;
  let frame = 0;

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  const keys = {};
  let mouse = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, down: false };

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (state === "title" && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) startGame();
    if ((state === "win" || state === "lose") && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) startGame();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W;
    mouse.y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * H;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    mouse.down = true;
    if (state === "title") startGame();
    if (state === "win" || state === "lose") startGame();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mouseup", () => { mouse.down = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W;
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) / r.height * H;
    mouse.down = true;
    if (state === "title") startGame();
    if (state === "win" || state === "lose") startGame();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W;
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) / r.height * H;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend", () => { mouse.down = false; });

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function startGame() {
    state = "play";
    score = 0;
    kills = 0;
    lives = MAX_LIVES;
    bullets = [];
    enemies = [];
    particles = [];
    player.x = PLAYER_X;
    player.y = H / 2;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.invuln = 0;
    shootCd = 0;
    enemyCd = 0;
  }

  function rectHit(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x &&
           a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
  }

  function spawnEnemy() {
    enemies.push({
      x: W,
      y: 20 + Math.random() * (H - 60),
      w: ENEMY_W,
      h: ENEMY_H,
      bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  function explode(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 0.5 + Math.random() * 2.5;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: 20 + Math.random() * 20,
        color: color
      });
    }
  }

  function initClouds() {
    clouds = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: 20 + Math.random() * 90,
        w: 24 + Math.random() * 30,
        speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.4
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update() {
    frame++;

    // clouds always drift
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed;
      if (c.x + c.w < 0) {
        c.x = W;
        c.y = 20 + Math.random() * 90;
      }
    }

    if (state !== "play") return;

    // --- player movement ---
    player.vy = 0;
    if (keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"]) player.vy -= PLAYER_SPEED;
    if (keys["arrowdown"] || keys["s"]) player.vy += PLAYER_SPEED;
    player.y += player.vy;
    player.y = Math.max(8, Math.min(GROUND_Y - PLAYER_H, player.y));
    player.thrust = (keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"] || keys["arrowdown"] || keys["s"]) ? 1 : 0;
    if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln--;

    // --- shooting ---
    if (shootCd > 0) shootCd--;
    if (mouse.down && shootCd <= 0) {
      bullets.push({ x: player.x + PLAYER_W, y: player.y + PLAYER_H / 2 - 1, w: 8, h: 3 });
      shootCd = BULLET_RATE;
    }

    // --- bullets ---
    for (const b of bullets) b.x += BULLET_SPEED;
    bullets = bullets.filter(b => b.x < W + 10);

    // --- enemies spawn ---
    if (enemyCd > 0) enemyCd--;
    if (enemyCd <= 0) {
      spawnEnemy();
      enemyCd = Math.max(28, ENEMY_RATE - kills * 2);
    }

    // --- enemies move ---
    for (const e of enemies) {
      e.x -= ENEMY_SPEED;
      e.bob += 0.15;
      e.y += Math.sin(e.bob) * 0.5;
    }
    enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.x + e.w > -4);

    // --- bullet vs enemy ---
    for (const e of enemies) {
      for (const b of bullets) {
        if (rectHit(b, e)) {
          b.x = 9999;
          e.x = 9999;
          score += 100;
          kills++;
          explode(e.x, e.y, PAL.enemyLight);
        }
      }
    }
    bullets = bullets.filter(b => b.x < 9000);
    enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.x < 9000);

    // --- enemy vs player ---
    if (player.invuln <= 0) {
      const pbox = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: PLAYER_W, h: PLAYER_H };
      for (const e of enemies) {
        if (rectHit(pbox, e)) {
          lives--;
          player.invuln = 90;
          explode(player.x + PLAYER_W / 2, player.y + PLAYER_H / 2, PAL.fox);
          if (lives <= 0) {
            state = "lose";
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // --- enemy reaches left edge (pass) ---
    // (enemies that pass are just removed; no penalty, but they reduce chance)

    // --- win ---
    if (kills >= WIN_KILLS) {
      state = "win";
    }

    // --- particles ---
    for (const p of particles) {
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05;
      p.life--;
    }
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function draw() {
    // --- sky gradient (chunky bands) ---
    const bands = 8;
    for (let i = 0; i < bands; i++) {
      const t = i / (bands - 1);
      const r = Math.round(28 + (94 - 28) * t);
      const g = Math.round(47 + (121 - 47) * t);
      const b = Math.round(110 + (184 - 110) * t);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
      ctx.fillRect(0, i * (GROUND_Y / bands), W, GROUND_Y / bands + 1);
    }

    // --- clouds ---
    for (const c of clouds) {
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.cloudShad;
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x), Math.floor(c.y) + 4, Math.floor(c.w), Math.floor(c.w * 0.35));
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.cloud;
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x) + 3, Math.floor(c.y), Math.floor(c.w * 0.7), Math.floor(c.w * 0.35));
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x) + Math.floor(c.w * 0.3), Math.floor(c.y) - 4, Math.floor(c.w * 0.4), Math.floor(c.w * 0.25));
    }

    // --- ground ---
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.ground;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.groundHi;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 16) {
      ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND_Y + 4, 8, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 8, GROUND_Y + 10, 8, 3);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.grass;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, 3);
    for (let x = 4; x < W; x += 20) {
      ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND_Y - 3, 2, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 3, GROUND_Y - 5, 2, 6);
    }

    // --- enemies (purple bats) ---
    for (const e of enemies) {
      const ex = Math.floor(e.x), ey = Math.floor(e.y);
      // body
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.enemy;
      ctx.fillRect(ex + 4, ey + 4, 8, 7);
      // dark underside
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.enemyDark;
      ctx.fillRect(ex + 4, ey + 9, 8, 3);
      // light top
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.enemyLight;
      ctx.fillRect(ex + 5, ey + 3, 6, 2);
      // wings
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.enemy;
      ctx.fillRect(ex, ey + 5, 5, 4);

    }

    for (const b of bullets) {

      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(b.x) + 2, Math.floor(b.y) + 1, Math.floor(b.w) - 2, Math.floor(b.h) - 2);

    if (state === "play" || state === "win") {
      const px = Math.floor(player.x), py = Math.floor(player.y);
      const blink = player.invuln > 0 && (Math.floor(player.invuln / 4) % 2 === 0);
      if (!blink) {
        // body
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.fox;
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 3, 10, 8);

        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.fox;
        ctx.fillRect(px + 10, py + 1, 5, 6);
        // snout
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.foxLight;
        ctx.fillRect(px + 14, py + 3, 2, 3);
        // ear

        ctx.fillRect(px + 11, py, 2, 3);

        ctx.fillRect(px + 12, py + 3, 2, 2);

        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.foxLight;
        ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 7, 6, 4);
        // dark back
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.foxDark;
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 3, 3, 3);
        // tail (flapping)
        const tailY = py + (player.thrust ? 2 : 5);
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.fox;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 2, tailY, 5, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.foxLight;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 3, tailY + 1, 3, 2);
        // legs
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.foxDark;
        ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 11, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 9, py + 11, 3, 3);
        // jet flame when thrusting
        if (player.thrust) {
          ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bullet;

        }
      }

    // --- particles ---
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x), Math.floor(p.y), 2, 2);
    }

    // --- HUD ---
    if (state === "play") {
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.text;
      ctx.font = "bold 10px monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
      ctx.fillText("SCORE " + score, 6, 14);
      ctx.fillText("KILLS " + kills + "/" + WIN_KILLS, 6, 26);
      // lives
      for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.fox;
        ctx.fillRect(W - 14 - i * 14, 6, 10, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.foxDark;
        ctx.fillRect(W - 14 - i * 14 + 3, 4, 2, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(W - 14 - i * 14 + 7, 4, 2, 2);
      }
    }

    // --- title screen ---
    if (state === "title") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
      ctx.font = "bold 28px monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("SKYFOX", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.text;
      ctx.font = "bold 11px monospace";
      ctx.fillText("FLY. SHOOT. SURVIVE.", W / 2, H / 2 - 18);

      ctx.fillText("CLICK / HOLD - SHOOT", W / 2, H / 2 + 24);

      ctx.fillRect(fx + 2, fy + 3, 10, 8);

    // --- win screen ---
    if (state === "win") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      ctx.font = "11px monospace";
      ctx.fillText("[ PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO RETRY ]", W / 2, H / 2 + 28);

  }

  // ---------- CANVAS SETUP ----------
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  function resize() {
    const aspect = W / H;
    let cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
    if (cw / ch > aspect) {
      cw = ch * aspect;
    } else {
      ch = cw / aspect;
    }
    canvas.style.width = cw + "px";
    canvas.style.height = ch + "px";
    canvas.style.position = "absolute";
    canvas.style.left = ((window.innerWidth - cw) / 2) + "px";
    canvas.style.top = ((window.innerHeight - ch) / 2) + "px";
    canvas.width = W;
    canvas.height = H;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();
  initClouds();

  // ---------- MAIN LOOP ----------
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
