<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Rocket Ranger</title>
</head>
<body style="margin:0;background:#000;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh">
<canvas id="c" width="320" height="240" style="image-rendering:pixelated"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById("c");
const cx=cv.getContext("2d");
cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;

// ---- State ----
const W=320,H=240;
const G=0.28;
const player={x:160,y:100,vx:0,vy:0,face:1,onGround:false,alive:true,inv:0};
let score=0, lives=3, hi=0;
let enemies=[], bullets=[], ebullets=[], parts=[];
let state="start"; // start, play, win, lose
let tick=0;

// ---- Input ----
const keys={};
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if(["arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"," "].includes(e.key.toLowerCase()))e.preventDefault();
  if(e.key==="Enter"){
    if(state==="start"){state="play";reset();}
    else if(state==="win"||state==="lose"){state="start";}
  }
  if(e.key===" "&&state==="play"&&player.alive)shoot();
});
addEventListener("keyup",e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});

function shoot(){
  const dir=player.face;
  bullets.push({x:player.x+dir*14,y:player.y-2,vx:dir*4,vy:0,life:60});
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++)parts.push({x:player.x+dir*14,y:player.y, vx:dir*(1+Math.random()*2),vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*2,life:12,c:"#ffcc00"});
}

function reset(){
  player.x=160;player.y=100;player.vx=0;player.vy=0;player.alive=true;player.inv=0;
  enemies=[
    {x:80,y:150,dir:1,alive:true},
    {x:240,y:150,dir:-1,alive:true},
    {x:160,y:120,dir:1,alive:true}
  ];
  bullets=[];ebullets=[];parts=[];score=0;
}

// ---- Update ----
function update(){
  tick++;
  if(state!=="play")return;

  if(player.alive){
    const left=keys["arrowleft"]||keys["a"];
    const right=keys["arrowright"]||keys["d"];
    const up=keys["arrowup"]||keys["w"]||keys["z"];
    if(left){player.vx-=0.4;player.face=-1;}
    if(right){player.vx+=0.4;player.face=1;}
    if(up&&player.onGround){player.vy=-4.2;player.onGround=false;}
    player.vx*=0.82;
    if(player.vx<-2.2)player.vx=-2.2;
    if(player.vx>2.2)player.vx=2.2;
    player.vy+=G;
    player.x+=player.vx;
    player.y+=player.vy;
    if(player.x<14)player.x=14;
    if(player.x>W-14)player.x=W-14;
    if(player.y>150){player.y=150;player.vy=0;player.onGround=true;}
    if(player.inv>0)player.inv--;
  }

  // enemies
  for(const e of enemies){
    if(!e.alive)continue;
    e.x+=e.dir*0.6;
    if(e.x<20){e.x=20;e.dir=1;}
    if(e.x>W-20){e.x=W-20;e.dir=-1;}
    if(tick%90===0&&Math.random()<0.6){
      ebullets.push({x:e.x,y:e.y+4,vx:player.x>e.x?1.4:-1.4,vy:0,life:80});
    }
  }

  // bullets
  for(const b of bullets){
    b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;b.life--;
    for(const e of enemies){
      if(e.alive&&Math.abs(b.x-e.x)<10&&Math.abs(b.y-e.y)<10){
        e.alive=false;b.life=0;score+=100;
        for(let i=0;i<14;i++)parts.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*4,life:25,c:"#ff4422"});
      }
    }
  }
  bullets=bullets.filter(b=>b.life>0&&b.x>0&&b.x<W);

  // enemy bullets
  for(const b of ebullets){
    b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;b.life--;
    if(player.alive&&player.inv===0&&Math.abs(b.x-player.x)<9&&Math.abs(b.y-player.y)<9){
      hurt();b.life=0;
    }
  }
  ebullets=ebullets.filter(b=>b.life>0&&b.x>0&&b.x<W);

  // enemy contact
  if(player.alive&&player.inv===0){
    for(const e of enemies){
      if(e.alive&&Math.abs(e.x-player.x)<12&&Math.abs(e.y-player.y)<12){hurt();}
    }
  }

  // particles
  for(const p of parts){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.05;p.life--;}
  parts=parts.filter(p=>p.life>0);

  if(!player.alive){
    state="lose";
    if(score>hi)hi=score;
  }
  if(enemies.every(e=>!e.alive)){
    state="win";
    if(score>hi)hi=score;
  }
}

function hurt(){
  lives--;
  player.inv=60;
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++)parts.push({x:player.x,y:player.y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*4,life:20,c:"#ffffff"});
  if(lives<=0){player.alive=false;}
}

// ---- Draw ----
function px(x,y,w,h,c){cx.fillStyle=c;cx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);}

function drawBG(){
  // sky
  px(0,0,W,H,"#0b1e3a");
  // stars
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const sx=(i*53)%W, sy=(i*31)%140;
    if((i+Math.floor(tick/40))%2===0)px(sx,sy,1,1,"#ffffff");
  }
  // moon
  px(250,28,22,22,"#e8e8d0");
  px(254,32,4,4,"#b8b898");
  px(264,42,3,3,"#b8b898");
  // ground
  px(0,158,W,H-158,"#2b6b3a");
  px(0,158,W,4,"#3f8f4f");
  // ground bumps
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++)px(20+i*40,156,10,3,"#3f8f4f");
}

function drawRanger(){
  if(!player.alive)return;
  if(player.inv>0&&Math.floor(tick/4)%2===0)return;
  const x=Math.floor(player.x), y=Math.floor(player.y);
  const f=player.face;
  // backpack / rocket tank
  px(x-6*f-4,y-8,8,14,"#c0c0c0");
  px(x-6*f-4,y-8,8,3,"#888888");
  // body
  px(x-5,y-6,10,12,"#22aa44");
  px(x-5,y-6,10,3,"#1d8a3a");
  // helmet
  px(x-5,y-14,10,8,"#22aa44");
  px(x-3,y-12,6,4,"#e8e8d0"); // visor
  px(x-3,y-12,2,4,"#77d0ff");
  // legs
  px(x-4,y+6,3,6,"#1d8a3a");
  px(x+1,y+6,3,6,"#1d8a3a");
  // arm / gun
  px(x+f*3,y-2,5*f,3,"#22aa44");
  px(x+f*8,y-3,4,5,"#c0c0c0");
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  if(!e.alive)return;
  const x=Math.floor(e.x), y=Math.floor(e.y);
  // body
  px(x-9,y-6,18,14,"#cc2233");
  px(x-9,y-6,18,3,"#ff5566");
  // dome
  px(x-6,y-11,12,6,"#991122");
  px(x-4,y-10,8,3,"#ffcc00"); // visor
  // legs
  px(x-7,y+8,3,5,"#991122");
  px(x+4,y+8,3,5,"#991122");
  // eye
  px(x-2,y-9,4,2,"#ffffff");
}

function draw(){
  drawBG();
  for(const b of bullets)px(b.x-2,b.y-1,4,2,"#ffcc00");
  for(const b of ebullets)px(b.x-2,b.y-1,4,2,"#ff4422");
  for(const e of enemies)drawEnemy(e);
  drawRanger();
  for(const p of parts)px(p.x,p.y,2,2,p.c);

  // HUD
  px(4,4,80,14,"#000000");
  cx.fillStyle="#ffffff";cx.font="10px monospace";
  cx.fillText("SCORE "+score,8,14);
  cx.fillStyle="#ffcc00";
  cx.fillText("LIVES "+lives,110,14);

  if(state==="start"){
    cx.fillStyle="#000000";cx.fillRect(40,80,240,80);
    cx.fillStyle="#22aa44";cx.font="16px monospace";
    cx.fillText("ROCKET RANGER",80,105);
    cx.fillStyle="#ffffff";cx.font="10px monospace";
    cx.fillText("ARROWS/WASD MOVE  SPACE SHOOT",70,128);
    cx.fillStyle="#ffcc00";
    cx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO START",95,148);
  }
  if(state==="win"){
    cx.fillStyle="#000000";cx.fillRect(40,80,240,70);
    cx.fillStyle="#ffcc00";cx.font="16px monospace";
    cx.fillText("YOU WIN!",120,108);
    cx.fillStyle="#ffffff";cx.font="10px monospace";
    cx.fillText("SCORE "+score,120,130);
    cx.fillStyle="#22aa44";
    cx.fillText("ENTER = MENU",120,144);
  }
  if(state==="lose"){
    cx.fillStyle="#000000";cx.fillRect(40,80,240,70);
    cx.fillStyle="#cc2233";cx.font="16px monospace";
    cx.fillText("GAME OVER",110,108);
    cx.fillStyle="#ffffff";cx.font="10px monospace";
    cx.fillText("SCORE "+score,120,130);
    cx.fillStyle="#22aa44";
    cx.fillText("ENTER = MENU",120,144);
  }
}

// ---- Loop ----
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   HOVER BOVVER  —  a chunky 8-bit remake
   Drive the hover-bull across the arena, ram the cows,
   dodge the red spikes. 3 hits and you're done.
   ============================================================ */

const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

/* ---------- palette (6 solid colors) ---------- */
const COL = {
  bg:    '#12243c',   // dark teal arena
  border:'#0a1420',   // darker border
  white: '#f4f7ff',   // cow
  black: '#0b0b12',   // cow spots / eyes
  pink:  '#ff5f8f',   // cow muzzle / nose
  red:   '#ff3b30',   // spikes / danger
  green: '#39d98a',   // player accent
  yellow:'#ffd23f',    // score / highlight
};

/* ---------- state ---------- */
let state = 'title';   // 'title' | 'play' | 'over'
let score = 0;
let best  = 0;
let lives = 3;
let elapsed = 0;        // seconds in current run
let shake = 0;
let msgTimer = 0;
let msgText = '';

const player = { x: W/2, y: H*0.72, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 10, dir: 1, hover: 0, inv: 0 };

let cows = [];
let spikes = [];
let particles = [];

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const rand = (a,b)=> a + Math.random()*(b-a);
const clamp = (v,a,b)=> v<a?a:(v>b?b:v);

function resetGame(){
  score = 0; lives = 3; elapsed = 0;
  player.x = W/2; player.y = H*0.72; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0; player.inv = 1.2;
  particles = [];
  spikes = [];
  cows = [];
  // 3 cows start in the upper area
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) spawnCow();
  // 3 spikes
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) spawnSpike();
}

function spawnCow(){
  const x = rand(40, W-40), y = rand(30, 70);
  cows.push({ x, y, vx: rand(-1.4,1.4), vy: rand(-1.0,1.0),
               r: 11, hit: 0, wob: rand(0,6) });
}

function spawnSpike(){
  const x = rand(30, W-30), y = rand(100, H-24);
  spikes.push({ x, y, r: 9, spin: rand(0,6), grow: 0 });
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
const keys = {};
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  if (state !== 'play') {
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') { state = 'play'; resetGame(); }
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// basic touch / mouse move control
function pointTo(x,y){
  if (state === 'play'){
    player.tx = clamp(x, 20, W-20);
    player.ty = clamp(y, 20, H-20);
  }
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointTo((e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width), (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height));
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const t = e.touches[0];
  pointTo((t.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width), (t.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height));
}, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { if (state !== 'play'){ state='play'; resetGame(); } });

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt){
  if (state !== 'play') return;
  elapsed += dt;

  // --- player movement (keys) ---
  const sp = 130;
  let ax = 0, ay = 0;
  if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) ax -= 1;
  if (keys['arrowright']|| keys['d']) ax += 1;
  if (keys['arrowup']   || keys['w']) ay -= 1;
  if (keys['arrowdown'] || keys['s']) ay += 1;
  player.vx = ax * sp;
  player.vy = ay * sp;

  // pointer steering (smooth)
  if (player.tx !== undefined){
    const dx = player.tx - player.x, dy = player.ty - player.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if (d > 3){ player.vx += (dx/d) * 220 * dt * 60; player.vy += (dy/d) * 220 * dt * 60; }
  }
  // gentle damping when no input
  if (ax===0 && ay===0 && player.tx===undefined){ player.vx*=0.85; player.vy*=0.85; }

  player.x = clamp(player.x + player.vx*dt, player.r, W-player.r);
  player.y = clamp(player.y + player.vy*dt, player.r, H-player.r);
  if (player.vx > 2) player.dir = 1; else if (player.vx < -2) player.dir = -1;
  player.hover = Math.sin(elapsed*8)*1.5;
  if (player.inv > 0) player.inv -= dt;

  // --- cows wander + react to player ---
  for (const c of cows){
    c.wob += dt;
    // steer away from player if close
    const dx = c.x - player.x, dy = c.y - player.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if (d < 46 && d > 0.01){
      c.vx += (dx/d) * 90 * dt;
      c.vy += (dy/d) * 90 * dt;
    }
    // random drift
    c.vx += rand(-30,30)*dt; c.vy += rand(-30,30)*dt;
    // cap speed
    const s = Math.hypot(c.vx,c.vy);
    if (s > 70){ c.vx = c.vx/s*70; c.vy = c.vy/s*70; }
    c.x += c.vx*dt; c.y += c.vy*dt;
    // bounce off walls
    if (c.x < c.r){ c.x=c.r; c.vx*=-1; }
    if (c.x > W-c.r){ c.x=W-c.r; c.vx*=-1; }
    if (c.y < c.r){ c.y=c.r; c.vy*=-1; }
    if (c.y > H-c.r){ c.y=H-c.r; c.vy*=-1; }
    if (c.hit > 0) c.hit -= dt;
  }

  // --- spikes grow in ---
  for (const s of spikes){
    s.spin += dt*2;
    if (s.grow < 1) s.grow = Math.min(1, s.grow + dt*0.8);
  }

  // --- collisions: player vs cow (score) ---
  for (const c of cows){
    const d = Math.hypot(c.x-player.x, c.y-player.y);
    if (d < player.r + c.r && c.hit <= 0){
      c.hit = 0.6;
      score += 10;
      shake = 5;
      msgText = '+10'; msgTimer = 0.7;
      // knock the cow away
      const dx = c.x-player.x, dy = c.y-player.y;
      const dd = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      c.vx += (dx/dd)*90; c.vy += (dy/dd)*90;
      // splash particles
      for (let i=0;i<10;i++)
        particles.push({ x:c.x, y:c.y, vx:rand(-60,60), vy:rand(-60,60),
                         life:0.5, col: COL.white });
      // respawn a fresh cow
      spawnCow();
    }
  }

  // --- collisions: player vs spike (lose life) ---
  if (player.inv <= 0){
    for (const s of spikes){
      if (s.grow < 0.5) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(s.x-player.x, s.y-player.y);
      if (d < player.r + s.r*0.7){
        lives -= 1;
        player.inv = 1.4;
        shake = 9;
        msgText = 'OOF!'; msgTimer = 0.8;
        // scatter particles
        for (let i=0;i<14;i++)
          particles.push({ x:player.x, y:player.y, vx:rand(-90,90), vy:rand(-90,90),
                           life:0.6, col: COL.red });
        // nudge player away
        const dx = player.x-s.x, dy = player.y-s.y;
        const dd = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        player.x += (dx/dd)*14; player.y += (dy/dd)*14;
        if (lives <= 0){
          state = 'over';
          best = Math.max(best, score);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // --- particles ---
  for (let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
    p.vy += 60*dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt*30);
  if (msgTimer > 0) msgTimer -= dt;
}

/* ---------- draw ---------- */
function px(x,y,w,h,col){ ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),w,h); }

function drawBackground(){
  // arena floor
  px(0,0,W,H, COL.bg);
  // subtle grid
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)';
  for (let gx=0; gx<W; gx+=20) ctx.fillRect(gx,0,1,H);
  for (let gy=0; gy<H; gy+=20) ctx.fillRect(0,gy,W,1);
  // border
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.border;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,4); ctx.fillRect(0,H-4,W,4);
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,4,H); ctx.fillRect(W-4,4,H,H);
  // corner bolts
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.green;
  ctx.fillRect(6,6,3,3); ctx.fillRect(W-9,6,3,3);
  ctx.fillRect(6,H-9,3,3); ctx.fillRect(W-9,H-9,3,3);
}

function drawCow(c){
  const x = Math.round(c.x), y = Math.round(c.y);
  const flash = c.hit > 0;
  const body = flash ? COL.yellow : COL.white;
  const spot = COL.black;
  // shadow
  px(x-9, y+7, 18, 3, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)');
  // body (chunky oval made of rects)
  px(x-9, y-4, 18, 8, body);
  px(x-7, y-7, 14, 3, body);
  px(x-7, y+4, 14, 3, body);
  // head (front)
  const hx = x + (c.vx>=0? 7 : -7);
  px(hx-4, y-3, 8, 7, body);
  // muzzle
  px(hx-3, y+1, 6, 3, COL.pink);
  // nostrils
  px(hx-2, y+2, 1, 1, spot);
  px(hx+1, y+2, 1, 1, spot);
  // eyes
  px(hx-2, y-2, 2, 2, spot);
  px(hx+1, y-2, 2, 2, spot);
  // spots on body
  px(x-5, y-2, 3, 3, spot);
  px(x+2, y+1, 3, 2, spot);
  // horns
  px(hx-5, y-5, 2, 2, COL.yellow);
  px(hx+3, y-5, 2, 2, COL.yellow);
  // legs
  px(x-7, y+6, 2, 3, body);
  px(x+5, y+6, 2, 3, body);
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const x = Math.round(player.x), y = Math.round(player.y + player.hover);
  const blink = player.inv > 0 && (Math.floor(elapsed*12)%2===0);
  // shadow
  px(x-9, y+9, 18, 3, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)');
  if (!blink){
    // hover glow ring
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(57,217,138,0.25)';
    ctx.fillRect(x-11, y-2, 22, 12);
    // body (hover-bull)
    px(x-8, y-3, 16, 9, COL.green);
    px(x-6, y-6, 12, 3, COL.green);
    px(x-6, y+6, 12, 2, COL.green);
    // head
    const hx = x + player.dir*8;
    px(hx-4, y-3, 8, 8, COL.green);
    // face
    px(hx-3, y+1, 6, 3, COL.white);
    px(hx-2, y+2, 1, 1, COL.black);
    px(hx+1, y+2, 1, 1, COL.black);
    px(hx-2, y-2, 2, 2, COL.black);
    px(hx+1, y-2, 2, 2, COL.black);
    // horns
    px(hx-5, y-5, 2, 2, COL.yellow);
    px(hx+3, y-5, 2, 2, COL.yellow);
    // thrusters (hover jets)
    const j = Math.floor(elapsed*20)%2;
    px(x-7, y+8, 3, 2, j? COL.yellow : COL.white);
    px(x+4, y+8, 3, 2, j? COL.white : COL.yellow);
  }
}

function drawSpike(s){
  const x = Math.round(s.x), y = Math.round(s.y);
  const g = s.grow;
  const sz = Math.round(9*g);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.rotate(s.spin);
  // red spike star
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.red;
  for (let i=0;i<4;i++){
    ctx.rotate(Math.PI/2);
    ctx.fillRect(-1, -sz, 2, sz);
    ctx.fillRect(-sz, -1, sz, 2);
  }
  // center
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
  ctx.fillRect(-2,-2,4,4);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles(){
  for (const p of particles){
    ctx.fillStyle = p.col;
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life*2,0,1);
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x), Math.round(p.y), 2, 2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD(){
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
  ctx.font = 'bold 12px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + String(score).padStart(4,'0'), 12, 10);
  // best
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.fillText('BEST ' + String(best).padStart(4,'0'), 12, 24);
  // lives as little hearts
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const lx = W-16 - i*14, ly = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? COL.pink : COL.border;
    ctx.fillRect(lx, ly, 6, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(lx+8, ly, 6, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(lx, ly+4, 14, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(lx+2, ly+8, 10, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(lx+4, ly+10, 6, 2);
  }
  // floating message
  if (msgTimer > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(msgText, W/2, 40);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
}

function drawTitle(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.green;
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('HOVER', W/2, 52);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
  ctx.fillText('BOVVER', W/2, 78);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('RAM THE COWS. DODGE THE SPIKES.', W/2, 104);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.pink;
  ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD  OR  DRAG TO FLY', W/2, 118);
  if (Math.floor(elapsed*2)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W/2, 140);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.red;
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, W/2, 90);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
  ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('BEST ' + best, W/2, 106);
  if (Math.floor(elapsed*2)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.green;
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RETRY', W/2, 132);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0){
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake), rand(-shake,shake));
  }
  drawBackground();
  for (const s of spikes) drawSpike(s);
  for (const c of cows) drawCow(c);
  drawPlayer();
  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();
  if (state === 'play') drawHUD();
  if (state === 'title') drawTitle();
  if (state === 'over') drawOver();
}

/* ---------- main loop ---------- */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;   // clamp big gaps
  elapsed += dt;                 // used for title blink even in title
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

    player.anim = 0;
    player.drill = 0;
  }

  function newGame() {
    initGrid();
    resetPlayer();
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    drop = null;
    flash = 0;
    shake = 0;
    winFlash = 0;
    loseFlash = 0;
    state = "play";
  }

  // --- Input ---
  const keys = {};
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    keys[e.key] = true;
    if (state === "title" && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) {
      newGame();
    } else if (state === "win" || state === "lose") {
      if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") {
        state = "title";
      }
    } else if (state === "play") {
      if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") {
        drill();
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "a" || e.key === "A") {
        move(-1);
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "d" || e.key === "D") {
        move(1);
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "w" || e.key === "W") {
        moveUp();
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") {
        moveDown();
      }
    }
    if (["ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","ArrowUp","ArrowDown"," "].includes(e.key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener("keyup", function(e) {
    keys[e.key] = false;
  });

  function inBounds(x, y) {
    return x >= 0 && x < COLS && y >= 0 && y < ROWS;
  }

  function move(dx) {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    const nx = player.x + dx;
    if (!inBounds(nx, player.y)) return;
    if (grid[player.y][nx] === GROUND) return;
    player.x = nx;
    player.dir = dx;
  }

  function moveUp() {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    const ny = player.y - 1;
    if (!inBounds(player.x, ny)) return;
    if (grid[ny][player.x] === GROUND) return;
    player.y = ny;
  }

  function moveDown() {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    const ny = player.y + 1;
    if (!inBounds(player.x, ny)) return;
    if (grid[ny][player.x] === GROUND) return;
    player.y = ny;
  }

  function drill() {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    const dx = player.x + player.dir;
    if (!inBounds(dx, player.y)) return;
    if (grid[player.y][dx] === GROUND) {
      grid[player.y][dx] = AIR;
      score += 10;
      player.drill = 6;
      // Check if this creates a hole under the player
      const below = player.y + 1;
      if (inBounds(player.x, below) && grid[below][player.x] === AIR) {
        // Player will fall
        startFall();
      }
      // Also check if drilling removed support under something
      checkStructural();
    }
  }

  function startFall() {
    if (drop) return;
    drop = { x: player.x, y: player.y, vy: 0.3 };
    state = "falling";
  }

  function checkStructural() {
    // Simple: for each ground tile, if all 4 neighbors (up, down, left, right) are AIR, it becomes AIR
    let changed = true;
    let iterations = 0;
    while (changed && iterations < 20) {
      changed = false;
      iterations++;
      for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
          if (grid[y][x] === GROUND) {
            const up = inBounds(x, y-1) ? grid[y-1][x] : AIR;
            const down = inBounds(x, y+1) ? grid[y+1][x] : AIR;
            const left = inBounds(x-1, y) ? grid[y][x-1] : AIR;
            const right = inBounds(x+1, y) ? grid[y][x+1] : AIR;
            if (up === AIR && down === AIR && left === AIR && right === AIR) {
              grid[y][x] = AIR;
              changed = true;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // Check if player is now in air with no support
    if (state === "play") {
      const below = player.y + 1;
      if (inBounds(player.x, below) && grid[below][player.x] === AIR) {
        startFall();
      }
    }
  }

  function checkWin() {
    // Win if the bottom row is all AIR
    for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
      if (grid[ROWS-1][x] !== AIR) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function update() {
    frames++;

    if (state === "falling" && drop) {
      drop.vy += 0.15;
      drop.y += drop.vy;
      shake = 3;
      if (drop.y >= ROWS) {
        lives--;
        shake = 0;
        if (lives <= 0) {
          state = "lose";
          loseFlash = 30;
        } else {
          state = "play";
          resetPlayer();
          drop = null;
          checkStructural();
        }
      }
    }

    if (state === "play") {
      // Auto-drill if holding direction
      if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["a"] || keys["A"]) {
        if (player.dir !== -1) {
          player.dir = -1;
          drill();
        }
      }
      if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["d"] || keys["D"]) {
        if (player.dir !== 1) {
          player.dir = 1;
          drill();
        }
      }
      // Check win
      if (checkWin()) {
        state = "win";
        winFlash = 30;
        score += 100;
      }
    }

    if (flash > 0) flash--;
    if (shake > 0) shake--;
    if (winFlash > 0) winFlash--;
    if (loseFlash > 0) loseFlash--;
    if (player.drill > 0) player.drill--;
    player.anim = (frames % 30) / 30;
  }

  // --- Draw ---
  function drawTile(x, y, type) {
    const px = PX + x * TILE;
    const py = PY + y * TILE;
    const t = (x * 7 + y * 13) % 4;

    if (type === GROUND) {
      // Dark ground with texture
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.ground;
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.ground2;
      if (t === 0) {
        ctx.fillRect(px+2, py+2, 4, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(px+10, py+8, 4, 4);
      } else if (t === 1) {
        ctx.fillRect(px+4, py+6, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(px+11, py+3, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(px+6, py+12, 3, 3);
      } else if (t === 2) {
        ctx.fillRect(px+1, py+8, 5, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(px+9, py+1, 4, 3);
      } else {
        ctx.fillRect(px+3, py+3, 3, 5);
        ctx.fillRect(px+10, py+9, 3, 4);
      }
      // Edge highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4a4a4a";
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, 1, TILE);
    } else if (type === AIR) {
      // Dark air
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.bg;
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, TILE);
      // Subtle depth
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
      ctx.fillRect(px+1, py+1, TILE-2, TILE-2);
    } else if (type === WALL) {
      // Solid wall
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.wall;
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.wall2;
      ctx.fillRect(px+1, py+1, TILE-2, TILE-2);
      // Brick lines
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.wall;
      ctx.fillRect(px, py+7, TILE, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(px+7, py, 2, TILE);
      // Top highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8a8a";
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, 1);
    } else if (type === BRIDGE) {
      // Bridge / thin support
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.bridge;
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.bridge2;
      ctx.fillRect(px+2, py+2, TILE-4, TILE-4);
      // Cross pattern
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.bridge;
      ctx.fillRect(px+6, py, 4, TILE);
      ctx.fillRect(px, py+6, TILE, 4);
      // Top highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = "#a0a0a0";
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, 1, TILE);
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const px = PX + player.x * TILE;
    const py = PY + player.y * TILE;
    const cx = px + TILE/2;
    const cy = py + TILE/2;
    const bob = Math.sin(player.anim * Math.PI * 2) * 1.5;

    // Body (white rounded shape)
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player;
    // Head
    ctx.fillRect(cx-5, cy-8 + bob, 10, 6);
    // Body
    ctx.fillRect(cx-4, cy-2 + bob, 8, 8);
    // Arms
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player2;
    if (player.dir === 1) {
      // Right arm extended
      ctx.fillRect(cx+4, cy-1 + bob, 5, 3);
      // Left arm
      ctx.fillRect(cx-8, cy-1 + bob, 4, 3);
    } else {
      // Left arm extended
      ctx.fillRect(cx-9, cy-1 + bob, 5, 3);
      // Right arm
      ctx.fillRect(cx+4, cy-1 + bob, 4, 3);
    }
    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player3;
    ctx.fillRect(cx-4, cy+6 + bob, 3, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(cx+1, cy+6 + bob, 3, 4);

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
    if (player.dir === 1) {
      ctx.fillRect(cx-1, cy-6 + bob, 2, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(cx+2, cy-6 + bob, 2, 2);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(cx-3, cy-6 + bob, 2, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(cx, cy-6 + bob, 2, 2);
    }

    // Drill indicator
    if (player.drill > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      const dx = px + (player.dir === 1 ? TILE : 0);
      const dy = py + 6;
      // Spark
      ctx.fillRect(dx + (player.dir===1?0:TILE-2), dy, 2, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(dx + (player.dir===1?2:TILE-4), dy+2, 2, 2);
    }
  }

  function drawDrop() {
    if (!drop) return;
    const px = PX + drop.x * TILE;
    const py = PY + drop.y * TILE;
    // Falling player (spinning)
    const rot = Math.floor(frames / 3) % 4;
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player;
    if (rot === 0) {
      ctx.fillRect(px+4, py+2, 8, 12);
    } else if (rot === 1) {
      ctx.fillRect(px+2, py+4, 12, 8);
    } else if (rot === 2) {
      ctx.fillRect(px+4, py+2, 8, 12);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(px+2, py+4, 12, 8);
    }
    // Trail
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player3;
    ctx.fillRect(px+6, py-8, 4, 8);
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.panel;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, PY);
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.panel2;
    ctx.fillRect(0, PY-2, W, 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
    ctx.font = "10px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE", 4, 12);
    ctx.fillText(String(score).padStart(6, "0"), 40, 12);

    // Lives
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("LIVES", W-50, 12);
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.life;
      ctx.fillRect(W - 40 + i * 12, 4, 8, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.player3;
      ctx.fillRect(W - 40 + i * 12 + 2, 6, 4, 4);
    }

    // Title bar
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.accent;
    ctx.font = "10px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
    ctx.fillText("DRILLER", W/2, 12);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Background pattern
    for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
        const px = PX + x * TILE;
        const py = PY + y * TILE;
        const t = (x * 7 + y * 13) % 4;
        ctx.fillStyle = t === 0 ? colors.ground2 : colors.bg;
        ctx.fillRect(px, py, TILE, TILE);
        if (t === 1) {
          ctx.fillStyle = colors.ground;
          ctx.fillRect(px+2, py+2, 4, 4);
        }
      }
    }

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("DRILLER", W/2, 70);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player2;
    ctx.font = "10px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("A 8-BIT DRILLING GAME", W/2, 90);

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
    ctx.font = "10px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("ARROWS / WASD - MOVE", W/2, 120);
    ctx.fillText("HOLD DIRECTION TO DRILL", W/2, 135);
    ctx.fillText("REACH THE BOTTOM TO WIN", W/2, 150);

    // Blinking prompt
    if (Math.floor(frames / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
      ctx.font = "bold 12px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE TO START", W/2, 185);
    }

    // Decorative player
    const cx = W/2;
    const cy = 210;
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player;
    ctx.fillRect(cx-5, cy-8, 10, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(cx-4, cy-2, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.player3;
    ctx.fillRect(cx-4, cy+6, 3, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(cx+1, cy+6, 3, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
    ctx.fillRect(cx-1, cy-6, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(cx+2, cy-6, 2, 2);
  }

  function drawWin() {
    // Flash
    if (winFlash > 0 && winFlash % 6 < 3) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("YOU WIN!", W/2, 100);
    ctx.font = "12px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, W/2, 125);
    if (Math.floor(frames / 20) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.font = "10px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE FOR TITLE", W/2, 155);
    }
  }

  function drawLose() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(136,0,0,0.4)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W/2, 100);
    ctx.font = "12px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, W/2, 125);
    if (Math.floor(frames / 20) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.font = "10px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE FOR TITLE", W/2, 155);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    // Clear
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (state === "title") {
      drawTitle();
      return;
    }

    // Shake offset
    let ox = 0, oy = 0;
    if (shake > 0) {
      ox = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
      oy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(Math.round(ox), Math.round(oy));

    // Draw grid
    for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
        drawTile(x, y, grid[y][x]);
      }
    }

    // Draw player
    if (state === "play" || state === "falling") {
      if (state === "play") {
        drawPlayer();
      } else {
        drawDrop();
      }
    }

    ctx.restore();

    // HUD
    drawHUD();

    // Overlays
    if (state === "win") drawWin();
    if (state === "lose") drawLose();
  }

  // --- Main loop ---
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // Init
  initGrid();
  resetPlayer();
  loop();

})();

<script>
"use strict";

// ---------- CONFIG ----------
const W = 480, H = 640;
const PADDLE_W = 90, PADDLE_H = 16;
const BALL_R = 7;
const ROWS = 5, COLS = 8;
const BRICK_W = 50, BRICK_H = 22, GAP = 6;
const BRICK_TOP = 70;
const START_SPEED = 3.4;

const ROW_COLORS = [0xff5252, 0xffa726, 0xffe082, 0x66bb6a, 0x42a5f5];

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state = "start"; // start, play, win, lose
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let paddle = { x: W/2, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H, y: H-40 };
let ball = { x: W/2, y: paddle.y - 20, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: START_SPEED, stuck: true };
let bricks = [];
let particles = [];
let shake = 0;
let keys = { left:false, right:false };
let mouseX = null;

// ---------- PIXI SETUP ----------
const app = new PIXI.Application({ width: W, height: H, backgroundColor: 0x0b1020, antialias: true });
document.getElementById("game").appendChild(app.view);

// Background
const bg = new PIXI.Graphics();
bg.beginFill(0x0b1020); bg.drawRect(0,0,W,H); bg.endFill();
bg.beginFill(0x101a3a); bg.drawRect(0,0,W,120); bg.endFill();
bg.beginFill(0x0e1630); bg.drawRect(0,H-70,W,70); bg.endFill();
app.stage.addChild(bg);

// Decorative side accents
const side = new PIXI.Graphics();
side.beginFill(0x22305f); side.drawRect(0,0,10,H); side.drawRect(W-10,0,10,H); side.endFill();
app.stage.addChild(side);

// HUD
const hud = new PIXI.Container();
app.stage.addChild(hud);

const scoreText = new PIXI.Text("SCORE 0", { fontFamily:"Arial", fontSize:22, fill:0xffffff, fontWeight:"bold" });
scoreText.x = 20; scoreText.y = 14;
const livesText = new PIXI.Text("LIVES 3", { fontFamily:"Arial", fontSize:22, fill:0xffd166, fontWeight:"bold" });
livesText.x = W-150; livesText.y = 14;
hud.addChild(scoreText, livesText);

// Message overlay
const overlay = new PIXI.Container();
overlay.visible = false;
app.stage.addChild(overlay);

const msgTitle = new PIXI.Text("", { fontFamily:"Arial", fontSize:44, fill:0xffffff, fontWeight:"bold", align:"center" });
const msgSub = new PIXI.Text("", { fontFamily:"Arial", fontSize:20, fill:0xbcd0ff, align:"center" });
msgTitle.anchor.set(0.5); msgSub.anchor.set(0.5);
overlay.addChild(msgTitle, msgSub);

// Game objects
const paddleG = new PIXI.Graphics();
const ballG = new PIXI.Graphics();
const brickLayer = new PIXI.Container();
const particleLayer = new PIXI.Container();
app.stage.addChild(brickLayer, paddleG, ballG, particleLayer);

// ---------- BUILD BRICKS ----------
function buildBricks(){
  for (let i = brickLayer.children.length-1; i >= 0; i--) brickLayer.removeChildAt(i).destroy();
  bricks = [];
  const totalW = COLS*BRICK_W + (COLS-1)*GAP;
  const startX = (W - totalW)/2;
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++){
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++){
      const x = startX + c*(BRICK_W+GAP);
      const y = BRICK_TOP + r*(BRICK_H+GAP);
      const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
      g.beginFill(ROW_COLORS[r]);

      g.endFill();
      // highlight
      g.beginFill(0xffffff, 0.25);
      g.drawRoundedRect(x+3, y+3, BRICK_W-6, 6, 3);
      g.endFill();
      brickLayer.addChild(g);
      bricks.push({ x, y, w:BRICK_W, h:BRICK_H, g, alive:true });

function updateShip(dt) {

      if (dist2(b, a) < (a.r + 3) * (a.r + 3)) {
        bullets.splice(bi, 1);
        b.g.destroy({ children: true });
        destroyAsteroid(ai);
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // ship vs asteroids
  if (ship.alive) {
    for (let ai = asteroids.length - 1; ai >= 0; ai--) {
      const a = asteroids[ai];
      if (dist2(ship, a) < (a.r + 12) * (a.r + 12)) {
        destroyAsteroid(ai);
        explodeShip();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // win condition
  if (state === "play" && asteroids.length === 0) {
    if (wave >= 5) winGame();
    else {
      wave++;
      spawnWave();
      updateHUD();
    }
  }
}

function destroyAsteroid(index) {
  const a = asteroids[index];
  spawnExplosion(a.x, a.y, 0x8fd6ff, 18);
  a.g.destroy({ children: true });
  asteroids.splice(index, 1);

  const pts = a.size === 2 ? 20 : a.size === 1 ? 50 : 100;
  score += pts;
  updateHUD();

  if (a.size > 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const child = { x: a.x, y: a.y, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
      const n = spawnAsteroid(a.size - 1);
      const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 60 + Math.random() * 60;
      n.vx += Math.cos(ang) * sp;
      n.vy += Math.sin(ang) * sp;
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RESIZE
   ============================================================ */
function onResize() {
  const w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
  app.renderer.resize(w, h);
  W = w; H = h;
  // rebuild background to cover new size
  bgStars.destroy({ children: true });
  buildBackground();
  app.stage.addChildAt(bgStars, 0);
  // reposition HUD
  livesText.x = W - 18;
  titleText.x = W/2; titleText.y = H/2 - 96;
  promptText.x = W/2; promptText.y = H/2 - 20;
  scoreText2.x = W/2; scoreText2.y = H/2 + 28;
  subText.x = W/2; subText.y = H/2 + 74;
}

/* ============================================================
   BOOT
   ============================================================ */
window.addEventListener("load", () => {
  init();
  showOverlay("ASTEROIDS", "Press ENTER to start", "", "Arrows / WASD to steer · Space to fire · P to pause");
});
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Balloon Fight</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden; background: #0a1420;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@7.4.2/dist/pixi.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  /* ============================================================
     STATE
  ============================================================ */
  var W = 0, H = 0;
  var app, world, ui;
  var state = 'title';           // title | play | win | lose
  var score = 0, kills = 0, total = 0;
  var time = 0;
  var shake = 0;

  var player = null;
  var bullets = [];
  var enemies = [];
  var parts  = [];
  var clouds = [];
  var stars  = [];
  var wind = 0;
  var fireCd = 0;
  var keys = { l:false, r:false, up:false, down:false, fire:false };

  var COLORS = {
    skyTop: 0x1a2f6e, skyMid: 0x3b5bb0, skyBot: 0x8fb6e8,
    gold: 0xffd24a, red: 0xe8412f, blue: 0x3d7be0,
    green: 0x46c06a, purple: 0x9b5de5, white: 0xffffff,
    dark: 0x0b1626, sun: 0xfff2a8
  };

  function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
  function pick(arr){ return arr[(Math.random()*arr.length)|0]; }

  /* ============================================================
     SETUP
  ============================================================ */
  function resize(){
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    app.renderer.resize(W, H);
    rebuildSky();
    rebuildStars();
    if(player){
      player.position.x = Math.max(40, Math.min(W-40, player.position.x));
      player.position.y = Math.max(60, Math.min(H-60, player.position.y));
    }
  }

  function rebuildSky(){
    // background gradient drawn into a full-screen Graphics
    if(!world) return;
    var g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    g.beginFill(COLORS.skyTop).drawRect(0,0,W,H*0.35);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(COLORS.skyMid).drawRect(0,H*0.35,W,H*0.3);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(COLORS.skyBot).drawRect(0,H*0.65,W,H*0.35);
    g.endFill();
    world.addChildAt(g, 0);
  }

  function rebuildStars(){
    stars.length = 0;
    for(var i=0;i<60;i++){
      var s = new PIXI.Graphics();
      var r = rand(0.5,1.6);
      s.beginFill(0xffffff, rand(0.25,0.8)).drawCircle(0,0,r).endFill();
      s.position.set(rand(0,W), rand(0,H*0.5));
      s.t = rand(0, Math.PI*2);
      stars.push(s);
      world.addChild(s);
    }
  }

  function init(){
    app = new PIXI.Application({
      width: W, height: H,
      antialias: true,
      backgroundAlpha: 1,
      resolution: Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1),
      autoDensity: true
    });
    document.getElementById('game').appendChild(app.view);

    world = new PIXI.Container();
    ui    = new PIXI.Container();
    app.stage.addChild(world);
    app.stage.addChild(ui);

    rebuildSky();
    rebuildStars();
    buildClouds();

    // ground
    var ground = new PIXI.Graphics();
    ground.beginFill(0x2f7d4f).drawRect(0, H-28, W, 28);
    ground.endFill();
    ground.beginFill(0x256540).drawRect(0, H-28, W, 6);
    ground.endFill();
    world.addChild(ground);

    buildTitle();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    bindInput();
    app.ticker.add(tick);
  }

  /* ---------- clouds ---------- */
  function makeCloud(x,y,s){
    var c = new PIXI.Graphics();
    var puff = function(px,py,r){
      c.beginFill(0xffffff, 0.9).drawCircle(px,py,r).endFill();
      c.beginFill(0xeaf2ff, 0.5).drawCircle(px-r*0.2,py+r*0.2,r*0.7).endFill();
    };
    puff(-30*s, 5*s, 22*s);
    puff(0, -8*s, 30*s);
    puff(34*s, 6*s, 24*s);
    puff(8*s, 12*s, 20*s);
    c.position.set(x,y);
    c.speed = rand(0.15,0.5)*s;
    c.s = s;
    return c;
  }
  function buildClouds(){
    for(var i=0;i<7;i++){
      var s = rand(0.6,1.4);
      var c = makeCloud(rand(0,W), rand(40,H*0.55), s);
      clouds.push(c);
      world.addChild(c);
    }
  }

  /* ---------- player ---------- */
  function buildPlayer(){
    var p = new PIXI.Container();
    var g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    // body
    g.beginFill(0xffd24a).drawEllipse(0,0,16,20).endFill();
    // wings
    g.beginFill(0xffffff).drawEllipse(-14,-2,9,6).drawEllipse(14,-2,9,6).endFill();
    // face
    g.beginFill(0x0b1626).drawCircle(-5,-4,2.4).drawCircle(5,-4,2.4).endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xe8412f).drawCircle(0,3,3).endFill();
    p.addChild(g);
    p.g = g;
    p.vy = 0; p.vx = 0;
    p.wing = 0;
    return p;
  }

  /* ---------- enemies ---------- */
  function buildEnemy(x, y, color){
    var e = new PIXI.Container();
    var g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    // balloon body
    g.beginFill(color).drawEllipse(0,-4,14,18).endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff,0.5).drawEllipse(-5,-12,4,6).endFill();
    // knot
    g.beginFill(color).drawCircle(0,14,3).endFill();
    // angry face
    g.beginFill(0x0b1626).drawCircle(-4,-4,2.2).drawCircle(4,-4,2.2).endFill();
    g.lineStyle(2,0x0b1626);
    g.moveTo(-6,-9); g.lineTo(-2,-7);
    g.moveTo(6,-9); g.lineTo(2,-7);
    g.moveTo(-3,4); g.quadraticCurveTo(0,2,3,4);
    g.endFill();
    e.addChild(g);
    e.g = g;
    e.color = color;
    e.x = x; e.y = y;
    e.vx = rand(-0.6,0.6);
    e.vy = 0;
    e.baseY = y;
    e.t = rand(0, Math.PI*2);
    e.hp = 1;
    return e;
  }

  /* ---------- particles ---------- */
  function burst(x,y,color,n){
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var a = rand(0,Math.PI*2), sp = rand(1,5);
      var p = new PIXI.Graphics();
      var sz = rand(2,5);
      p.beginFill(color).drawCircle(0,0,sz).endFill();
      p.position.set(x,y);
      p.vx = Math.cos(a)*sp; p.vy = Math.sin(a)*sp;
      p.life = rand(20,40);
      parts.push(p);
      world.addChild(p);
    }
  }
  function smoke(x,y){
    var p = new PIXI.Graphics();
    var sz = rand(3,7);
    p.beginFill(0xffffff,0.6).drawCircle(0,0,sz).endFill();
    p.position.set(x,y);
    p.vx = rand(-0.5,0.5); p.vy = rand(-1.5,-0.3);
    p.life = rand(15,30);
    parts.push(p);
    world.addChild(p);
  }

  /* ---------- UI text ---------- */
  function makeText(str, size, color, bold){
    var t = new PIXI.Text(str, {
      fontFamily: 'Trebuchet MS, sans-serif',
      fontSize: size,
      fill: color,
      fontWeight: bold ? 'bold' : 'normal',
      stroke: 0x0b1626,
      strokeThickness: size>24 ? 4 : 2
    });
    t.anchor.set(0.5);
    return t;
  }

  /* ---------- title / overlays ---------- */
  var titleLayer, banner, bannerSub, scoreLabel, killLabel;
  function buildTitle(){
    titleLayer = new PIXI.Container();
    ui.addChild(titleLayer);

    // big title
    var t1 = makeText('BALLOON', 58, COLORS.gold, true);
    t1.y = H*0.30;
    var t2 = makeText('FIGHT', 58, COLORS.red, true);
    t2.y = H*0.30 + 60;
    titleLayer.addChild(t1, t2);

    bannerSub = makeText('Pop every balloon to win!', 22, COLORS.white, false);
    bannerSub.y = H*0.30 + 120;
    titleLayer.addChild(bannerSub);

    banner = makeText('PRESS  SPACE  /  TAP  TO  START', 26, COLORS.green, true);
    banner.y = H*0.72;
    titleLayer.addChild(banner);

    var hint = makeText('Arrows / WASD to fly  •  Space to shoot  •  Aim with mouse', 16, 0xcfe0ff, false);
    hint.y = H*0.80;
    titleLayer.addChild(hint);
  }

  function showBanner(main, sub, color){
    banner = makeText(main, 46, color, true);
    banner.y = H*0.34;
    bannerSub = makeText(sub, 22, COLORS.white, false);
    bannerSub.y = H*0.34 + 54;
    titleLayer.addChild(banner, bannerSub);
  }

  function hud(){
    scoreLabel = makeText('SCORE 0', 24, COLORS.gold, true);
    scoreLabel.anchor.set(0,0.5);
    scoreLabel.position.set(20, 30);
    killLabel = makeText('BALLOONS 0/0', 20, COLORS.white, false);
    killLabel.anchor.set(0,0.5);
    killLabel.position.set(W-20, 30);
    killLabel.anchor.set(1,0.5);
    ui.addChild(scoreLabel, killLabel);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     GAME FLOW
  ============================================================ */
  function startGame(){
    // clear
    bullets.forEach(b=>world.removeChild(b)); bullets.length=0;
    enemies.forEach(e=>world.removeChild(e)); enemies.length=0;
    parts.forEach(p=>world.removeChild(p)); parts.length=0;
    titleLayer.removeChildren();

    player = buildPlayer();
    player.position.set(W*0.5, H*0.6);
    world.addChild(player);

    score = 0; kills = 0;
    total = 12;
    hud();
    state = 'play';
    spawnWave();
  }

  function spawnWave(){
    // spawn remaining balloons from the top
    var remaining = total - kills;
    for(var i=0;i<remaining;i++){
      var x = rand(60, W-60);
      var y = rand(-40, -200) + i*10;
      var color = pick([COLORS.red, COLORS.blue, COLORS.green, COLORS.purple, COLORS.gold]);
      var e = buildEnemy(x, y, color);
      enemies.push(e);
      world.addChild(e);
    }
  }

  function win(){
    state = 'win';
    showBanner('YOU WIN!', 'All ' + total + ' balloons popped  •  Score ' + score, COLORS.gold);
  }
  function lose(){
    state = 'lose';
    showBanner('GAME OVER', 'You got popped  •  Score ' + score, COLORS.red);
    // respawn hint
    var r = makeText('Press SPACE / TAP to try again', 20, COLORS.white, false);
    r.y = H*0.34 + 96;
    titleLayer.addChild(r);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     INPUT
  ============================================================ */
  function bindInput(){
    window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if(k==='arrowleft'||k==='a') keys.l=true;
      if(k==='arrowright'||k==='d') keys.r=true;
      if(k==='arrowup'||k==='w') keys.up=true;
      if(k==='arrowdown'||k==='s') keys.down=true;
      if(k===' '){
        keys.fire=true;
        e.preventDefault();
        if(state==='title') startGame();
        else if(state==='win'||state==='lose') startGame();
      }
      if(k==='r' && (state==='play'||state==='win'||state==='lose')) startGame();
    });
    window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
      var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if(k==='arrowleft'||k==='a') keys.l=false;
      if(k==='arrowright'||k==='d') keys.r=false;
      if(k==='arrowup'||k==='w') keys.up=false;
      if(k==='arrowdown'||k==='s') keys.down=false;
      if(k===' ') keys.fire=false;
    });

    var cv = app.view;
    function ptr(e){
      var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
    }
    cv.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
      if(player && state==='play') player.aim = ptr(e);
    });
    cv.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
      if(state==='title'||state==='win'||state==='lose'){ startGame(); return; }
      keys.fire = true;
      if(player) player.aim = ptr(e);
    });
    cv.addEventListener('mouseup', function(){ keys.fire=false; });
    cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(state==='title'||state==='win'||state==='lose'){ startGame(); return; }
      keys.fire = true;
      if(player && e.touches[0]) player.aim = ptr(e.touches[0]);
    }, {passive:false});
    cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
      if(player && e.touches[0]) player.aim = ptr(e.touches[0]);
    }, {passive:false});
    cv.addEventListener('touchend', function(){ keys.fire=false; });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     UPDATE
  ============================================================ */
  function tick(){
    time += 0.016;
    updateStars();
    updateClouds();
    if(state==='play') updatePlay();
    updateParts();
    if(shake>0){
      world.position.set(rand(-shake,shake), rand(-shake,shake));
      shake *= 0.9;
      if(shake<0.3) shake=0;
    } else world.position.set(0,0);
  }

  function updateStars(){
    for(var i=0;i<stars.length;i++){
      var s = stars[i];
      s.t += 0.05;
      s.alpha = 0.35 + 0.45*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.t));
    }
  }
  function updateClouds(){
    for(var i=0;i<clouds.length;i++){
      var c = clouds[i];
      c.position.x += c.speed;
      if(c.position.x > W + 120) c.position.x = -120;
    }
  }

  function updatePlay(){
    // --- player movement ---
    var acc = 0.45, maxv = 5.2;
    if(keys.l) player.vx -= acc;
    if(keys.r) player.vx += acc;
    if(keys.up) player.vy -= acc;
    if(keys.down) player.vy += acc;
    player.vx *= 0.92; player.vy *= 0.92;
    player.vx = Math.max(-maxv, Math.min(maxv, player.vx));
    player.vy = Math.max(-maxv, Math.min(maxv, player.vy));
    player.position.x += player.vx;
    player.position.y += player.vy;
    player.position.x = Math.max(28, Math.min(W-28, player.position.x));
    player.position.y = Math.max(40, Math.min(H-44, player.position.y));

    // tilt by velocity + wing flap
    player.wing += 0.35;
    var tilt = player.vx*0.06 + Math.sin(player.wing)*0.05;
    player.g.rotation = tilt;
    var wingScale = 1 + Math.sin(player.wing)*0.25;
    player.g.scale.set(1, wingScale);

    // exhaust smoke
    if(Math.random()<0.4) smoke(player.position.x - player.vx*2, player.position.y + 18);

    // --- firing ---
    fireCd -= 0.016;
    if(keys.fire && fireCd<=0 && player.aim){
      fireBullet();
      fireCd = 0.22;
    }

    updateBullets();
    updateEnemies();

    // player-enemy collision
    for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++){
      var e = enemies[i];
      if(dist(player.position, e.position) < 30){
        lose();
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  function fireBullet(){
    var a = player.aim;
    var dx = a.x - player.position.x, dy = a.y - player.position.y;
    var len = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
    var b = new PIXI.Graphics();
    b.beginFill(0xfff2a8).drawCircle(0,0,5).endFill();
    b.beginFill(0xffd24a).drawCircle(0,0,3).endFill();
    b.position.set(player.position.x + dx/len*20, player.position.y + dy/len*20);
    b.vx = dx/len*11; b.vy = dy/len*11;
    b.life = 90;
    bullets.push(b);
    world.addChild(b);
    // muzzle flash
    var f = new PIXI.Graphics();
    f.beginFill(0xffffff,0.8).drawCircle(0,0,8).endFill();
    f.position.set(b.position.x, b.position.y);
    f.life = 8;
    parts.push(f);
    world.addChild(f);
  }

  function updateBullets(){
    for(var i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var b = bullets[i];
      b.position.x += b.vx;
      b.position.y += b.vy;
      b.life--;
      if(b.life<=0 || b.position.x<-20 || b.position.x>W+20 || b.position.y<-20 || b.position.y>H+20){
        world.removeChild(b);
        bullets.splice(i,1);
        continue;
      }
      // hit enemies
      for(var j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        var e = enemies[j];
        if(dist(b.position, e.position) < 22){
          popEnemy(j);
          world.removeChild(b);
          bullets.splice(i,1);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function popEnemy(idx){
    var e = enemies[idx];
    burst(e.position.x, e.position.y, e.color, 16);
    burst(e.position.x, e.position.y, COLORS.white, 6);
    world.removeChild(e);
    enemies.splice(idx,1);
    kills++;
    score += 100 + (total - kills) * 5;
    shake = 6;
    if(scoreLabel) scoreLabel.text = 'SCORE ' + score;
    if(killLabel) killLabel.text = 'BALLOONS ' + kills + '/' + total;
    if(kills >= total) win();
  }

  function updateEnemies(){
    for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++){
      var e = enemies[i];
      e.t += 0.04;
      // gentle bob + drift
      e.position.y += Math.sin(e.t)*0.4 + e.vy;
      e.position.x += e.vx;
      if(e.position.x < 40 || e.position.x > W-40) e.vx *= -1;
      if(e.position.y < 40) e.vy += 0.05;
      if(e.position.y > H-60) e.vy -= 0.05;
      // face player
      var ang = Math.atan2(player.position.y - e.position.y, player.position.x - e.position.x);
      e.g.rotation = Math.sin(ang)*0.2;
      // scale pulse
      var sc = 1 + Math.sin(e.t*2)*0.06;
      e.g.scale.set(sc, sc);
    }
  }

  function updateParts(){
    for(var i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var p = parts[i];
      p.position.x += p.vx;
      p.position.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.08;      // gravity for debris
      if(p.vx) p.vx *= 0.96;

      if(p.life<=0){

        parts.splice(i,1);
      }
    }
  }

  function dist(a,b){ return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y); }

  /* ============================================================
     BOOT
  ============================================================ */
  window.addEventListener('load', function(){
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    init();
  });
})();

function startGame() {
  S.running = true; S.won = false; S.lost = false;
  S.score = 0; S.boyX = 120; S.vx = 0; S.throwDir = 1; S.throwCount = 0;
  flyers.forEach(f => world.removeChild(f.g)); flyers.length = 0;
  spawnLevel();
  overlay.visible = false;
}

// ============ UPDATE ============
function update(dt) {
  if (!S.running) return;
  S.time += dt;

  // movement
  const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
  const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
  const speed = 230;
  if (left && !right) S.vx = -speed;
  else if (right && !left) S.vx = speed;
  else S.vx = 0;
  S.boyX += S.vx * dt;
  S.boyX = Math.max(30, Math.min(W - 30, S.boyX));

  // flyers physics
  for (let i = flyers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = flyers[i];
    f.vy += 9.5 * dt;
    f.x += f.vx * dt;
    f.y += f.vy * dt;
    f.spin += 0.15;
    f.g.x = f.x; f.g.y = f.y;
    f.g.rotation = f.spin;
    // land on a paper
    if (!f.landed) {
      for (const p of S.papers) {
        if (!p.thrown && Math.abs(f.x - p.x) < 20 && f.y >= PAPER_Y - 6 && f.y <= PAPER_Y + 14 && f.vy > 0) {
          p.thrown = true;
          f.landed = true;
          S.score++;
          f.g.x = p.x; f.g.y = PAPER_Y; f.g.rotation = 0;
          break;
        }
      }
      // hit the ground
      if (f.y >= GROUND + 4) {
        f.landed = true;
        f.g.y = GROUND + 4;
      }
    }
    if (f.landed && f.g.y >= GROUND + 4) {
      // remove after a beat
      f.g.alpha -= dt * 0.8;
      if (f.g.alpha <= 0) { world.removeChild(f.g); flyers.splice(i, 1); }
    }
  }

  // obstacle collisions
  for (const o of S.obstacles) {
    if (!o.hit && Math.abs(S.boyX - o.x) < 20) {
      o.hit = true;
      S.lost = true;
      showOverlay('CRASHED!', 'You hit an obstacle on the road.', 'Press ENTER to run it again');
    }
  }

  // win check
  if (S.score >= S.total && !S.won) {
    S.won = true;
    showOverlay('DELIVERED!', 'You tossed every paper. Nice running!', 'Press ENTER to play again');
  }
}

// ============ CLOUDS (ambient) ============
const clouds = [];
function makeCloud(x, y, s) {
  const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
  g.beginFill(0xffffff, 0.9);
  g.drawCircle(0, 0, 18 * s);
  g.drawCircle(20 * s, 4 * s, 14 * s);
  g.drawCircle(-20 * s, 4 * s, 13 * s);
  g.drawCircle(8 * s, -8 * s, 13 * s);
  g.endFill();
  g.x = x; g.y = y;
  world.addChild(g);
  clouds.push({ g, x, y, s, sp: 8 + Math.random() * 10 });
}
makeCloud(120, 90, 1); makeCloud(420, 130, 0.8); makeCloud(700, 70, 1.1);

// ============ DRAW ============
function draw() {
  drawBoy();
  scoreTxt.text = 'Delivered: ' + S.score + ' / ' + S.total;
  hintTxt.text = '← → move   ·   SPACE throw   ·   aim with ← / →';
}

// ============ LOOP ============
const clock = new PIXI.Ticker();
clock.add((ticker) => {
  const dt = ticker.deltaTime / 60; // normalize to ~1 per frame
  update(Math.min(dt, 0.05));
  // drift clouds
  clouds.forEach(c => {
    c.x += c.sp * Math.min(dt, 0.05);
    if (c.x > W + 60) c.x = -60;
    c.g.x = c.x;
  });
  draw();
});

// initial overlay
showOverlay('PAPERBOY', 'Run the route. Toss a paper onto each front lawn. Don\u2019t hit the road clutter!', 'Press ENTER or SPACE to start');
</script>

(function(){

let H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

  particles: [],

const ENEMY_TYPES = {
  vort: { hp: 30, speed: 1.6, r: 22, color: '#6a5a9e', score: 10, name: 'Vortigaunt' },
  headcrab: { hp: 15, speed: 2.8, r: 16, color: '#8a5a3a', score: 8, name: 'Headcrab' },
  zombie: { hp: 70, speed: 1.0, r: 28, color: '#4a6a4a', score: 20, name: 'Zombie' }
};

function spawnWave() {
  state.totalEnemies = 8;
  state.enemiesLeft = state.totalEnemies;
  const spawn = (type, x, y) => state.enemies.push({
    type, x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: ENEMY_TYPES[type].hp, maxhp: ENEMY_TYPES[type].hp,
    r: ENEMY_TYPES[type].r, fireCd: Math.random()*1.5, hit: 0, bob: Math.random()*6
  });
  for (let i=0;i<4;i++) spawn('vort', 900 + Math.random()*400, 80 + Math.random()*200);
  for (let i=0;i<2;i++) spawn('zombie', 1000 + Math.random()*300, 300 + Math.random()*200);
  for (let i=0;i<2;i++) spawn('headcrab', 800 + Math.random()*400, 400 + Math.random()*200);
}

function startGame() {
  state.mode = 'playing';
  state.score = 0;
  state.kills = 0;
  state.bullets = [];
  state.particles = [];
  state.player.x = 260; state.player.y = 520; state.player.hp = state.player.maxhp;
  state.player.angle = -Math.PI/2; state.player.fireCd = 0;

}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  state.keys[e.code] = true;
  if (state.mode !== 'playing' && (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space')) startGame();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { state.keys[e.code] = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  state.player.angle = Math.atan2((e.clientY - r.top) - H/2, (e.clientX - r.left) - W/2);
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
  if (state.mode !== 'playing') { startGame(); return; }
  fire();
});
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());

function fire() {
  const p = state.player;
  if (p.fireCd > 0) return;
  p.fireCd = 0.16;
  const a = p.angle;
  state.bullets.push({ x: p.x + Math.cos(a)*40, y: p.y + Math.sin(a)*40, vx: Math.cos(a)*14, vy: Math.sin(a)*14, life: 2 });
  state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3);
  for (let i=0;i<6;i++) state.particles.push({ x: p.x + Math.cos(a)*42, y: p.y + Math.sin(a)*42, vx: Math.cos(a+ (Math.random()-0.5))*4, vy: Math.sin(a+(Math.random()-0.5))*4, life: 0.3, color: '#ffcf6a', size: 3 });
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;
  if (state.mode !== 'playing') return;
  const p = state.player;

  // movement
  let mx = 0, my = 0;
  if (state.keys['KeyW'] || state.keys['ArrowUp']) my -= 1;
  if (state.keys['KeyS'] || state.keys['ArrowDown']) my += 1;
  if (state.keys['KeyA'] || state.keys['ArrowLeft']) mx -= 1;
  if (state.keys['KeyD'] || state.keys['ArrowRight']) mx += 1;
  const len = Math.hypot(mx,my) || 1;
  const spd = 4.2;
  p.x += (mx/len)*spd;
  p.y += (my/len)*spd;
  p.x = Math.max(60, Math.min(1340, p.x));
  p.y = Math.max(120, Math.min(680, p.y));

  p.fireCd = Math.max(0, p.fireCd - dt);

    const dx = p.x - e.x, dy = p.y - e.y, d = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;

    e.x += (dx/d)*t.speed;
    e.y += (dy/d)*t.speed;
    e.bob += dt*8;
    e.hit = Math.max(0, e.hit - dt);

      }
    }

    }

  state.enemies = state.enemies.filter(e => {
    if (e.hp <= 0) {

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake);
  drawBackground();
  drawPortal();

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

    ctx.font = "28px serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    // Background
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillText(bd.icon, b.x, b.y);
  }

  function drawHUD(W, H) {
    // Top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 50);

    ctx.font = "bold 16px Georgia";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    // Turn
    ctx.fillStyle = "#a0c0ff";
    ctx.fillText("Turn " + state.turn + " / " + state.maxTurn, 16, 25);

    // Gold
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe060";
    ctx.fillText("💰 " + state.gold, 140, 25);

    // Food
    ctx.fillStyle = "#80ff80";
    ctx.fillText("🌾 " + state.food + " / " + state.foodMax, 240, 25);

    // Population
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff9060";
    ctx.fillText("👥 " + state.pop + " / " + state.maxPop, 370, 25);

    // Goal
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ccc";
    ctx.font = "13px Georgia";
    ctx.fillText("Goal: " + GOAL_POP + " pop & " + GOAL_GOLD + " gold", 500, 25);
  }

  function drawButtons(W, H) {
    const bw = 150, bh = 52, gap = 10;
    const totalW = BUILDINGS.length * bw + (BUILDINGS.length - 1) * gap;
    const startX = (W - totalW) / 2;
    const btnY = H - bh - 14;

    for (let i = 0; i < BUILDINGS.length; i++) {
      const bx = startX + i * (bw + gap);
      const bd = BUILDINGS[i];
      const affordable = state.gold >= bd.cost;

      // Button bg
      ctx.fillStyle = affordable ? "rgba(40,80,40,0.85)" : "rgba(60,30,30,0.85)";
      ctx.strokeStyle = affordable ? "#60a060" : "#804040";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      roundRect(bx, btnY, bw, bh, 8);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();

      // Icon + name
      ctx.font = "22px serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillStyle = affordable ? "#fff" : "#888";
      ctx.fillText(bd.icon, bx + 10, btnY + bh / 2);

      ctx.font = "bold 14px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = affordable ? "#e0e0e0" : "#777";
      ctx.fillText(bd.name, bx + 40, btnY + 18);

      ctx.font = "12px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = affordable ? "#ffe060" : "#885555";
      ctx.fillText(bd.cost + "g  " + bd.desc, bx + 40, btnY + 36);
    }

    // End Turn button
    const ew = 180, eh = 48;
    const ex = W - ew - 16;
    const ey = 16;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(80,40,120,0.9)";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#b080e0";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(ex, ey, ew, eh, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.font = "bold 16px Georgia";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillText("⏭ End Turn", ex + ew / 2, ey + eh / 2);
  }

  function drawStartScreen(W, H) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    ctx.font = "bold 48px Georgia";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe060";
    ctx.fillText("CIVILIZATION", W / 2, H / 2 - 80);

    ctx.font = "20px Georgia";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ccc";
    ctx.fillText("Found a city. Build. Grow. Prosper.", W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

    ctx.font = "16px Georgia";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#a0c0ff";
    ctx.fillText("Goal: Reach " + GOAL_POP + " population and " + GOAL_GOLD + " gold in " + TURNS + " turns.", W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#80ff80";
    ctx.fillText("Build farms for food, housing for population, markets for gold.", W / 2, H / 2 + 40);

    ctx.font = "bold 22px Georgia";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    const pulse = 0.7 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003) * 0.3;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText("Click anywhere to begin", W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawGameOver(W, H) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    if (state.won) {
      ctx.font = "bold 52px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe060";
      ctx.fillText("🏆 VICTORY! 🏆", W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

      ctx.font = "22px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#80ff80";
      ctx.fillText("Your civilization has prospered!", W / 2, H / 2);

      ctx.font = "18px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ccc";
      ctx.fillText("Population: " + state.pop + "   Gold: " + state.gold + "   Turns: " + state.turn, W / 2, H / 2 + 40);
    } else {
      ctx.font = "bold 52px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6060";
      ctx.fillText("☠️ GAME OVER ☠️", W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

      ctx.font = "22px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffa0a0";
      ctx.fillText("Your civilization has fallen.", W / 2, H / 2);

      ctx.font = "18px Georgia";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ccc";
      ctx.fillText("Final: " + state.pop + " pop, " + state.gold + " gold (needed " + GOAL_POP + " pop, " + GOAL_GOLD + " gold)", W / 2, H / 2 + 40);
    }

    ctx.font = "bold 20px Georgia";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.004) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText("Click to play again", W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  MAIN LOOP
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  loop();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
