<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Flower</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
    background: #0d0a1a;
    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ---------- canvas ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0;
function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

// ---------- state ----------
const STATE = {
  mode: "start",      // start | play | win | lose
  petals: 0,
  target: 6,
  time: 0
};

// ---------- flower (player) ----------
const flower = {
  x: 0, y: 0,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  radius: 18,
  petals: 6,
  angle: 0,
  bloom: 0,          // 0..1 how open
  sway: 0
};
function resetFlower() {
  flower.x = W * 0.2;
  flower.y = H * 0.6;
  flower.vx = 0;
  flower.vy = 0;
  flower.bloom = 0;
  flower.sway = 0;
}

// ---------- floating seeds (collectibles) ----------
let seeds = [];
function spawnSeed(x, y) {
  const hues = [150, 170, 190, 210, 240, 280, 320, 30, 50];
  seeds.push({
    x: x !== undefined ? x : Math.random() * W,
    y: y !== undefined ? y : Math.random() * H,
    r: 6 + Math.random() * 6,
    hue: hues[(Math.random() * hues.length) | 0],
    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    life: 1
  });
}
function initSeeds() {
  seeds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) spawnSeed();
}

// ---------- wind / drifting pollen particles ----------
let pollen = [];
function initPollen() {
  pollen = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    pollen.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      s: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5,
      a: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.35,
      drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
    });
  }
}

// ---------- leaves (obstacles) ----------
let leaves = [];
function initLeaves() {
  leaves = [];
  const n = 7;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    leaves.push({
      x: W * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.6),
      y: H * (0.15 + Math.random() * 0.7),
      r: 26 + Math.random() * 22,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      spin: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
      bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowRight") e.preventDefault();
  if (STATE.mode === "start" && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) startGame();
  if ((STATE.mode === "win" || STATE.mode === "lose") && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) startGame();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

function startGame() {
  STATE.mode = "play";
  STATE.petals = 0;
  STATE.time = 0;
  resetFlower();
  initSeeds();
  initLeaves();
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt) {
  // ambient pollen always drifts
  for (const p of pollen) {
    p.x += p.drift + 0.15;
    p.y += Math.sin(STATE.time * 0.5 + p.x * 0.01) * 0.1;
    if (p.x > W + 10) p.x = -10;
    if (p.y > H + 10) p.y = -10;
    if (p.y < -10) p.y = H + 10;
  }

  if (STATE.mode !== "play") return;
  STATE.time += dt;

  // movement
  const speed = 240;
  let ax = 0, ay = 0;
  if (keys["arrowleft"] || keys["a"]) ax -= 1;
  if (keys["arrowright"] || keys["d"]) ax += 1;
  if (keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"]) ay -= 1;
  if (keys["arrowdown"] || keys["s"]) ay += 1;
  const len = Math.hypot(ax, ay) || 1;
  flower.vx += (ax / len) * speed * dt * 3;
  flower.vy += (ay / len) * speed * dt * 3;

  // gentle damping + ambient breeze
  flower.vx *= 0.92;
  flower.vy *= 0.92;
  flower.vx += Math.sin(STATE.time * 0.8) * 4 * dt;
  flower.vy += Math.cos(STATE.time * 0.6) * 4 * dt;

  flower.x += flower.vx;
  flower.y += flower.vy;

  // bounds (soft bounce)
  const m = flower.radius;
  if (flower.x < m) { flower.x = m; flower.vx *= -0.5; }
  if (flower.x > W - m) { flower.x = W - m; flower.vx *= -0.5; }
  if (flower.y < m) { flower.y = m; flower.vy *= -0.5; }
  if (flower.y > H - m) { flower.y = H - m; flower.vy *= -0.5; }

  // bloom grows with motion
  const spd = Math.hypot(flower.vx, flower.vy);
  flower.bloom += (Math.min(1, spd / 120) - flower.bloom) * dt * 2;
  flower.sway += dt;

  // seeds drift + collect
  for (let i = seeds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = seeds[i];
    s.phase += dt;
    s.x += Math.sin(s.phase) * 6 * dt;
    s.y += Math.cos(s.phase * 0.7) * 5 * dt;
    if (s.x < 0) s.x = W; if (s.x > W) s.x = 0;
    if (s.y < 0) s.y = H; if (s.y > H) s.y = 0;

    const d = Math.hypot(s.x - flower.x, s.y - flower.y);
    if (d < flower.radius + s.r + 6) {
      STATE.petals++;
      // burst: convert this seed into a few drifting motes
      for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
        pollen.push({ x: s.x, y: s.y, s: s.r * 0.4, a: 0.5, drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 });
      }
      seeds.splice(i, 1);
      spawnSeed(); // keep field full
      if (STATE.petals >= STATE.target) { STATE.mode = "win"; }
    }
  }

  // leaves drift + collide (lose)
  for (const l of leaves) {
    l.rot += l.spin;
    l.bob += dt;
    l.x += Math.sin(l.bob) * 10 * dt;
    l.y += Math.cos(l.bob * 0.8) * 8 * dt;
    if (l.x < l.r) l.x = l.r; if (l.x > W - l.r) l.x = W - l.r;
    if (l.y < l.r) l.y = l.r; if (l.y > H - l.r) l.y = H - l.r;

    const d = Math.hypot(l.x - flower.x, l.y - flower.y);
    if (d < l.r * 0.8 + flower.radius * 0.7) {
      STATE.mode = "lose";
    }
  }
}

// ---------- draw helpers ----------
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#1b1436");
  g.addColorStop(0.45, "#2a2450");
  g.addColorStop(0.8, "#3a3560");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#4a4570");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // soft light glow near top
  const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.5, H * 0.15, 10, W * 0.5, H * 0.15, H * 0.8);
  rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,240,200,0.18)");
  rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,240,200,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = rg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawPollen() {
  for (const p of pollen) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,230," + p.a + ")";
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawSeed(s) {
  // glowing seed / petal of light
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, s.r * 3);
  glow.addColorStop(0, "hsla(" + s.hue + ",90%,75%,0.9)");
  glow.addColorStop(1, "hsla(" + s.hue + ",90%,75%,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, s.r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // petal shape
  ctx.fillStyle = "hsl(" + s.hue + ",95%,80%)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s.r * 0.7, s.r * 1.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, -s.r * 0.3, s.r * 0.3, s.r * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawLeaf(l) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(l.x, l.y);
  ctx.rotate(l.rot);
  // leaf body
  ctx.fillStyle = "hsl(120,45%,32%)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-l.r, 0);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -l.r * 0.9, l.r, 0);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, l.r * 0.9, -l.r, 0);
  ctx.fill();
  // vein
  ctx.strokeStyle = "hsl(120,50%,20%)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-l.r * 0.8, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(l.r * 0.8, 0);
  ctx.stroke();
  // side veins
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(i * l.r * 0.25, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(i * l.r * 0.35, -l.r * 0.3);
    ctx.moveTo(i * l.r * 0.25, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(i * l.r * 0.35, l.r * 0.3);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFlower() {
  const open = flower.bloom;
  const n = flower.petals;
  const base = flower.radius;
  const petalLen = base * (0.9 + open * 1.4);
  const petalW = base * (0.5 + open * 0.5);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(flower.x, flower.y);
  const rot = Math.sin(flower.sway * 0.6) * 0.15;
  ctx.rotate(rot);

  // aura
  const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, base * 3);
  aura.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,220,255,0.35)");
  aura.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,220,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = aura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, base * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // petals
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 + flower.sway * 0.2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.rotate(a);
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, -petalLen);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "hsl(320,85%,72%)");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "hsl(285,90%,82%)");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(petalW, -petalLen * 0.55, 0, -petalLen);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-petalW, -petalLen * 0.55, 0, 0);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // center
  const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, base * 0.7);
  cg.addColorStop(0, "hsl(45,100%,90%)");
  cg.addColorStop(1, "hsl(35,95%,60%)");
  ctx.fillStyle = cg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, base * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // face
  ctx.fillStyle = "hsl(30,60%,25%)";
  const eo = base * 0.18;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-eo, -base * 0.05, base * 0.09, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(eo, -base * 0.05, base * 0.09, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "hsl(30,60%,25%)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, base * 0.12, base * 0.22, 0.15 * Math.PI, 0.85 * Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // petal counter
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
  ctx.font = "22px Georgia";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Petals", 24, 40);
  for (let i = 0; i < STATE.target; i++) {
    const cx = 34 + i * 30;
    const cy = 66;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, 8, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < STATE.petals ? "hsl(320,85%,72%)" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function centerText(lines, y0, size, color) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  let y = y0;
  for (const line of lines) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color || "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
    ctx.font = (line.size || size) + "px Georgia";
    ctx.fillText(line.text, W / 2, y);
    y += (line.gap || size * 1.3);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawOverlays() {
  if (STATE.mode === "start") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,8,25,0.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    centerText([
      { text: "Flower", size: 64, gap: 80 },
      { text: "Glide on the breeze. Collect the glowing seeds.", size: 20, gap: 30 },
      { text: "Dodge the drifting leaves.", size: 20, gap: 46 },
      { text: "Move:  Arrow keys  or  W A S D", size: 18, gap: 40 },
      { text: "Press  Enter  to bloom", size: 22, gap: 20, color: "hsl(320,90%,80%)" }
    ], H * 0.32, 20);
  } else if (STATE.mode === "win") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,8,25,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    centerText([
      { text: "In Full Bloom", size: 52, gap: 70 },
      { text: "You gathered every petal of light.", size: 22, gap: 44 },
      { text: "Press  Enter  to bloom again", size: 20, color: "hsl(320,90%,80%)" }
    ], H * 0.35, 20);
  } else if (STATE.mode === "lose") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,5,10,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    centerText([
      { text: "Scattered", size: 52, gap: 70 },
      { text: "A leaf caught you in the wind.", size: 22, gap: 44 },
      { text: "Press  Enter  to try again", size: 20, color: "hsl(20,90%,75%)" }
    ], H * 0.35, 20);
  }
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawPollen();
  for (const l of leaves) drawLeaf(l);
  for (const s of seeds) drawSeed(s);
  if (STATE.mode === "play" || STATE.mode === "win") drawFlower();
  if (STATE.mode === "play") drawHUD();
  drawOverlays();
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// init
initPollen();
initSeeds();
initLeaves();
resetFlower();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<title>Syndicate</title>

  }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
// ===================== SETUP =====================
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width = 800;
const H = canvas.height = 600;

// ===================== STATE =====================
let gameState = 'start'; // 'start', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
let score = 0;
let combo = 0;
let comboTimer = 0;
let frames = 0;

// Player
const player = {
  x: W / 2,
  y: H / 2,
  angle: 0,
  speed: 4
};

// Enemies
let enemies = [];
let enemySpawnTimer = 0;

// Projectiles
let projectiles = [];

// Particles
let particles = [];

// Stars (background)
let stars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1,
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3
  });
}

// Grid lines
let gridOffset = 0;

// ===================== INPUT =====================
const keys = {};
let mouseX = W / 2, mouseY = H / 2;
let mouseDown = false;

window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (gameState === 'start' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    startGame();
  }
  if ((gameState === 'won' || gameState === 'lost') && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    gameState = 'start';
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  mouseY = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { mouseDown = true; });
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', e => { mouseDown = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  mouseY = (e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
  mouseDown = true;
  if (gameState === 'start') startGame();
  if (gameState === 'won' || gameState === 'lost') gameState = 'start';
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  mouseY = (e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', e => { mouseDown = false; });

// ===================== GAME LOGIC =====================
function startGame() {
  gameState = 'playing';
  score = 0;
  combo = 0;
  comboTimer = 0;
  frames = 0;
  enemies = [];
  projectiles = [];
  particles = [];
  player.x = W / 2;
  player.y = H / 2;
}

function spawnEnemy() {
  const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
  let x, y;
  if (side === 0) { x = -20; y = Math.random() * H; }
  else if (side === 1) { x = W + 20; y = Math.random() * H; }
  else if (side === 2) { x = Math.random() * W; y = -20; }
  else { x = Math.random() * W; y = H + 20; }

  const type = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 'heavy' : 'light';
  enemies.push({
    x, y,
    r: type === 'heavy' ? 18 : 12,
    speed: type === 'heavy' ? 0.8 : 1.4,
    type,
    hp: type === 'heavy' ? 3 : 1,
    angle: 0,
    wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

function shoot() {
  const dx = mouseX - player.x;
  const dy = mouseY - player.y;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (dist < 5) return;
  const speed = 8;
  projectiles.push({
    x: player.x,
    y: player.y,
    vx: (dx / dist) * speed,
    vy: (dy / dist) * speed,
    life: 60
  });
}

function addParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: Math.random() * 30 + 15,
      maxLife: 45,
      color,
      r: Math.random() * 3 + 1
    });
  }
}

// ===================== UPDATE =====================
function update() {
  if (gameState !== 'playing') return;
  frames++;

  // Player movement
  let mx = 0, my = 0;
  if (keys['KeyW'] || keys['ArrowUp']) my = -1;
  if (keys['KeyS'] || keys['ArrowDown']) my = 1;
  if (keys['KeyA'] || keys['ArrowLeft']) mx = -1;
  if (keys['KeyD'] || keys['ArrowRight']) mx = 1;
  if (mx !== 0 || my !== 0) {
    const len = Math.sqrt(mx * mx + my * my);
    player.x += (mx / len) * player.speed;
    player.y += (my / len) * player.speed;
  }
  player.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(H - 20, player.y));
  player.angle = Math.atan2(mouseY - player.y, mouseX - player.x);

  // Shooting
  if (mouseDown && frames % 8 === 0) shoot();

  // Spawn enemies
  enemySpawnTimer++;
  const spawnRate = Math.max(30, 90 - Math.floor(frames / 200) * 5);
  if (enemySpawnTimer >= spawnRate) {
    enemySpawnTimer = 0;
    spawnEnemy();
    if (frames > 1000 && Math.random() < 0.4) spawnEnemy();
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    const dx = player.x - e.x;
    const dy = player.y - e.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist > 0) {
      e.x += (dx / dist) * e.speed;
      e.y += (dy / dist) * e.speed;
    }
    e.angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    e.wobble += 0.05;

    // Collision with player
    if (dist < e.r + 15) {
      gameState = 'lost';
      addParticles(player.x, player.y, '#ff4444', 30);
      return;
    }
  }

  // Update projectiles
  for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = projectiles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0 || p.x < -10 || p.x > W + 10 || p.y < -10 || p.y > H + 10) {
      projectiles.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    // Check collision with enemies
    for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const e = enemies[j];
      const dx = p.x - e.x;
      const dy = p.y - e.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < e.r + 4) {
        e.hp--;
        projectiles.splice(i, 1);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          const color = e.type === 'heavy' ? '#ff8800' : '#00ffcc';
          addParticles(e.x, e.y, color, 15);
          enemies.splice(j, 1);
          combo++;
          comboTimer = 120;
          score += e.type === 'heavy' ? 50 * combo : 25 * combo;
        } else {
          addParticles(e.x, e.y, '#ffffff', 5);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Combo timer
  if (comboTimer > 0) {
    comboTimer--;
    if (comboTimer === 0) combo = 0;
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.95;
    p.vy *= 0.95;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Win condition
  if (score >= 2000) {
    gameState = 'won';
  }

  // Grid scroll
  gridOffset = (gridOffset + 0.5) % 40;
}

// ===================== DRAW =====================
function draw() {
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a1a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 200, 0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = -gridOffset; x < W; x += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = -gridOffset; y < H; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  if (gameState === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen();
    return;
  }

  // Particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Projectiles
  for (const p of projectiles) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#00ffcc';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  // Enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    const wobble = Math.sin(e.wobble) * 3;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y + wobble);
    ctx.rotate(e.angle);

    if (e.type === 'heavy') {
      // Hexagon shape
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffaa00';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const a = (Math.PI / 3) * i;
        const px = Math.cos(a) * e.r;
        const py = Math.sin(a) * e.r;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      // Inner detail
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3300';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, e.r * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      // Triangle shape
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cc0033';
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff4466';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(e.r, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(-e.r * 0.7, e.r * 0.6);
      ctx.lineTo(-e.r * 0.7, -e.r * 0.6);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      // Eye
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(e.r * 0.2, 0, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Player
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
  ctx.rotate(player.angle);

  // Glow
  ctx.shadowColor = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 15;

  // Ship body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00ddaa';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(20, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-12, -14);
  ctx.lineTo(-6, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-12, 14);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(5, 0, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Engine glow
  ctx.shadowColor = '#ff8800';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8800';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-12, -6);
  ctx.lineTo(-20, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-12, 6);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Win/Lose overlay
  if (gameState === 'won') drawEndScreen('SYNDICATE', '#00ffcc', 'You dismantled the Syndicate.');
  if (gameState === 'lost') drawEndScreen('SYSTEM FAILURE', '#ff3344', 'The Syndicate consumed you.');
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  // Title
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  // Glow effect
  ctx.shadowColor = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SYNDICATE', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '18px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('A tactical shooter against the machine', W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

  // Blinking prompt
  const blink = Math.sin(frames * 0.05) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc';
    ctx.font = '22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('[ PRESS SPACE OR CLICK TO START ]', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  }

  // Controls
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('WASD / Arrows to move  |  Mouse to aim  |  Click to fire', W / 2, H / 2 + 110);
  ctx.fillText('Reach 2000 points to win. Avoid the machines.', W / 2, H / 2 + 135);

  // Decorative shapes
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,200,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const rx = W / 2 + Math.cos(frames * 0.02 + i * 1.2) * 200;
    const ry = H / 2 + Math.sin(frames * 0.02 + i * 1.2) * 120;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rx, ry, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';

  // Score
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 20, 15);

  // Combo
  if (combo > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('COMBO x' + combo, 20, 45);
  }

  // Progress bar
  const progress = Math.min(1, score / 2000);
  const barW = 150;
  const barH = 8;
  const barX = W - barW - 20;
  const barY = 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * progress, barH);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('TARGET: 2000', W - 20, barY + barH + 4);

  // Enemy count
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('HOSTILES: ' + enemies.length, 20, H - 25);

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEndScreen(title, color, subtitle) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  ctx.shadowColor = color;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(subtitle, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 50);

  const blink = Math.sin(frames * 0.05) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('[ PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE ]', W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ===================== MAIN LOOP =====================
function loop() {
  frames++;
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>NetHack</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    background: #000;
    cursor: default;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  // ===== STATE =====
  const canvas = document.getElementById("gameCanvas");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  const COLS = 50;
  const ROWS = 30;
  const CELL = 16;
  const OFFSET_X = (canvas.width - COLS * CELL) / 2;
  const OFFSET_Y = 20;

  let grid = [];
  let player = { x: 0, y: 0, hp: 10, maxHp: 10, gold: 0, kills: 0, level: 1 };
  let monsters = [];
  let message = "Welcome to NetHack. Find the Amulet of Yendor and escape!";
  let messageTimer = 0;
  let gameOver = false;
  let won = false;
  let amuletPlaced = false;
  let amuletPos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  let exitPos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  let turnCount = 0;

  const T = { WALL: 0, FLOOR: 1, DOOR: 2, EXIT: 3, AMULET: 4 };

  function init() {
    grid = [];
    for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
      grid[y] = [];
      for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
        grid[y][x] = T.WALL;
      }
    }

    // Carve rooms
    const rooms = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const rw = 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
      const rh = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
      const rx = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (COLS - rw - 2));
      const ry = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (ROWS - rh - 2));
      rooms.push({ x: rx, y: ry, w: rw, h: rh });
      for (let y = ry; y < ry + rh; y++) {
        for (let x = rx; x < rx + rw; x++) {
          if (x > 0 && x < COLS - 1 && y > 0 && y < ROWS - 1) {
            grid[y][x] = T.FLOOR;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Connect rooms with corridors
    for (let i = 1; i < rooms.length; i++) {
      const a = rooms[i - 1];
      const b = rooms[i];
      const ax = Math.floor(a.x + a.w / 2);
      const ay = Math.floor(a.y + a.h / 2);
      const bx = Math.floor(b.x + b.w / 2);
      const by = Math.floor(b.y + b.h / 2);
      // Horizontal then vertical
      for (let x = Math.min(ax, bx); x <= Math.max(ax, bx); x++) {
        if (ay > 0 && ay < ROWS - 1) grid[ay][x] = T.FLOOR;
      }
      for (let y = Math.min(ay, by); y <= Math.max(ay, by); y++) {
        if (bx > 0 && bx < COLS - 1) grid[y][bx] = T.FLOOR;
      }
    }

    // Place player in first room
    player.x = Math.floor(rooms[0].x + rooms[0].w / 2);
    player.y = Math.floor(rooms[0].y + rooms[0].h / 2);

    // Place amulet in last room
    const lastRoom = rooms[rooms.length - 1];
    amuletPos.x = Math.floor(lastRoom.x + lastRoom.w / 2);
    amuletPos.y = Math.floor(lastRoom.y + lastRoom.h / 2);
    grid[amuletPos.y][amuletPos.x] = T.AMULET;
    amuletPlaced = true;

    // Place exit near amulet
    exitPos.x = Math.max(1, amuletPos.x - 2);
    exitPos.y = Math.max(1, amuletPos.y - 2);
    grid[exitPos.y][exitPos.x] = T.EXIT;

    // Place some doors
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const r = rooms[Math.floor(Math.random() * rooms.length)];
      const dx = Math.floor(r.x + r.w / 2);
      const dy = Math.floor(r.y + r.h / 2);
      if (grid[dy][dx] === T.FLOOR) {
        grid[dy][dx] = T.DOOR;
      }
    }

    // Spawn monsters
    monsters = [];
    const monsterTypes = [
      { ch: "r", name: "rat", hp: 2, atk: 1, color: "#888" },
      { ch: "g", name: "goblin", hp: 3, atk: 2, color: "#5a5" },
      { ch: "o", name: "ogre", hp: 5, atk: 3, color: "#a55" },
      { ch: "d", name: "dragon", hp: 8, atk: 4, color: "#d44" },
      { ch: "s", name: "skeleton", hp: 3, atk: 2, color: "#ccc" },
      { ch: "w", name: "wraith", hp: 4, atk: 3, color: "#aaf" }
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
      const r = rooms[1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (rooms.length - 1))];
      const mx = Math.floor(r.x + Math.random() * r.w);
      const my = Math.floor(r.y + Math.random() * r.h);
      if (grid[my][mx] === T.FLOOR && mx !== player.x && my !== player.y) {
        const type = monsterTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * monsterTypes.length)];
        monsters.push({ x: mx, y: my, hp: type.hp, maxHp: type.hp, atk: type.atk, ch: type.ch, color: type.color, name: type.name });
      }
    }

    player.hp = player.maxHp;
    player.gold = 0;
    player.kills = 0;
    player.level = 1;
    turnCount = 0;
    gameOver = false;
    won = false;
    message = "You enter the dungeon. Find the Amulet of Yendor!";
    messageTimer = 200;
  }

  // ===== INPUT =====
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if (gameOver) {
      if (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") {
        init();
      }
      return;
    }
    let dx = 0, dy = 0;
    switch (e.key) {
      case "ArrowUp": case "w": case "W": dy = -1; break;
      case "ArrowDown": case "s": case "S": dy = 1; break;
      case "ArrowLeft": case "a": case "A": dx = -1; break;
      case "ArrowRight": case "d": case "D": dx = 1; break;
      case " ": // attack in place / wait
        attackPlayer();
        endTurn();
        return;
      default: return;
    }
    if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();

    const nx = player.x + dx;
    const ny = player.y + dy;

    if (nx < 0 || nx >= COLS || ny < 0 || ny >= ROWS) return;
    if (grid[ny][nx] === T.WALL) {
      message = "You bump into a wall.";
      messageTimer = 60;
      return;
    }

    // Check for monster in target cell
    const target = monsters.find(m => m.x === nx && m.y === ny);
    if (target) {
      // Attack the monster
      target.hp -= 2 + Math.floor(player.level / 2);
      message = "You hit the " + target.name + "!";
      messageTimer = 80;
      if (target.hp <= 0) {
        message = "The " + target.name + " dies!";
        messageTimer = 100;
        player.kills++;
        player.gold += Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1;
        monsters = monsters.filter(m => m !== target);
        if (player.kills % 3 === 0 && player.level < 5) {
          player.level++;
          player.maxHp += 2;
          player.hp = player.maxHp;
          message = "Level up! You are now level " + player.level + ".";
          messageTimer = 150;
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Move
      player.x = nx;
      player.y = ny;
      const cell = grid[ny][nx];
      if (cell === T.AMULET) {
        grid[ny][nx] = T.FLOOR;
        amuletPlaced = false;
        message = "You pick up the Amulet of Yendor! Find the exit!";
        messageTimer = 200;
      } else if (cell === T.EXIT) {
        if (!amuletPlaced) {
          won = true;
          gameOver = true;
          message = "You escape with the Amulet! You WIN!";
        } else {
          message = "You need the Amulet to escape!";
          messageTimer = 100;
        }
      }
    }
    endTurn();
  });

  function attackPlayer() {
    // No attack in place in this version, just wait
  }

  function endTurn() {
    turnCount++;
    // Monster AI
    for (const m of monsters) {
      const dist = Math.abs(m.x - player.x) + Math.abs(m.y - player.y);
      if (dist <= 8) {
        // Move toward player
        const dx = player.x - m.x;
        const dy = player.y - m.y;
        let sx = 0, sy = 0;
        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
          sx = Math.sign(dx);
        } else {
          sy = Math.sign(dy);
        }
        const nx = m.x + sx;
        const ny = m.y + sy;
        if (nx >= 0 && nx < COLS && ny >= 0 && ny < ROWS && grid[ny][nx] !== T.WALL) {
          const occupied = monsters.some(o => o !== m && o.x === nx && o.y === ny);
          if (!occupied && !(nx === player.x && ny === player.y)) {
            m.x = nx;
            m.y = ny;
          }
        }
      }
      // Attack if adjacent
      if (Math.abs(m.x - player.x) + Math.abs(m.y - player.y) === 1) {
        player.hp -= m.atk;
        message = "The " + m.name + " hits you! (" + player.hp + " HP)";
        messageTimer = 80;
        if (player.hp <= 0) {
          player.hp = 0;
          gameOver = true;
          message = "You are dead. Press R to restart.";
          messageTimer = 99999;
        }
      }
    }
    // Regenerate slowly
    if (player.hp < player.maxHp && turnCount % 30 === 0) {
      player.hp++;
    }
  }

  // ===== DRAW =====
  function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Draw grid
    for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
        const px = OFFSET_X + x * CELL;
        const py = OFFSET_Y + y * CELL;
        const cell = grid[y][x];
        switch (cell) {
          case T.WALL:
            ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
            ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#444";
            ctx.fillRect(px + 1, py + 1, CELL - 2, CELL - 2);
            break;
          case T.FLOOR:
            ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e";
            ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
            break;
          case T.DOOR:
            ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e";
            ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#8B4513";
            ctx.fillRect(px + 3, py + 2, CELL - 6, CELL - 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
            ctx.fillRect(px + CELL - 6, py + CELL / 2 - 1, 2, 2);
            break;
          case T.AMULET:
            ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e";
            ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
            ctx.font = "bold 12px Courier New";
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillText("◆", px + CELL / 2, py + CELL / 2);
            break;
          case T.EXIT:
            ctx.fillStyle = "#0d2137";
            ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
            ctx.strokeStyle = "#4488ff";
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(px + 2, py + 2, CELL - 4, CELL - 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#4488ff";
            ctx.font = "10px Courier New";
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillText("EXIT", px + CELL / 2, py + CELL / 2);
            break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Draw monsters
    for (const m of monsters) {
      const px = OFFSET_X + m.x * CELL;
      const py = OFFSET_Y + m.y * CELL;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.font = "bold 13px Courier New";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(m.ch, px + CELL / 2, py + CELL / 2);
      // HP bar
      if (m.hp < m.maxHp) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#300";
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + CELL - 3, CELL - 4, 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#f44";
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + CELL - 3, (CELL - 4) * (m.hp / m.maxHp), 2);
      }
    }

    // Draw player
    const ppx = OFFSET_X + player.x * CELL;
    const ppy = OFFSET_Y + player.y * CELL;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#00ff00";
    ctx.font = "bold 14px Courier New";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("@", ppx + CELL / 2, ppy + CELL / 2);
    // Glow
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,255,0,0.3)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ppx + CELL / 2, ppy + CELL / 2, CELL / 2 + 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle = "#111";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, OFFSET_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f0";
    ctx.font = "12px Courier New";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("HP: " + player.hp + "/" + player.maxHp + "  Gold: " + player.gold + "  Kills: " + player.kills + "  Level: " + player.level + "  Turns: " + turnCount, 10, 4);

    // Message
    if (messageTimer > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 30, canvas.width, 30);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff0";
      ctx.font = "13px Courier New";
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(message, 10, canvas.height - 15);
      messageTimer--;
    }

    // Game over / Win overlay
    if (gameOver) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      if (won) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
        ctx.font = "bold 36px Courier New";
        ctx.fillText("YOU ESCAPED!", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#0f0";
        ctx.font = "18px Courier New";
        ctx.fillText("Kills: " + player.kills + "  Gold: " + player.gold + "  Turns: " + turnCount, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 10);
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#f44";
        ctx.font = "bold 36px Courier New";
        ctx.fillText("YOU DIED", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ccc";
        ctx.font = "18px Courier New";
        ctx.fillText("Kills: " + player.kills + "  Gold: " + player.gold + "  Turns: " + turnCount, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 10);
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#aaa";
      ctx.font = "16px Courier New";
      ctx.fillText("Press R to restart", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 50);
    }

    // Controls hint
    if (!gameOver && turnCount < 3) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
      ctx.font = "11px Courier New";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "top";
      ctx.fillText("WASD or Arrow Keys to move. Walk into monsters to attack. Find the ◆ Amulet, then the EXIT.", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 48);
    }
  }

  // ===== LOOP =====
  function loop() {
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  init();
  loop();

})();
</script>

/* ============================================================
   VIB RIBBON — a famous scene
   Ride the glowing ribbon. It weaves in a sine pattern.
   Move to stay on it. Each second you keep the ribbon alive
   is a point. Miss the ribbon and you lose.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------------- STATE ---------------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

const state = {
  screen: "start",        // "start" | "play" | "over"
  score: 0,               // seconds survived (the goal)
  best: 0,
  time: 0,               // game clock (seconds, only advances in play)
  speed: 150,            // px/sec scroll
  ribbonHalf: 52,        // half thickness of the ribbon
  playerX: 0,
  playerY: 0,
  playerTrail: [],       // recent player positions
  shake: 0,
  particles: [],
  ambient: [],           // drifting background orbs
  flash: 0
};

const PLAYER_R = 15;
const TRAIL_MAX = 22;

/* ---------------- INPUT ---------------- */
let pointer = { x: null, y: null, active: false };

function updatePointer(cx, cy) {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointer.x = cx - r.left;
  pointer.y = cy - r.top;
  pointer.active = true;
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", e => updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY));
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", e => { updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY); onDown(); });
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const t = e.touches[0]; updatePointer(t.clientX, t.clientY); onDown();
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const t = e.touches[0]; updatePointer(t.clientX, t.clientY);
}, { passive: false });

window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (state.screen === "start") { if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") onDown(); }
  else if (state.screen === "over") { if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") onDown(); }
});

function onDown() {
  if (state.screen === "start") startGame();
  else if (state.screen === "over") startGame();
}

function startGame() {
  state.screen = "play";
  state.score = 0;
  state.time = 0;
  state.speed = 150;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = 0;
  state.particles = [];
  state.playerTrail = [];
  state.playerX = W / 2;
  state.playerY = H * 0.72;
}

/* ---------------- HELPERS ---------------- */
function ribbonCenterY(worldY) {
  // worldY increases downward; scroll moves world up => use (time*speed + worldY)
  const t = state.time * state.speed + worldY;
  return H * 0.5 + Math.sin(t * 0.006) * (H * 0.28);
}

function spawnBurst(x, y, color, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = 40 + Math.random() * 260;
    state.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
      life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.7,
      max: 1.2,
      r: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
      color
    });
  }
}

function initAmbient() {
  state.ambient = [];
  const n = 46;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    state.ambient.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: 1 + Math.random() * 2.4,
      vy: 8 + Math.random() * 30,
      tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
}

/* ---------------- RESIZE ---------------- */
function resize() {
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  if (!state.playerX) { state.playerX = W/2; state.playerY = H*0.72; }
  initAmbient();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

/* ---------------- UPDATE ---------------- */
function update(dt) {
  // ambient always drifts
  for (const o of state.ambient) {
    o.y -= o.vy * dt;
    o.tw += dt * 2;
    if (o.y < -10) { o.y = H + 10; o.x = Math.random() * W; }
  }

  // particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 220 * dt;      // light gravity
    p.vx *= 0.98;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 3);
  state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 2.5);

  if (state.screen !== "play") return;

  state.time += dt;
  state.score += dt;
  state.speed = Math.min(420, 150 + state.time * 12);

  // player follows pointer (or stays if none)
  if (pointer.active && pointer.x != null) {
    const k = Math.min(1, dt * 18);
    state.playerX += (pointer.x - state.playerX) * k;
    state.playerY += (pointer.y - state.playerY) * k;
  }
  state.playerX = Math.max(PLAYER_R, Math.min(W - PLAYER_R, state.playerX));
  state.playerY = Math.max(PLAYER_R, Math.min(H - PLAYER_R, state.playerY));

  // trail
  state.playerTrail.unshift({ x: state.playerX, y: state.playerY });
  if (state.playerTrail.length > TRAIL_MAX) state.playerTrail.pop();

  // check ribbon
  const cy = ribbonCenterY(state.playerY);
  const dist = Math.abs(state.playerY - cy);
  const onRibbon = dist <= state.ribbonHalf;

  if (onRibbon) {
    // sparkle along the ribbon near the player
    if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
      state.particles.push({
        x: state.playerX + (Math.random()*2-1)*state.ribbonHalf,
        y: state.playerY + (Math.random()*2-1)*12,
        vx: (Math.random()*2-1)*40,
        vy: -30 - Math.random()*60,
        life: 0.5 + Math.random()*0.4, max: 0.9,
        r: 1.5 + Math.random()*2.5,
        color: "#9ff0ff"
      });
    }
  } else {
    // off ribbon -> lose
    state.screen = "over";
    state.best = Math.max(state.best, Math.floor(state.score));
    state.shake = 1;
    state.flash = 1;
    spawnBurst(state.playerX, state.playerY, "#ff5a7a", 60);
    spawnBurst(state.playerX, state.playerY, "#ffd36b", 30);
  }
}

/* ---------------- DRAW ---------------- */
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#141a33");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#0c1022");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#080a14");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // soft nebula glows
  const t = performance.now() * 0.0002;
  const glow = (x, y, r, col) => {
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
    rg.addColorStop(0, col);
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  };
  glow(W*0.25 + Math.sin(t)*40, H*0.3, W*0.5, "rgba(70,120,220,0.16)");
  glow(W*0.8 + Math.cos(t)*40, H*0.7, W*0.45, "rgba(220,90,150,0.12)");

  // ambient orbs
  for (const o of state.ambient) {
    const a = 0.25 + 0.35 * (0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(o.tw));
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(180,220,255," + a.toFixed(3) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawRibbon() {
  const step = 8;
  const top = state.playerY - 200;
  const bot = state.playerY + 260;

  const left = [], right = [], center = [];
  for (let y = top; y <= bot; y += step) {
    const cy = ribbonCenterY(y);
    center.push({ x: cy, y });
    left.push({ x: cy - state.ribbonHalf, y });
    right.push({ x: cy + state.ribbonHalf, y });
  }

  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.004);

  // outer glow band
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  pathFrom(left, right);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(90,200,255," + (0.10 + pulse*0.06).toFixed(3) + ")";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // main ribbon body (gradient)
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, bot);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#2f6bff");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#37c6ff");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#7d5cff");
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  pathFrom(left, right);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // moving shimmer stripes
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  pathFrom(left, right);
  ctx.clip();
  const off = (performance.now() * 0.12) % 40;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  for (let y = top - 40; y <= bot + 40; y += 40) {
    const yy = y + off;
    const cy = ribbonCenterY(yy);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cy - state.ribbonHalf, yy);
    ctx.lineTo(cy + state.ribbonHalf, yy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // bright center line
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(center[0].x, center[0].y);
  for (let i = 1; i < center.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(center[i].x, center[i].y);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.shadowColor = "#bff0ff";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function pathFrom(left, right) {
  ctx.moveTo(left[0].x, left[0].y);
  for (let i = 1; i < left.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(left[i].x, left[i].y);
  for (let i = right.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) ctx.lineTo(right[i].x, right[i].y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawPlayer() {
  // trail
  for (let i = state.playerTrail.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.playerTrail[i];
    const a = (1 - i / TRAIL_MAX) * 0.5;
    const r = PLAYER_R * (1 - i / TRAIL_MAX * 0.6);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,120," + a.toFixed(3) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  const x = state.playerX, y = state.playerY;
  // glow
  const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, PLAYER_R*3);
  rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,220,140,0.5)");
  rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,220,140,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = rg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, PLAYER_R*3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  // body
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "#ffd36b";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x-4, y-5, 2, x, y, PLAYER_R);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "#fff6e0");
  bg.addColorStop(0.6, "#ffcf6b");
  bg.addColorStop(1, "#ff9a3c");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, PLAYER_R, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, PLAYER_R + 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  // score
  ctx.font = "700 34px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eaf6ff";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  const s = Math.floor(state.score).toString();
  ctx.fillText(s, 26, 22);
  ctx.font = "500 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(180,210,240,0.7)";
  ctx.fillText("seconds riding", 28, 62);

  // best
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.font = "600 18px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,150,0.9)";
  ctx.fillText("best  " + state.best, W - 26, 24);
}

function drawStart() {
  overlay(0.55);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;

  ctx.font = "800 " + Math.min(72, W*0.11) + "px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx-200, cy-40, cx+200, cy+40);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#5cc8ff");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#ff9ecb");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(120,200,255,0.6)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
  ctx.fillText("VIB RIBBON", cx, cy - 70);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.font = "500 20px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dceeff";
  ctx.fillText("Ride the glowing ribbon. Keep it alive.", cx, cy + 6);

  ctx.font = "500 16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(190,215,245,0.85)";
  ctx.fillText("Move with your mouse or finger to stay on the ribbon.", cx, cy + 34);
  ctx.fillText("Each second you survive is a point.", cx, cy + 58);

  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now()*0.005);
  ctx.font = "700 22px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,225,160," + pulse.toFixed(3) + ")";
  ctx.fillText("— click or tap to ride —", cx, cy + 110);
}

function drawOver() {
  overlay(0.6);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;

  ctx.font = "800 " + Math.min(58, W*0.09) + "px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6f8e";
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255,110,140,0.5)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  ctx.fillText("RIBBON LOST", cx, cy - 70);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.font = "700 40px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eaf6ff";
  ctx.fillText(Math.floor(state.score) + " seconds", cx, cy + 4);

  ctx.font = "500 18px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,150,0.95)";
  ctx.fillText("best  " + state.best, cx, cy + 44);

  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now()*0.005);
  ctx.font = "700 22px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,225,160," + pulse.toFixed(3) + ")";
  ctx.fillText("— click or tap to ride again —", cx, cy + 100);
}

function overlay(a) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6,9,18," + a + ")";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0) {
    const m = state.shake * 12;
    ctx.translate((Math.random()*2-1)*m, (Math.random()*2-1)*m);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawRibbon();
  drawParticles();
  if (state.screen === "play" || state.screen === "over") drawPlayer();
  ctx.restore();

  if (state.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (state.flash*0.5).toFixed(3) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  if (state.screen === "play") drawHUD();
  else if (state.screen === "start") drawStart();
  else if (state.screen === "over") drawOver();
}

/* ---------------- LOOP ---------------- */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;   // clamp big frame gaps
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

/* ---------------- BOOT ---------------- */
resize();
state.playerX = W/2;
state.playerY = H*0.72;
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bastion</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    background: #1a1428;
    display: flex; justify-content: center; align-content: center;
    height: 100vh; width: 100vw;
    font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    border: 3px solid #4a3a5c;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(80,50,120,0.4);
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
// ===== STATE =====
const W = 960, H = 540;
let state = 'title';
let score = 0, hiScore = 0;
let player = { x: W/2, y: H-80, r: 14, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false, facing: 1, invuln: 0 };
let bullets = [], enemies = [], particles = [], clouds = [], stars = [];
let keys = {};
let shootCd = 0;
let enemyTimer = 0, enemyInterval = 180;
let shake = 0;
let time = 0;

// ===== INIT =====
function init() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++)
    clouds.push({ x: Math.random()*W, y: 30+Math.random()*100, w: 80+Math.random()*120, speed: 0.2+Math.random()*0.3 });
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++)
    stars.push({ x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*200, s: 0.5+Math.random()*2, tw: Math.random()*6.28 });
}

// ===== INPUT =====
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; if (e.code==='Space'||e.code==='Enter') e.preventDefault(); });
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update() {
  time += 0.016;
  if (state === 'title') {
    if (keys['Space'] || keys['Enter']) { state = 'play'; reset(); }
    return;
  }
  if (state === 'over') {
    if (keys['Space'] || keys['Enter']) { state = 'title'; }
    return;
  }

  // Player movement
  let ax = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) { ax = -1; player.facing = -1; }
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) { ax = 1; player.facing = 1; }
  player.vx += ax * 0.7;
  player.vx *= 0.85;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W - player.r, player.x));

  // Jump
  if ((keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['Space']) && player.onGround) {
    player.vy = -13;
    player.onGround = false;
  }
  player.vy += 0.65;
  player.y += player.vy;
  if (player.y >= H - 60) { player.y = H - 60; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true; }

  // Shoot
  shootCd -= 1;
  if (keys['KeyX'] || keys['KeyZ'] || keys['KeyJ'] || keys['KeyK']) {
    if (shootCd <= 0) {
      let bx = player.x + player.facing * 20;
      let by = player.y - 5;
      bullets.push({ x: bx, y: by, vx: player.facing * 12, r: 4 });
      shootCd = 12;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        particles.push({ x: bx, y: by, vx: player.facing*(2+Math.random()*3), vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*3, life: 10, max: 10, color: '#ffd700', size: 2+Math.random()*2 });
    }
  }

  // Bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length-1; i >= 0; i--) {
    bullets[i].x += bullets[i].vx;
    if (bullets[i].x < -20 || bullets[i].x > W+20) bullets.splice(i,1);
  }

  // Spawn enemies
  enemyTimer++;
  if (enemyTimer >= enemyInterval) {
    enemyTimer = 0;
    enemyInterval = Math.max(60, enemyInterval - 2);
    let type = Math.random();
    let ex = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -30 : W+30;
    let ey = 50 + Math.random()*(H-180);
    if (type < 0.4) enemies.push({ x: ex, y: ey, r: 18, hp: 2, vx: (ex<0?1:-1)*(1.5+Math.random()), vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5, type: 'drone', color: '#ff4466', t: 0 });
    else if (type < 0.75) enemies.push({ x: ex, y: ey, r: 14, hp: 1, vx: (ex<0?1:-1)*(2.5+Math.random()), vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*2, type: 'wasp', color: '#ffaa22', t: 0 });
    else enemies.push({ x: ex, y: ey, r: 24, hp: 4, vx: (ex<0?1:-1)*(0.8+Math.random()*0.5), vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*1, type: 'tank', color: '#8844ff', t: 0 });
  }

  // Enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length-1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let e = enemies[i];
    e.t += 0.05;
    e.x += e.vx;
    e.y += e.vy + Math.sin(e.t*2)*0.5;
    if (e.x < -60 || e.x > W+60 || e.y < -40 || e.y > H+40) { enemies.splice(i,1); continue; }

    // Hit player
    if (player.invuln <= 0) {
      let dx = player.x - e.x, dy = player.y - e.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy) < player.r + e.r) {
        player.invuln = 90;
        shake = 15;
        score = Math.max(0, score - 5);
        for (let j = 0; j < 12; j++)
          particles.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*8, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*8, life: 20, max: 20, color: '#ff3344', size: 3 });
        if (score <= 0) { state = 'over'; hiScore = Math.max(hiScore, score); }
      }
    }
    player.invuln = Math.max(0, player.invuln - 1);

    // Bullets hit enemy
    for (let j = bullets.length-1; j >= 0; j--) {
      let b = bullets[j];
      let bdx = b.x - e.x, bdy = b.y - e.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(bdx*bdx+bdy*bdy) < b.r + e.r) {
        e.hp--;
        bullets.splice(j,1);
        for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++)
          particles.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*6, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*6, life: 15, max: 15, color: e.color, size: 2+Math.random()*3 });
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          enemies.splice(i,1);
          score += e.type === 'tank' ? 30 : e.type === 'drone' ? 15 : 10;
          hiScore = Math.max(hiScore, score);
          shake = 5;
          for (let k = 0; k < 15; k++)
            particles.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*10, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*10, life: 25, max: 25, color: e.color, size: 3+Math.random()*4 });
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Particles
  for (let i = particles.length-1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  // Clouds
  for (let c of clouds) {
    c.x += c.speed;
    if (c.x - c.w > W) c.x = -c.w;
  }

  shake = Math.max(0, shake - 0.8);
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function draw() {
  const ctx = document.getElementById('c').getContext('2d');
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake);

  // Sky gradient
  let sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#0d0b2e');
  sky.addColorStop(0.3, '#1a1450');
  sky.addColorStop(0.6, '#2d1b6b');
  sky.addColorStop(0.85, '#4a2080');
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#2a1040');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // Stars
  for (let s of stars) {
    let a = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time*2 + s.tw));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,210,255,${a})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.s, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Moon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e0ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(780, 70, 30, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1450';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(790, 65, 26, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Clouds
  for (let c of clouds) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,80,160,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.w*0.5, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w*0.2, c.y - 8, c.w*0.35, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Distant mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1040';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H-100);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 60)
    ctx.lineTo(x, H-100 - Math.sin(x*0.01)*40 - Math.sin(x*0.025)*25);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.fill();

  // Mid mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#251555';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H-70);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40)
    ctx.lineTo(x, H-70 - Math.sin(x*0.015+1)*30 - Math.cos(x*0.03)*20);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.fill();

  // Ground
  let gnd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H-60, 0, H);
  gnd.addColorStop(0, '#2a1860');
  gnd.addColorStop(1, '#150d35');
  ctx.fillStyle = gnd;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H-60, W, 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2870';
  ctx.fillRect(0, H-60, W, 4);

  // Ground details
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,60,140,0.3)';
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 30) {
    ctx.fillRect(x, H-40, 2, 40);
  }

  // Bullets
  for (let b of bullets) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ffaa00';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8e0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r*0.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Enemies
  for (let e of enemies) {
    let pulse = 1 + Math.sin(e.t*3)*0.1;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
    ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);

    if (e.type === 'drone') {
      ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -e.r);
      ctx.lineTo(e.r, e.r*0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(-e.r, e.r*0.5);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 4, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0033';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (e.type === 'wasp') {
      ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, e.r, e.r*0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#331100';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-e.r*0.3, 0, e.r*0.2, e.r*0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(e.r*0.5, -e.r*0.2, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(e.r*0.5, -e.r*0.2, 1.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        let a = (Math.PI*2/6)*i + e.t;
        let px = Math.cos(a)*e.r, py = Math.sin(a)*e.r;
        i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px,py) : ctx.lineTo(px,py);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff00ff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Player
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
  let flash = player.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(player.invuln/4) % 2 === 0;
  if (flash) ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#44ccff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, player.r*0.7, player.r, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#66ddff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -player.r*0.6, player.r*0.45, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Visor
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(player.facing*3, -player.r*0.65, 5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#003355';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(player.facing*4, -player.r*0.65, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Cannon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
  let cx = player.facing * player.r * 0.5;
  ctx.fillRect(cx, -4, player.facing * 18, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.fillRect(cx + player.facing*14, -5, player.facing*6, 10);

  // Legs
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3399cc';
  ctx.fillRect(-8, player.r*0.5, 6, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(2, player.r*0.5, 6, 10);

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.restore();

  // Particles
  for (let p of particles) {
    let a = p.life / p.max;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * a, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // HUD
  if (state === 'play' || state === 'over') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 200, 50);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#44ccff';
    ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, 200, 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE', 20, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff88';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(String(score), 20, 52);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '12px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('BEST: ' + hiScore, 120, 30);
  }

  // Title screen
  if (state === 'title') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#44ccff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 64px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('BASTION', W/2, 180);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6688';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Defend the Last Bastion', W/2, 220);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('A  A  D  —  Move', W/2, 300);
    ctx.fillText('W  /  SPACE  —  Jump', W/2, 325);
    ctx.fillText('X  /  Z  /  J  /  K  —  Shoot', W/2, 350);

    let pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  BEGIN', W/2, 430);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // Game over
  if (state === 'over') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4466';
    ctx.font = 'bold 56px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('THE BASTION HAS FALLEN', W/2, 200);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '24px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W/2, 260);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + hiScore, W/2, 290);
    let pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  RETURN', W/2, 380);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ===== LOOP =====
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

init();
loop();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Maze War</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #000;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    display: block;

<canvas id="maze"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
// ---------- State ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("maze");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0;
let maze = [];
const MW = 12, MH = 9;
const CELL = 1;
let player = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, dir: 0, alive: true };
let enemies = [];
let score = 0;
let kills = 0;
let shots = [];
let keys = {};
let gameOver = false;
let won = false;
let lastShot = 0;
let startTime = 0;
let exitCell = { x: MW - 1, y: MH - 1 };
let shake = 0;

// ---------- Setup ----------
function resize() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

function generateMaze() {
  maze = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < MH; y++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < MW; x++) row.push({ walls: [true, true, true, true], visited: false });
    maze.push(row);
  }
  const stack = [];
  const sx = 0, sy = 0;
  maze[sy][sx].visited = true;
  stack.push({ x: sx, y: sy });
  while (stack.length) {
    const cur = stack[stack.length - 1];
    const dirs = [
      { dx: 1, dy: 0, w: 0, ow: 3 },
      { dx: -1, dy: 0, w: 3, ow: 0 },
      { dx: 0, dy: 1, w: 1, ow: 2 },
      { dx: 0, dy: -1, w: 2, ow: 1 }
    ].filter(d => {
      const nx = cur.x + d.dx, ny = cur.y + d.dy;
      return nx >= 0 && nx < MW && ny >= 0 && ny < MH && !maze[ny][nx].visited;
    });
    if (dirs.length === 0) {
      stack.pop();
      continue;
    }
    const d = dirs[Math.floor(Math.random() * dirs.length)];
    maze[cur.y][cur.x].walls[d.w] = false;
    maze[cur.y + d.dy][cur.x + d.dx].walls[d.ow] = false;
    maze[cur.y + d.dy][cur.x + d.dx].visited = true;
    stack.push({ x: cur.x + d.dx, y: cur.y + d.dy });
  }
}

function spawnEnemies() {
  enemies = [];
  const count = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    let x, y;
    do {
      x = Math.floor(Math.random() * MW);
      y = Math.floor(Math.random() * MH);
    } while ((x === 0 && y === 0) || (x === exitCell.x && y === exitCell.y));
    enemies.push({ x: x + 0.5, y: y + 0.5, dir: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, speed: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4, alive: true, respawn: 0 });
  }
}

function reset() {
  generateMaze();
  player = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, dir: 0, alive: true };
  spawnEnemies();
  score = 0;
  kills = 0;
  shots = [];
  gameOver = false;
  won = false;
  lastShot = 0;
  startTime = performance.now();
  shake = 0;
}
reset();

// ---------- Input ----------
window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") reset();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
});
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
  player.dir = Math.atan2(my - H / 2, mx - W / 2);
});
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", () => {
  if (gameOver) { reset(); return; }
  shoot();
});
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (gameOver) { reset(); return; }
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const t = e.touches[0];
  player.dir = Math.atan2(t.clientY - rect.top - H / 2, t.clientX - rect.left - W / 2);
  shoot();
});

function shoot() {
  const now = performance.now();
  if (now - lastShot < 200) return;
  lastShot = now;
  shots.push({
    x: player.x,
    y: player.y,
    dx: Math.cos(player.dir),
    dy: Math.sin(player.dir),
    life: 0
  });
  shake = 3;
}

// ---------- Update ----------
function canMove(x, y, dx, dy) {
  const nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
  const cx = Math.floor(nx), cy = Math.floor(ny);
  if (cx < 0 || cx >= MW || cy < 0 || cy >= MH) return false;
  const cell = maze[cy][cx];
  const fracX = nx - cx, fracY = ny - cy;
  const r = 0.25;
  if (fracX < r && cell.walls[3]) return false;
  if (fracX > 1 - r && cell.walls[0]) return false;
  if (fracY < r && cell.walls[2]) return false;
  if (fracY > 1 - r && cell.walls[1]) return false;
  return true;
}

function updatePlayer(dt) {
  if (!player.alive) return;
  const speed = 3.0 * dt;
  let mx = 0, my = 0;
  if (keys["w"] || keys["arrowup"]) my -= 1;
  if (keys["s"] || keys["arrowdown"]) my += 1;
  if (keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"]) mx -= 1;
  if (keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"]) mx += 1;
  if (mx !== 0 || my !== 0) {
    const len = Math.sqrt(mx * mx + my * my);
    mx /= len; my /= len;
    const dx = mx * speed, dy = my * speed;
    if (canMove(player.x, player.y, dx, 0)) player.x += dx;
    if (canMove(player.x, player.y, 0, dy)) player.y += dy;
    if (mx !== 0 || my !== 0) player.dir = Math.atan2(my, mx);
  }
  if (player.x > exitCell.x + 0.2 && player.x < exitCell.x + 0.8 &&
      player.y > exitCell.y + 0.2 && player.y < exitCell.y + 0.8) {
    won = true;
    gameOver = true;
  }
}

function updateEnemies(dt) {
  for (const e of enemies) {
    if (!e.alive) {
      e.respawn -= dt;
      if (e.respawn <= 0) {
        let x, y;
        do {
          x = Math.floor(Math.random() * MW);
          y = Math.floor(Math.random() * MH);
        } while ((x === 0 && y === 0) || (x === exitCell.x && y === exitCell.y));
        e.x = x + 0.5;
        e.y = y + 0.5;
        e.alive = true;
      }
      continue;
    }
    const dx = player.x - e.x, dy = player.y - e.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist < 2.5) {
      e.dir = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    } else {
      e.dir += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
    }
    const speed = e.speed * dt;
    const ex = Math.cos(e.dir) * speed, ey = Math.sin(e.dir) * speed;
    if (canMove(e.x, e.y, ex, 0)) e.x += ex; else e.dir += Math.PI / 2;
    if (canMove(e.x, e.y, 0, ey)) e.y += ey; else e.dir += Math.PI / 2;
    if (dist < 0.4) {
      player.alive = false;
      gameOver = true;
      shake = 8;
    }
  }
}

function updateShots(dt) {
  for (let i = shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = shots[i];
    s.x += s.dx * 8 * dt;
    s.y += s.dy * 8 * dt;
    s.life += dt;
    const cx = Math.floor(s.x), cy = Math.floor(s.y);
    if (cx < 0 || cx >= MW || cy < 0 || cy >= MH || s.life > 2) {
      shots.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    const cell = maze[cy][cx];
    const fx = s.x - cx, fy = s.y - cy;
    if ((fx < 0.1 && cell.walls[3]) || (fx > 0.9 && cell.walls[0]) ||
        (fy < 0.1 && cell.walls[2]) || (fy > 0.9 && cell.walls[1])) {
      shots.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (!e.alive) continue;
      const ex = e.x - s.x, ey = e.y - s.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey) < 0.35) {
        e.alive = false;
        e.respawn = 5;
        kills++;
        score += 100;
        shots.splice(i, 1);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  if (gameOver) return;
  updatePlayer(dt);
  updateEnemies(dt);
  updateShots(dt);
  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 20);
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function project(px, py, pz) {
  const cx = Math.cos(player.dir), sx = Math.sin(player.dir);
  const sy = Math.sin(player.dir), cx2 = Math.cos(player.dir);
  const tx = px - player.x, ty = py - player.y;
  const xCam = tx * cx2 - ty * sy;
  const yCam = tx * sy + ty * cx2;
  if (yCam < 0.05) return null;
  const screenX = W / 2 + (xCam / yCam) * (H / 2);
  const screenY = H / 2 - (pz / yCam) * (H / 2);
  const h = (1 / yCam) * H;
  return { x: screenX, y: screenY, h: h, z: yCam };
}

function drawMaze() {
  const fog = 0.0;
  for (let y = 0; y < MH; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < MW; x++) {
      const cell = maze[y][x];
      const corners = [
        { x: x, y: y },
        { x: x + 1, y: y },
        { x: x + 1, y: y + 1 },
        { x: x, y: y + 1 }
      ];
      const projected = corners.map(c => project(c.x, c.y, 0));
      if (projected.some(p => p === null)) continue;
      const avgZ = projected.reduce((s, p) => s + p.z, 0) / 4;
      const fogFactor = Math.min(1, avgZ / 8);
      const floorShade = Math.max(0.15, 1 - fogFactor);
      const r = Math.floor(40 * floorShade);
      const g = Math.floor(35 * floorShade);
      const b = Math.floor(50 * floorShade);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(projected[0].x, projected[0].y);
      for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) ctx.lineTo(projected[i].x, projected[i].y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
      ctx.fill();
      if (x === exitCell.x && y === exitCell.y) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,100,${0.3 * floorShade})`;
        ctx.fill();
      }
      const walls = [
        [0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 0]
      ];
      for (let wi = 0; wi < 4; wi++) {
        if (!cell.walls[wi]) continue;
        const [a, b] = walls[wi];
        const pa = projected[a], pb = projected[b];
        const wallH = pa.h * 0.7;
        const shade = Math.max(0.2, 1 - fogFactor);
        const wr = Math.floor(80 * shade);
        const wg = Math.floor(70 * shade);
        const wb = Math.floor(90 * shade);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pa.x, pa.y);
        ctx.lineTo(pa.x, pa.y - wallH);
        ctx.lineTo(pb.x, pb.y - wallH);
        ctx.lineTo(pb.x, pb.y);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${wr},${wg},${wb})`;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(120,110,140,${0.3 * shade})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawEnemies() {
  const sorted = enemies.filter(e => e.alive).sort((a, b) => {
    const za = Math.sqrt((a.x - player.x) ** 2 + (a.y - player.y) ** 2);
    const zb = Math.sqrt((b.x - player.x) ** 2 + (b.y - player.y) ** 2);
    return zb - za;
  });
  for (const e of sorted) {
    const p = project(e.x, e.y, 0);
    if (!p) continue;
    const size = p.h * 0.5;
    const fogF = Math.min(1, p.z / 8);
    const shade = Math.max(0.2, 1 - fogF);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - size * 0.5, size * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.fill();

function drawHUD() {

function drawGameOver() {

function draw() {

  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake
    );
  }

}

// ---------- Loop ----------
let lastTime = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

<style>
