<script>
"use strict";
const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=960,H=600;
canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H;
function fit(){const s=Math.min(window.innerWidth/W,window.innerHeight/H);canvas.style.width=(W*s)+'px';canvas.style.height=(H*s)+'px';}
window.addEventListener('resize',fit);fit();

// ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
const TILE=40;
const COLS=14, ROWS=9;
const OX=40, OY=70;
const GOLD=120, POP=6;
const MAX_ROOMS=64;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state='title'; // title, playing, won, lost
let gold=0, roomCount=0, roomList=[];
let enemies=[], projectiles=[], particles=[], floaters=[];
let mouse={x:0,y:0};
let hover=null;
let time=0;

// ---------- INPUT ----------
function toCanvas(e){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width),y:(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height)};}
function tileAt(x,y){const c=Math.floor((x-OX)/TILE),r=Math.floor((y-OY)/TILE);if(c<0||c>=COLS||r<0||r>=ROWS)return null;return{c,r};}
function inGrid(x,y){return x>=OX&&x<OX+COLS*TILE&&y>=OY&&y<OY+ROWS*TILE;}

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const p=toCanvas(e);mouse.x=p.x;mouse.y=p.y;
  if(state==='playing'){const t=tileAt(p.x,p.y);
    if(t && !roomAt(t.c,t.r) && gold>=GOLD && roomCount<MAX_ROOMS) hover={c:t.c,r:t.r};
    else hover=null;
  } else hover=null;
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{const p=toCanvas(e);
  if(state==='title'){startGame();return;}
  if(state==='won'||state==='lost'){startGame();return;}
  if(state==='playing'){
    const t=tileAt(p.x,p.y);
    if(t && !roomAt(t.c,t.r) && gold>=GOLD && roomCount<MAX_ROOMS){
      buildRoom(t.c,t.r);
    }
  }
});

function startGame(){
  state='playing';
  gold=0; roomCount=0; roomList=[];
  enemies=[]; projectiles=[]; particles=[]; floaters=[];
  hover=null;
}

function roomAt(c,r){return roomList.find(rm=>rm.c===c&&rm.r===r);}
function buildRoom(c,r){
  gold-=GOLD; roomCount++;
  const rm={c,r,hp:100,max:100,age:0};
  roomList.push(rm);
  spawnPop(c,r);
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++) particles.push(mkP(c*TILE+OX+TILE/2,r*TILE+OY+TILE/2,'#7a5cff'));
  floaters.push({x:c*TILE+OX+TILE/2,y:r*TILE+OY+TILE/2,txt:'-'+GOLD,life:1,col:'#ffd27a'});
}

function spawnPop(c,r){
  const cx=c*TILE+OX+TILE/2, cy=r*TILE+OY+TILE/2;
  for(let i=0;i<POP;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    enemies.push({
      x:cx+Math.cos(a)*10, y:cy+Math.sin(a)*10,
      vx:Math.cos(a)*40, vy:Math.sin(a)*40,
      hp:1, max:1, r:6, t:0,
      col:'#ff5a3c'
    });
  }
}

function mkP(x,y,col){return{x,y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*120,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*120,life:1,col};}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt){
  time+=dt;
  if(state!=='playing') return;

  // spawn enemies toward random rooms
  const rate=0.5 + roomCount*0.03;
  if(Math.random()<rate*dt && roomList.length>0){
    const target=roomList[Math.floor(Math.random()*roomList.length)];
    const side=Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
    let x,y;
    if(side===0){x=-10;y=Math.random()*H;}
    else if(side===1){x=W+10;y=Math.random()*H;}
    else if(side===2){x=Math.random()*W;y=-10;}
    else {x=Math.random()*W;y=H+10;}
    enemies.push({x,y,vx:0,vy:0,hp:2,max:2,r:8,t:0,col:'#ff8a3c',seek:target});
  }

  // move enemies
  for(const e of enemies){
    e.t+=dt;
    if(e.seek){
      const tc=e.seek.c*TILE+OX+TILE/2, tr=e.seek.r*TILE+OY+TILE/2;
      const dx=tc-e.x, dy=tr-e.y, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      const sp=70;
      e.vx=dx/d*sp; e.vy=dy/d*sp;
      if(d<10){
        e.seek=null;
        e.vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*60; e.vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*60;
      }
    }
    e.x+=e.vx*dt; e.y+=e.vy*dt;
    // bounce at edges
    if(e.x<0){e.x=0;e.vx*=-1;} if(e.x>W){e.x=W;e.vx*=-1;}
    if(e.y<0){e.y=0;e.vy*=-1;} if(e.y>H){e.y=H;e.vy*=-1;}
  }

  // rooms fire at nearby enemies
  for(const rm of roomList){
    rm.age+=dt;
    const cx=rm.c*TILE+OX+TILE/2, cy=rm.r*TILE+OY+TILE/2;
    let best=null, bd=140*140;
    for(const e of enemies){
      const dx=e.x-cx, dy=e.y-cy, d2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
      if(d2<bd){bd=d2;best=e;}
    }
    if(best && Math.random()<12*dt){
      const dx=best.x-cx, dy=best.y-cy, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      const sp=320;
      projectiles.push({x:cx,y:cy,vx:dx/d*sp,vy:dy/d*sp,life:1.2});
    }
    // decay
    rm.hp-=1.5*dt;
    if(rm.hp<=0){
      rm.hp=0;
      for(let i=0;i<14;i++) particles.push(mkP(cx,cy,'#5a3cff'));
      roomList=roomList.filter(r=>r!==rm);
      roomCount--;
      floaters.push({x:cx,y:cy,txt:'collapsed',life:1.4,col:'#9a7cff'});
    }
  }

  // projectiles
  for(const p of projectiles){
    p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.life-=dt;
    for(const e of enemies){
      const dx=e.x-p.x, dy=e.y-p.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy<(e.r+5)*(e.r+5)){
        e.hp-=1; p.life=0;
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++) particles.push(mkP(e.x,e.y,'#ffd27a'));
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  projectiles=projectiles.filter(p=>p.life>0 && p.x>-20 && p.x<W+20 && p.y>-20 && p.y<H+20);

  // damage enemies / collect gold
  for(const e of enemies){
    if(e.hp<=0){
      gold+=10;
      floaters.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,txt:'+10',life:1,col:'#ffe08a'});
      for(let i=0;i<6;i++) particles.push(mkP(e.x,e.y,e.col));
    }
  }
  enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0);

  // particles
  for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=60*dt;p.life-=dt*1.4;}
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);

  // floaters
  for(const f of floaters){f.y-=20*dt;f.life-=dt;}
  floaters=floaters.filter(f=>f.life>0);

  // win / lose
  if(roomCount===0 && enemies.length===0 && time>3) state='lost';
  if(gold>=1000) state='won';
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function draw(){
  // background
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H/2,50,W/2,H/2,W*0.7);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#1a1030');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0d0820');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#05040a');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // ambient floating motes
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const x=(i*97+time*10)%W, y=(i*53+Math.sin(time*0.5+i)*20)%H;
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.15;
    ctx.fillStyle='#6a4cff';
    ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,90,200,0.18)';
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let c=0;c<=COLS;c++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(OX+c*TILE,OY);ctx.lineTo(OX+c*TILE,OY+ROWS*TILE);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let r=0;r<=ROWS;r++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(OX,OY+r*TILE);ctx.lineTo(OX+COLS*TILE,OY+r*TILE);ctx.stroke();}

  // border
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(160,120,255,0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.strokeRect(OX,OY,COLS*TILE,ROWS*TILE);

  // rooms
  for(const rm of roomList){
    const x=rm.c*TILE+OX, y=rm.r*TILE+OY;
    const pulse=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*3+rm.c+rm.r);
    ctx.fillStyle='#241640';
    ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+2,TILE-4,TILE-4);
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(150,110,255,${0.5+0.3*pulse})`;
    ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.strokeRect(x+2,y+2,TILE-4,TILE-4);
    // inner glow
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(120,80,220,${0.25+0.2*pulse})`;
    ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+8,TILE-16,TILE-16);
    // hp bar
    const hpw=(TILE-8)*(rm.hp/rm.max);
    ctx.fillStyle='#0a0818';
    ctx.fillRect(x+4,y+TILE-8,TILE-8,3);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8a5cff';
    ctx.fillRect(x+4,y+TILE-8,hpw,3);
  }

  // hover
  if(hover){
    const x=hover.c*TILE+OX, y=hover.r*TILE+OY;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,200,120,0.25)';
    ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+2,TILE-4,TILE-4);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#7aff9a';
    ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.strokeRect(x+2,y+2,TILE-4,TILE-4);
  }

  // enemies
  for(const e of enemies){
    const wob=Math.sin(time*6+e.t*10)*1.5;
    ctx.fillStyle=e.col;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x,e.y+wob,e.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(e.x-2,e.y+wob-1,1.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(e.x+2,e.y+wob-1,1.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    if(e.max>1){
      ctx.fillStyle='#0a0818';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x-e.r,e.y-e.r-4,e.r*2,2);
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff6a4a';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x-e.r,e.y-e.r-4,e.r*2*(e.hp/e.max),2);
    }
  }

  // projectiles
  for(const p of projectiles){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe08a';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,200,120,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x-p.vx*0.02,p.y-p.vy*0.02,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }

  // particles
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.col;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,3,3);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  // floaters
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.font='bold 14px Georgia';
  for(const f of floaters){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f.life));
    ctx.fillStyle=f.col;
    ctx.fillText(f.txt,f.x,f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  if(state==='title') drawTitle();
  if(state==='won') drawEnd('DUNGEON MASTER!','You amassed 1000 gold. The dungeon is yours.','#ffd27a');
  if(state==='lost') drawEnd('THE DUNGEON FELL','All rooms collapsed. The keepers have vanished.','#ff6a4a');
}

function drawHUD(){
  // top bar
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,8,20,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,54);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(150,110,255,0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,54);ctx.lineTo(W,54);ctx.stroke();

  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.font='bold 20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8d9a8';
  ctx.fillText('DUNGEON KEEPER',18,34);

  ctx.font='16px Georgia';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe08a';
  ctx.fillText('Gold: '+gold,220,34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9a7cff';
  ctx.fillText('Rooms: '+roomCount,340,34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff6a4a';
  ctx.fillText('Enemies: '+enemies.length,470,34);

  // goal bar
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0818';
  ctx.fillRect(620,20,300,14);
  const gp=Math.min(1,gold/1000);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a';
  ctx.fillRect(620,20,300*gp,14);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,210,122,0.6)';
  ctx.strokeRect(620,20,300,14);
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8d9a8';
  ctx.font='12px Georgia';

  ctx.fillRect(0,H-40,W,40);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(150,110,255,0.4)';

  ctx.fillStyle='#c8b890';
  ctx.font='14px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('Click an empty tile to build a room (cost '+GOLD+' gold). Rooms spawn minions that fight invaders and earn gold. Keep your rooms alive — they decay over time!',18,H-16);
}

function drawTitle(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,4,10,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.font='bold 64px Georgia';
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8d9a8';
  ctx.fillText('DUNGEON KEEPER',W/2,H/2-40);
  ctx.font='20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillStyle='#9a7cff';
  ctx.fillText('Build rooms. Command minions. Grow your dungeon.',W/2,H/2+10);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a';
  ctx.font='bold 24px Georgia';
  const blink=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*4);
  ctx.globalAlpha=blink;
  ctx.fillText('Click anywhere to begin',W/2,H/2+60);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawEnd(title,sub,col){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,4,10,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.font='bold 56px Georgia';
  ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.fillText(title,W/2,H/2-30);
  ctx.font='20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8d9a8';
  ctx.fillText(sub,W/2,H/2+10);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a';
  ctx.font='bold 22px Georgia';
  const blink=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*4);
  ctx.globalAlpha=blink;
  ctx.fillText('Click to play again',W/2,H/2+60);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

// ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
const BASE = { x: W/2, y: H - 105 };
const BASE_R = 42;
const MAX_HP = 100;
const FIRE_CD = 0.09;
const BULLET_SPEED = 560;
const ENEMY_SPEED = 55;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state = 'start';
let hp = MAX_HP;
let score = 0;
let kills = 0;
let fireCd = 0;
let time = 0;
let shake = 0;
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 1.6;
let bullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let stars = [];
let flash = 0;
let keys = {};
let last = performance.now();

// ---------- INIT ----------
function init() {
  hp = MAX_HP; score = 0; kills = 0; fireCd = 0; time = 0; shake = 0;
  spawnTimer = 0; spawnInterval = 1.6;
  bullets = []; enemies = []; particles = []; flash = 0;
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 130; i++) {
    stars.push({ x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*(H*0.7), r: Math.random()*1.4+0.3, tw: Math.random()*6.28, sp: 0.5+Math.random()*1.5 });
  }
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(e.key.toLowerCase()) || e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();
  if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') {
    if (state === 'start') { state = 'playing'; init(); }
    else if (state === 'over') { state = 'start'; }
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
function addParticle(x,y,color,spd,life){
  particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(spd.a)*spd.s, vy: Math.sin(spd.a)*spd.s, life, max: life, color, r: spd.r });
}
function explode(x,y,color,n){
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = rand(0,6.28), s = rand(40,240);
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a)*s, vy: Math.sin(a)*s, life: rand(0.4,0.9), max:0.9, color, r: rand(1.5,3.5) });
  }
}
function spawnEnemy(){
  const types = [
    { r:16, hp:1, color:'#ff5a5a', pts:50, spd:rand(45,70) },
    { r:20, hp:2, color:'#ff9e3a', pts:120, spd:rand(35,55) },
    { r:24, hp:4, color:'#c86bff', pts:300, spd:rand(28,42) }
  ];
  const t = types[Math.random() < 0.55 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.7 ? 1 : 2)];
  enemies.push({
    x: rand(80, W-80), y: -30,
    r: t.r, hp: t.hp, maxHp: t.hp, color: t.color, pts: t.pts,
    spd: t.spd, wob: rand(0,6.28), wobSpd: rand(1,3), wobAmp: rand(20,55)
  });
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt) {
  time += dt;
  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt*40);
  if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt*3);

  // stars always drift
  for (const s of stars) { s.tw += s.sp*dt; }

  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // difficulty
  spawnInterval = Math.max(0.35, spawnInterval - dt*0.02);
  spawnTimer -= dt;
  if (spawnTimer <= 0) { spawnEnemy(); spawnTimer = spawnInterval; }

  // fire
  fireCd -= dt;
  if (keys[' '] && fireCd <= 0) {
    fireCd = FIRE_CD;
    bullets.push({ x: BASE.x, y: BASE.y - BASE_R, vy: -BULLET_SPEED, r: 5 });
    addParticle(BASE.x, BASE.y-BASE_R, '#aef7ff', {a:-Math.PI/2, s:80, r:3}, 0.2);
    shake = Math.max(shake, 2);
  }

  // bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.y += b.vy*dt;
    if (b.y < -20) { bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    // hit enemies
    for (let j = enemies.length-1; j>=0; j--) {
      const e = enemies[j];
      const dx = b.x - e.x, dy = b.y - e.y;
      if (dx*dx + dy*dy < (e.r + b.r)*(e.r + b.r)) {
        bullets.splice(i,1);
        e.hp--;
        explode(b.x, b.y, '#ffffff', 5);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          explode(e.x, e.y, e.color, 22);
          score += e.pts; kills++;
          enemies.splice(j,1);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    e.wob += e.wobSpd*dt;
    e.x += Math.sin(e.wob)*e.wobAmp*dt;
    e.y += e.spd*dt;
    // reached base
    const dx = e.x - BASE.x, dy = e.y - BASE.y;
    if (dx*dx + dy*dy < (BASE_R + e.r)*(BASE_R + e.r)) {
      explode(e.x, e.y, '#ff3b3b', 26);
      hp -= 15;
      shake = Math.max(shake, 12);
      flash = 1;
      enemies.splice(i,1);
      if (hp <= 0) { hp = 0; state = 'over'; }
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (let i = particles.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
    p.vx *= 0.96; p.vy *= 0.96;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground() {
  // sky gradient
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#050a14');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0a1220');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#0e1a2b');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    const a = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.tw));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe8ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // distant grid floor
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,220,150,0.10)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const horizon = H*0.72;
  for (let i=0;i<10;i++){
    const y = horizon + i*i*3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let i=-8;i<=8;i++){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(BASE.x + i*40, horizon); ctx.lineTo(BASE.x + i*140, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawBase() {
  const x = BASE.x, y = BASE.y;
  // platform
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d2233';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x-BASE_R-20, y+BASE_R); ctx.lineTo(x+BASE_R+20, y+BASE_R);
  ctx.lineTo(x+BASE_R, y-BASE_R); ctx.lineTo(x-BASE_R, y-BASE_R);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1f4d63'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();

  // turret dome
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x-12, y-14, 4, x, y, BASE_R);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#3fd6ff');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1273a0');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#0a3550');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, BASE_R, Math.PI, 0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#6fe3ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();

  // barrel
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2b3d';
  ctx.fillRect(x-6, y-BASE_R-26, 12, 26);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6fe3ff';
  ctx.fillRect(x-6, y-BASE_R-26, 12, 4);

  // glow
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35 + 0.2*Math.sin(time*4);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3fd6ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y-6, BASE_R*0.5, Math.PI, 0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const x = e.x, y = e.y;
  // glow
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
  ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, e.r+8, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // body (angular)
  ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y+e.r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+e.r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y-e.r);
  ctx.lineTo(x-e.r, y);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
  // core
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, e.r*0.3, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  // hp pips for tough enemies
  if (e.maxHp > 1) {
    for (let i=0;i<e.maxHp;i++){
      ctx.fillStyle = i < e.hp ? e.color : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
      ctx.fillRect(x - e.maxHp*6 + i*12, y - e.r - 12, 8, 4);
    }
  }
}

function drawBullet(b) {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aef7ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r*0.5, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
}

function drawParticle(p) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life/p.max);
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fffcf';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, 24, 40);
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5a8a7a';
  ctx.fillText('KILLS  ' + kills, 24, 64);

  // defcon level
  const lvl = Math.min(5, 1 + Math.floor(kills/15));
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffb04a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('DEFCON ' + (6-lvl), W-24, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7a5a3a';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('THREAT LEVEL', W-24, 60);

  // health bar
  const bw = 320, bx = (W-bw)/2, by = 22;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx-4, by-4, bw+8, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2a2a';
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 22);
  const frac = hp/MAX_HP;
  const hc = frac > 0.5 ? '#39ff9e' : (frac > 0.25 ? '#ffd24a' : '#ff4a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle = hc;
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw*frac, 22);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a5a5a'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, 22);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#dffff2';
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('BASE INTEGRITY  ' + Math.ceil(hp) + '%', W/2, by+16);
}

function drawOverlay(text, sub, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,8,14,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(text, W/2, H/2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd8c8';
  ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 30);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake), rand(-shake,shake));

  drawBackground();

  if (state === 'start') {
    drawBase();
    drawOverlay('DEFCON', 'PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH', '#39ff9e');
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  drawBase();
  for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  for (const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);
  for (const p of particles) drawParticle(p);
  drawHUD();

  if (flash > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = flash*0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff2a2a';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  if (state === 'over') {
    drawOverlay('DEFCON 5', 'FINAL SCORE  ' + score + '   —   PRESS SPACE', '#ff5a5a');
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last)/1000;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

init();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Habitat</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #000;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ============ STATE ============
  const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const W = 1024;
  const H = 576;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  const state = {
    started: false,
    over: false,
    won: false,
    score: 0,
    player: { x: W / 2, y: 460, vx: 0, vy: 0, facing: 1, grounded: true, walk: 0 },
    enemies: [],
    trees: [],
    clouds: [],
    goal: { x: W - 120, y: 0 },
    time: 0
  };

  // ============ INIT WORLD ============
  const groundY = 500;

  function buildWorld() {
    // trees
    const treeXs = [120, 280, 450, 620, 780, 900];
    state.trees = treeXs.map(x => ({
      x,
      h: 60 + Math.random() * 40,
      w: 40 + Math.random() * 30,
      sway: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    }));

    // clouds
    state.clouds = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      state.clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: 40 + Math.random() * 120,
        w: 80 + Math.random() * 80,
        speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.4
      });
    }

    // goal
    state.goal.x = W - 120;
    state.goal.y = groundY;

    // enemies
    state.enemies = [
      { x: 350, y: groundY, vx: -1, dir: -1, bob: 0 },
      { x: 600, y: groundY, vx: 1, dir: 1, bob: 0 },
      { x: 750, y: groundY, vx: -0.8, dir: -1, bob: 0 }
    ];

    // player
    state.player = { x: 80, y: groundY, vx: 0, vy: 0, facing: 1, grounded: true, walk: 0 };
    state.score = 0;
    state.started = false;
    state.over = false;
    state.won = false;
    state.time = 0;
  }

  buildWorld();

  // ============ INPUT ============
  const keys = {};
  const kmap = {
    'ArrowLeft': 'left', 'KeyA': 'left',
    'ArrowRight': 'right', 'KeyD': 'right',
    'ArrowUp': 'up', 'KeyW': 'up', 'Space': 'up',
    'ArrowDown': 'down', 'KeyS': 'down'
  };

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const k = kmap[e.code];
    if (k) { keys[k] = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.code === 'Enter') {
      if (!state.started && !state.over) state.started = true;
      else if (state.over) { buildWorld(); }
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    const k = kmap[e.code];
    if (k) keys[k] = false;
  });

  // ============ UPDATE ============
  function update(dt) {
    state.time += dt;

    // clouds
    for (const cl of state.clouds) {
      cl.x += cl.speed;
      if (cl.x - cl.w > W) cl.x = -cl.w;
    }

    if (!state.started || state.over) return;

    const p = state.player;

    // horizontal
    const speed = 3.5;
    if (keys.left) { p.vx = -speed; p.facing = -1; }
    else if (keys.right) { p.vx = speed; p.facing = 1; }
    else { p.vx = 0; }

    // jump
    if (keys.up && p.grounded) {
      p.vy = -13;
      p.grounded = false;
    }

    // gravity
    p.vy += 0.6;
    if (p.vy > 18) p.vy = 18;

    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;

    // ground
    if (p.y >= groundY) {
      p.y = groundY;
      p.vy = 0;
      p.grounded = true;
    }

    // bounds
    if (p.x < 20) p.x = 20;
    if (p.x > W - 20) p.x = W - 20;

    // walk cycle
    if (p.vx !== 0 && p.grounded) p.walk += dt * 12;
    else p.walk = 0;

    // enemies
    for (const en of state.enemies) {
      en.x += en.vx * en.dir;
      en.bob += dt * 5;
      if (en.x < 40 || en.x > W - 40) {
        en.dir *= -1;
        en.vx = Math.abs(en.vx) * en.dir;
      }
      // collision with player
      const dx = Math.abs(p.x - en.x);
      const dy = Math.abs(p.y - en.y);
      if (dx < 28 && dy < 40 && p.y < en.y - 5) {
        // player hit
        state.over = true;
        state.won = false;
        return;
      }
    }

    // score: distance
    const dist = Math.max(0, Math.floor((p.x - 80) / 10));
    if (dist > state.score) state.score = dist;

    // win: reach goal
    if (Math.abs(p.x - state.goal.x) < 30) {
      state.over = true;
      state.won = true;
      state.score += 500;
    }
  }

  // ============ DRAW ============
  function draw() {
    // sky gradient
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#1a2a4a');
    sky.addColorStop(0.4, '#2e5a8a');
    sky.addColorStop(0.7, '#5a9aba');
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#8acaca');
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars (upper area)
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
      const sy = (i * 61.3) % 200;
      const r = 0.5 + (i % 3) * 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // moon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e0c8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 150, 70, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d0c8b0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 140, 65, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // clouds
    for (const cl of state.clouds) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,230,240,0.6)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cl.x, cl.y, cl.w * 0.5, cl.w * 0.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cl.x + cl.w * 0.3, cl.y - 8, cl.w * 0.35, cl.w * 0.15, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cl.x - cl.w * 0.3, cl.y - 5, cl.w * 0.3, cl.w * 0.13, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // distant hills
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a5a4a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 20) {
      const y = groundY - 40 - Math.sin(x * 0.008) * 30 - Math.cos(x * 0.015) * 20;
      ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, groundY);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // ground
    const gnd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
    gnd.addColorStop(0, '#3a7a4a');
    gnd.addColorStop(0.3, '#2a5a3a');
    gnd.addColorStop(1, '#1a3a2a');
    ctx.fillStyle = gnd;
    ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);

    // ground texture lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,120,70,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 30) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, groundY + 5);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 15, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // trees
    for (const t of state.trees) {
      const sway = Math.sin(state.time * 0.8 + t.sway) * 3;

      // trunk
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3a2a';
      ctx.fillRect(t.x - 6, groundY - t.h, 12, t.h);

      // foliage
      const fy = groundY - t.h;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2a6a3a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(t.x + sway, fy - t.w * 0.3, t.w * 0.5, t.w * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a8a4a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(t.x + sway * 0.7, fy - t.w * 0.5, t.w * 0.35, t.w * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#4aaa5a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(t.x + sway * 0.5, fy - t.w * 0.65, t.w * 0.25, t.w * 0.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // goal flag
    const gx = state.goal.x;
    const gy = state.goal.y;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6a4a';
    ctx.fillRect(gx - 3, gy - 80, 6, 80);
    const flagWave = Math.sin(state.time * 3) * 5;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cc3a3a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx + 3, gy - 80);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + 40 + flagWave, gy - 70);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + 3, gy - 55);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // enemies (critters)
    for (const en of state.enemies) {
      const bob = Math.sin(en.bob) * 4;
      const ey = en.y - 20 + bob;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(ex, ey, 18, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // head
      ctx.fillStyle = '#9a5a9a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex + en.dir * 12, ey - 8, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // eye
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex + en.dir * 15, ey - 10, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex + en.dir * 16, ey - 10, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a3a6a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      const legSwing = Math.sin(en.bob * 2) * 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ex - 8, ey + 12);
      ctx.lineTo(ex - 8 + legSwing, ey + 22);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ex + 8, ey + 12);
      ctx.lineTo(ex + 8 - legSwing, ey + 22);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a4a8a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ex + en.dir * 12, ey - 18);
      ctx.lineTo(ex + en.dir * 12 + en.dir * 5, ey - 28);
      ctx.stroke();

    const p = state.player;
    const px = p.x;
    const py = p.y;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px, groundY + 2, 16, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a6aaa';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px, py - 25, 14, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8c8a8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py - 50, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3a2a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py - 54, 12, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + face * 4, py - 50, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a4a7a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px - 5, py - 8);
    ctx.lineTo(px - 5 + walkOff * face, py);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px + 5, py - 8);
    ctx.lineTo(px + 5 - walkOff * face, py);
    ctx.stroke();

    // arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a6aaa';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    const armSwing = Math.sin(p.walk + Math.PI) * 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px - face * 10, py - 30);
    ctx.lineTo(px - face * 10 + armSwing, py - 15);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px + face * 10, py - 30);
    ctx.lineTo(px + face * 10 - armSwing, py - 15);
    ctx.stroke();

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 200, 36);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, 20, 34);

    // instructions / overlay
    if (!state.started && !state.over) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 220, H / 2 - 80, 440, 160);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 28px monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('HABITAT', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.font = '16px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Arrow keys / WASD to move', W / 2, H / 2);
      ctx.fillText('Space / Up to jump', W / 2, H / 2 + 25);
      ctx.fillText('Reach the flag. Avoid the critters!', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
      ctx.font = '14px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    }

    if (state.over) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 200, H / 2 - 70, 400, 140);
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      if (state.won) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4aca5a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 32px monospace';
        ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ca4a4a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 32px monospace';
        ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '18px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 15);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
      ctx.font = '14px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 45);
    }
  }

  // ============ LOOP ============
  let lastTime = performance.now();

  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = now;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>River Raid</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #0a0a1a;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;

  canvas {
    display: block;

<canvas id="c" width="320" height="448"></canvas>
<script>
const W = 320, H = 448;
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// --- STATE ---
let state = 'title';
let river = [];
let enemies = [];
let bullets = [];
let particles = [];
let player = { x: W / 2, y: H - 40, w: 24, h: 32, fuel: 100, score: 0, alive: true, invuln: 0 };
let scrollY = 0;
let speed = 1.2;
let keys = {};
let lastTime = 0;

// --- RIVER GENERATION ---
const SEG_H = 40;
const MIN_W = 50;
const MAX_W = 200;

function genSegment(prevW) {
  let w = prevW + (Math.random() * 60 - 30);
  w = Math.max(MIN_W, Math.min(MAX_W, w));
  let cx = W / 2 + (Math.random() * 80 - 40);
  cx = Math.max(w / 2 + 5, Math.min(W - w / 2 - 5, cx));
  return { cx, w, h: SEG_H };
}

function initRiver() {
  river = [];
  let w = 120;
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.ceil(H / SEG_H) + 4; i++) {
    river.push(genSegment(w));
    w = river[river.length - 1].w;
  }
}

// --- ENEMIES ---
function spawnEnemy(segIdx) {
  if (segIdx < 0 || segIdx >= river.length) return;
  const seg = river[segIdx];
  const type = Math.random();
  let e = null;
  if (type < 0.3) {
    e = { type: 'ship', x: seg.cx + (Math.random() * seg.w * 0.6 - seg.w * 0.3), y: 0, w: 28, h: 20, hp: 1, score: 100, alive: true };
  } else if (type < 0.55) {
    e = { type: 'helicopter', x: seg.cx, y: 0, w: 30, h: 24, hp: 1, score: 200, alive: true, moveDir: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1, moveSpeed: 1 + Math.random() };
  } else if (type < 0.75) {
    e = { type: 'bomber', x: seg.cx, y: 0, w: 36, h: 24, hp: 3, score: 500, alive: true };
  } else if (type < 0.9) {
    e = { type: 'submarine', x: seg.cx + (Math.random() * seg.w * 0.5 - seg.w * 0.25), y: 0, w: 32, h: 16, hp: 1, score: 150, alive: true };
  } else {
    e = { type: 'fuel', x: seg.cx, y: 0, w: 20, h: 20, hp: 1, score: 0, alive: true };
  }
  enemies.push(e);
}

// --- INPUT ---
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (state === 'title' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    startGame();
  }
  if (state === 'gameover' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    state = 'title';
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

// --- START GAME ---
function startGame() {
  state = 'playing';
  player = { x: W / 2, y: H - 40, w: 24, h: 32, fuel: 100, score: 0, alive: true, invuln: 0 };
  bullets = [];
  enemies = [];
  particles = [];
  scrollY = 0;
  speed = 1.2;
  initRiver();
}

// --- UPDATE ---
function update(dt) {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Scroll
  scrollY += speed * dt * 60;
  while (scrollY >= SEG_H) {
    scrollY -= SEG_H;
    river.shift();
    river.push(genSegment(river[river.length - 1].w));
    // Spawn enemy in new segment
    if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
      spawnEnemy(river.length - 1);
    }
  }

  // Player movement
  const mx = 3;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= mx;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += mx;
  player.x = Math.max(12, Math.min(W - 12, player.x));

  // Fuel
  if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) {
    player.fuel -= 0.3;
  }
  if (player.fuel <= 0) {
    player.alive = false;
    state = 'gameover';
    return;
  }

  // Invulnerability
  if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;

  // Shooting
  if (keys[' '] || keys['Enter']) {
    if (!update.shootLock) {
      bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 20, vy: -6 });
      update.shootLock = true;
    }
  }
  if (!keys[' '] && !keys['Enter']) update.shootLock = false;

  // Update bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    bullets[i].y += bullets[i].vy * dt * 60;
    if (bullets[i].y < -10) bullets.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    if (!e.alive) { enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    e.y += speed * dt * 60;

    // Helicopter movement
    if (e.type === 'helicopter') {
      e.x += e.moveDir * e.moveSpeed * dt * 60;
      const seg = river.find(s => true); // just bounce
      if (e.x < 20 || e.x > W - 20) e.moveDir *= -1;
    }

    // Off screen
    if (e.y > H + 30) { enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }

    // Collision with player
    if (player.alive && player.invuln <= 0) {
      const dx = Math.abs(e.x - player.x);
      const dy = Math.abs(e.y - player.y);
      if (dx < (e.w + player.w) / 2 && dy < (e.h + player.h) / 2) {
        player.alive = false;
        state = 'gameover';
        return;
      }
    }

    // Bullet collision
    for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const b = bullets[j];
      const bdx = Math.abs(b.x - e.x);
      const bdy = Math.abs(b.y - e.y);
      if (bdx < (e.w + 4) / 2 && bdy < (e.h + 4) / 2) {
        e.hp--;
        bullets.splice(j, 1);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          e.alive = false;
          player.score += e.score;
          if (e.type === 'fuel') player.fuel = Math.min(100, player.fuel + 30);
          // Explosion particles
          for (let p = 0; p < 8; p++) {
            particles.push({
              x: e.x, y: e.y,
              vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
              vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
              life: 0.5, color: e.type === 'fuel' ? '#0f0' : '#ff4400'
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    particles[i].x += particles[i].vx * dt * 60;
    particles[i].y += particles[i].vy * dt * 60;
    particles[i].life -= dt;
    if (particles[i].life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Check river collision for player
  const segIdx = Math.floor((H - player.y) / SEG_H);
  if (segIdx >= 0 && segIdx < river.length) {
    const seg = river[segIdx];
    const segTop = H - (segIdx + 1) * SEG_H + scrollY;
    const segBot = H - segIdx * SEG_H + scrollY;
    if (player.y > segTop && player.y < segBot) {
      const leftEdge = seg.cx - seg.w / 2;
      const rightEdge = seg.cx + seg.w / 2;
      if (player.x - player.w / 2 < leftEdge || player.x + player.w / 2 > rightEdge) {
        player.alive = false;
        state = 'gameover';
      }
    }
  }
}

// --- DRAW ---
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (state === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
    return;
  }

  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2a1a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Draw river
  for (let i = 0; i < river.length; i++) {
    const seg = river[i];
    const y = H - (i + 1) * SEG_H + scrollY;
    const y2 = H - i * SEG_H + scrollY;
    if (y > H || y2 < 0) continue;

    // Land
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2d5a2d';
    ctx.fillRect(0, y, W, SEG_H);

    // River
    const left = seg.cx - seg.w / 2;
    const right = seg.cx + seg.w / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a4a8a';
    ctx.fillRect(left, y, right - left, SEG_H);

    // River banks
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a7a3a';
    ctx.fillRect(left - 4, y, 4, SEG_H);
    ctx.fillRect(right, y, 4, SEG_H);

    // Water highlights
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a6aba';
    for (let wy = y + 5; wy < y + SEG_H - 5; wy += 10) {
      ctx.fillRect(left + 10, wy, 20, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(right - 30, wy + 5, 15, 2);
    }
  }

  // Draw enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    if (!e.alive) continue;
    drawEnemy(e);
  }

  // Draw bullets
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff00';
  for (const b of bullets) {
    ctx.fillRect(b.x - 2, b.y - 6, 4, 12);
  }

  // Draw particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - 3, p.y - 3, 6, 6);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Draw player
  if (player.alive) {
    if (player.invuln <= 0 || Math.floor(player.invuln * 10) % 2 === 0) {
      drawPlayer();
    }
  }

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  if (state === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + player.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to continue', W / 2, H / 2 + 40);
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const x = player.x, y = player.y;
  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4488ff';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 8, 16, 24);
  // Nose
  ctx.fillStyle = '#66aaff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - 20);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 6, y - 8);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y - 8);
  ctx.fill();
  // Wings
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2266dd';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y + 4, 8, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 4, 8, 8);
  // Tail
  ctx.fillStyle = '#335599';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y + 14, 8, 6);
  // Cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y - 6, 6, 6);
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const x = e.x, y = e.y;
  switch (e.type) {
    case 'ship':
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cc4444';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y - 6, 24, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 10, 8, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#882222';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y + 4, 24, 4);
      break;
    case 'helicopter':
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44aa44';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y - 6, 20, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#66cc66';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 10, 8, 6);
      // Rotor
      ctx.fillStyle = '#228822';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y - 12, 32, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y - 14, 4, 4);
      // Tail
      ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y - 4, 10, 4);
      break;
    case 'bomber':
      ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y - 6, 32, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 10, 16, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#666666';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y + 4, 32, 4);
      // Wings
      ctx.fillRect(x - 20, y - 2, 40, 4);
      break;
    case 'submarine':
      ctx.fillStyle = '#335577';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, 16, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#447799';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 12, 8, 8);
      break;
    case 'fuel':
      ctx.fillStyle = '#22cc22';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 8, 16, 16);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px Courier New';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('F', x, y + 4);
      break;
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + player.score, 8, 18);

  // Fuel bar
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(8, 24, 100, 12);
  const fuelColor = player.fuel > 50 ? '#44cc44' : player.fuel > 25 ? '#cccc44' : '#cc4444';
  ctx.fillStyle = fuelColor;
  ctx.fillRect(8, 24, player.fuel, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '10px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('FUEL', 8, 44);
}

function drawTitle() {
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a1a2a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Decorative river
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3a5a';
  ctx.fillRect(100, 0, 120, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a5a7a';
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 20) {
    ctx.fillRect(110, y + 5, 40, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(170, y + 12, 30, 3);
  }

  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#44aaff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('RIVER', W / 2, 120);
  ctx.fillText('RAID', W / 2, 155);

  // Subtitle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Navigate the river. Destroy enemies.', W / 2, 200);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.fillText('← → Move  |  ↑ Boost  |  SPACE Shoot', W / 2, 225);
  ctx.fillText('Collect F for fuel. Avoid the banks!', W / 2, 245);

  // Start prompt
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
  const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2 === 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START', W / 2, 320);

  // Decorative ship
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4488ff';
  ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 8, 360, 16, 24);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#66aaff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 340);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2 - 6, 352);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 6, 352);
  ctx.fill();
}

// --- GAME LOOP ---
function loop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Discs of Tron</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #05060a; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; background: #05060a; cursor: crosshair; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
/* ============================================================
   DISCS OF TRON  —  one playable scene
   You are the blue disc. Launch your disc to hit the orange
   target disc. Hit 5 targets to WIN. Lose your 3 lives and
   you LOSE.
   Controls:
     Mouse  aim  |  Left-click / Space  launch
     P  pause  |  R  restart
   ============================================================ */

// ---------------- STATE ----------------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0;

const TARGETS_TO_WIN = 5;
const MAX_LIVES = 3;

let state = "start";   // start | playing | paused | won | lost
let score = 0;
let lives = MAX_LIVES;
let shotsThisTurn = 0;
let maxShots = 3;
let aimAngle = -Math.PI / 2;
let mouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let particles = [];
let rings = [];
let time = 0;

const player = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 26, angle: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, moving: false, trail: [] };
const target = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 22, pulse: 0 };
const disc = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 14, vx: 0, vy: 0, active: false, trail: [] };

const LAUNCH_SPEED = 15;
const FRICTION = 0.985;
const STOP_EPS = 0.06;

// ---------------- INPUT ----------------
function updateMouse(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  mouse.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
}
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", updateMouse);
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  if (e.button === 0) {
    if (state === "start") { startGame(); return; }
    if (state === "won" || state === "lost") { resetToStart(); return; }
    if (state === "playing") launch();
  }
});
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === " " || k === "spacebar") {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === "start") startGame();
    else if (state === "playing") launch();
    else if (state === "won" || state === "lost") resetToStart();
  } else if (k === "p") {
    if (state === "playing") state = "paused";
    else if (state === "paused") state = "playing";
  } else if (k === "r") {
    if (state === "playing" || state === "paused") startGame();
    else if (state === "won" || state === "lost") startGame();
  }
});

// ---------------- SETUP / RESET ----------------
function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  layout();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

function layout() {
  player.x = W * 0.5;
  player.y = H * 0.72;
  target.x = W * 0.5;
  target.y = H * 0.28;
  if (player.moving) {
    player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W - player.r, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H - player.r, player.y));
  }
}

function startGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = MAX_LIVES;
  shotsThisTurn = 0;
  particles = [];
  rings = [];
  player.moving = false;
  player.vx = player.vy = 0;
  player.trail = [];
  target.pulse = 0;
  layout();
  state = "playing";
}

function resetToStart() {
  state = "start";
  particles = [];
  rings = [];
  layout();
}

// ---------------- GAME LOGIC ----------------
function launch() {
  if (disc.active || player.moving) return;
  if (shotsThisTurn >= maxShots) return;
  shotsThisTurn++;
  aimAngle = Math.atan2(mouse.y - player.y, mouse.x - player.x);
  disc.x = player.x + Math.cos(aimAngle) * (player.r + disc.r + 2);
  disc.y = player.y + Math.sin(aimAngle) * (player.r + disc.r + 2);
  disc.vx = Math.cos(aimAngle) * LAUNCH_SPEED;
  disc.vy = Math.sin(aimAngle) * LAUNCH_SPEED;
  disc.active = true;
  disc.trail = [];
}

function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, n, speed) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = speed * (0.3 + Math.random());
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.025,
      color,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3
    });
  }
}

function spawnRing(x, y, color) {
  rings.push({ x, y, r: 8, max: 90, life: 1, color });
}

function onHitTarget() {
  score++;
  spawnParticles(target.x, target.y, "#ff9d2e", 40, 6);
  spawnRing(target.x, target.y, "#ff9d2e");
  target.pulse = 1;
  if (score >= TARGETS_TO_WIN) {
    state = "won";
    spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, "#33d6ff", 60, 7);
  }
}

function onLoseLife() {
  lives--;
  spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, "#33d6ff", 30, 5);
  spawnRing(player.x, player.y, "#33d6ff");
  if (lives <= 0) state = "lost";
}

function endTurn() {
  // all discs stopped
  const d = dist(player, target);
  const gap = d - (player.r + target.r);
  if (gap < 26) {
    // close enough -> win the turn
    onHitTarget();
    if (state === "playing") {
      // reset positions for next turn
      player.x = W * 0.5; player.y = H * 0.72;
      target.x = W * 0.5; target.y = H * 0.28;
      shotsThisTurn = 0;
    }
  } else {
    // missed -> lose a life
    onLoseLife();
    if (state === "playing") {
      player.x = W * 0.5; player.y = H * 0.72;
      target.x = W * 0.5; target.y = H * 0.28;
      shotsThisTurn = 0;
    }
  }
}

// ---------------- UPDATE ----------------
function update() {
  time += 1;
  target.pulse = Math.max(0, target.pulse - 0.02);

  // particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.96; p.vy *= 0.96;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
  // rings
  for (let i = rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const r = rings[i];
    r.r += (r.max - r.r) * 0.12;
    r.life -= 0.025;
    if (r.life <= 0) rings.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (state !== "playing") return;

  // player movement (arrows / WASD)
  if (player.moving) {
    const sp = 5;
    if (keys.a || keys.ArrowLeft)   player.x -= sp;
    if (keys.d || keys.ArrowRight)  player.x += sp;
    if (keys.w || keys.ArrowUp)     player.y -= sp;
    if (keys.s || keys.ArrowDown)   player.y += sp;
    player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W - player.r, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H - player.r, player.y));
    player.trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, life: 1 });
    if (player.trail.length > 22) player.trail.shift();
  }
  for (let i = player.trail.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    player.trail[i].life -= 0.05;
    if (player.trail[i].life <= 0) player.trail.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // disc physics
  if (disc.active) {
    disc.x += disc.vx;
    disc.y += disc.vy;
    disc.vx *= FRICTION;
    disc.vy *= FRICTION;
    disc.trail.push({ x: disc.x, y: disc.y, life: 1 });
    if (disc.trail.length > 26) disc.trail.shift();

    // walls
    if (disc.x < disc.r) { disc.x = disc.r; disc.vx *= -0.8; }
    if (disc.x > W - disc.r) { disc.x = W - disc.r; disc.vx *= -0.8; }
    if (disc.y < disc.r) { disc.y = disc.r; disc.vy *= -0.8; }
    if (disc.y > H - disc.r) { disc.y = H - disc.r; disc.vy *= -0.8; }

    // collision with target
    if (dist(disc, target) < disc.r + target.r) {
      disc.active = false;
      onHitTarget();
      if (state === "playing") {
        player.x = W * 0.5; player.y = H * 0.72;
        target.x = W * 0.5; target.y = H * 0.28;
        shotsThisTurn = 0;
      }
    }

    // collision with player
    if (dist(disc, player) < disc.r + player.r) {
      disc.active = false;
      onLoseLife();
      if (state === "playing") {
        player.x = W * 0.5; player.y = H * 0.72;
        target.x = W * 0.5; target.y = H * 0.28;
        shotsThisTurn = 0;
      }
    }

    // stopped?
    if (disc.active && Math.hypot(disc.vx, disc.vy) < STOP_EPS) {
      disc.active = false;
      endTurn();
    }
  }
}

// ---------------- DRAW ----------------
function drawBackground() {
  // deep space gradient
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.4, 60, W/2, H*0.5, Math.max(W,H)*0.8);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#0b1622");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#070b14");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#03040a");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // perspective grid floor
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(40,180,255,0.10)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const horizon = H * 0.35;
  // horizontal lines converging
  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
    const t = i / 21;
    const y = horizon + (H - horizon) * (t * t);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // vertical lines converging to vanishing point
  const vpx = W/2, vpy = horizon;
  for (let i = -12; i <= 12; i++) {
    const xb = W/2 + i * (W/24);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xb, H);
    ctx.lineTo(vpx + (xb - vpx) * 0.15, vpy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // glowing horizon line
  ctx.save();
  const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, horizon - 20, 0, horizon + 20);
  hg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(51,214,255,0)");
  hg.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(51,214,255,0.35)");
  hg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(51,214,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = hg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, horizon - 20, W, 40);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawDisc(x, y, r, color, glow, pulse) {
  ctx.save();
  // glow
  ctx.shadowColor = color;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30 + glow;
  // outer ring
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r + (pulse || 0) * 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.stroke();
  // inner disc
  const ig = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 2, x, y, r);
  ig.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
  ig.addColorStop(0.3, color);
  ig.addColorStop(1, shade(color, -40));
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = ig;
  ctx.fill();
  // highlight
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - r*0.3, y - r*0.35, r*0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function shade(hex, amt) {
  const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  let r = (n >> 16) + amt, g = ((n >> 8) & 255) + amt, b = (n & 255) + amt;
  r = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, r));
  g = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, g));
  b = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, b));
  return "rgb(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ")";
}

function drawTrail(arr, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    const t = arr[i];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = t.life * 0.35;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 6 * t.life + 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawAim() {
  if (state !== "playing" || disc.active || player.moving) return;
  const len = 130;
  const ex = player.x + Math.cos(aimAngle) * len;
  const ey = player.y + Math.sin(aimAngle) * len;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(51,214,255,0.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 8]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y);
  ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // arrow head
  const a = aimAngle;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ex, ey);
  ctx.lineTo(ex - Math.cos(a - 0.4) * 14, ey - Math.sin(a - 0.4) * 14);
  ctx.moveTo(ex, ey);
  ctx.lineTo(ex - Math.cos(a + 0.4) * 14, ey - Math.sin(a + 0.4) * 14);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  for (const r of rings) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, r.life);
    ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.shadowColor = r.color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe9ff";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score + " / " + TARGETS_TO_WIN, 24, 40);

  // lives as small discs
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("LIVES", W - 24, 32);
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_LIVES; i++) {
    const x = W - 24 - (MAX_LIVES - 1 - i) * 34;
    const y = 54;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? "#33d6ff" : "rgba(80,100,120,0.35)";
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // shots remaining
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "15px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(150,200,255,0.8)";
  if (state === "playing") {
    ctx.fillText("Shots left this turn: " + Math.max(0, maxShots - shotsThisTurn), W/2, H - 22);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCenterMessage(title, sub, color) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.shadowColor = color;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = "bold 64px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 10);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.font = "20px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe9ff";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 40);
  ctx.font = "15px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(150,200,255,0.7)";
  ctx.fillText("Click / Space to play  ·  R to restart", W/2, H/2 + 74);
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();

  drawTrail(player.trail, "#33d6ff");
  drawTrail(disc.trail, "#33d6ff");

  // target
  const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(time * 0.08) * 0.5;
  drawDisc(target.x, target.y, target.r, "#ff9d2e", 10 + pulse * 12, target.pulse);

  // player
  drawDisc(player.x, player.y, player.r, "#33d6ff", 12, 0);

  // flying disc
  if (disc.active) drawDisc(disc.x, disc.y, disc.r, "#e8fbff", 18, 0);

  drawAim();
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();

  if (state === "start")      drawCenterMessage("DISCS OF TRON", "Move with arrows · Launch to hit the orange disc", "#33d6ff");
  else if (state === "paused") drawCenterMessage("PAUSED", "Press P to resume", "#33d6ff");
  else if (state === "won")    drawCenterMessage("YOU WIN", "All " + TARGETS_TO_WIN + " discs captured", "#5cff9d");
  else if (state === "lost")   drawCenterMessage("GAME OVER", "You lost all your lives", "#ff5c5c");
}

// ---------------- KEY STATE ----------------
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { keys[e.key] = true; keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true; });
window.addEventListener("keyup",   (e) => { keys[e.key] = false; keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
// enable player movement when a movement key is held
function checkMove() {
  if (state !== "playing") return;
  const moving = keys["a"]||keys["d"]||keys["w"]||keys["s"]||
                 keys["ArrowLeft"]||keys["ArrowRight"]||keys["ArrowUp"]||keys["ArrowDown"];
  if (moving && !disc.active) player.moving = true;
  else if (!moving) player.moving = false;
}

// ---------------- LOOP ----------------
function loop() {
  aimAngle = Math.atan2(mouse.y - player.y, mouse.x - player.x);
  checkMove();
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------------- BOOT ----------------
resize();
mouse.x = W/2; mouse.y = H/2;
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Crimson Skies</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#0a0a14;height:100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;}
  #game{display:block;margin:0 auto;background:#0a0a14;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const W=960, H=540, canvas=document.getElementById('game'), ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');

  /* ============ STATE ============ */
  const S={
    mode:'start',
    t:0,
    score:0,
    lives:3,
    ship:{x:W/2,y:H-60,hp:100,inv:0},
    bullets:[],
    ebullets:[],
    enemies:[],
    waves:[],
    waveNo:0,
    waveTimer:0,
    particles:[],
    stars:[],
    msg:'', msgT:0,
    shake:0
  };
  const keys={};

  function initStars(){
    S.stars=[];
    for(let i=0;i<120;i++)
      S.stars.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,sp:0.2+Math.random()*1.5,sz:0.5+Math.random()*2});
  }
  initStars();

  function reset(){
    S.score=0;S.lives=3;
    S.ship={x:W/2,y:H-60,hp:100,inv:0};
    S.bullets=[];S.ebullets=[];S.enemies=[];S.waves=[];
    S.particles=[];S.waveNo=0;S.waveTimer=1.2;
    S.msg='';S.msgT=0;S.shake=0;
  }

  function spawnWave(){
    S.waveNo++;
    const n=Math.min(3+S.waveNo,9);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const x=80+Math.random()*(W-160);
      const y=-40-Math.random()*200;
      const type=Math.random()<0.25?'bomber':'fighter';
      S.enemies.push({
        x:x,y:y,
        vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.8,
        vy:0.6+Math.random()*0.6,
        hp:type==='bomber'?6:3,
        type:type,
        fire:1+Math.random()*2,
        wob:Math.random()*6.28
      });
    }
    S.msg='WAVE '+S.waveNo; S.msgT=1.5;
  }

  function explode(x,y,col,n){
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const a=Math.random()*6.28, sp=1+Math.random()*4;
      S.particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.6,col:col,sz:1+Math.random()*3});
    }
  }

  /* ============ INPUT ============ */
  window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    keys[e.code]=true;
    if(e.code==='Space') e.preventDefault();
    if(S.mode==='start' && (e.code==='Enter'||e.code==='Space')){ reset(); S.mode='play'; }
    else if(S.mode==='over' && (e.code==='Enter'||e.code==='Space')){ S.mode='start'; }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ keys[e.code]=false; });

  /* ============ UPDATE ============ */
  function update(dt){
    S.t+=dt;
    if(S.msgT>0) S.msgT-=dt;
    if(S.shake>0) S.shake-=dt*30;

    // stars
    for(const s of S.stars){
      s.y+=s.sp*dt*60;
      if(s.y>H){s.y=0;s.x=Math.random()*W;}
    }

    // particles
    for(let i=S.particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p=S.particles[i];
      p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.05;p.life-=dt;
      if(p.life<=0) S.particles.splice(i,1);
    }

    if(S.mode!=='play') return;

    // ship
    const sh=S.ship;
    const spd=320;
    if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['KeyA']) sh.x-=spd*dt;
    if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD']) sh.x+=spd*dt;
    if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW']) sh.y-=spd*dt;
    if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['KeyS']) sh.y+=spd*dt;
    sh.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(W-20,sh.x));
    sh.y=Math.max(H/2,Math.min(H-30,sh.y));
    if(sh.inv>0) sh.inv-=dt;

    // fire
    if(keys['Space']||keys['KeyZ']){
      if(!sh._cool || sh._cool<=0){
        S.bullets.push({x:sh.x,y:sh.y-18,vy:-520});
        sh._cool=0.13;
      }
    }
    if(sh._cool) sh._cool-=dt;

    // bullets
    for(let i=S.bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b=S.bullets[i]; b.y+=b.vy*dt;
      if(b.y<-10) S.bullets.splice(i,1);
    }

    // wave spawning
    if(S.waveTimer>0){
      S.waveTimer-=dt;
      if(S.waveTimer<=0) spawnWave();
    } else if(S.enemies.length===0){
      S.waveTimer=1.4;
    }

    // enemies
    for(let i=S.enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const e=S.enemies[i];
      e.wob+=dt*3;
      e.x+=e.vx + Math.sin(e.wob)*0.4;
      e.y+=e.vy;
      if(e.x<30||e.x>W-30) e.vx*=-1;

      e.fire-=dt;
      if(e.fire<=0 && e.y>0 && e.y<H-80){
        const dx=sh.x-e.x, dy=sh.y-e.y, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const sp=180;
        S.ebullets.push({x:e.x,y:e.y+14,vx:dx/d*sp,vy:dy/d*sp});
        e.fire=(e.type==='bomber')?1.6:1.1+Math.random();
      }

      if(e.y>H+40){ S.enemies.splice(i,1); continue; }

      // bullet hits
      for(let j=S.bullets.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        const b=S.bullets[j];
        if(Math.abs(b.x-e.x)<20 && Math.abs(b.y-e.y)<20){
          e.hp--;
          S.bullets.splice(j,1);
          explode(b.x,b.y,'#ffcc44',4);
          if(e.hp<=0){
            explode(e.x,e.y, e.type==='bomber'?'#ff5522':'#ff8844', e.type==='bomber'?26:16);
            S.score += e.type==='bomber'?150:100;
            S.enemies.splice(i,1);
            S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,3);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      if(e.hp<=0) continue;
    }

    // enemy bullets
    for(let i=S.ebullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b=S.ebullets[i];
      b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt;
      if(b.x<0||b.x>W||b.y<0||b.y>H){ S.ebullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
      if(sh.inv<=0 && Math.abs(b.x-sh.x)<16 && Math.abs(b.y-sh.y)<16){
        S.ebullets.splice(i,1);
        sh.hp-=18; sh.inv=0.8; S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,5);
        explode(sh.x,sh.y,'#ff3333',10);
        if(sh.hp<=0){
          S.lives--;
          explode(sh.x,sh.y,'#ff6622',30);
          S.shake=10;
          if(S.lives<=0){ S.mode='over'; }
          else { sh.x=W/2;sh.y=H-60;sh.hp=100;sh.inv=2; }
        }
      }
    }

    // collision ship vs enemy
    if(sh.inv<=0){
      for(let i=S.enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        const e=S.enemies[i];
        if(Math.abs(e.x-sh.x)<24 && Math.abs(e.y-sh.y)<24){
          sh.hp-=30; sh.inv=1; S.shake=8;
          explode(sh.x,sh.y,'#ff3333',12);
          explode(e.x,e.y,'#ff8844',14);
          S.score+=50;
          S.enemies.splice(i,1);
          if(sh.hp<=0){
            S.lives--;
            explode(sh.x,sh.y,'#ff6622',30);
            S.shake=10;
            if(S.lives<=0) S.mode='over';
            else { sh.x=W/2;sh.y=H-60;sh.hp=100;sh.inv=2; }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* ============ DRAW ============ */
  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(S.shake>0) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*S.shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*S.shake);

    // sky gradient
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#1a1a3e');
    g.addColorStop(0.5,'#3a2a55');
    g.addColorStop(0.85,'#7a3a5a');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#c05a4a');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(-10,-10,W+20,H+20);

    // stars
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
    for(const s of S.stars){
      ctx.globalAlpha=0.3+s.sz/3;
      ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.sz,s.sz);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    // distant clouds
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,70,90,0.25)';
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
      const cx=((i*230 + S.t*12)%(W+200))-100;
      const cy=120+i*60;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,90,22,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx+50,cy-10,60,18,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    }

    // particles
    for(const p of S.particles){
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);
      ctx.fillStyle=p.col;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.sz,p.sz);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    if(S.mode==='play'){
      // bullets
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffee66';
      for(const b of S.bullets){ ctx.fillRect(b.x-2,b.y-8,4,12); }
      // enemy bullets
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff5555';
      for(const b of S.ebullets){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,3.5,0,6.28); ctx.fill(); }

      // enemies
      for(const e of S.enemies) drawEnemy(e);

      // player ship
      drawShip(S.ship);
    }

    // HUD
    if(S.mode==='play'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffdd88';
      ctx.font='bold 18px Courier New';
      ctx.textAlign='left';
      ctx.fillText('SCORE '+String(S.score).padStart(6,'0'),16,28);
      // lives
      for(let i=0;i<S.lives;i++){
        ctx.fillStyle='#ff5555';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-30-i*24,24,7,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
      }
      // hp bar
      ctx.fillStyle='#333'; ctx.fillRect(16,40,120,8);
      ctx.fillStyle='#44dd66'; ctx.fillRect(16,40,120*(Math.max(0,S.ship.hp)/100),8);
      if(S.msgT>0){
        ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,S.msgT);
        ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 34px Courier New'; ctx.textAlign='center';
        ctx.fillText(S.msg,W/2,H/2-40);
        ctx.globalAlpha=1;
      }
    }

    // overlays
    if(S.mode==='start') drawStart();
    if(S.mode==='over') drawOver();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawShip(sh){
    const x=sh.x,y=sh.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x,y);
    if(sh.inv>0 && Math.floor(S.t*20)%2===0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.4;
    // engine flame
    const fl=8+Math.random()*8;
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8822';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-4,18); ctx.lineTo(4,18); ctx.lineTo(0,18+fl); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffdd44';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-2,18); ctx.lineTo(2,18); ctx.lineTo(0,18+fl*0.6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // wings
    ctx.fillStyle='#cc2222';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-22,8); ctx.lineTo(0,-2); ctx.lineTo(22,8); ctx.lineTo(22,14); ctx.lineTo(0,6); ctx.lineTo(-22,14); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff4444';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14,6); ctx.lineTo(0,0); ctx.lineTo(14,6); ctx.lineTo(14,10); ctx.lineTo(0,4); ctx.lineTo(-14,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle='#ee3333';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-20); ctx.lineTo(6,4); ctx.lineTo(6,14); ctx.lineTo(-6,14); ctx.lineTo(-6,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle='#88ddff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-4,3,5,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    // tail
    ctx.fillStyle='#cc2222';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-3,14); ctx.lineTo(-10,20); ctx.lineTo(-3,18); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(3,14); ctx.lineTo(10,20); ctx.lineTo(3,18); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(e){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);
    if(e.type==='bomber'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#556677';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,26,12,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#334455';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-26,-2); ctx.lineTo(-40,-10); ctx.lineTo(-26,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(26,-2); ctx.lineTo(40,-10); ctx.lineTo(26,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#778899';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-8,10,5,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff8844';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,12,3,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle='#883333';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,18); ctx.lineTo(8,0); ctx.lineTo(20,4); ctx.lineTo(10,10); ctx.lineTo(0,14); ctx.lineTo(-10,10); ctx.lineTo(-20,4); ctx.lineTo(-8,0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#aa4444';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,10); ctx.lineTo(5,0); ctx.lineTo(-5,0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffdd44';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,2,2.5,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStart(){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,10,20,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff3333';
    ctx.font='bold 64px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('CRIMSON SKIES',W/2,180);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffdd88';
    ctx.font='bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Defend the skies. Survive the waves.',W/2,230);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
    ctx.font='18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Arrows / WASD  —  Move',W/2,300);
    ctx.fillText('Space / Z  —  Fire',W/2,330);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8844';
    ctx.font='bold 24px Courier New';
    if(Math.floor(S.t*2)%2===0) ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO START',W/2,420);
  }

  function drawOver(){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,10,20,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff3333';
    ctx.font='bold 56px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,200);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffdd88';
    ctx.font='bold 28px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  '+S.score,W/2,270);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
    ctx.font='18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Waves reached: '+S.waveNo,W/2,310);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8844';
    ctx.font='bold 22px Courier New';
    if(Math.floor(S.t*2)%2===0) ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR SPACE',W/2,400);
  }

  /* ============ LOOP ============ */
  let last=performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt=(now-last)/1000;
    if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
    last=now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
