<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pogo Joe</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border: 4px solid #333;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,200,0,0.3);
    max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// ============ STATE ============
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const GROUND_Y = H - 60;
const GRAVITY = 0.55;
const JUMP_FORCE = -13;
const POLE_HEIGHT = 80;
const POLE_WIDTH = 10;
const JUMP_HEIGHT = 55;

let state = {
  started: false,
  gameOver: false,
  score: 0,
  best: 0,
  timer: 0
};

let joe = {
  x: 100,
  y: GROUND_Y,
  vy: 0,
  onGround: true,
  pogoing: false,
  facing: 1
};

let obstacles = [];
let particles = [];
let clouds = [];
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 90;
let scrollSpeed = 3;

// ============ INIT ============
function initClouds() {
  clouds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    clouds.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: 30 + Math.random() * 80,
      w: 60 + Math.random() * 80,
      speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5
    });
  }
}

function resetGame() {
  joe = { x: 100, y: GROUND_Y, vy: 0, onGround: true, pogoing: false, facing: 1 };
  obstacles = [];
  particles = [];
  spawnTimer = 0;
  spawnInterval = 90;
  scrollSpeed = 3;
  state.score = 0;
  state.gameOver = false;
  state.started = true;
  state.timer = 0;
  initClouds();
}

initClouds();

// ============ INPUT ============
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!state.started) {
      resetGame();
    } else if (state.gameOver) {
      resetGame();
    } else if (joe.onGround) {
      doPogo();
    }
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (!state.started) {
    resetGame();
  } else if (state.gameOver) {
    resetGame();
  } else if (joe.onGround) {
    doPogo();
  }
});

// ============ POGO JUMP ============
function doPogo() {
  joe.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
  joe.onGround = false;
  joe.pogoing = true;
  // spawn dust particles
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: joe.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
      y: GROUND_Y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
      vy: -Math.random() * 2,
      life: 20 + Math.random() * 15,
      maxLife: 35,
      color: `hsl(${30 + Math.random() * 20}, 60%, ${50 + Math.random() * 20}%)`
    });
  }
}

// ============ OBSTACLES ============
function spawnObstacle() {
  const types = ['rock', 'log', 'spike'];
  const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
  let ob;
  if (type === 'rock') {
    ob = { type, x: W + 30, y: GROUND_Y, w: 35, h: 30, passed: false };
  } else if (type === 'log') {
    ob = { type, x: W + 30, y: GROUND_Y - 20, w: 55, h: 22, passed: false };
  } else {
    ob = { type, x: W + 30, y: GROUND_Y, w: 28, h: 35, passed: false };
  }
  obstacles.push(ob);
}

// ============ UPDATE ============
function update() {
  if (!state.started || state.gameOver) return;
  state.timer++;

  // Joe physics
  joe.vy += GRAVITY;
  joe.y += joe.vy;

  if (joe.y >= GROUND_Y) {
    joe.y = GROUND_Y;
    joe.vy = 0;
    joe.onGround = true;
    joe.pogoing = false;
  }

  // Scroll speed increases over time
  scrollSpeed = 3 + state.timer * 0.003;
  spawnInterval = Math.max(45, 90 - state.timer * 0.05);

  // Spawn obstacles
  spawnTimer++;
  if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnObstacle();
  }

  // Move obstacles
  for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    obstacles[i].x -= scrollSpeed;
    if (obstacles[i].x + obstacles[i].w < -20) {
      obstacles.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    // Score when passed
    if (!obstacles[i].passed && obstacles[i].x + obstacles[i].w < joe.x) {
      obstacles[i].passed = true;
      state.score++;
      if (state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
    }
    // Collision check
    if (checkCollision(joe, obstacles[i])) {
      state.gameOver = true;
      // explosion particles
      for (let j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
        const angle = (j / 20) * Math.PI * 2;
        particles.push({
          x: joe.x, y: joe.y - 20,
          vx: Math.cos(angle) * (2 + Math.random() * 3),
          vy: Math.sin(angle) * (2 + Math.random() * 3),
          life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
          maxLife: 50,
          color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 60}, 90%, ${50 + Math.random() * 30}%)`
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    particles[i].x += particles[i].vx;
    particles[i].y += particles[i].vy;
    particles[i].life--;
    if (particles[i].life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update clouds
  for (let c of clouds) {
    c.x -= c.speed;
    if (c.x + c.w < 0) {
      c.x = W + c.w;
      c.y = 30 + Math.random() * 80;
    }
  }
}

function checkCollision(j, o) {
  const jLeft = j.x - 15;
  const jRight = j.x + 15;
  const jTop = j.y - 50;
  const jBottom = j.y;
  const oLeft = o.x;
  const oRight = o.x + o.w;
  const oTop = o.y - o.h;
  const oBottom = o.y;
  return jRight > oLeft && jLeft < oRight && jBottom > oTop && jTop < oBottom;
}

// ============ DRAW ============
function draw() {
  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#B0E0FF');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#D4EDFF');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Sun
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 80, 70, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,215,0,0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const a = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W - 80 + Math.cos(a) * 42, 70 + Math.sin(a) * 42);
    ctx.lineTo(W - 80 + Math.cos(a) * 55, 70 + Math.sin(a) * 55);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Clouds
  for (let c of clouds) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w * 0.3, c.y + 10, c.w * 0.3, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w * 0.55, c.y + 5, c.w * 0.25, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w * 0.75, c.y + 12, c.w * 0.2, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Distant hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5BA05B';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 10) {
    const hillY = GROUND_Y - 40 - Math.sin(x * 0.01 + state.timer * 0.005) * 25;
    ctx.lineTo(x, hillY);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Ground
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#8B6914');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#6B4E0A');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4A3508');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);

  // Grass on top
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4CAF50';
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y - 4, W, 6);

  // Grass blades
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#388E3C';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 12) {
    const h = 6 + Math.sin(x * 0.3 + state.timer * 0.05) * 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND_Y - 2);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 3, GROUND_Y - 2 - h);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Obstacles
  for (let o of obstacles) {
    if (o.type === 'rock') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w * 0.3, o.y - o.h);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w * 0.7, o.y - o.h * 0.9);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(o.x + o.w * 0.2, o.y);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w * 0.4, o.y - o.h * 0.8);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w * 0.6, o.y - o.h * 0.7);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w * 0.8, o.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (o.type === 'log') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(o.x, o.y - o.h, o.w, o.h, 8);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#A0522D';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(o.x + o.w, o.y - o.h / 2, 6, o.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6B3410';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(o.x + o.w, o.y - o.h / 2, 3 + i * 2, o.h / 4 - i * 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    } else {
      // spike
      ctx.fillStyle = '#C0C0C0';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y - o.h);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#888';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      // second smaller spike
      ctx.fillStyle = '#D0D0D0';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(o.x + o.w * 0.3, o.y);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w * 0.5, o.y - o.h * 0.6);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w * 0.7, o.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Particles
  for (let p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3 + alpha * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Joe (Pogo stick character)
  drawJoe();

  // HUD
  if (state.started && !state.gameOver) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(10, 10, 180, 40, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${state.score}`, 20, 36);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(`BEST: ${state.best}`, 120, 36);
  }

  // Start screen
  if (!state.started) {
    drawOverlay('POGO JOE', 'Press SPACE or CLICK to start!', 'Jump over rocks, logs and spikes');
  }

  // Game over
  if (state.gameOver) {
    drawOverlay('GAME OVER', `Score: ${state.score}  |  Best: ${state.best}`, 'Press SPACE or CLICK to retry');
  }
}

function drawJoe() {
  const jx = joe.x;
  const jy = joe.y;
  const bounce = joe.onGround ? 0 : Math.min(1, Math.abs(joe.vy) / 10);
  const pogoStretch = joe.pogoing ? 0.85 : 1;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(jx, jy);

  // Pogo stick pole
  const poleH = POLE_HEIGHT * pogoStretch;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6600';
  ctx.fillRect(-POLE_WIDTH / 2, -poleH, POLE_WIDTH, poleH);
  // Pole highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF9944';
  ctx.fillRect(-POLE_WIDTH / 2 + 2, -poleH, 3, poleH);
  // Spring coil
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const sy = -8 - i * 10;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, sy, 8, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Base
  ctx.fillStyle = '#CC4400';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, -2, 14, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Body
  const bodyY = -poleH - 10;
  // Torso
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2196F3';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-12, bodyY - 20, 24, 25, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  // Shirt stripe
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1565C0';
  ctx.fillRect(-12, bodyY - 5, 24, 5);

  // Head
  const headY = bodyY - 30;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFCC80';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, headY, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Hair
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5D4037';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, headY - 4, 12, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-4, headY, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(4, headY, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Smile
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, headY + 3, 6, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Arms
  const armWave = Math.sin(state.timer * 0.15) * 5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFCC80';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  // Left arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-12, bodyY - 15);
  ctx.lineTo(-22, bodyY - 5 + armWave);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Right arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, bodyY - 15);
  ctx.lineTo(22, bodyY - 5 - armWave);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Legs (on pogo)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-6, bodyY + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(-4, -poleH + 5);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(6, bodyY + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(4, -poleH + 5);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, hint) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(subtitle, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#AAA';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(hint, W / 2, H / 2 + 45);

  // Bouncing arrow
  const arrowY = H / 2 + 70 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 8;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6600';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - 10, arrowY);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 10, arrowY);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2, arrowY + 15);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<style>

<body>
<canvas id="c" width="900" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   INFIDEL  —  a single playable scene
   Steer the lone diver down into the deep. Harvest light,
   avoid the things that hunt in the dark, and survive 60s
   to surface.  Touch the ceiling and you win.
   ============================================================ */

const cv = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
const W = cv.width, H = cv.height;

// ---------- STATE ----------
const state = {
  mode: "start",        // start | play | win | lose
  time: 0,              // elapsed in play
  goal: 60,             // seconds to survive
  score: 0,
  best: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  player: { x: W/2, y: 120, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 13, hurt: 0, glow: 0 },
  enemies: [],
  orbs: [],
  bubbles: [],
  motes: [],
  particles: [],
  spawnT: 0,
  orbT: 0,
};

// ---------- INPUT ----------
const keys = {};
addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;

function startGame(){
  state.mode = "play";
  state.time = 0; state.score = 0; state.shake = 0; state.flash = 0;
  state.player.x = W/2; state.player.y = 130; state.player.vx = 0; state.player.vy = 0; state.player.hurt = 0;
  state.enemies = []; state.orbs = []; state.particles = [];
  state.bubbles = []; state.spawnT = 0; state.orbT = 0;
}

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }

function spawnEnemy(){
  const fromSide = Math.random() < 0.5;
  const e = {
    x: fromSide ? (Math.random()<0.5 ? -30 : W+30) : rand(40, W-40),
    y: fromSide ? rand(H*0.35, H-40) : -30,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    r: rand(14, 22),
    speed: rand(60, 120),

    hue: rand(280, 330),

  state.enemies.push(e);
}

function spawnOrb(){
  state.orbs.push({ x: rand(50, W-50), y: H+20, vy: rand(-40,-70), life: 1, pulse: rand(0,6) });
}

function burst(x,y,color,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = rand(0,Math.PI*2), s = rand(40,180);
    state.particles.push({ x,y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, life:rand(.4,.9), max:.9, color });

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt){
  // ambient background always drifts
  for(const m of state.motes){ m.y += m.vy*dt; if(m.y>H+5){m.y=-5;m.x=rand(0,W);} }

  if(state.mode !== "play") return;

  state.time += dt;
  if(state.time >= state.goal){ state.mode = "win"; state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score); return; }

  const p = state.player;

  // --- player movement ---
  const acc = 900, maxv = 340, drag = 3.2;
  let ax=0, ay=0;
  if(keys["arrowleft"]||keys["a"]) ax -= 1;
  if(keys["arrowright"]||keys["d"]) ax += 1;
  if(keys["arrowup"]||keys["w"]) ay -= 1;
  if(keys["arrowdown"]||keys["s"]) ay += 1;
  if(ax&&ay){ ax*=0.7071; ay*=0.7071; }
  p.vx += ax*acc*dt; p.vy += ay*acc*dt;
  p.vx -= p.vx*drag*dt; p.vy -= p.vy*drag*dt;
  const sp = Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vy);
  if(sp>maxv){ p.vx*=maxv/sp; p.vy*=maxv/sp; }
  p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
  if(p.x < p.r){ p.x = p.r; p.vx*=-0.4; }
  if(p.x > W-p.r){ p.x = W-p.r; p.vx*=-0.4; }
  if(p.y > H-p.r){ p.y = H-p.r; p.vy*=-0.4; }
  if(p.y < 20){ // reached the surface
    state.mode = "win"; state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
    burst(p.x, 20, "#7ff3ff", 40); return;
  }
  if(p.hurt>0) p.hurt -= dt;
  p.glow = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time*4)*0.2;

  // --- spawn enemies (ramp with time) ---
  state.spawnT -= dt;
  const interval = Math.max(0.7, 2.2 - state.time*0.02);
  if(state.spawnT <= 0 && state.enemies.length < 14){ spawnEnemy(); state.spawnT = interval; }

  // --- spawn orbs ---
  state.orbT -= dt;
  if(state.orbT <= 0){ spawnOrb(); state.orbT = rand(1.2, 2.4); }

  // --- enemies chase player ---
  for(const e of state.enemies){
    const dx = p.x-e.x, dy = p.y-e.y, d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    const want = e.speed*(1 + state.time*0.005);
    e.vx += (dx/d)*want*dt*3; e.vy += (dy/d)*want*dt*3;
    const es = Math.hypot(e.vx,e.vy); if(es>want){ e.vx*=want/es; e.vy*=want/es; }
    e.wob += dt*6;
    e.x += (e.vx + Math.cos(e.wob)*10)*dt;
    e.y += (e.vy + Math.sin(e.wob)*10)*dt;
    e.tail.push({x:e.x,y:e.y}); if(e.tail.length>10) e.tail.shift();

    if(d < e.r + p.r){
      if(p.hurt<=0){
        p.hurt = 1.2; state.shake = 14; state.flash = 0.7;
        burst(p.x,p.y,"#ff5b7a",26);
        state.score = Math.max(0, state.score-15);
      }
    }
  }

  // --- orbs float up, collect ---
  for(let i=state.orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const o = state.orbs[i];
    o.y += o.vy*dt; o.pulse += dt*4; o.life -= dt*0.05;
    if(Math.hypot(p.x-o.x,p.y-o.y) < p.r+12){
      state.score += 10; burst(o.x,o.y,"#ffe07a",16); state.orbs.splice(i,1);
    } else if(o.y < -20 || o.life<=0) state.orbs.splice(i,1);
  }

  // --- bubbles ---
  if(Math.random()<0.4) state.bubbles.push({x:rand(0,W),y:H+5,r:rand(2,7),vy:rand(-30,-70)});
  for(let i=state.bubbles.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const b=state.bubbles[i]; b.y+=b.vy*dt; b.x+=Math.sin(b.y*0.05)*0.5; if(b.y<-10) state.bubbles.splice(i,1); }

  // --- particles ---
  for(let i=state.particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const q=state.particles[i]; q.x+=q.vx*dt; q.y+=q.vy*dt; q.vy+=200*dt; q.life-=dt; if(q.life<=0) state.particles.splice(i,1); }

  if(state.shake>0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt*40);
  if(state.flash>0) state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt*2);
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#0a1830"); g.addColorStop(0.4,"#0a1226"); g.addColorStop(1,"#04060d");
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // light shafts from the surface
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const x = (i+0.5)/5*W + Math.sin(state.time*0.3+i)*30;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x,0,x, H*0.7);
    grad.addColorStop(0,"rgba(90,180,255,0.10)"); grad.addColorStop(1,"rgba(90,180,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x-25,0); ctx.lineTo(x+25,0); ctx.lineTo(x+90,H*0.7); ctx.lineTo(x-90,H*0.7); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // drifting motes
  ctx.save();
  for(const m of state.motes){
    ctx.globalAlpha = m.a; ctx.fillStyle = "#9fd8ff";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // bubbles
  ctx.save();
  for(const b of state.bubbles){
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(160,220,255,0.35)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  }

}

function drawOrbs(){
  ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  for(const o of state.orbs){
    const r = 9 + Math.sin(o.pulse)*2;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x,o.y,0,o.x,o.y,r*3);
    g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,230,140,0.9)"); g.addColorStop(0.4,"rgba(255,190,80,0.5)"); g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,180,60,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,r*3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff6d8"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,r*0.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemies(){
  for(const e of state.enemies){
    // tail
    ctx.save();
    for(let i=0;i<e.tail.length;i++){
      const t = e.tail[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha = i/e.tail.length*0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${e.hue},70%,45%)`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x,t.y,e.r*(0.3+i/e.tail.length*0.6),0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // body
    const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(e.wob)*0.08;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(e.x,e.y,0,e.x,e.y,e.r*1.6*pulse);
    g.addColorStop(0,`hsl(${e.hue},85%,60%)`); g.addColorStop(0.6,`hsl(${e.hue},80%,35%)`); g.addColorStop(1,`hsl(${e.hue},80%,20%)`);

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.r*pulse,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // tendrils
    ctx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${e.hue},70%,55%)`; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
      const a = e.wob + i*(Math.PI*2/5);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x,e.y);
      ctx.lineTo(e.x+Math.cos(a)*e.r*1.8, e.y+Math.sin(a)*e.r*1.8); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // glowing eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4d6d";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x-4,e.y-2,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x+4,e.y-2,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const p = state.player;
  const hurt = p.hurt>0 && Math.floor(state.time*12)%2===0;
  ctx.save();
  if(!hurt){
    // glow
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,60*p.glow);
    g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(120,240,255,0.55)"); g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(120,240,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,60*p.glow,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = hurt ? "#ff7b93" : "#5fe0ff";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // visor
  ctx.fillStyle = hurt ? "#fff" : "#062a3a";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x+3,p.y-2,5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // fin
  ctx.fillStyle = hurt ? "#ff9db0" : "#33b6e6";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p.x-10,p.y); ctx.lineTo(p.x-24,p.y+6); ctx.lineTo(p.x-24,p.y-6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles(){
  ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  for(const q of state.particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha = q.life/q.max; ctx.fillStyle = q.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,44);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8fe6ff"; ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + state.score, 20, 22);
  const remain = Math.max(0, state.goal - state.time);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("SURFACE  " + remain.toFixed(1) + "s", W-20, 22);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.restore();

  // progress bar
  ctx.save();
  const bw = 240, bx = W/2-bw/2, by = 14, bh = 8;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)"; ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw,bh);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5fe0ff"; ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw*(state.time/state.goal),bh);
  ctx.restore();
}

function centerPanel(title, sub, color){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(3,6,12,0.72)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.font = "bold 64px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#cfeeff"; ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8fe6ff"; ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  OR  TAP  TO  DIVE  AGAIN", W/2, H/2 + 55);
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0){ ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake,state.shake), rand(-state.shake,state.shake)); }
  drawBackground();
  drawOrbs();
  drawEnemies();
  drawPlayer();
  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();

  if(state.flash>0){ ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,60,90,${state.flash*0.4})`; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }

  if(state.mode === "play") drawHUD();
  else if(state.mode === "start")
    centerPanel("INFIDEL", "Dive. Harvest light. Survive 60 seconds.\nArrows / WASD to swim.  Touch the surface to win.", "#5fe0ff");
  else if(state.mode === "win")
    centerPanel("SURFACED", "You escaped.  Score: " + state.score, "#7fffb0");
  else if(state.mode === "lose")
    centerPanel("THE DEEP TOOK YOU", "Score: " + state.score, "#ff5b7a");
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now - last)/1000; last = now;
  if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// seed ambient motes
for(let i=0;i<40;i++){ state.motes.push({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(0,H),r:rand(0.6,2.2),vy:rand(4,14),a:rand(0.05,0.35)}); }

  return 'rgb(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + b + ')';
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fb0ff';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, 24, 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(143,176,255,0.5)';
  ctx.fillText('BEST  ' + Math.max(best, score), 24, 50);

  if (state === 'playing') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('drag / arrows to link 3+ same gems  •  space to lock  •  esc to clear', 24, H - 28);
  }
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;

  // big title with glow
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.12) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#7aa2ff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf1ff';
  ctx.fillText('STARCROSS', cx, cy - H * 0.05);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // subtitle
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.03) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4d7d';
  ctx.fillText('LINK THE CONSTELLATIONS', cx, cy + H * 0.05);

  // prompt
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + pulse * 0.5;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.035) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('— CLICK / TAP / PRESS ANY KEY TO START —', cx, cy + H * 0.16);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // floating demo gems
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const a = time * 0.6 + i * (Math.PI * 2 / 5);
    const gx = cx + Math.cos(a) * (H * 0.28);
    const gy = cy + Math.sin(a) * (H * 0.12);
    drawGem(gx, gy, PALETTE[i], H * 0.02, true);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawEnd(won) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,5,15,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;

  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.1) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.shadowColor = won ? '#5fe36b' : '#ff4d7d';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 26;
  ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#eafff0' : '#ffe9f0';
  ctx.fillText(won ? 'CONSTELLATION COMPLETE' : 'STARFALL', cx, cy - H * 0.06);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.05) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, cx, cy + H * 0.04);

  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.032) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.fillText('click / tap / press any key to play again', cx, cy + H * 0.14);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

/* ===================== DRAW ===================== */
function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  if (state === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
    return;
  }
  drawBoard();
  drawHUD();
  if (state === 'win') drawEnd(true);
  if (state === 'lose') drawEnd(false);
}

/* ===================== LOOP ===================== */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

/* ===================== BOOT ===================== */
resize();
makeStars();
seedGrid();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ===== STATE =====
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const state = {
  phase: 'title', // title, playing, gameover
  score: 0,
  lives: 3,
  wishes: 0,
  targetWishes: 10,
  player: { x: W/2, y: H - 60, w: 50, h: 30, speed: 6 },
  stars: [],
  wishOrbs: [],
  particles: [],
  keys: {},
  spawnTimer: 0,
  spawnInterval: 90,
  difficulty: 1,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  messages: []
};

// ===== INIT =====
function initStars() {
  state.stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    state.stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
      twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1
    });
  }
}

function resetGame() {
  state.score = 0;
  state.lives = 3;
  state.wishes = 0;
  state.wishOrbs = [];
  state.particles = [];
  state.spawnTimer = 0;
  state.difficulty = 1;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = 0;
  state.messages = [];
  state.player.x = W / 2;
  state.phase = 'playing';
}

// ===== INPUT =====
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  state.keys[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
    if (state.phase === 'title') {
      resetGame();
    } else if (state.phase === 'gameover') {
      state.phase = 'title';
    }
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  state.keys[e.key] = false;
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (state.phase === 'title') resetGame();
  else if (state.phase === 'gameover') state.phase = 'title';
});

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update() {
  state.time++;

  if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;

  // Player movement
  if (state.keys['ArrowLeft'] || state.keys['a']) state.player.x -= state.player.speed;
  if (state.keys['ArrowRight'] || state.keys['d']) state.player.x += state.player.speed;
  state.player.x = Math.max(state.player.w/2, Math.min(W - state.player.w/2, state.player.x));

  // Spawn wish orbs
  state.spawnTimer++;
  const interval = Math.max(30, state.spawnInterval - state.difficulty * 5);
  if (state.spawnTimer >= interval) {
    state.spawnTimer = 0;
    const type = Math.random();
    let orb = {
      x: Math.random() * (W - 40) + 20,
      y: -20,
      r: 15,
      speed: 1.5 + state.difficulty * 0.3,
      wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      wobbleSpeed: 0.03 + Math.random() * 0.04
    };
    if (type < 0.6) {
      orb.type = 'wish'; // good - collect
      orb.color = '#ffd700';
      orb.glow = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4)';
    } else if (type < 0.85) {
      orb.type = 'star'; // bonus
      orb.color = '#00ffcc';
      orb.glow = 'rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.4)';
      orb.r = 10;
    } else {
      orb.type = 'curse'; // bad - avoid
      orb.color = '#ff3366';
      orb.glow = 'rgba(255, 51, 102, 0.4)';
      orb.r = 18;
    }
    state.wishOrbs.push(orb);
  }

  // Update orbs
  for (let i = state.wishOrbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const o = state.wishOrbs[i];
    o.y += o.speed;
    o.wobble += o.wobbleSpeed;
    o.x += Math.sin(o.wobble) * 1.5;

    // Off screen
    if (o.y > H + 30) {
      state.wishOrbs.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    // Collision with player
    const dx = o.x - state.player.x;
    const dy = o.y - state.player.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    const hitDist = o.r + state.player.w/2;

    if (dist < hitDist) {
      if (o.type === 'wish') {
        state.wishes++;
        state.score += 100;
        state.flash = 8;
        spawnParticles(o.x, o.y, '#ffd700', 12);
        addMessage('+1 WISH!', o.x, o.y - 30, '#ffd700');
        state.wishOrbs.splice(i, 1);
      } else if (o.type === 'star') {
        state.score += 50;
        spawnParticles(o.x, o.y, '#00ffcc', 8);
        addMessage('+50', o.x, o.y - 30, '#00ffcc');
        state.wishOrbs.splice(i, 1);
      } else if (o.type === 'curse') {
        state.lives--;
        state.shake = 15;
        state.flash = 12;
        spawnParticles(o.x, o.y, '#ff3366', 15);
        addMessage('CURSE HIT!', o.x, o.y - 30, '#ff3366');
        state.wishOrbs.splice(i, 1);
        if (state.lives <= 0) {
          state.phase = 'gameover';
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update messages
  for (let i = state.messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = state.messages[i];
    m.y -= 0.8;
    m.life--;
    if (m.life <= 0) state.messages.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Difficulty ramp
  if (state.time % 600 === 0) {
    state.difficulty += 0.5;
  }

  // Win condition
  if (state.wishes >= state.targetWishes) {
    state.phase = 'gameover';
    state.won = true;
  }

  // Decay
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake *= 0.85;
  if (state.flash > 0) state.flash -= 0.5;
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    state.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      r: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
      color,
      life: 30 + Math.random() * 20
    });
  }
}

function addMessage(text, x, y, color) {
  state.messages.push({ text, x, y, color, life: 60 });
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function draw() {
  ctx.save();

  // Screen shake
  if (state.shake > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake
    );
  }

  // Background gradient
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1040');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a1535');

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(s.twinkle + state.time * 0.02));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;

  }

  ctx.fillRect(0, H - 40, W, 40);

  // Ground line
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150, 100, 255, 0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H - 40);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H - 40);
  ctx.stroke();

  if (state.phase === 'title') {

  }

  // Wish orbs
  for (const o of state.wishOrbs) {
    // Glow
    const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, o.r * 0.3, o.x, o.y, o.r * 2.5);
    glowGrad.addColorStop(0, o.glow);
    glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Orb body
    ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Inner highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(o.x - o.r * 0.3, o.y - o.r * 0.3, o.r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Type indicator
    if (o.type === 'wish') {
      drawStar(o.x, o.y, o.r * 0.5, 5, '#fff');
    } else if (o.type === 'curse') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = `bold ${o.r}px monospace`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('✕', o.x, o.y);
    }
  }

  // Player (Wishbringer)
  const px = state.player.x, py = state.player.y;
  // Body
  const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 5, px, py, 30);
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#88ccff');
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3355aa');
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(px, py, 25, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Cape
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6644cc';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px - 20, py - 5);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(px - 35, py + 20, px - 25, py + 30);
  ctx.lineTo(px + 25, py + 30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(px + 35, py + 20, px + 20, py - 5);
  ctx.fill();

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffddbb';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py - 22, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px - 4, py - 24, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(px + 4, py - 24, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Staff
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#aa8844';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px + 22, py + 15);
  ctx.lineTo(px + 30, py - 35);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Staff orb
  const staffGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(px + 30, py - 35, 2, px + 30, py - 35, 12);
  staffGlow.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
  staffGlow.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffcc00');
  staffGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = staffGlow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px + 30, py - 35, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Particles
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / 50;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Messages
  for (const m of state.messages) {
    const alpha = m.life / 60;
    ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(m.text, m.x, m.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Flash
  if (state.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${state.flash * 0.02})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // Game over
  if (state.phase === 'gameover') {
    drawGameOver();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStar(cx, cy, r, points, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < points * 2; i++) {
    const angle = (i * Math.PI) / points - Math.PI / 2;
    const radius = i % 2 === 0 ? r : r * 0.4;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${state.score}`, 20, 30);

  // Wishes progress
  ctx.fillText(`WISHES: ${state.wishes}/${state.targetWishes}`, 20, 55);

  // Progress bar
  const barW = 150, barH = 12;
  const barX = 20, barY = 65;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  const fill = state.wishes / state.targetWishes;
  const barGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, barY, barX + barW, barY);
  barGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffd700');
  barGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8800');
  ctx.fillStyle = barGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * fill, barH);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);

  // Lives
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5577';
  ctx.font = '20px monospace';
  let hearts = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) hearts += '♥ ';
  ctx.fillText(hearts, W - 20, 30);

  // Difficulty
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(`Level ${Math.floor(state.difficulty)}`, W - 20, 55);
}

function drawTitle() {
  // Title glow
  const t = state.time * 0.03;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  // Big title
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(t)})`;
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('WISHBRINGER', W/2, H/2 - 60);

  // Subtitle
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200, 220, 255, 0.8)';
  ctx.font = '18px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Catch golden wishes. Avoid the curses.', W/2, H/2);

  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('← → or A/D to move', W/2, H/2 + 40);
  ctx.fillText('Collect 10 wishes to win', W/2, H/2 + 65);

  // Blink prompt
  if (Math.sin(state.time * 0.08) > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('CLICK or PRESS ENTER to START', W/2, H/2 + 120);
  }

  // Decorative stars
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const sx = W/2 + Math.cos(t + i * 1.3) * 120;
    const sy = H/2 - 60 + Math.sin(t * 0.7 + i * 0.9) * 30;
    drawStar(sx, sy, 8, 5, `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${0.5 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t + i)})`);
  }
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  if (state.won) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('✨ WISHES GRANTED! ✨', W/2, H/2 - 40);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '20px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${state.score}`, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillText(`Wishes: ${state.wishes}/${state.targetWishes}`, W/2, H/2 + 40);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3366';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('CURSED!', W/2, H/2 - 40);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '20px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${state.score}`, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillText(`Wishes: ${state.wishes}/${state.targetWishes}`, W/2, H/2 + 40);

(function(){

  //  STATE
  // ============================================================
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

  const state = {
    running: false,
    won: false,
    lost: false,
    score: 0,
    time: 0
  };

  const player = {
    x: 0, y: 0,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    angle: 0,
    radius: 9
  };

  const keys = {
    up: false, left: false, right: false,
    thrust: false, brake: false
  };

  // Physics tuning
  const THUST_ACCEL   = 130;   // px/s^2
  const MAX_SPEED     = 340;   // px/s
  const TURN_RATE     = 3.4;   // rad/s
  const DRAG          = 0.12;   // per-second velocity decay
  const BRAKE_ACCEL   = 260;   // px/s^2

  const BOUND_PAD = 22;

  // Stars (background)
  let stars = [];
  function makeStars(){
    stars = [];
    const n = Math.floor((W*H)/14000);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random()*W,
        y: Math.random()*H,
        r: Math.random()*1.6 + 0.3,
        tw: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
        sp: 0.5 + Math.random()*1.5
      });
    }
  }

  // Particles
  let particles = [];
  function spawnParticle(x,y,vx,vy,life,color,size){
    particles.push({x,y,vx,vy,life,maxLife:life,color,size});
  }

  // ============================================================
  //  RESIZE
  // ============================================================
  function resize(){
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width  = Math.floor(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width  = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
    makeStars();
    if(!state.running){
      // keep player centered on first layout
      player.x = W/2; player.y = H/2;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  //  INPUT
  // ============================================================
  function resetGame(){
    player.x = W/2;
    player.y = H/2;
    player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.angle = -Math.PI/2;
    particles = [];
    state.running = true;
    state.won = false;
    state.lost = false;
    state.score = 0;
    state.time = 0;
  }

  function keyMap(e, down){
    switch(e.code){
      case 'ArrowUp': case 'KeyW': keys.up = down; break;
      case 'ArrowLeft': case 'KeyA': keys.left = down; break;
      case 'ArrowRight': case 'KeyD': keys.right = down; break;
      case 'Space': keys.thrust = down; break;
      case 'ShiftLeft': case 'ShiftRight': keys.brake = down; break;
      case 'Enter':
        if(down && (!state.running || state.won || state.lost)) resetGame();
        break;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
    if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    keyMap(e, true);
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keyMap(e, false); });

  // touch / mouse: tap to start, drag to steer, hold to thrust
  let pointer = { active:false, x:0, y:0 };
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{
    if(!state.running || state.won || state.lost){ resetGame(); }
    pointer.active = true;
    pointer.x = e.clientX; pointer.y = e.clientY;
    keys.thrust = true;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>{
    if(!pointer.active) return;
    pointer.x = e.clientX; pointer.y = e.clientY;
    // steer toward pointer
    const dx = pointer.x - player.x, dy = pointer.y - player.y;
    const target = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    let diff = target - player.angle;
    while(diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI*2;
    while(diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI*2;
    if(Math.abs(diff) > 0.02){
      const step = TURN_RATE * 0.016 * Math.sign(diff);
      player.angle += Math.max(-Math.abs(diff), Math.min(Math.abs(diff), step));
    }
  });
  function endPointer(e){
    pointer.active = false;
    keys.thrust = false;
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', endPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', endPointer);

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  // ============================================================
  //  UPDATE
  // ============================================================
  function update(dt){
    if(!state.running) return;
    state.time += dt;

    // --- steering (keyboard) ---
    if(keys.left)  player.angle -= TURN_RATE*dt;
    if(keys.right) player.angle += TURN_RATE*dt;

    // --- thrust ---
    if(keys.thrust){
      player.vx += Math.cos(player.angle)*THUST_ACCEL*dt;
      player.vy += Math.sin(player.angle)*THUST_ACCEL*dt;
      // exhaust particles
      const bx = player.x - Math.cos(player.angle)*player.radius;
      const by = player.y - Math.sin(player.angle)*player.radius;
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
        const spread = (Math.random()-0.5)*0.9;
        const a = player.angle + Math.PI + spread;
        const sp = 60 + Math.random()*120;
        spawnParticle(bx, by,
          Math.cos(a)*sp + player.vx*0.3,
          Math.sin(a)*sp + player.vy*0.3,
          0.35 + Math.random()*0.3,
          Math.random()<0.5 ? '#ff8a3d' : '#ffd24a',
          2 + Math.random()*3);
      }
    }

    // --- brake ---
    if(keys.brake){
      const sp = Math.hypot(player.vx, player.vy);
      if(sp > 0){
        const dec = Math.min(sp, BRAKE_ACCEL*dt);
        player.vx -= (player.vx/sp)*dec;
        player.vy -= (player.vy/sp)*dec;
      }
    }

    // --- drag ---
    const drag = Math.pow(DRAG, dt);
    player.vx *= drag;
    player.vy *= drag;

    // --- clamp speed ---
    const speed = Math.hypot(player.vx, player.vy);
    if(speed > MAX_SPEED){
      player.vx = player.vx/speed*MAX_SPEED;
      player.vy = player.vy/speed*MAX_SPEED;
    }

    // --- integrate ---
    player.x += player.vx*dt;
    player.y += player.vy*dt;

    // --- bounds: bumping a wall loses a life (score penalty) ---
    if(player.x < BOUND_PAD){ player.x = BOUND_PAD; player.vx = Math.abs(player.vx)*0.4; bump(); }
    if(player.x > W-BOUND_PAD){ player.x = W-BOUND_PAD; player.vx = -Math.abs(player.vx)*0.4; bump(); }
    if(player.y < BOUND_PAD){ player.y = BOUND_PAD; player.vy = Math.abs(player.vy)*0.4; bump(); }
    if(player.y > H-BOUND_PAD){ player.y = H-BOUND_PAD; player.vy = -Math.abs(player.vy)*0.4; bump(); }

    // --- score: distance traveled while thrusting ---
    if(keys.thrust){
      state.score += Math.floor(speed*dt);
    }

    // --- particles ---
    for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if(p.life <= 0){ particles.splice(i,1); continue; }
      p.x += p.vx*dt;
      p.y += p.vy*dt;
      p.vx *= Math.pow(0.2, dt);
      p.vy *= Math.pow(0.2, dt);

  function bump(){
    state.score = Math.max(0, state.score - 150);
    for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
      const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const sp = 40 + Math.random()*160;
      spawnParticle(player.x, player.y,
        Math.cos(a)*sp, Math.sin(a)*sp,
        0.4 + Math.random()*0.4,
        Math.random()<0.5 ? '#ff5a5a' : '#ffd24a',
        2 + Math.random()*3);
    }

  //  DRAW

    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 40, W/2, H/2, Math.max(W,H)*0.75);

    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#070c1e');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#03050d');

    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    const t = state.time;
    for(const s of stars){
      const tw = 0.55 + 0.45*Math.sin(t*s.sp + s.tw);
      ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe0ff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.06;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7a4bd6';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.25, H*0.3, 140, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2f8f8f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.75, H*0.7, 160, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  }

    // glowing boundary ring
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,180,255,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,180,255,0.8)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
    ctx.strokeRect(BOUND_PAD, BOUND_PAD, W-BOUND_PAD*2, H-BOUND_PAD*2);
    ctx.restore();

    for(const p of particles){
      const a = Math.max(0, p.life/p.maxLife);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size*a + 0.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    const {x,y,angle,radius} = player;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x,y);
    ctx.rotate(angle);

    // engine glow while thrusting
    if(keys.thrust){
      const flick = 0.7 + 0.3*Math.random();
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-radius,0,2, -radius,0, 34*flick);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,210,74,0.9)');
      g.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(255,120,40,0.5)');
      g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,80,20,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-radius,0,34*flick,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // body: sleek dart
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(120,200,255,0.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
    const body = ctx.createLinearGradient(-radius,0,radius,0);
    body.addColorStop(0,'#2f6fb0');
    body.addColorStop(0.5,'#7fd0ff');
    body.addColorStop(1,'#2f6fb0');
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(radius*1.4, 0);          // nose
    ctx.lineTo(-radius, -radius*0.8);   // back left
    ctx.lineTo(-radius*0.6, 0);         // notch
    ctx.lineTo(-radius, radius*0.8);    // back right
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dff6ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(radius*0.35, 0, radius*0.28, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,220,255,0.95)';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,180,255,0.7)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + state.score, 20, 16);
    ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,180,220,0.7)';
    ctx.fillText('thrust: SPACE   turn: ← →   brake: SHIFT', 20, H-30);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOverlay(){
    if(state.running && !state.won && !state.lost) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,5,13,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    if(!state.running && !state.lost){
      // start screen
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd0ff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 64px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,180,255,0.9)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
      ctx.fillText('THRUST', W/2, H/2 - 60);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe0ff';
      ctx.font = '20px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Fly the ship. Chase score. Don\'t slam the walls.', W/2, H/2 + 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
      ctx.font = '18px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or TAP to start', W/2, H/2 + 44);
    } else {
      const win = state.won;
      ctx.fillStyle = win ? '#7dffb0' : '#ff6b6b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 56px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.shadowColor = win ? 'rgba(125,255,176,0.9)' : 'rgba(255,107,107,0.9)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
      ctx.fillText(win ? 'YOU WIN' : 'SHIP LOST', W/2, H/2 - 50);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe0ff';
      ctx.font = '26px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Final Score  ' + state.score, W/2, H/2 + 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
      ctx.font = '18px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or TAP to fly again', W/2, H/2 + 52);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw(){
    drawBackground();
    drawBounds();
    drawParticles();
    if(state.running || state.lost) drawPlayer();
    drawHUD();
    drawOverlay();
  }

  // ============================================================
  //  MAIN LOOP
  // ============================================================
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now - last)/1000;
    last = now;
    if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp big frame gaps
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // init
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

    if (plane.x > W + 40) {
      // missed all — treat as a miss, respawn
      hitRing();
    }
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawSky() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#1f3a6b');
    g.addColorStop(0.45, '#3f6ea5');
    g.addColorStop(0.8, '#7fa9c9');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#c9d8e2');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun glow
    const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W - 200, 130, 20, W - 200, 130, 260);
    sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,190,0.9)');
    sg.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255,220,150,0.35)');
    sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,150,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2c4';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W - 200, 130, 46, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawHills() {
    // far hills
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5b83a6';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) {
      ctx.lineTo(x, H - 90 - Math.sin(x * 0.006 + 1) * 40);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    // near hills
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a7d6b';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) {
      ctx.lineTo(x, H - 40 - Math.sin(x * 0.008 + 3) * 30);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawCloud(c) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);
    ctx.scale(c.s, c.s);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
    for (let i = 0; i < c.puffs; i++) {
      const ox = i * 26 - c.puffs * 13;
      const oy = Math.sin(i * 1.5) * 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ox, oy, 26 - Math.abs(i - c.puffs / 2) * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRings() {
    for (const r of rings) {
      const glow = 0.5 + Math.sin(r.pulse) * 0.3;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
      // outer glow
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,210,63,${glow * 0.5})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 16;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r.r * 0.55, r.r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      // ring
      ctx.strokeStyle = r.passed ? '#7ee0a0' : '#ffd23f';
      ctx.lineWidth = 8;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r.r * 0.55, r.r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      // inner highlight
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r.r * 0.55 - 4, r.r - 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawPlane() {
    const t = plane.trail;
    // trail
    for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
      const a = (i / t.length) * 0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t[i].x, t[i].y, 3 + (i / t.length) * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(plane.x, plane.y);
    ctx.rotate(plane.tilt);

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 34, 34, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // tail
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-34, 0); ctx.lineTo(-22, -14); ctx.lineTo(-22, 14); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-30, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-10, -18, 20, -10);
    ctx.lineTo(34, -4);
    ctx.lineTo(34, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(20, 10);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-10, 18, -30, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // stripe
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
    ctx.fillRect(-28, -3, 58, 6);

    // wing
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3e50';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-4, -2); ctx.lineTo(16, -2); ctx.lineTo(10, 20); ctx.lineTo(-8, 20);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    // window
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aee3f5';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(14, -4, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // propeller
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3e50';
    const pa = state.time * 0.9;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(38, 0);
    ctx.rotate(pa);
    ctx.fillRect(-2, -22, 4, 44);
    ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillRect(-2, -22, 4, 44);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(38, 0, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    roundRect(20, 18, 210, 54, 12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE', 36, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(state.score + ' / ' + state.target, 36, 66);

    // lives
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    roundRect(W - 200, 18, 180, 54, 12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES', W - 184, 40);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const on = i < state.lives;
      ctx.fillStyle = on ? '#e74c3c' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      const cx = W - 178 + i * 40, cy = 58;
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + 8);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - 12, cy - 6, cx - 4, cy - 14, cx, cy - 4);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + 4, cy - 14, cx + 12, cy - 6, cx, cy + 8);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,15,30,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 72px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
    ctx.font = '20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or CLICK to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake);
    }
    drawSky();
    drawHills();
    for (const c of clouds) drawCloud(c);
    drawRings();
    drawPlane();
    drawParticles();
    ctx.restore();

    if (state.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${state.flash * 0.5})`;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    if (state.screen === 'play') drawHUD();
    if (state.screen === 'start') drawOverlay('BARNSTORMING', 'Fly the plane through every ring', '#ffd23f');
    if (state.screen === 'win') drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', 'Score: ' + state.score, '#7ee0a0');
    if (state.screen === 'lose') drawOverlay('GAME OVER', 'Score: ' + state.score + ' / ' + state.target, '#ff5a2c');
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // init
  makeRings();
  makeClouds();
  loop();

})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Section Z</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;
    background: #04040a;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Courier New", monospace;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ===================== STATE ===================== */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let W = 0, H = 0;
const CFG = {
  bulletSpeed: 780,
  fireCooldown: 0.13,
  playerSpeed: 340,
  enemySpeed: 165,
  enemyHP: 1,
  enemyRadius: 16,
  playerRadius: 12,
  bulletRadius: 4,
  maxEnemies: 9,
  spawnInterval: 0.95,
  targetScore: 30
};

const state = {
  screen: "start",   // start | play | win | lose
  score: 0,
  player: { x:0, y:0, angle:0, fireTimer:0, invuln:0, recoil:0 },
  enemies: [],
  bullets: [],
  particles: [],
  stars: [],
  spawnTimer: 0,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  crosshair: { x:0, y:0, down:false }
};

/* ===================== SETUP / RESIZE ===================== */
function resize(){
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  if(!state.stars.length) initStars();
}
function initStars(){
  state.stars = [];
  for(let i=0;i<140;i++){
    state.stars.push({
      x: Math.random()*W,
      y: Math.random()*H,
      z: Math.random()*0.8+0.2,
      tw: Math.random()*Math.PI*2
    });
  }
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

function resetGame(){
  state.score = 0;
  state.enemies = [];
  state.bullets = [];
  state.particles = [];
  state.spawnTimer = 0.4;
  state.time = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.player.x = W/2;
  state.player.y = H/2;
  state.player.angle = 0;
  state.player.fireTimer = 0;
  state.player.invuln = 0;
  state.player.recoil = 0;
}
resetGame();
state.player.x = W/2; state.player.y = H/2;

/* ===================== INPUT ===================== */
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener("keydown", e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if(e.key===" "||e.key==="Enter"){
    if(state.screen==="start"){ state.screen="play"; resetGame(); }
    else if(state.screen==="win"||state.screen==="lose"){ state.screen="play"; resetGame(); }
  }
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", e=>{
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  state.crosshair.x = e.clientX - r.left;
  state.crosshair.y = e.clientY - r.top;
});
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", e=>{
  state.crosshair.down = true;
  if(state.screen==="start"){ state.screen="play"; resetGame(); }
  else if(state.screen==="win"||state.screen==="lose"){ state.screen="play"; resetGame(); }
});
window.addEventListener("mouseup", ()=>{ state.crosshair.down = false; });

/* ===================== HELPERS ===================== */
function dist(ax,ay,bx,by){ return Math.hypot(ax-bx, ay-by); }
function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }

function spawnEnemy(){
  const edge = Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
  let x, y;
  const m = 40;
  if(edge===0){ x = rand(-m, W+m); y = -m; }
  else if(edge===1){ x = W+m; y = rand(-m, H+m); }
  else if(edge===2){ x = rand(-m, W+m); y = H+m; }
  else { x = -m; y = rand(-m, H+m); }
  state.enemies.push({ x, y, hp: CFG.enemyHP, wobble: Math.random()*Math.PI*2, hue: rand(275,335) });
}

function explode(x,y,base){
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const sp = rand(40, 320);
    state.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a)*sp, vy: Math.sin(a)*sp,
      life: rand(0.4,0.9), max: 0.9,
      size: rand(2,5),
      hue: base + rand(-30,30)
    });
  }
}

/* ===================== UPDATE ===================== */
function update(dt){
  state.time += dt;
  if(state.shake>0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt*30);

  // stars drift
  for(const s of state.stars){
    s.y += s.z*12*dt;
    if(s.y>H){ s.y=0; s.x=Math.random()*W; }
    s.tw += dt*3;
  }

  if(state.screen!=="play") return;

  const p = state.player;

  // movement
  let mx=0, my=0;
  if(keys["w"]||keys["arrowup"]) my -= 1;
  if(keys["s"]||keys["arrowdown"]) my += 1;
  if(keys["a"]||keys["arrowleft"]) mx -= 1;
  if(keys["d"]||keys["arrowright"]) mx += 1;
  if(mx||my){
    const len = Math.hypot(mx,my);
    p.x += (mx/len)*CFG.playerSpeed*dt;
    p.y += (my/len)*CFG.playerSpeed*dt;
  }
  p.x = Math.max(CFG.playerRadius, Math.min(W-CFG.playerRadius, p.x));
  p.y = Math.max(CFG.playerRadius, Math.min(H-CFG.playerRadius, p.y));

  // aim
  p.angle = Math.atan2(state.crosshair.y - p.y, state.crosshair.x - p.x);

  // fire
  p.fireTimer -= dt;
  p.recoil = Math.max(0, p.recoil - dt*4);
  if(state.crosshair.down && p.fireTimer<=0){
    p.fireTimer = CFG.fireCooldown;
    p.recoil = 1;
    const bx = p.x + Math.cos(p.angle)*CFG.playerRadius;
    const by = p.y + Math.sin(p.angle)*CFG.playerRadius;
    state.bullets.push({
      x:bx, y:by,
      vx: Math.cos(p.angle)*CFG.bulletSpeed,
      vy: Math.sin(p.angle)*CFG.bulletSpeed
    });
    // muzzle sparks
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const a = p.angle + rand(-0.4,0.4);
      state.particles.push({ x:bx, y:by, vx:Math.cos(a)*rand(80,220), vy:Math.sin(a)*rand(80,220), life:rand(0.1,0.3), max:0.3, size:rand(1.5,3), hue:180 });
    }
    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3);
  }

  // bullets
  for(let i=state.bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b = state.bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
    if(b.x<-20||b.x>W+20||b.y<-20||b.y>H+20){ state.bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    // hit enemies
    for(let j=state.enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const en = state.enemies[j];
      if(dist(b.x,b.y,en.x,en.y) < CFG.enemyRadius + CFG.bulletRadius){
        en.hp -= 1;
        state.bullets.splice(i,1);
        if(en.hp<=0){
          explode(en.x,en.y,en.hue);
          state.enemies.splice(j,1);
          state.score += 1;
          state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 6);
          if(state.score >= CFG.targetScore){ state.screen="win"; }
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // enemies
  state.spawnTimer -= dt;
  if(state.spawnTimer<=0 && state.enemies.length < CFG.maxEnemies){
    spawnEnemy();
    state.spawnTimer = CFG.spawnInterval * rand(0.7,1.3);
  }
  for(const en of state.enemies){
    const a = Math.atan2(p.y-en.y, p.x-en.x);
    en.x += Math.cos(a)*CFG.enemySpeed*dt;
    en.y += Math.sin(a)*CFG.enemySpeed*dt;
    en.wobble += dt*4;
    // collide with player
    if(p.invuln<=0 && dist(en.x,en.y,p.x,p.y) < CFG.enemyRadius + CFG.playerRadius){
      explode(p.x,p.y,0);
      state.shake = 18;
      state.screen = "lose";
    }
  }
  if(p.invuln>0) p.invuln -= dt;

  // particles
  for(let i=state.particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const q = state.particles[i];
    q.x += q.vx*dt; q.y += q.vy*dt;
    q.vx *= 0.94; q.vy *= 0.94;
    q.life -= dt;
    if(q.life<=0) state.particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

/* ===================== DRAW ===================== */
function drawBackground(){
  // deep space gradient
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H/2,50, W/2,H/2, Math.max(W,H)*0.75);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#14123a");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#0b0a24");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#04040c");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // nebula glows
  const n1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.25,H*0.3,10, W*0.25,H*0.3,260);
  n1.addColorStop(0,"rgba(120,40,180,0.35)");
  n1.addColorStop(1,"rgba(120,40,180,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=n1; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const n2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.78,H*0.72,10, W*0.78,H*0.72,300);
  n2.addColorStop(0,"rgba(30,90,150,0.30)");
  n2.addColorStop(1,"rgba(30,90,150,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=n2; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  for(const s of state.stars){
    const a = 0.4 + Math.sin(s.tw)*0.35 + s.z*0.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(220,230,255,"+Math.max(0.1,a)+")";
    const sz = s.z*2.2;
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, sz, sz);
  }

  // faint grid floor
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,110,200,0.06)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const step = 60;
  const off = (state.time*20) % step;
  for(let x=-off; x<W; x+=step){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x,H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for(let y=-off; y<H; y+=step){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke(); }
}

function drawEnemy(en){
  const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(en.wobble)*0.12;
  const r = CFG.enemyRadius * pulse;
  // glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(en.x,en.y,2,en.x,en.y,r*2.4);
  glow.addColorStop(0,"hsla("+en.hue+",90%,65%,0.55)");
  glow.addColorStop(1,"hsla("+en.hue+",90%,65%,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=glow; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(en.x,en.y,r*2.4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  // spiky body
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(en.x,en.y);
  ctx.rotate(en.wobble*0.5);
  ctx.beginPath();
  const spikes = 8;
  for(let i=0;i<spikes*2;i++){
    const ang = (i/(spikes*2))*Math.PI*2;
    const rr = (i%2===0)? r : r*0.55;
    const px = Math.cos(ang)*rr, py = Math.sin(ang)*rr;
    if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = "hsl("+en.hue+",75%,55%)";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "hsl("+en.hue+",90%,75%)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  // core eye
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,r*0.32,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff2d0"; ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,r*0.16,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a0a30"; ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const p = state.player;
  if(p.invuln>0 && Math.floor(state.time*20)%2===0) return;
  const recoil = p.recoil*6;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
  ctx.rotate(p.angle);
  // engine glow
  const eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(-14,0,2,-14,0,26);
  eg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(90,200,255,0.6)");
  eg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(90,200,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=eg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-14,0,26,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // ship body (triangle)
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(18-recoil,0);
  ctx.lineTo(-14-recoil,-13);
  ctx.lineTo(-8-recoil,0);
  ctx.lineTo(-14-recoil,13);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8f4ff";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#57b8ff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  // cockpit
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(4-recoil,0,4,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1c2f5c"; ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBullets(){
  for(const b of state.bullets){
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x,b.y,1,b.x,b.y,10);
    g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,240,180,0.95)");
    g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,180,60,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,10,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#fff"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,CFG.bulletRadius,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const q of state.particles){
    const a = Math.max(0, q.life/q.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = "hsla("+q.hue+",90%,65%,"+a+")";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,q.size*a+1,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawCrosshair(){
  const c = state.crosshair;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);
  ctx.strokeStyle = state.crosshair.down ? "#ff5a7a" : "#7fe0ff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  const g = 8, len = 12;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-g-len,0); ctx.lineTo(-g,0);
  ctx.moveTo(g,0); ctx.lineTo(g+len,0);
  ctx.moveTo(0,-g-len); ctx.lineTo(0,-g);
  ctx.moveTo(0,g); ctx.lineTo(0,g+len);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD(){
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
  ctx.fillRect(18,18,220,54);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,200,255,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(18,18,220,54);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8fe6ff";
  ctx.font = "bold 15px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SECTION Z", 32, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE  "+state.score+" / "+CFG.targetScore, 32, 64);

  // progress bar
  const bw = 220, bx = 18, by = H-34;
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw,14);
  const prog = Math.min(1, state.score/CFG.targetScore);
  const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx,0,bx+bw,0);
  pg.addColorStop(0,"#39d0ff"); pg.addColorStop(1,"#b06bff");
  ctx.fillStyle=pg; ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw*prog,14);
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(120,200,255,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeRect(bx,by,bw,14);
  ctx.fillStyle="#9fd8ff"; ctx.font="12px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("CLEAR "+CFG.targetScore+" INTRUDERS TO WIN", bx, by-6);
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(4,4,14,0.72)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.font="bold 64px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2-30);
  ctx.fillStyle="#cfe6ff";
  ctx.font="20px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2+18);
  ctx.fillStyle="#7fb0ff";
  ctx.font="16px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE / CLICK TO START", W/2, H/2+58);
  ctx.textAlign="left";
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0){
    ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake,state.shake), rand(-state.shake,state.shake));
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawParticles();
  for(const en of state.enemies) drawEnemy(en);
  drawBullets();
  drawPlayer();
  ctx.restore();

  if(state.screen==="play"){
    drawHUD();
    drawCrosshair();
  } else if(state.screen==="start"){
    drawOverlay("SECTION Z", "DEFEND THE SECTOR. FIRE ON THE INTRUDERS.", "#5fd0ff");
  } else if(state.screen==="win"){
    drawOverlay("SECTOR CLEARED", "SCORE "+state.score+"  —  YOU SURVIVED SECTION Z", "#6bff9f");
  } else if(state.screen==="lose"){
    drawOverlay("K.I.A.", "FINAL SCORE "+state.score+"  —  THE SECTOR IS LOST", "#ff5a7a");
  }
}

/* ===================== LOOP ===================== */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now - last)/1000;
  last = now;
  if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
