<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Duck Hunt</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    cursor: crosshair;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
// ─── STATE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = 960;
const H = 600;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

const state = {
  phase: 'start',       // 'start' | 'playing' | 'gameover'
  score: 0,
  lives: 3,
  ducks: [],
  bullets: [],
  particles: [],
  shotCooldown: 0,
  time: 0,
  message: '',
  messageTimer: 0
};

// ─── HELPERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

// ─── INPUT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (state.phase === 'start') {
    state.phase = 'playing';
    state.score = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.ducks = [];
    state.bullets = [];
    state.particles = [];
    spawnDuck();
    return;
  }
  if (state.phase === 'gameover') {
    state.phase = 'start';
    return;
  }
  if (state.phase === 'playing' && state.shotCooldown <= 0) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
    // Fire bullet toward click
    state.bullets.push({ x, y, life: 60 });
    state.shotCooldown = 20;
    // Check hits
    for (let d of state.ducks) {
      const dx = d.x - x, dy = d.y - y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < d.radius + 10) {
        d.hp--;
        if (d.hp <= 0) {
          d.dead = true;
          state.score += 10;
          spawnParticles(d.x, d.y, '#e8a020');
        } else {
          spawnParticles(x, y, '#fff');
        }
      }
    }
    // Remove dead ducks
    state.ducks = state.ducks.filter(d => !d.dead);
    if (state.ducks.length === 0) spawnDuck();
  }
});

// ─── DUCK SPAWNING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function spawnDuck() {
  const fromLeft = Math.random() > 0.5;
  const y = rand(60, 250);
  const speed = rand(2, 4.5);
  const duck = {
    x: fromLeft ? -40 : W + 40,
    y: y,
    vx: fromLeft ? speed : -speed,
    vy: 0,
    wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    wobbleSpeed: rand(0.05, 0.12),
    radius: 22,
    hp: 1,
    dead: false,
    color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? '#e8a020' : '#4a90d9',
    size: rand(0.8, 1.2)
  };
  state.ducks.push(duck);
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    state.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: rand(-3, 3),
      vy: rand(-4, 1),
      life: rand(20, 40),
      color: color
    });
  }
}

// ─── UPDATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function update() {
  state.time++;
  if (state.shotCooldown > 0) state.shotCooldown--;
  if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer--;

  if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;

  // Update ducks
  for (let d of state.ducks) {
    d.x += d.vx;
    d.wobble += d.wobbleSpeed;
    d.y += Math.sin(d.wobble) * 0.8;
    // If duck flies off screen, lose a life
    if ((d.vx > 0 && d.x > W + 50) || (d.vx < 0 && d.x < -50)) {
      d.dead = true;
      state.lives--;
      if (state.lives <= 0) {
        state.phase = 'gameover';
      }
    }
  }
  state.ducks = state.ducks.filter(d => !d.dead);
  if (state.ducks.length === 0 && state.phase === 'playing') spawnDuck();

  // Update bullets
  for (let b of state.bullets) b.life--;
  state.bullets = state.bullets.filter(b => b.life > 0);

  // Update particles
  for (let p of state.particles) {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15;
    p.life--;
  }
  state.particles = state.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

// ─── DRAW ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function draw() {
  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a2a5e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#3a6ea5');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#7ab8e0');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b8e0f0');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Sun
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 120, 80, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  const sunGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W-120, 80, 10, W-120, 80, 40);
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fff8e0');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ffcc44');
  ctx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
  ctx.fill();

  // Clouds
  drawCloud(150, 70, 60);
  drawCloud(400, 50, 45);
  drawCloud(700, 90, 55);

  // Distant hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a5a3a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 10) {
    const y = H - 120 + Math.sin(x * 0.008) * 40 + Math.sin(x * 0.003) * 25;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Water
  const waterGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H - 100, 0, H);
  waterGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a90c0');
  waterGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a5a80');
  ctx.fillStyle = waterGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H - 100, W, 100);

  // Water ripples
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const ry = H - 80 + i * 18;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 5) {
      const y = ry + Math.sin(x * 0.03 + state.time * 0.05 + i) * 3;
      x === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Trees
  drawTree(50, H - 130);
  drawTree(130, H - 140);
  drawTree(850, H - 135);
  drawTree(920, H - 125);

  // Ducks
  for (let d of state.ducks) {
    drawDuck(d);
  }

  // Bullets (muzzle flash)
  for (let b of state.bullets) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 6 * (b.life / 60), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 200, 50, ${b.life / 60})`;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Particles
  for (let p of state.particles) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3 * (p.life / 40), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 40;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Overlays
  if (state.phase === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (state.phase === 'gameover') drawGameOver();
}

function drawCloud(x, y, size) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, size * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + size * 0.4, y - size * 0.1, size * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x - size * 0.3, y + size * 0.05, size * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + size * 0.7, y + size * 0.05, size * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawTree(x, y) {
  // Trunk
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3a20';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 5, y, 10, 50);
  // Foliage
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a7a3a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y - 15, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a9a4a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 10, y - 5, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 12, y - 8, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawDuck(d) {
  const s = d.size;
  const dir = d.vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(d.x, d.y);
  ctx.scale(dir * s, s);

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = d.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 22, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Wing
  ctx.fillStyle = shadeColor(d.color, -30);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-3, -3, 14, 8, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Tail
  ctx.fillStyle = d.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-20, -2);
  ctx.lineTo(-30, -10);
  ctx.lineTo(-25, 2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = d.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(18, -10, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Beak
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e07020';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(26, -12);
  ctx.lineTo(38, -10);
  ctx.lineTo(26, -7);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Eye
  ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(20, -12, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Legs (visible when diving)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#e07020';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-5, 12);
  ctx.lineTo(-5, 22);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(5, 12);
  ctx.lineTo(5, 22);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.restore();
}

function shadeColor(hex, percent) {
  let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3), 16);
  let g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5), 16);
  let b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7), 16);
  r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, r + percent));
  g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, g + percent));
  b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, b + percent));
  return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 180, 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${state.score}`, 20, 33);

  // Lives
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(W - 150, 10, 140, 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES:', W - 60, 33);
  // Hearts
  for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) {
    drawHeart(W - 50 + i * 22, 25, 8, '#e04040');
  }
}

function drawHeart(x, y, size, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y + size * 0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, y - size * 0.3, x - size, y - size * 0.3, x - size, y + size * 0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - size, y + size, x, y + size * 1.3, x, y + size * 1.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, y + size * 1.3, x + size, y + size, x + size, y + size * 0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + size, y - size * 0.3, x, y - size * 0.3, x, y + size * 0.3);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('DUCK HUNT', W/2, H/2 - 60);

  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
  ctx.fillText('Click to start shooting ducks!', W/2, H/2);
  ctx.fillText('Don\'t let them fly away — 3 escapes = game over', W/2, H/2 + 35);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Click anywhere to begin', W/2, H/2 + 90);
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '24px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${state.score}`, W/2, H/2 + 20);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Click to return to title', W/2, H/2 + 70);
}

// ─── GAME LOOP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ─── INIT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Resize canvas to fit window while maintaining aspect ratio
function resize() {
  const windowW = window.innerWidth;
  const windowH = window.innerHeight;
  const scale = Math.min(windowW / W, windowH / H);
  canvas.style.width = (W * scale) + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = (H * scale) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

loop();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Flappy Bird</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#1a2332;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;}
  canvas{border:3px solid #2d4a6e;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="400" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

// ---- State ----
let bird, pipes, score, best = 0, gameState, frameCount, clouds, stars;
const GRAVITY = 0.45;
const JUMP = -7.5;
const PIPE_WIDTH = 65;
const PIPE_GAP = 150;
const PIPE_SPACING = 220;
const PIPE_SPEED = 2.5;
const GROUND_H = 80;

function init() {
  bird = { x: 80, y: H/2, r: 16, vy: 0, rot: 0, wingPhase: 0 };
  pipes = [];
  score = 0;
  frameCount = 0;
  gameState = 'start';
  clouds = [];
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    clouds.push({ x: Math.random()*W, y: 30+Math.random()*120, r: 20+Math.random()*25, speed: 0.3+Math.random()*0.5 });
  }
  stars = [];
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    stars.push({ x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*(H-GROUND_H-40), size: 1+Math.random()*2, twinkle: Math.random()*Math.PI*2 });
  }
}

// ---- Input ----
function flap() {
  if(gameState === 'start'){
    gameState = 'playing';
    bird.vy = JUMP;
  } else if(gameState === 'playing'){
    bird.vy = JUMP;
  } else if(gameState === 'gameover'){
    init();
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if(e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp'){
    e.preventDefault();
    flap();
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('click', flap);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); flap(); });

// ---- Update ----
function update() {
  frameCount++;

  // clouds
  for(let c of clouds){
    c.x -= c.speed;
    if(c.x + c.r < 0) c.x = W + c.r;
  }

  if(gameState !== 'playing') return;

  // bird
  bird.vy += GRAVITY;
  bird.y += bird.vy;
  bird.rot = Math.atan2(bird.vy, 4);
  bird.wingPhase += 0.3;

  // pipes
  if(pipes.length === 0 || pipes[pipes.length-1].x < W - PIPE_SPACING){
    let gapY = 120 + Math.random() * (H - GROUND_H - 240);
    pipes.push({ x: W + PIPE_WIDTH, gapY: gapY, passed: false });
  }
  for(let p of pipes){
    p.x -= PIPE_SPEED;
  }
  pipes = pipes.filter(p => p.x + PIPE_WIDTH > -10);

  // scoring
  for(let p of pipes){
    if(!p.passed && p.x + PIPE_WIDTH < bird.x){
      p.passed = true;
      score++;
      if(score > best) best = score;
    }
  }

  // collision
  let groundY = H - GROUND_H;
  if(bird.y + bird.r >= groundY){
    bird.y = groundY - bird.r;
    gameState = 'gameover';
  }
  if(bird.y - bird.r < 0){
    bird.y = bird.r;
    bird.vy = 0;
  }
  for(let p of pipes){
    let birdLeft = bird.x - bird.r;
    let birdRight = bird.x + bird.r;
    let birdTop = bird.y - bird.r;
    let birdBottom = bird.y + bird.r;
    if(birdRight > p.x && birdLeft < p.x + PIPE_WIDTH){
      if(birdTop < p.gapY || birdBottom > p.gapY + PIPE_GAP){
        gameState = 'gameover';
      }
    }
  }
}

// ---- Draw ----
function drawSky() {
  let grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grd.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a3e');
  grd.addColorStop(0.4, '#2d3a6e');
  grd.addColorStop(0.7, '#4a5a8e');
  grd.addColorStop(1, '#6a7aae');
  ctx.fillStyle = grd;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawStars() {
  for(let s of stars){
    let alpha = 0.4 + 0.4 * Math.sin(s.twinkle + frameCount * 0.03);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,220,${alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawClouds() {
  for(let c of clouds){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(c.x + c.r*0.6, c.y - c.r*0.3, c.r*0.7, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(c.x - c.r*0.5, c.y + c.r*0.1, c.r*0.6, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawMountains() {
  let groundY = H - GROUND_H;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a5e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
  for(let x = 0; x <= W; x += 10){
    let h = 40 + 30 * Math.sin(x * 0.02 + 1) + 20 * Math.sin(x * 0.05);
    ctx.lineTo(x, groundY - h);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, groundY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4a6e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
  for(let x = 0; x <= W; x += 10){
    let h = 20 + 20 * Math.sin(x * 0.03 + 3) + 10 * Math.sin(x * 0.07);
    ctx.lineTo(x, groundY - h);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, groundY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawPipes() {
  for(let p of pipes){
    let topH = p.gapY;
    let botY = p.gapY + PIPE_GAP;
    let botH = H - GROUND_H - botY;

    // top pipe
    let grd1 = ctx.createLinearGradient(p.x, 0, p.x + PIPE_WIDTH, 0);
    grd1.addColorStop(0, '#2d8a3e');
    grd1.addColorStop(0.3, '#4ec95e');
    grd1.addColorStop(0.5, '#5ee86e');
    grd1.addColorStop(0.7, '#4ec95e');
    grd1.addColorStop(1, '#2d8a3e');
    ctx.fillStyle = grd1;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, 0, PIPE_WIDTH, topH);
    // top pipe cap
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3ab04e';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - 5, topH - 20, PIPE_WIDTH + 10, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2d8a3e';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - 5, topH - 20, PIPE_WIDTH + 10, 3);

    // bottom pipe
    let grd2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(p.x, 0, p.x + PIPE_WIDTH, 0);
    grd2.addColorStop(0, '#2d8a3e');
    grd2.addColorStop(0.3, '#4ec95e');
    grd2.addColorStop(0.5, '#5ee86e');
    grd2.addColorStop(0.7, '#4ec95e');
    grd2.addColorStop(1, '#2d8a3e');
    ctx.fillStyle = grd2;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, botY, PIPE_WIDTH, botH);
    // bottom pipe cap
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3ab04e';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - 5, botY, PIPE_WIDTH + 10, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2d8a3e';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - 5, botY, PIPE_WIDTH + 10, 3);

    // pipe highlights
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + 8, 0, 4, topH - 20);
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + 8, botY + 20, 4, botH - 20);
  }
}

function drawGround() {
  let groundY = H - GROUND_H;
  // dirt
  let grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
  grd.addColorStop(0, '#8B6914');
  grd.addColorStop(0.3, '#6B4E12');
  grd.addColorStop(1, '#4a350e');
  ctx.fillStyle = grd;
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, GROUND_H);

  // grass
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ec95e';
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3ab04e';
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundY + 8, W, 4);

  // grass tufts
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5ee86e';
  for(let x = 0; x < W; x += 20){
    let offset = (frameCount * 0.5) % 20;
    let tx = x - offset;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tx, groundY);
    ctx.lineTo(tx + 4, groundY - 6);
    ctx.lineTo(tx + 8, groundY);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // dirt texture
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
  for(let x = 0; x < W; x += 30){
    let offset = (frameCount * 0.5) % 30;
    ctx.fillRect(x - offset, groundY + 20, 15, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x - offset + 10, groundY + 40, 12, 3);
  }
}

function drawBird() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(bird.x, bird.y);
  ctx.rotate(bird.rot);

  // body
  let bodyGrd = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 2, 0, 0, bird.r + 4);
  bodyGrd.addColorStop(0, '#ffe066');
  bodyGrd.addColorStop(0.6, '#f5c842');
  bodyGrd.addColorStop(1, '#d4a020');
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrd;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, bird.r + 4, bird.r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // belly
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff5cc';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(2, 4, bird.r * 0.6, bird.r * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // wing
  let wingY = Math.sin(bird.wingPhase) * 6;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8b830';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-4, wingY, 10, 7, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a020';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-4, wingY, 8, 5, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(8, -5, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(10, -5, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(11, -7, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // beak
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6633';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(14, -2);
  ctx.lineTo(26, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(14, 4);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e05522';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(14, 1);
  ctx.lineTo(24, 2);
  ctx.lineTo(14, 5);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawScore() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(score, W/2 + 2, 62);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillText(score, W/2, 60);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('FLAPPY BIRD', W/2, H/2 - 60);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  let pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText('Click or Press Space', W/2, H/2);
  ctx.fillText('to Start', W/2, H/2 + 30);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  if(best > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + best, W/2, H/2 + 70);
  }
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 60);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '24px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 - 10);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Best: ' + best, W/2, H/2 + 25);

  let pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Click to Restart', W/2, H/2 + 70);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
  drawSky();
  drawStars();
  drawClouds();
  drawMountains();
  drawPipes();
  drawGround();
  drawBird();

  if(gameState === 'playing'){
    drawScore();
  } else if(gameState === 'start'){
    drawScore();
    drawStartScreen();
  } else if(gameState === 'gameover'){
    drawScore();
    drawGameOver();
  }
}

// ---- Loop ----
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

init();
loop();
</script>

<style>

const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resolveBattle() {

function update(dt) {

  battleTimer += dt;
  if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.9;
  if (shake < 0.1) shake = 0;

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15; // gravity
    p.life -= dt * 0.8;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

// ============ DRAW ============
function drawCard(x, y, card, faceUp, scale) {
  const w = 60 * scale, h = 85 * scale;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);

  // Card shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-w/2 + 3, -h/2 + 3, w, h, 8);
  ctx.fill();

  // Card body
  if (faceUp && card) {
    // White background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8f0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-w/2, -h/2, w, h, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = card.suit.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Suit symbol
    ctx.fillStyle = card.suit.color;
    ctx.font = `${Math.floor(28 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(card.suit.symbol, 0, 5 * scale);

    // Value
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(18 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText(card.value === 1 ? 'A' : card.value === 11 ? 'J' : card.value === 12 ? 'Q' : card.value === 13 ? 'K' : String(card.value), 0, -25 * scale);
  } else {
    // Card back
    ctx.fillStyle = '#264653';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-w/2, -h/2, w, h, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Pattern
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = `${Math.floor(20 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('\u2660', 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a9d8f';
    ctx.font = `${Math.floor(14 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText('\u2665', -12 * scale, -12 * scale);
    ctx.fillText('\u2666', 12 * scale, 12 * scale);
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBackground() {
  // Gradient sky
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a2e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#16213e');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#0f3460');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const sx = (Math.sin(i * 127.1) * 0.5 + 0.5) * W;
    const sy = (Math.cos(i * 311.7) * 0.5 + 0.5) * H * 0.6;
    const ss = 1 + (Math.sin(i * 43.7) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, ss, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Table / ground
  const tableGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.55, 0, H);
  tableGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2d6a4f');
  tableGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b4332');
  ctx.fillStyle = tableGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.55);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H * 0.55);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H);
  ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Table border
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#40916c';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Decorative circles on table
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W/2, H * 0.75, 50 + i * 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawDecks() {
  const deckY = H * 0.15;
  const playerX = W * 0.25;
  const enemyX = W * 0.75;
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) / 800;

  // Player deck (bottom left area)
  if (playerDeck.length > 0) {
    // Stack effect
    for (let i = Math.min(5, playerDeck.length); i >= 0; i--) {
      drawCard(playerX + i * 2, deckY + i * 2, null, false, scale);
    }
    // Count label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(16 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`You: ${playerDeck.length}`, playerX, deckY + 55 * scale);
  }

  // Enemy deck (top right area)
  if (enemyDeck.length > 0) {
    for (let i = Math.min(5, enemyDeck.length); i >= 0; i--) {
      drawCard(enemyX - i * 2, deckY + i * 2, null, false, scale);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e63946';
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(16 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`Enemy: ${enemyDeck.length}`, enemyX, deckY + 55 * scale);
  }
}

function drawBattleCards() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H * 0.4;
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) / 700;

  if (phase === 'battle' && battleTimer >= 0.3) {
    // Player card from left
    const pc = playerDeck[0] || { value: 0, suit: SUITS[0] };
    const ec = enemyDeck[0] || { value: 0, suit: SUITS[1] };

    const slide = Math.min(1, (battleTimer - 0.3) / 0.5);
    const pX = cx - 120 * scale + (1 - slide) * (-100);
    const eX = cx + 120 * scale - (1 - slide) * (100);

    drawCard(pX, cy, pc, true, scale);
    drawCard(eX, cy, ec, true, scale);

    // VS text
    if (slide >= 1) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f4a261';
      ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(24 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('VS', cx, cy);
    }
  }

  if (phase === 'tie') {
    const pc = playerPile[playerPile.length - 1] || { value: 0, suit: SUITS[0] };
    const ec = enemyPile[enemyPile.length - 1] || { value: 0, suit: SUITS[1] };
    drawCard(cx - 80 * scale, cy, pc, true, scale);
    drawCard(cx + 80 * scale, cy, ec, true, scale);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f4a261';
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(28 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('TIE!', cx, cy - 60 * scale);
  }
}

function drawPiles() {
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) / 800;
  const pileY = H * 0.65;

  // Player pile
  if (playerPile.length > 0) {
    const px = W * 0.3;
    for (let i = Math.min(3, playerPile.length); i >= 0; i--) {
      drawCard(px + i * 2, pileY + i * 2, null, false, scale * 0.7);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = `${Math.floor(14 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`${playerPile.length} cards`, px, pileY + 35 * scale);
  }

  // Enemy pile
  if (enemyPile.length > 0) {
    const ex = W * 0.7;
    for (let i = Math.min(3, enemyPile.length); i >= 0; i--) {
      drawCard(ex - i * 2, pileY + i * 2, null, false, scale * 0.7);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e63946';
    ctx.font = `${Math.floor(14 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`${enemyPile.length} cards`, ex, pileY + 35 * scale);
  }
}

function drawUI() {
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) / 800;

  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4a261';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(36 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('\u2660 Card War \u2665', W / 2, H * 0.06);

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(20 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H * 0.12);

  // Phase-specific text
  if (phase === 'start') {
    const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(animT * 3) * 0.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(24 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText('Click to Start!', W / 2, H * 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.font = `${Math.floor(16 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText('Higher card wins the round. Collect all cards to win!', W / 2, H * 0.56);
  }

  if (phase === 'battle' && battleTimer >= 0.8) {
    const pulse = 0.7 + Math.sin(animT * 4) * 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(20 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText('Click to Reveal!', W / 2, H * 0.58);
  }

  if (phase === 'tie') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f4a261';
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(20 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText('Both cards are the same! Click to continue.', W / 2, H * 0.58);
  }

  if (phase === 'win' || phase === 'lose') {
    const pulse = 0.7 + Math.sin(animT * 3) * 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = resultColor;
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(40 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText(resultText, W / 2, H * 0.45);

    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.floor(20 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, H * 0.53);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.font = `${Math.floor(16 * scale)}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', W / 2, H * 0.6);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawDecks();
  drawBattleCards();
  drawPiles();
  drawParticles();
  drawUI();

  ctx.restore();
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
let lastTime = performance.now();

function gameLoop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
  lastTime = now;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ============ INIT ============
initGame();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

  function drawBackground() {
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a1428');
    grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1a3a5c');
    grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#2d5f7a');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a3a5c');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d2137';

        for (let wx = bx + 8; wx < bx + 52; wx += 14) {
          if (Math.random() > 0.3) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 8, 10);
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0d2137';
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a1830';
    ctx.fillRect(0, BASE_Y, W, H - BASE_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#152a45';
    ctx.fillRect(0, BASE_Y, W, 4);

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {

      ctx.moveTo(i * 80, BASE_Y + 5);
      ctx.lineTo(i * 80, H);

  function drawTower() {

    ctx.fillRect(TOWER_X - TOWER_W / 2, CRANE_Y, TOWER_W, BASE_Y - CRANE_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a5a6c';
    ctx.fillRect(TOWER_X - TOWER_W / 2 + 5, CRANE_Y, TOWER_W - 10, BASE_Y - CRANE_Y);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a4c';
    for (let y = CRANE_Y + 20; y < BASE_Y; y += 40) {

    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6a7c';
    ctx.fillRect(TOWER_X - TOWER_W / 2 - 10, CRANE_Y - 10, TOWER_W + 20, 15);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6a7a8c';
    ctx.fillRect(TOWER_X - TOWER_W / 2 - 5, CRANE_Y - 5, TOWER_W + 10, 8);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.beginPath();

  function drawCable() {

    const bottomX = state.current.x + state.current.width / 2;

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#667788';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(topX - 3, topY);
    ctx.lineTo(bottomX - 3, bottomY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(topX + 3, topY);
    ctx.lineTo(bottomX + 3, bottomY);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawContainer(c) {
    ctx.fillStyle = c.color;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.width, c.height);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y + c.height - 4, c.width, 4);

  }

  function drawMessages() {
    for (let m of state.messages) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(233,196,106,${m.life / 60})`;

  }

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('CRASH!', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e9c46a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8ecae6';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or Click to restart', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e9c46a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('CONTAINER CRANE', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8ecae6';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('The crane swings. Drop containers onto the tower.', W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.fillText('If the stack gets too high, it crashes.', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a9d8f';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or Click to Start', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate(
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake,
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake
      );
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawCranes();
    drawTower();

    for (let c of state.containers) {
      drawContainer(c);
    }

    if (state.current) {
      drawCable();
      drawContainer(state.current);
    }

    drawMessages();
    drawUI();

    ctx.restore();

    if (!state.started) drawStartScreen();
    if (state.gameOver) drawGameOver();
  }

  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();

<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// === STATE ===
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

let state = 'start'; // 'start', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
let score = 0;
let lives = 20;
let wave = 0;
let maxWave = 5;
let enemies = [];
let towers = [];
let projectiles = [];
let path = [];
let pathBuilt = false;
let selectedTowerType = 'cannon';
let towerTypes = {
  cannon: { cost: 100, range: 100, damage: 20, fireRate: 500, color: '#e74c3c', bulletColor: '#ff6b6b' },
  laser: { cost: 150, range: 120, damage: 10, fireRate: 200, color: '#3498db', bulletColor: '#74b9ff' },
  frost: { cost: 120, range: 90, damage: 5, fireRate: 400, color: '#2ecc71', bulletColor: '#55efc4' }
};
let money = 300;
let lastTime = 0;
let waveTimer = 0;
let waveDelay = 3000;
let enemiesInWave = 0;
let enemiesSpawned = 0;
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 800;

// Build the path
function buildPath() {
  path = [];
  const segments = [
    { x: 0, y: 300, w: 100, h: 40 },
    { x: 100, y: 300, w: 40, h: 200 },
    { x: 100, y: 500, w: 200, h: 40 },
    { x: 300, y: 300, w: 40, h: 200 },
    { x: 300, y: 300, w: 200, h: 40 },
    { x: 500, y: 100, w: 40, h: 200 },
    { x: 500, y: 100, w: 300, h: 40 }
  ];
  segments.forEach(s => path.push(s));
  pathBuilt = true;
}

function isOnPath(x, y) {
  for (let p of path) {
    if (x >= p.x && x <= p.x + p.w && y >= p.y && y <= p.y + p.h) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function dist(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  return Math.sqrt((x2 - x1) ** 2 + (y2 - y1) ** 2);
}

function spawnEnemy() {
  const types = [
    { hp: 50, speed: 1.5, color: '#e17055', radius: 12, reward: 10 },
    { hp: 80, speed: 1.0, color: '#fdcb6e', radius: 14, reward: 15 },
    { hp: 120, speed: 0.8, color: '#a29bfe', radius: 16, reward: 20 }
  ];
  let t = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(wave, types.length))];
  let enemy = {
    x: 0,
    y: 300,
    hp: t.hp + wave * 10,
    maxHp: t.hp + wave * 10,
    speed: t.speed,
    color: t.color,
    radius: t.radius,
    reward: t.reward,
    pathIndex: 0,
    pathProgress: 0
  };
  enemies.push(enemy);
}

function updateEnemy(e, dt) {
  if (e.pathIndex >= path.length) {
    lives--;
    return;
  }
  const p = path[e.pathIndex];
  const cx = p.x + p.w / 2;
  const cy = p.y + p.h / 2;
  const dx = cx - e.x;
  const dy = cy - e.y;
  const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (d < 5) {
    e.pathIndex++;
    return;
  }
  const step = e.speed * dt * 0.06;
  e.x += (dx / d) * step;
  e.y += (dy / d) * step;
}

function updateProjectiles(dt) {
  for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = projectiles[i];
    const dx = p.target.x - p.x;
    const dy = p.target.y - p.y;
    const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (d < p.target.radius + 5) {
      p.target.hp -= p.damage;
      if (p.target.hp <= 0) {
        score += p.target.reward;
        money += p.target.reward;
        enemies.splice(enemies.indexOf(p.target), 1);
      }
      projectiles.splice(i, 1);
    } else {
      const speed = 8;
      p.x += (dx / d) * speed;
      p.y += (dy / d) * speed;
    }
  }
}

function updateTowers(dt) {
  for (let t of towers) {
    t.cooldown -= dt;
    if (t.cooldown <= 0) {
      let target = null;
      let minDist = Infinity;
      for (let e of enemies) {
        const d = dist(t.x, t.y, e.x, e.y);
        if (d <= t.range && d < minDist) {
          minDist = d;
          target = e;
        }
      }
      if (target) {
        projectiles.push({
          x: t.x,
          y: t.y,
          target: target,
          damage: t.damage,
          color: t.bulletColor
        });
        t.cooldown = t.fireRate;
      }
    }
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Wave management
  if (enemiesInWave === 0) {
    waveTimer += dt;
    if (waveTimer >= waveDelay) {
      wave++;
      if (wave > maxWave) {
        state = 'won';
        return;
      }
      enemiesInWave = 5 + wave * 3;
      enemiesSpawned = 0;
      waveTimer = 0;
      spawnTimer = 0;
    }
  } else {
    spawnTimer += dt;
    if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval && enemiesSpawned < enemiesInWave) {
      spawnEnemy();
      enemiesSpawned++;
      spawnTimer = 0;
    }
  }

  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    updateEnemy(enemies[i], dt);
    if (enemies[i].x > W + 20) {
      lives--;
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  updateTowers(dt);
  updateProjectiles(dt);

  if (lives <= 0) state = 'lost';
}

// === INPUT ===
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

  if (state === 'start') {
    state = 'playing';

      if (idx === 0 && money >= towerTypes.cannon.cost) selectedTowerType = 'cannon';
      else if (idx === 1 && money >= towerTypes.laser.cost) selectedTowerType = 'laser';
      else if (idx === 2 && money >= towerTypes.frost.cost) selectedTowerType = 'frost';
      return;
    }

    // Place tower
    const tt = towerTypes[selectedTowerType];
    if (money >= tt.cost && !isOnPath(x, y)) {

      }
      if (!overlap) {
        towers.push({
          x: x,
          y: y,
          range: tt.range,
          damage: tt.damage,
          fireRate: tt.fireRate,
          cooldown: 0,
          color: tt.color,
          bulletColor: tt.bulletColor,
          type: selectedTowerType
        });
        money -= tt.cost;
      }
    }
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {

const mouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };

// === DRAW ===
function drawBackground() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2d3436';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawPath() {
  if (!pathBuilt) return;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#636e72';
  for (let p of path) {
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
  }
  // Path border
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#b2bec3';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let p of path) {
    ctx.strokeRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
  }
}

function drawTowers() {
  for (let t of towers) {
    // Range circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, t.range, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
    ctx.stroke();

    // Tower body
    ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Tower center
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawEnemies() {
  for (let e of enemies) {
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, e.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // HP bar
    const barW = e.radius * 2;
    const barH = 4;
    const barX = e.x - e.radius;
    const barY = e.y - e.radius - 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d63031';
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00b894';
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * (e.hp / e.maxHp), barH);
  }
}

function drawProjectiles() {
  for (let p of projectiles) {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawUI() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
  ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, 10, 55);
  ctx.fillText('Wave: ' + wave + '/' + maxWave, 10, 80);
  ctx.fillText('Money: $' + money, 10, 105);

  // Tower selection buttons
  const btnY = H - 50;
  const btnH = 40;
  const btnW = 80;
  const btnX = 10;
  const types = ['cannon', 'laser', 'frost'];
  const labels = ['Cannon $100', 'Laser $150', 'Frost $120'];

  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const bx = btnX + i * (btnW + 10);
    const selected = selectedTowerType === types[i];
    const affordable = money >= towerTypes[types[i]].cost;

    ctx.fillStyle = selected ? towerTypes[types[i]].color : (affordable ? '#555' : '#333');
    ctx.fillRect(bx, btnY, btnW, btnH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = selected ? '#fff' : '#666';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx, btnY, btnW, btnH);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '12px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(labels[i], bx + btnW / 2, btnY + btnH / 2 + 4);
  }

  if (state === 'playing') {
    const tt = towerTypes[selectedTowerType];
    if (!isOnPath(mouse.x, mouse.y)) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, tt.range, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = tt.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('TOWER DEFENSE', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);

  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('One Path - 5 Waves', W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.fillText('Click to Start', W / 2, H / 2 + 40);

  ctx.font = '16px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.fillText('Place towers to stop enemies from reaching the end', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
}

function drawEndScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = state === 'won' ? '#00b894' : '#d63031';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(state === 'won' ? 'YOU WON!' : 'GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawPath();
  drawTowers();
  drawEnemies();
  drawProjectiles();
  drawUI();

  if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') drawEndScreen();
}

// === LOOP ===
function loop(timestamp) {
  const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ============================================================
   COLOR STACK — a one-minute (60s) tower game.
   One playable scene: grow the tower, stack same-color blocks,
   slice off misaligned edges. Win = survive the minute.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- 1. STATE ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

const GAME_TIME = 60;            // seconds
const START_LIFE = 3;            // lives
const BASE_W = 240;             // reference block width
const BLOCK_H = 26;             // block height
const BASE_Y = 0.80;           // fraction of H for ground
const TOWER_X = 0.42;          // fraction of W for tower center
const DROP_SPEED = 620;         // px/s
const MAX_PARTICLES = 400;

const state = {
  phase: "menu",       // "menu" | "playing" | "win" | "lose"
  timeLeft: GAME_TIME,
  score: 0,
  best: 0,
  combo: 0,
  lives: START_LIFE,
  tower: [],           // {w, x, color, h}
  active: null,        // moving block {w, x, y, dir, color}
  spawnX: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  lastTime: 0,
  particles: [],
  floaters: [],
  stars: [],
  bgHue: 220
};

const PALETTE = ["#ff5d73", "#ffb03a", "#4fd1c5", "#5b8cff", "#b56cff", "#7be07b"];
let activeColor = PALETTE[0];
let nextColor = PALETTE[1];

/* ---------- 2. HELPERS ---------- */
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function baseY() { return H * BASE_Y; }
function towerX() { return W * TOWER_X; }
function towerTopY() { return baseY() - state.tower.length * BLOCK_H; }
function blockWidth() { return clamp(BASE_W * (W / 1000), 90, 340); }

/* ---------- 3. INPUT ---------- */
function primaryAction() {
  if (state.phase === "menu") { startGame(); return; }
  if (state.phase === "win" || state.phase === "lose") {
    state.phase = "menu"; return;
  }
  if (state.phase === "playing" && state.active) {
    dropActive();
  }
}

function startGame() {
  state.phase = "playing";
  state.timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
  state.score = 0;
  state.combo = 0;
  state.lives = START_LIFE;
  state.tower = [];
  state.particles = [];
  state.floaters = [];
  state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = 0;
  spawnActive();
}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); primaryAction(); });
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); primaryAction(); }
});

/* ---------- 4. UPDATE ---------- */
function spawnActive() {
  const w = blockWidth();
  const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
  const x = fromLeft ? -w : W;
  const y = towerTopY() - BLOCK_H * 2.4;
  state.active = { w, x, y, dir: fromLeft ? 1 : -1, color: activeColor };
  // choose next color
  const idx = PALETTE.indexOf(activeColor);
  let n;
  do { n = (idx + 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (PALETTE.length - 1))) % PALETTE.length; }
  while (n === idx);
  nextColor = PALETTE[n];
}

function dropActive() {
  const a = state.active;
  if (!a) return;
  const prev = state.tower.length ? state.tower[state.tower.length - 1] : null;
  const pw = prev ? prev.w : blockWidth();
  const px = prev ? prev.x : towerX() - pw / 2;

  const overlap = Math.min(a.x + a.w, px + pw) - Math.max(a.x, px);

  if (overlap <= 0) {
    // complete miss
    spawnDebris(a, 1);
    state.active = null;
    loseLife();
    return;
  }

  const perfect = Math.abs(overlap - pw) < 8 && Math.abs(a.x - px) < 8;
  const newW = overlap;
  const newX = Math.max(a.x, px);
  state.tower.push({ w: newW, x: newX, color: a.color, h: BLOCK_H });

  // score
  let pts = 10;
  if (perfect) pts += 15;
  if (a.color === activeColor) {
    state.combo++;
    pts += state.combo * 5;
    addFloater("COMBO x" + state.combo, a.x + a.w / 2, a.y - 10, "#ffe14d");
  } else {
    state.combo = 0;
  }
  state.score += pts;
  if (perfect) {
    state.flash = 0.5;
    addFloater("PERFECT!", a.x + a.w / 2, a.y - 10, "#8affc1");
  }

  // slice off the excess
  const leftOver = (a.x < px) ? (px - a.x) : 0;
  const rightOver = ((a.x + a.w) > (px + pw)) ? ((a.x + a.w) - (px + pw)) : 0;
  if (leftOver > 0) spawnDebris({ x: a.x, y: a.y, w: leftOver, color: a.color }, 0.5);
  if (rightOver > 0) spawnDebris({ x: px + pw, y: a.y, w: rightOver, color: a.color }, 0.5);

  // tower too narrow -> life lost
  if (newW < pw * 0.22) {
    loseLife();
  }
  state.active = null;

  // advance colors
  activeColor = nextColor;
  // schedule next spawn
  setTimeout(() => { if (state.phase === "playing") spawnActive(); }, 380);
}

function loseLife() {
  state.lives--;
  state.shake = 14;
  state.combo = 0;
  if (state.lives <= 0) {
    state.phase = "lose";
    updateBest();
  }
}

function updateBest() {
  if (state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
}

function spawnDebris(block, spread) {
  const n = Math.max(3, Math.floor(block.w / 12));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    state.particles.push({
      x: block.x + Math.random() * block.w,
      y: block.y + Math.random() * BLOCK_H,
      vx: rand(-160, 160) * spread,
      vy: rand(-260, -40),
      size: rand(4, 9),
      color: block.color,
      life: 1
    });
  }
  if (state.particles.length > MAX_PARTICLES) state.particles.splice(0, state.particles.length - MAX_PARTICLES);
}

function addFloater(text, x, y, color) {
  state.floaters.push({ text, x, y, color, life: 1 });
}

function update(dt) {
  // ambient
  state.bgHue = (state.bgHue + dt * 4) % 360;
  state.shake *= Math.pow(0.001, dt); // decay
  state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 2);

  // particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.vy += 900 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt * 0.9;
    if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
  // floaters
  for (let i = state.floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = state.floaters[i];
    f.y -= 40 * dt;
    f.life -= dt * 0.8;
    if (f.life <= 0) state.floaters.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (state.phase !== "playing") return;

  // timer
  state.timeLeft -= dt;
  if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
    state.timeLeft = 0;
    state.phase = "win";
    updateBest();
    return;
  }

  // move active block
  const a = state.active;
  if (a) {
    const speed = DROP_SPEED * (1 + (GAME_TIME - state.timeLeft) * 0.02);
    a.x += a.dir * speed * dt;
    if (a.dir > 0 && a.x > W + 20) { a.dir = -1; }
    if (a.dir < 0 && a.x < -a.w - 20) { a.dir = 1; }
  }
}

/* ---------- 5. DRAW ---------- */
function buildStars() {
  state.stars = [];
  const count = Math.floor((W * H) / 12000);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    state.stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H * 0.7, r: rand(0.5, 1.8), tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
  }
}

function drawBackground(t) {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  const h1 = state.bgHue, h2 = (state.bgHue + 40) % 360;
  g.addColorStop(0, "hsl(" + h1 + ", 45%, 8%)");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "hsl(" + h2 + ", 40%, 13%)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "hsl(" + ((h1 + 200) % 360) + ", 45%, 6%)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    const a = 0.35 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * 0.002 + s.tw);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a.toFixed(3) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // distant glowing orbs
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const ox = W * (0.2 + i * 0.3) + Math.sin(t * 0.0003 + i) * 40;
    const oy = H * (0.25 + i * 0.12) + Math.cos(t * 0.0004 + i) * 30;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(ox, oy, 0, ox, oy, 120);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "hsla(" + ((state.bgHue + i * 60) % 360) + ", 80%, 60%, 0.10)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "hsla(" + ((state.bgHue + i * 60) % 360) + ", 80%, 60%, 0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ox, oy, 120, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // ground
  const gy = baseY();
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy, 0, H);
  gg.addColorStop(0, "hsl(" + ((state.bgHue + 200) % 360) + ", 30%, 16%)");
  gg.addColorStop(1, "hsl(" + ((state.bgHue + 200) % 360) + ", 35%, 7%)");
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, gy, W, H - gy);
  // ground line
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, gy);
  ctx.lineTo(W, gy);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawBlock(b, alpha) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  const y = b.y;
  // body
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + BLOCK_H);
  g.addColorStop(0, shade(b.color, 30));
  g.addColorStop(0.5, b.color);
  g.addColorStop(1, shade(b.color, -25));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  roundRect(b.x, y, b.w, BLOCK_H, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  // top highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
  roundRect(b.x + 4, y + 3, b.w - 8, 5, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  // side bevel
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)";
  ctx.fillRect(b.x + b.w - 5, y + 3, 3, BLOCK_H - 6);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function shade(hex, amt) {
  const c = hex.replace("#", "");
  let r = parseInt(c.substr(0, 2), 16), g = parseInt(c.substr(2, 2), 16), b = parseInt(c.substr(4, 2), 16);
  r = clamp(r + amt, 0, 255); g = clamp(g + amt, 0, 255); b = clamp(b + amt, 0, 255);
  return "rgb(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ")";
}

function drawTower() {
  let y = baseY();
  for (let i = 0; i < state.tower.length; i++) {
    const b = state.tower[i];
    y -= BLOCK_H;
    drawBlock({ x: b.x, y: y, w: b.w, color: b.color }, 1);
  }
}

function drawActive(t) {
  const a = state.active;
  if (!a) return;
  // shadow / guide
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
  const prev = state.tower.length ? state.tower[state.tower.length - 1] : null;
  const gy = towerTopY();
  if (prev) {
    const overlap = Math.min(a.x + a.w, prev.x + prev.w) - Math.max(a.x, prev.x);
    if (overlap > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)";
      ctx.fillRect(Math.max(a.x, prev.x), gy, overlap, BLOCK_H);
    }
  }
  drawBlock({ x: a.x, y: a.y, w: a.w, color: a.color }, 1);
  // pulsing outline
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 0.008);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.3 + pulse * 0.4).toFixed(3) + ")";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(a.x - 2, a.y - 2, a.w + 4, BLOCK_H + 4, 8);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloaters() {
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  for (const f of state.floaters) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(f.life, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // timer bar
  const bw = Math.min(W * 0.5, 460);
  const bx = (W - bw) / 2, by = 22, bh = 16;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
  roundRect(bx - 3, by - 3, bw + 6, bh + 6, 10);
  ctx.fill();
  const frac = clamp(state.timeLeft / GAME_TIME, 0, 1);
  const tcol = frac > 0.4 ? "#4fd1c5" : (frac > 0.18 ? "#ffb03a" : "#ff5d73");
  ctx.fillStyle = tcol;
  if (frac > 0) { roundRect(bx, by, bw * frac, bh, 8); ctx.fill(); }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 15px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(state.timeLeft) + "s", W / 2, by + bh + 20);

  // score
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE", 22, 40);
  ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14d";
  ctx.fillText(String(state.score), 22, 82);
  if (state.combo > 1) {
    ctx.font = "bold 18px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8affc1";
    ctx.fillText("COMBO x" + state.combo, 22, 108);
  }

  // lives
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.font = "bold 16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.fillText("LIVES", W - 22, 40);
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIFE; i++) {
    const cx = W - 22 - (START_LIFE - 1 - i) * 30, cy = 62;
    ctx.fillStyle = i < state.lives ? "#ff5d73" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + 8);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - 12, cy - 6, cx - 6, cy - 14, cx, cy - 6);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + 6, cy - 14, cx + 12, cy - 6, cx, cy + 8);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // best
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
  ctx.font = "13px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("BEST " + state.best, W - 22, 100);
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6,8,18,0.72)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(64, W * 0.09) + "px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.4);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H * 0.4 + 44);
  if (state.phase === "win" || state.phase === "lose") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14d";
    ctx.font = "bold 30px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + state.score, W / 2, H * 0.4 + 92);
  }
  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.005);

  ctx.font = "18px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";

  function splash(x, y, n) {

      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: rand(-120, 120),
        vy: rand(-260, -60),
        r: rand(2, 6),

  function loop(t) {
    if (!last) last = t;
    var dt = (t - last) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    last = t;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

    ctx.lineTo(-needleLen*0.35, -needleLen*0.12);
    ctx.lineTo(-needleLen*0.35, needleLen*0.12);
    ctx.closePath();
    const redG = ctx.createLinearGradient(needleLen, 0, -needleLen*0.35, 0);
    redG.addColorStop(0, '#ff5b5b');
    redG.addColorStop(1, '#c22f3a');
    ctx.fillStyle = redG; ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)'; ctx.stroke();
    // south (blue) half
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-needleLen, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(needleLen*0.35, -needleLen*0.12);
    ctx.lineTo(needleLen*0.35, needleLen*0.12);
    ctx.closePath();
    const blueG = ctx.createLinearGradient(-needleLen, 0, needleLen*0.35, 0);
    blueG.addColorStop(0, '#5aa8ff');
    blueG.addColorStop(1, '#2f6fc2');
    ctx.fillStyle = blueG; ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // hub
    const hub = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY, 0, CX, CY, needleLen*0.16);
    hub.addColorStop(0, '#e8f2ff');
    hub.addColorStop(1, '#7fa8d0');
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(CX, CY, needleLen*0.16, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = hub; ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = '#22344a'; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(CX, CY, needleLen*0.05, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#22344a'; ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: HUD ----------
  function drawHUD(){
    // score
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf4ff';
    ctx.fillText(state.score, 28, 24);
    ctx.font = '15px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7f9bb8';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE', 30, 74);

    // best
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e6';
    ctx.fillText(state.best, W - 28, 26);
    ctx.font = '14px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6f8aa6';
    ctx.fillText('BEST', W - 30, 58);

    if (state.mode === 'playing'){
      // time bar
      const bw = Math.min(W*0.5, 320);
      const bh = 16;
      const bx = (W - bw)/2;
      const by = H - 54;
      const frac = state.timeLeft / state.maxLife;
      // frame
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
      roundRect(bx-3, by-3, bw+6, bh+6, 10); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
      roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 7); ctx.fill();
      // fill
      const col = frac > 0.5 ? '#3ee08f' : frac > 0.25 ? '#ffcf5a' : '#ff5a5a';
      ctx.fillStyle = col;
      roundRect(bx, by, Math.max(0, bw*frac), bh, 7); ctx.fill();
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
      ctx.font = '14px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e6';
      ctx.fillText('TIME  ' + state.timeLeft.toFixed(1) + 's', W/2, by - 8);
    }
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y+h, x, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y+h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x+w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: overlays ----------
  function drawStart(t){
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    // title
    ctx.font = 'bold 54px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf4ff';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,160,255,0.5)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
    ctx.fillText('COMPASS HEADING', W/2, H*0.22);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.font = '20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e6';
    ctx.fillText('Steer the needle into the glowing green heading', W/2, H*0.22 + 44);
    ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7f9bb8';
    ctx.fillText('Move your mouse (or finger) to turn the compass.  Every hit refills the timer.', W/2, H*0.22 + 72);
    // prompt
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(t*3);
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(125,255,176,' + (0.6 + pulse*0.4) + ')';
    ctx.fillText('Click or tap anywhere to begin', W/2, H*0.72);
  }

  function drawOver(){
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    // dim
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,10,18,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7a6a';
    ctx.fillText('TIME UP', W/2, H*0.32);
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf4ff';
    ctx.fillText('Score  ' + state.score, W/2, H*0.32 + 52);
    if (state.score >= state.best && state.score > 0){
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7dffb0';
      ctx.fillText('New best!', W/2, H*0.32 + 90);
    } else {
      ctx.font = '18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e6';
      ctx.fillText('Best  ' + state.best, W/2, H*0.32 + 90);
    }
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(performance.now()*0.003);
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(125,255,176,' + (0.6 + pulse*0.4) + ')';
    ctx.fillText('Click to play again', W/2, H*0.68);
  }

  // ---------- Draw: background ----------
  function drawBackground(t){
    // stars
    for (const s of state.stars){
      const tw = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(t*0.001*s.s + s.p));
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,220,255,' + (tw*0.8) + ')';
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for (const p of state.particles){
      const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawFlash(){
    if (state.flash <= 0) return;
    ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash * 0.25;
    ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  function frame(now){
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last)/1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBackground(now);
    drawCompass(now);
    drawParticles();
    drawFlash();
    drawHUD();
    if (state.mode === 'start') drawStart(now);
    if (state.mode === 'over') drawOver();

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Calendar Quest</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border: 3px solid #e94560;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(233,69,96,0.3);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// === STATE ===
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let gameState = 'start'; // 'start', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
let targetDate = 15;
let movesLeft = 8;
let score = 0;
let hoveredCell = null;
let message = '';
let messageTimer = 0;
let particles = [];

const daysInMonth = 31;
const weeks = 5;
const dayNames = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
const monthName = 'June 2025';

// Cell layout
const gridX = 100;
const gridY = 140;
const cellW = 90;
const cellH = 70;
const gap = 4;

// === INPUT ===
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);

  if (gameState === 'start') {
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (gameState === 'won' || gameState === 'lost') {
    gameState = 'start';
    return;
  }
  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    const col = Math.floor((mx - gridX) / (cellW + gap));
    const row = Math.floor((my - gridY) / (cellH + gap));
    if (col >= 0 && col < 7 && row >= 0 && row < weeks) {
      const dayIndex = row * 7 + col;
      if (dayIndex < daysInMonth) {
        clickCell(dayIndex);
      }
    }
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);
  hoveredCell = null;
  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    const col = Math.floor((mx - gridX) / (cellW + gap));
    const row = Math.floor((my - gridY) / (cellH + gap));
    if (col >= 0 && col < 7 && row >= 0 && row < weeks) {
      const dayIndex = row * 7 + col;
      if (dayIndex < daysInMonth) {
        hoveredCell = dayIndex;
      }
    }
  }
});

// === GAME LOGIC ===
function startGame() {
  targetDate = Math.floor(Math.random() * daysInMonth) + 1;
  movesLeft = 8;
  score = 0;
  message = '';
  messageTimer = 0;
  particles = [];
  gameState = 'playing';
}

function clickCell(dayIndex) {
  if (movesLeft <= 0) return;
  movesLeft--;
  const clickedDay = dayIndex + 1;

  if (clickedDay === targetDate) {
    gameState = 'won';
    score += movesLeft * 100;
    spawnWinParticles();
  } else {
    if (movesLeft <= 0) {
      gameState = 'lost';
    } else {
      const diff = Math.abs(clickedDay - targetDate);
      message = clickedDay < targetDate ? '📅 Too early!' : '📅 Too late!';
      messageTimer = 90;
    }
  }
}

function spawnWinParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: canvas.width / 2,
      y: canvas.height / 2,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10 - 3,
      life: 60 + Math.random() * 40,
      color: ['#e94560','#0f3460','#16213e','#f5c518','#4ecdc4'][Math.floor(Math.random()*5)],
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 5
    });
  }
}

// === UPDATE ===
function update() {
  if (messageTimer > 0) messageTimer--;
  particles = particles.filter(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15;
    p.life--;
    return p.life > 0;
  });
}

// === DRAW ===
function draw() {
  // Background
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a2e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#16213e');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Decorative circles in background
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(100, 500, 120, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(700, 100, 80, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(650, 480, 100, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  if (gameState === 'start') drawStart();
  else if (gameState === 'playing') drawGame();
  else if (gameState === 'won') drawWin();
  else if (gameState === 'lost') drawLose();

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 100;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size/2, p.y - p.size/2, p.size, p.size);
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawStart() {
  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('CALENDAR QUEST', canvas.width/2, 150);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.font = '24px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Find the hidden date!', canvas.width/2, 210);

  // Mini calendar icon
  const iconX = canvas.width/2 - 50;
  const iconY = 250;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c518';
  ctx.fillRect(iconX, iconY, 100, 80);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#16213e';
  ctx.fillRect(iconX, iconY, 100, 25);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('JUN', iconX + 50, iconY + 17);
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#16213e';
      ctx.fillRect(iconX + 10 + c*18, iconY + 32 + r*16, 12, 10);
    }
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('You have 8 moves to find the target date.', canvas.width/2, 390);
  ctx.fillText('Each wrong guess tells you if you need', canvas.width/2, 420);
  ctx.fillText('to go EARLIER or LATER in the month.', canvas.width/2, 450);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c518';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('▶ CLICK TO START ◀', canvas.width/2, 530);
}

function drawGame() {
  // Header
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('📅 ' + monthName, gridX, 50);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Moves: ' + movesLeft, canvas.width - gridX, 50);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c518';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width/2, 50);

  // Day names
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    const cx = gridX + i * (cellW + gap) + cellW/2;
    ctx.fillText(dayNames[i], cx, gridY - 12);
  }

  // Calendar cells
  for (let r = 0; r < weeks; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < 7; c++) {
      const idx = r * 7 + c;
      const x = gridX + c * (cellW + gap);
      const y = gridY + r * (cellH + gap);

      if (idx >= daysInMonth) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)';
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, cellW, cellH);
        continue;
      }

      const day = idx + 1;
      const isHovered = hoveredCell === idx;
      const isWeekend = (c === 0 || c === 6);

      // Cell background
      if (isHovered) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
      } else if (isWeekend) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a4a';
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1e1e3a';
      }
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, cellW, cellH);

      // Border
      ctx.strokeStyle = isHovered ? '#f5c518' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
      ctx.lineWidth = isHovered ? 2 : 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(x, y, cellW, cellH);

      // Day number
      ctx.fillStyle = isHovered ? '#fff' : (isWeekend ? '#e94560' : '#ccc');
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(day, x + cellW/2, y + cellH/2 + 8);
    }
  }

  // Message
  if (messageTimer > 0 && message) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c518';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(message, canvas.width/2, canvas.height - 30);
  }
}

function drawWin() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.font = 'bold 42px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('🎉 YOU FOUND IT! 🎉', canvas.width/2, 200);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c518';
  ctx.font = '28px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('The date was: ' + targetDate, canvas.width/2, 270);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.font = '24px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width/2, 340);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Click to play again', canvas.width/2, 450);
}

function drawLose() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.font = 'bold 42px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('💀 OUT OF MOVES', canvas.width/2, 200);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c518';
  ctx.font = '28px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('The date was: ' + targetDate, canvas.width/2, 270);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Click to try again', canvas.width/2, 450);
}

// === MAIN LOOP ===
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

Complete HTML game file with canvas/script.
