<html_file>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, user-scalable=no">
<title>Red Black Streak</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; width: 100%;
    background: #05050a; overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Arial", sans-serif;
  }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 0, H = 0;
  function resize(){ W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth; H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---- State ----
  const state = {
    running: false,
    score: 0,
    best: 0,
    streak: 0,
    currentColor: "red",
    lastColor: null,
    timeLeft: 0,
    timeLimit: 2.5,
    over: false,
    wrongFlash: 0,
    shake: 0
  };

  const particles = [];
  let stars = [];
  function initStars(){
    stars = [];
    for(let i=0;i<120;i++){
      stars.push({x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*H, r: Math.random()*1.5+0.3, tw: Math.random()*Math.PI*2});
    }
  }
  initStars();
  window.addEventListener("resize", initStars);

  function startGame(){
    state.running = true;
    state.over = false;
    state.score = 0;
    state.streak = 0;
    state.lastColor = null;
    state.currentColor = Math.random() < 0.5 ? "red" : "black";
    state.timeLimit = 2.5;
    state.timeLeft = state.timeLimit;
    state.wrongFlash = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
  }

  function endGame(){
    state.running = false;
    state.over = true;
    state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
  }

  function hit(color){
    if(!state.running) return;
    if(color === state.currentColor){
      state.streak++;
      state.score += 1 + Math.floor(state.streak/3);
      state.lastColor = state.currentColor;
      state.currentColor = state.currentColor === "red" ? "black" : "red";
      state.timeLimit = Math.max(1.1, state.timeLimit - 0.08);
      state.timeLeft = state.timeLimit;
      burst(color, 14);
    } else {
      state.wrongFlash = 1;
      state.shake = 12;
      endGame();
      burst("gray", 24);
    }
  }

  function burst(color, n){
    const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const sp = Math.random()*5+2;
      particles.push({
        x: cx, y: cy,
        vx: Math.cos(a)*sp, vy: Math.sin(a)*sp,
        life: 1, color: color, r: Math.random()*3+1
      });
    }
  }

  // ---- Input ----
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e)=>{
    if(e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter"){
      if(!state.running && !state.over) startGame();
      return;
    }
    if(!state.running) return;
    if(e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") hit("red");
    if(e.key === "b" || e.key === "B") hit("black");
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e)=>{
    const x = e.clientX, y = e.clientY;
    if(!state.running && !state.over){ startGame(); return; }
    if(!state.running) return;
    if(x < W/2) hit("red"); else hit("black");
  });

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(dt){
    if(state.running){
      state.timeLeft -= dt;
      if(state.timeLeft <= 0){ endGame(); }
    }
    if(state.wrongFlash > 0) state.wrongFlash = Math.max(0, state.wrongFlash - dt*2);
    if(state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt*40);

    for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.15;
      p.life -= dt*1.4;
      if(p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function drawBackground(){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#0a0a14");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#12121f");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#05050a");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // stars
    for(const s of stars){
      const a = 0.4 + 0.4*Math.sin(s.tw + performance.now()*0.002);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,"+a.toFixed(2)+")";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // ground glow
    const gg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.85, 50, W/2, H*0.85, W*0.7);
    gg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,40,40,0.18)");
    gg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }

  function drawTarget(){
    const cx = W/2, cy = H*0.42;
    const R = Math.min(W,H)*0.16;
    const color = state.currentColor;
    const col = color === "red" ? "#e0202a" : "#1a1a1a";
    const glow = color === "red" ? "rgba(255,40,40,0.6)" : "rgba(120,120,160,0.4)";

    // outer glow ring
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 40;
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // inner ring
    ctx.lineWidth = R*0.12;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color === "red" ? "#ff8080" : "#5a5a7a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R*0.6, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();

    // center dot
    ctx.fillStyle = color === "red" ? "#ffffff" : "#8888aa";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R*0.12, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // label
    ctx.fillStyle = color === "red" ? "#ffd0d0" : "#c0c0e0";
    ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(R*0.35)+"px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(color.toUpperCase(), cx, cy + R + Math.floor(R*0.4));
  }

  function drawTimer(){
    const cx = W/2, cy = H*0.42;
    const R = Math.min(W,H)*0.16;
    const frac = state.running ? state.timeLeft/state.timeLimit : 0;
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = frac > 0.4 ? "#e0202a" : "#ff9040";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R+18, -Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2 + frac*Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(H*0.05)+"px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  "+state.score, 20, 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6060";
    ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(H*0.035)+"px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("STREAK  "+state.streak, 20, 20 + Math.floor(H*0.06));

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8888aa";
    ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(H*0.035)+"px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("BEST  "+state.best, W-20, 20);

    if(state.wrongFlash > 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,0,0,"+state.wrongFlash.toFixed(2)+")";
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    }
  }

  function drawOverlays(){
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    if(!state.running && !state.over){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(H*0.08)+"px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("RED BLACK STREAK", W/2, H*0.2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#cccccc";
      ctx.font = Math.floor(H*0.04)+"px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("Match the color. Press R for Red, B for Black.", W/2, H*0.3);
      ctx.fillText("Tap left half = Red, right half = Black.", W/2, H*0.36);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e0202a";
      ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(H*0.05)+"px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS ANY KEY OR TAP TO START", W/2, H*0.55);
    } else if(state.over){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(H*0.07)+"px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W/2, H*0.32);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6060";
      ctx.font = "bold "+Math.floor(H*0.05)+"px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("Score: "+state.score+"   Best: "+state.best, W/2, H*0.45);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#cccccc";
      ctx.font = Math.floor(H*0.04)+"px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("Press Space or tap to play again", W/2, H*0.55);
    }
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(state.shake > 0){
      ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake);
    }
    drawBackground();
    if(state.running || state.over){
      drawTarget();
      drawTimer();
    }
    // particles
    for(const p of particles){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
      const c = p.color === "red" ? "#ff4040" : p.color === "black" ? "#222233" : "#888888";
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();
    drawOverlays();
  }

  // ---- Loop ----
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last)/1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Diabolo Duel</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #05070f; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize(){
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * DPR; canvas.height = H * DPR;
  canvas.style.width = W + "px"; canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

/* ---------- constants ---------- */
const GRAV = 1500;
const DIAMETER = 54;
const WIN = 15;
const START = 3;
const P1 = { color:"#ff5d5d", glow:"#ffb0b0", name:"Red",  key:"A" };
const P2 = { color:"#4aa3ff", glow:"#bcdcff", name:"Blue", key:"L" };

/* ---------- state ---------- */
let state = "title";
let p1, p2, particles, shake, t, winMsg, winSub, confetti;
const keys = {};

function makePlayer(cfg, x, facing){
  return {
    x, y:0, vx:0, vy:0,
    facing,
    phase:0,
    spin:0,
    spinVel:0,
    spinVelTarget:0,
    spinTimer:0,
    score:0,
    miss:0,
    combo:0,
    maxCombo:0,
    throwCount:0,
    catchCount:0,
    cfg
  };
}

function initMatch(){
  const base = H * 0.66;
  p1 = makePlayer(P1, W*0.28, 1);
  p2 = makePlayer(P2, W*0.72, -1);
  p1.y = p2.y = base;
  p1.spin = 2200; p2.spin = 2200;
  particles = [];
  shake = 0;
  t = 0;
  winMsg = ""; winSub = "";
  confetti = [];
}
initMatch();

/* ---------- input ---------- */
window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (state === "title" && (k === " " || k === "enter")) { startPlay(); }
  else if (state === "win" && (k === " " || k === "enter")) { startPlay(); }
  else if (state === "play") {
    if (k === "a") throwBall(p1);
    if (k === "l") throwBall(p2);
  }
  if (["arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"," "].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

function startPlay(){
  initMatch();
  state = "countdown";
  t = START;
}

/* ---------- physics helpers ---------- */
function throwBall(p){
  if (state !== "play") return;
  if (p.throwCount > 0) return; // already airborne
  p.throwCount++;
  p.vx = 0;
  p.vy = -(H * 0.0016) - 700 - Math.random()*120;
  // add a little spin kick
  p.spinVelTarget = p.spinVelTarget + 900;
  p.spinTimer = 0.5;
  p.combo = 0;
  spawnBurst(p.x, p.y, p.cfg.color, 10);
}

function groundY(){ return H * 0.82; }

function updatePlayer(p, dt){
  const g = groundY();
  // horizontal movement
  const left  = (p.facing === 1) ? keys["a"] : keys["arrowleft"];
  const right = (p.facing === 1) ? keys["d"] : keys["arrowright"];
  const speed = 380;
  let ax = 0;
  if (left)  ax -= speed;
  if (right) ax += speed;
  p.vx += ax * dt * 3;
  p.vx *= Math.pow(0.0015, dt); // damping
  p.x += p.vx * dt;

  // clamp to half
  const lo = W*0.05, hi = W*0.95;
  if (p.x < lo){ p.x = lo; p.vx = 0; }
  if (p.x > hi){ p.x = hi; p.vx = 0; }

  // spin
  p.spin += p.spinVel * dt;
  if (p.spinTimer > 0){
    p.spinTimer -= dt;
    p.spinVel += (p.spinVelTarget - p.spinVel) * Math.min(1, dt*6);
  } else {
    p.spinVel *= Math.pow(0.4, dt); // spin decays
  }

  // animation phase
  p.phase += dt * 3;
}

function updateBall(p, dt){
  if (p.throwCount === 0) return;
  p.vy += GRAV * dt;
  p.x += p.vx * dt;
  p.y += p.vy * dt;
  p.spin += p.spinVel * dt;

  // catch window: falling and near hand height
  const handY = H * 0.62;
  if (p.vy > 0 && Math.abs(p.y - handY) < 34){
    // caught
    p.throwCount = 0;
    p.y = handY;
    p.vy = 0; p.vx = 0;
    p.catchCount++;
    p.combo++;
    if (p.combo > p.maxCombo) p.maxCombo = p.combo;
    p.score++;
    p.spinVelTarget = 2400;
    p.spinTimer = 0.6;
    spawnBurst(p.x, handY, p.cfg.glow, 18);
    shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
    if (p.score >= WIN) triggerWin(p);
  }
  // ground miss
  if (p.y >= groundY() - 8){
    p.y = groundY() - 8;
    p.vy = -p.vy * 0.35;
    if (Math.abs(p.vy) < 40){
      p.vy = 0;
      p.miss++;
      p.combo = 0;
      p.throwCount = 0;
      spawnBurst(p.x, groundY(), "#8892a8", 14);
      shake = Math.max(shake, 8);
    }
  }
}

function triggerWin(p){
  state = "win";
  winMsg = p.cfg.name + " WINS!";
  winSub = "Score " + p.score + "  ·  best streak " + p.maxCombo;
  confetti = [];
  const cols = [p.cfg.color, p.cfg.glow, "#ffd166", "#ffffff"];
  for (let i=0;i<140;i++){
    confetti.push({
      x: Math.random()*W,
      y: -Math.random()*H,
      vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*80,
      vy: 120 + Math.random()*220,
      r: 4 + Math.random()*7,
      rot: Math.random()*6.28,
      vr: (Math.random()-0.5)*8,
      c: cols[i % cols.length]
    });
  }
}

function spawnObstacle() {

function addParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(Math.cos(a) * TOP_RADIUS * 0.85, Math.sin(a) * TOP_RADIUS * 0.85, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // motion blur lines when spinning fast
  if (Math.abs(spinSpeed) > 3) {
    const blurAlpha = Math.min(0.3, (Math.abs(spinSpeed) - 3) * 0.03);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,200,50,${blurAlpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = spinAngle + (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2;
      const r1 = TOP_RADIUS + 5;
      const r2 = TOP_RADIUS + 20 + Math.abs(spinSpeed) * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(TOP_X + Math.cos(a) * r1, TOP_Y + Math.sin(a) * r1);
      ctx.lineTo(TOP_X + Math.cos(a) * r2, TOP_Y + Math.sin(a) * r2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // HUD
  if (state === 'playing') {
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${Math.floor(score)}`, W / 2, 40);

    // spin speed bar
    const barW = 200, barH = 12;
    const barX = W / 2 - barW / 2, barY = 55;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
    const fill = Math.abs(spinSpeed) / MAX_SPIN;
    const barGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, 0, barX + barW, 0);
    barGrad.addColorStop(0, '#44ff88');
    barGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffcc00');
    barGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff4444');
    ctx.fillStyle = barGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * fill, barH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('SPIN SPEED', W / 2, barY + barH + 14);
  }

  // start screen
  if (state === 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('TOP SPIN', W / 2, H / 2 - 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Keep the top spinning!', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('← → or A D to spin', W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
    ctx.fillText('Spin fast to deflect obstacles', W / 2, H / 2 + 35);
    ctx.fillText('If spin is too slow, you crash', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3);
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 120);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    if (highScore > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText(`HIGH SCORE: ${highScore}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 160);
    }
  }

  // game over
  if (state === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 38px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('TOP STOPPED!', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, W / 2, H / 2);
    if (Math.floor(score) >= highScore && highScore > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
      ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('NEW HIGH SCORE!', W / 2, H / 2 + 35);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3);
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RESTART', W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

// ====== GAME LOOP ======
let lastTime = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = now;
  time += dt * 0.1; // for UI pulse even in menus
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Word Scramble</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.15);
  }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ===== STATE =====
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const WORDS = [
  'APPLE','BREAD','CHESS','DANCE','EAGLE','FLAME','GHOST','HARBOR',
  'ISLAND','JUNIOR','KETTLE','LANTERN','MANGO','NURSE','ORCHARD',
  'PENCIL','QUARTZ','RIVER','STORM','TUNNEL','URBAN','VELVET',
  'WALNUT','YACHT','ZENITH','BOLT','CREW','DUSK','ELM','FROG',
  'GEM','HIVE','INK','JAZZ','KITE','LUXE','MOSS','NOVA',
  'OAK','PEAR','RIFT','SUN','TIDE','VOW','WAVE','YARN'
];

let state = 'start'; // start, playing, won, lost
let score = 0;
let timeLeft = 60;
let lastTime = 0;
let currentWord = '';
let scrambledWord = '';
let targetWord = '';
let playerInput = '';
let hint = '';
let particles = [];
let shakeX = 0, shakeY = 0;
let shakeTimer = 0;
let correctFlash = 0;
let wrongFlash = 0;
let wordIndex = 0;
let totalWords = 0;
let usedWords = [];
let bgStars = [];
let floatingLetters = [];

// Init background stars
for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
  bgStars.push({
    x: Math.random() * 800,
    y: Math.random() * 600,
    size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1,
    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// Init floating decorative letters
const DECOR_LETTERS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
  floatingLetters.push({
    x: Math.random() * 800,
    y: Math.random() * 600,
    char: DECOR_LETTERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 26)],
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.08 + 0.02,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.2 + 0.05,
    size: Math.random() * 20 + 14,
    angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005
  });
}

function shuffleArray(arr) {
  const a = [...arr];
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}

function pickNextWord() {
  const available = WORDS.filter(w => !usedWords.includes(w));
  if (available.length === 0) {
    usedWords = [];
    return pickNextWord();
  }
  const word = available[Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length)];
  usedWords.push(word);
  targetWord = word;
  currentWord = word;
  scrambledWord = '';
  let attempts = 0;
  do {
    scrambledWord = shuffleArray(word.split('')).join('');
    attempts++;
  } while (scrambledWord === word && attempts < 20);
  playerInput = '';
  hint = 'First letter: ' + word[0];
}

function startGame() {
  state = 'playing';
  score = 0;
  timeLeft = 60;
  lastTime = performance.now();
  usedWords = [];
  particles = [];
  pickNextWord();
}

function addParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.015,
      color: color,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }
}

// ===== INPUT =====
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (state === 'start') {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      startGame();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      state = 'start';
    }
    return;
  }
  if (state === 'playing') {
    if (e.key === 'Backspace') {
      playerInput = playerInput.slice(0, -1);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      checkAnswer();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key.length === 1 && /[a-zA-Z]/.test(e.key)) {
      if (playerInput.length < targetWord.length) {
        playerInput += e.key.toUpperCase();
      }
    }
  }
});

// Touch / click support
canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (state === 'start') {
    startGame();
  } else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    state = 'start';
  }
});

// ===== UPDATE =====
function checkAnswer() {
  if (playerInput.toUpperCase() === targetWord) {
    score += targetWord.length * 10;
    correctFlash = 1;
    addParticles(400, 300, '#4ade80', 30);
    addParticles(400, 300, '#22d3ee', 20);
    shakeTimer = 0.3;
    totalWords++;
    pickNextWord();
  } else {
    wrongFlash = 1;
    shakeTimer = 0.4;
    addParticles(400, 300, '#ef4444', 15);
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  timeLeft -= dt;
  if (timeLeft <= 0) {
    timeLeft = 0;
    state = 'lost';
    addParticles(400, 300, '#f59e0b', 40);
    return;
  }

  if (shakeTimer > 0) {
    shakeTimer -= dt;
    shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8 * shakeTimer;
    shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8 * shakeTimer;
  } else {
    shakeX = 0;
    shakeY = 0;
  }

  if (correctFlash > 0) correctFlash = Math.max(0, correctFlash - dt * 3);
  if (wrongFlash > 0) wrongFlash = Math.max(0, wrongFlash - dt * 3);

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update floating letters
  for (const fl of floatingLetters) {
    fl.y -= fl.speed;
    fl.angle += fl.rotSpeed;
    if (fl.y < -30) {
      fl.y = 630;
      fl.x = Math.random() * 800;
    }
  }
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function drawBackground(time) {
  // Gradient background
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 600);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0c29');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1a3e');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#24243e');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  // Stars
  for (const star of bgStars) {
    const twinkle = Math.sin(time * 0.001 + star.phase) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 220, 255, ${star.alpha * twinkle})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Floating decorative letters
  for (const fl of floatingLetters) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(fl.x, fl.y);
    ctx.rotate(fl.angle);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100, 150, 255, ${fl.alpha})`;
    ctx.font = `bold ${fl.size}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(fl.char, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Subtle grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.03)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < 800; x += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, 600);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < 600; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(800, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawPlayingScreen(time) {

  ctx.fillText(scrambledWord, 400, 180);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Label
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.font = '16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Unscramble this word:', 400, 140);

  ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';

  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
  ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Type letters · ENTER to submit · BACKSPACE to delete', 400, 420);

  // Draw particles
  drawParticles();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEndScreen(time, won) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);
  drawBackground(time);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  if (won) {
    ctx.shadowColor = '#4ade80';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('TIME\'S UP!', 400, 180);
  } else {
    ctx.shadowColor = '#f59e0b';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('TIME\'S UP!', 400, 180);
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Final score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#22d3ee';
  ctx.font = 'bold 60px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(score + '', 400, 280);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
  ctx.font = '22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Total Score', 400, 330);

  // Words solved
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Words solved: ' + totalWords, 400, 390);

  // Rating
  let rating = '';
  if (score >= 500) rating = '🏆 Master Scrambler!';
  else if (score >= 300) rating = '⭐ Great Job!';
  else if (score >= 150) rating = '👍 Not Bad!';
  else rating = '📚 Keep Practicing!';

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(rating, 400, 450);

  const blink = Math.sin(time * 0.005) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
    ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', 400, 520);
  }

  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
  if (w < 0) w = 0;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ===== MAIN LOOP =====
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  if (state === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen(timestamp);
  } else if (state === 'playing') {
    drawPlayingScreen(timestamp);
  } else if (state === 'lost') {
    drawEndScreen(timestamp, false);
  } else if (state === 'won') {
    drawEndScreen(timestamp, true);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

lastTime = performance.now();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Twenty-One Sticks</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: Georgia, serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {

<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// === STATE ===
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let state = {
  phase: 'start', // start, playing, p1_pick, p2_pick, p1_remove, p2_remove, gameover
  sticks: [],
  currentPlayer: 1,
  taken: 0,
  winner: null,
  hoverStick: -1,
  animFrame: 0
};

function initSticks() {
  state.sticks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
    const row = Math.floor(i / 7);
    const col = i % 7;
    const baseX = 120 + col * 80;
    const baseY = 140 + row * 100;
    const angle = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15;
    state.sticks.push({
      x: baseX,
      y: baseY,
      length: 60 + Math.random() * 20,
      angle: angle,
      color: `hsl(${25 + Math.random() * 20}, ${50 + Math.random() * 20}%, ${35 + Math.random() * 15}%)`,
      removed: false,
      removeAnim: 0
    });
  }
}

initSticks();

// === INPUT ===
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const my = e.clientY - rect.top;

  if (state.phase === 'start') {
    startGame();
    return;
  }

  if (state.phase === 'gameover') {
    state.phase = 'start';
    initSticks();
    state.taken = 0;
    state.currentPlayer = 1;
    state.winner = null;
    return;
  }

  if (state.phase === 'p1_pick' || state.phase === 'p2_pick') {
    const idx = findStickAt(mx, my);
    if (idx >= 0 && !state.sticks[idx].removed) {
      state.sticks[idx].removed = true;
      state.sticks[idx].removeAnim = 1;
      state.taken++;
      checkEnd();
      if (state.phase !== 'gameover') {
        state.currentPlayer = state.currentPlayer === 1 ? 2 : 1;
        state.phase = state.currentPlayer === 1 ? 'p1_pick' : 'p2_pick';
      }
    }
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
  state.hoverStick = findStickAt(mx, my);
});

function findStickAt(mx, my) {
  for (let i = state.sticks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.sticks[i];
    if (s.removed) continue;
    const dx = mx - s.x;
    const dy = my - s.y;
    const cos = Math.cos(s.angle);
    const sin = Math.sin(s.angle);
    const localX = dx * cos + dy * sin;
    const localY = -dx * sin + dy * cos;
    if (Math.abs(localX) < s.length / 2 && Math.abs(localY) < 12) {
      return i;
    }
  }
  return -1;
}

function startGame() {
  initSticks();
  state.taken = 0;
  state.currentPlayer = 1;
  state.winner = null;
  state.phase = 'p1_pick';
}

function checkEnd() {
  const remaining = state.sticks.filter(s => !s.removed).length;
  if (remaining === 0) {
    state.winner = state.currentPlayer;
    state.phase = 'gameover';
  }
}

// === UPDATE ===
function update() {
  state.animFrame++;
  state.sticks.forEach(s => {
    if (s.removed && s.removeAnim > 0) {
      s.removeAnim -= 0.03;
    }
  });
}

// === DRAW ===
function draw() {
  // Background
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 500);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2d1b0e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#3d2815');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0f05');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 500);

  // Wood grain lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 60, 20, 0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, i * 25 + 5);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(200, i * 25 + 10, 500, i * 25 + 0, 800, i * 25 + 8);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e0c068';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('TWENTY-ONE STICKS', 400, 40);

  // Player indicators
  if (state.phase !== 'start' && state.phase !== 'gameover') {
    drawPlayerBadge(100, 70, 1, state.currentPlayer === 1);
    drawPlayerBadge(700, 70, 2, state.currentPlayer === 2);
  }

  // Draw sticks
  for (let i = 0; i < state.sticks.length; i++) {
    const s = state.sticks[i];
    if (s.removed && s.removeAnim <= 0) continue;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
    ctx.rotate(s.angle);

    if (s.removed) {
      const alpha = s.removeAnim;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      const scale = 1 + (1 - alpha) * 0.5;
      ctx.scale(scale, scale);
      ctx.translate(0, (1 - alpha) * -40);
    }

    const isHover = (i === state.hoverStick && !s.removed &&
      (state.phase === 'p1_pick' || state.phase === 'p2_pick'));

    // Stick shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(-s.length/2 + 2, -4 + 3, s.length, 8);

    // Stick body
    const stickGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-s.length/2, -5, s.length/2, 5);
    stickGrad.addColorStop(0, s.color);
    stickGrad.addColorStop(0.5, lightenColor(s.color, 20));
    stickGrad.addColorStop(1, s.color);
    ctx.fillStyle = isHover ? lightenColor(s.color, 40) : stickGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(-s.length/2, -5, s.length, 10);

    // Stick outline
    ctx.strokeStyle = isHover ? '#fff' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = isHover ? 2 : 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(-s.length/2, -5, s.length, 10);

    // Stick end caps
    ctx.fillStyle = isHover ? '#ffe0a0' : '#5a3a1a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-s.length/2, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.length/2, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Instructions
  if (state.phase === 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e0c0';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Take one stick per turn. Last player to take a stick WINS.', 400, 440);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0c068';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Start', 400, 475);
  }

  if (state.phase === 'p1_pick') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7ec8e3';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Player 1: Click a stick to take it', 400, 470);
  }
  if (state.phase === 'p2_pick') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e37e7e';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Player 2: Click a stick to take it', 400, 470);
  }

  if (state.phase === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 500);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0c068';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(`Player ${state.winner} Wins!`, 400, 230);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e0c0';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(`${state.taken} sticks taken`, 400, 270);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0c068';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', 400, 330);
  }

  // Score
  if (state.phase !== 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(224,192,104,0.8)';
    ctx.font = '14px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(`Sticks taken: ${state.taken} / 21`, 400, 490);
  }
}

function drawPlayerBadge(x, y, player, active) {
  const color = player === 1 ? '#7ec8e3' : '#e37e7e';
  ctx.fillStyle = active ? color : 'rgba(100,100,100,0.5)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(player.toString(), x, y + 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = active ? color : '#666';
  ctx.font = '12px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText(`P${player}`, x, y + 32);
}

function lightenColor(hslStr, amount) {
  const match = hslStr.match(/hsl\((\d+),\s*(\d+)%,\s*(\d+)%\)/);
  if (!match) return hslStr;
  const h = parseInt(match[1]);
  const s = parseInt(match[2]);
  const l = Math.min(90, parseInt(match[3]) + amount);
  return `hsl(${h}, ${s}%, ${l}%)`;
}

// === MAIN LOOP ===
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ---------- Canvas ----------
  var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
  function resize(){
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- State ----------
  var state = 'intro';        // intro | choose | flipping | result
  var chosen = 'Heads';
  var flip = { active: false, start: 0, duration: 2300, result: 'Heads', rot: 0, y: 0, vy: 0, apex: 0 };
  var score = { you: 0, cpu: 0 };
  var target = 3;
  var winner = null;
  var msg = '';
  var msgTimer = 0;
  var shake = 0;
  var time = 0;
  var particles = [];
  var stars = [];
  var confetti = [];
  var last = performance.now();

  for (var i = 0; i < 90; i++){
    stars.push({ x: Math.random(), y: Math.random() * 0.7, r: Math.random() * 1.4 + 0.3, tw: Math.random() * 6.28, sp: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5 });
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function choose(side){
    if (state !== 'choose') return;
    chosen = side;
    startFlip();
  }
  function startFlip(){
    state = 'flipping';
    flip.active = true;
    flip.start = time;
    flip.result = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'Heads' : 'Tails';
    flip.apex = H * 0.24;
    flip.y = 0;

    if (win){ score.you++; msg = 'You win this point!'; }
    else { score.cpu++; msg = 'CPU wins this point.'; }
    msgTimer = 1.4;
    spawnConfetti(win);
    if (score.you >= target || score.cpu >= target){
      state = 'over';
      winner = score.you > score.cpu ? 'you' : 'cpu';
      msg = winner === 'you' ? 'YOU WIN OVERTIME!' : 'CPU TAKES IT';
      msgTimer = 9999;

    state = 'choose'; msg = ''; msgTimer = 0;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawMagnet() {
  const mx = magnet.x;
  const my = magnet.y;
  const pulse = Math.sin(time * 3) * 0.1 + 1;

  // Magnet field glow
  const fieldGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx, my, 0, mx, my, MAGNET_RADIUS * pulse);
  fieldGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.15)');
  fieldGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.05)');
  fieldGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100, 200, 255, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = fieldGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(mx, my, MAGNET_RADIUS * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Magnet body - horseshoe shape
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(mx, my);

  // Left leg
  ctx.fillStyle = '#E53935';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-20, -30, 14, 50, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  // Right leg
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1E88E5';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(6, -30, 14, 50, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  // Top arc
  ctx.fillStyle = '#E53935';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -30, 20, Math.PI, 0, false);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#1E88E5';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -30, 20, 0, Math.PI, false);
  ctx.fill();

  // White tips
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-20, 14, 14, 12, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(6, 14, 14, 12, 3);
  ctx.fill();

  // Inner cutout
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e1a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -30, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCoin(coin) {
  const cx = coin.x;
  const cy = coin.y;
  const r = COIN_SIZE * coin.scale;

  if (r <= 0) return;

  const spinFactor = Math.sin(coin.spin) * 0.5 + 0.5;
  const width = r * (0.3 + spinFactor * 0.7);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);

  // Coin shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.3, width * 0.9, r * 0.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Coin body
  const coinGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-width * 0.2, -r * 0.2, 0, 0, 0, r);
  coinGrad.addColorStop(0, '#FFE066');
  coinGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#FFD700');
  coinGrad.addColorStop(1, '#B8860B');
  ctx.fillStyle = coinGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, width, r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Coin rim
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#DAA520';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Dollar sign
  if (spinFactor > 0.3) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#B8860B';
    ctx.font = `bold ${r * 0.9}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('$', 0, 1);
  }

  // Shine
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-width * 0.3, -r * 0.3, width * 0.25, r * 0.15, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 20);

  // Coin count
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`Coins: ${coins.filter(c => !c.collected).length}`, 20, 55);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('GOLD MAGNET', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Move your mouse to attract coins', W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.fillText('Catch as many as you can!', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);

  const pulse = Math.sin(time * 3) * 0.3 + 0.7;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${pulse})`;
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Click to Start', W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 42px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = '28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

  const pulse = Math.sin(time * 3) * 0.3 + 0.7;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${pulse})`;
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();

  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    drawMagnet();
    for (const coin of coins) {
      drawCoin(coin);
    }
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
  } else if (gameState === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen();
  } else if (gameState === 'over') {
    drawMagnet();
    for (const coin of coins) {
      drawCoin(coin);
    }
    drawParticles();
    drawGameOver();
  }
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
let lastTime = 0;

function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ============ INIT ============
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();
magnet.x = W / 2;
magnet.y = H / 2;
magnetTarget.x = W / 2;
magnetTarget.y = H / 2;
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Conveyor Belt Duel</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    border: 3px solid #333;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #222;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// === STATE ===
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const BELT_SPEED = 3;
const GRAVITY = 0.5;
const JUMP_FORCE = -12;
const PLAYER_SPEED = 4;
const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
const BELT_Y = 350;
const BELT_HEIGHT = 40;
const GOAL_Y = 50;

const state = {
  phase: 'start',
  p1: { x: 100, y: BELT_Y - PLAYER_SIZE, vx: 0, vy: 0, onBelt: true, score: 0 },
  p2: { x: 700, y: BELT_Y - PLAYER_SIZE, vx: 0, vy: 0, onBelt: true, score: 0 },
  particles: [],
  beltOffset: 0,
  winMessage: '',
  keys: {}
};

// === INPUT ===
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  state.keys[e.code] = true;
  if (state.phase === 'start' && e.code === 'Space') {
    state.phase = 'playing';
  }
  if (state.phase === 'over' && e.code === 'Space') {
    resetGame();
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  state.keys[e.code] = false;
});

function resetGame() {
  state.p1 = { x: 100, y: BELT_Y - PLAYER_SIZE, vx: 0, vy: 0, onBelt: true, score: 0 };
  state.p2 = { x: 700, y: BELT_Y - PLAYER_SIZE, vx: 0, vy: 0, onBelt: true, score: 0 };
  state.particles = [];
  state.beltOffset = 0;
  state.winMessage = '';
  state.phase = 'playing';
}

// === UPDATE ===
function update() {
  if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;

  state.beltOffset = (state.beltOffset + BELT_SPEED) % 40;

  // P1 controls: A/D move, W jump
  if (state.keys['KeyA']) state.p1.vx = -PLAYER_SPEED;
  else if (state.keys['KeyD']) state.p1.vx = PLAYER_SPEED;
  else state.p1.vx = 0;

  if (state.keys['KeyW'] && state.p1.onBelt) {
    state.p1.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
    state.p1.onBelt = false;
  }

  // P2 controls: Left/Right move, Up jump
  if (state.keys['ArrowLeft']) state.p2.vx = -PLAYER_SPEED;
  else if (state.keys['ArrowRight']) state.p2.vx = PLAYER_SPEED;
  else state.p2.vx = 0;

  if (state.keys['ArrowUp'] && state.p2.onBelt) {
    state.p2.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
    state.p2.onBelt = false;
  }

  // Update players
  [state.p1, state.p2].forEach((p, idx) => {
    // Belt pushes player
    if (p.onBelt) {
      p.x += BELT_SPEED;
    }

    // Player movement
    p.x += p.vx;

    // Gravity
    p.vy += GRAVITY;
    p.y += p.vy;

    // Land on belt
    if (p.y + PLAYER_SIZE >= BELT_Y && p.vy >= 0) {
      p.y = BELT_Y - PLAYER_SIZE;
      p.vy = 0;
      p.onBelt = true;
    }

    // Boundaries
    if (p.x < 0) p.x = 0;
    if (p.x + PLAYER_SIZE > W) p.x = W - PLAYER_SIZE;

    // Check if player reached the goal (top of screen)
    if (p.y < GOAL_Y) {
      if (idx === 0) {
        state.p1.score++;
        state.winMessage = 'P1 SCORES!';
        spawnParticles(p.x + PLAYER_SIZE / 2, p.y, '#ff6b6b', 20);
        resetGame();
      } else {
        state.p2.score++;
        state.winMessage = 'P2 SCORES!';
        spawnParticles(p.x + PLAYER_SIZE / 2, p.y, '#4ecdc4', 20);
        resetGame();
      }
      return;
    }

    // Fall off the bottom
    if (p.y > H + 50) {
      if (idx === 0) {
        state.p2.score++;
        state.winMessage = 'P2 WINS! P1 fell off!';
        state.phase = 'over';
      } else {
        state.p1.score++;
        state.winMessage = 'P1 WINS! P2 fell off!';
        state.phase = 'over';
      }
    }
  });

  // Check for player collision (push each other)
  const p1 = state.p1, p2 = state.p2;
  if (p1.x < p2.x + PLAYER_SIZE && p1.x + PLAYER_SIZE > p2.x &&
      p1.y < p2.y + PLAYER_SIZE && p1.y + PLAYER_SIZE > p2.y) {
    const mid = (p1.x + p2.x + PLAYER_SIZE) / 2;
    if (p1.x < p2.x) {
      p1.x = mid - PLAYER_SIZE;
      p2.x = mid;
    } else {
      p2.x = mid - PLAYER_SIZE;
      p1.x = mid;
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  state.particles = state.particles.filter(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.3;
    p.life--;
    return p.life > 0;
  });
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
    state.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3,
      color,
      life: Math.random() * 30 + 20
    });
  }
}

// === DRAW ===
function draw() {
  // Background
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0c29');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1a3e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#24243e');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff33';
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137 + 50) % W;
    const sy = (i * 89 + 30) % (BELT_Y - 50);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Goal zone at top
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd70033';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, GOAL_Y);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([10, 5]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GOAL_Y);
  ctx.lineTo(W, GOAL_Y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('★ GOAL ZONE ★', W / 2, 30);

  // Conveyor belt
  drawBelt();

  // Players
  drawPlayer(state.p1, '#ff6b6b', 'P1');
  drawPlayer(state.p2, '#4ecdc4', 'P2');

  // Particles
  state.particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 50;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('P1: ' + state.p1.score, 20, 30);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('P2: ' + state.p2.score, W - 20, 30);

  // Overlays
  if (state.phase === 'start') {
    drawOverlay('CONVEYOR BELT DUEL', 'P1: A/D move, W jump\nP2: ←/→ move, ↑ jump\nFirst to reach the GOAL ZONE wins!\nPress SPACE to start');
  } else if (state.phase === 'over') {
    drawOverlay(state.winMessage, 'Press SPACE to play again');
  } else if (state.winMessage && state.phase === 'playing') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(state.winMessage, W / 2, 100);
    setTimeout(() => { state.winMessage = ''; }, 1500);
  }
}

function drawBelt() {
  // Belt body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(0, BELT_Y, W, BELT_HEIGHT);

  // Belt stripes (moving)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
  const stripeW = 40;
  const offset = -state.beltOffset;
  for (let x = offset; x < W; x += stripeW) {
    ctx.fillRect(x, BELT_Y, stripeW / 2, BELT_HEIGHT);
  }

  // Belt edges
  ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
  ctx.fillRect(0, BELT_Y, W, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(0, BELT_Y + BELT_HEIGHT - 3, W, 3);

  // Belt rollers
  ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
  for (let x = 20; x < W; x += 80) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, BELT_Y + BELT_HEIGHT / 2, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, BELT_Y + BELT_HEIGHT / 2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
  }

  // Direction arrows on belt
  ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  for (let x = 50; x < W; x += 100) {
    ctx.fillText('→', x, BELT_Y + BELT_HEIGHT / 2 + 5);
  }

  // Support structure below belt
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a2a';
  for (let x = 40; x < W; x += 120) {
    ctx.fillRect(x, BELT_Y + BELT_HEIGHT, 10, H - BELT_Y - BELT_HEIGHT);
    ctx.fillRect(x - 20, BELT_Y + BELT_HEIGHT + 20, 50, 8);
  }

  // Floor
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, H - 20, W, 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(0, H - 20, W, 4);
}

function drawPlayer(p, color, label) {
  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00000044';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(p.x + PLAYER_SIZE / 2, BELT_Y + 2, PLAYER_SIZE / 2, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE);

  // Face
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x + 10, p.y + 10, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(p.x + 20, p.y + 10, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x + 10, p.y + 10, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(p.x + 20, p.y + 10, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Smile
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x + PLAYER_SIZE / 2, p.y + 18, 8, 0.1 * Math.PI, 0.9 * Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Label
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 12px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(label, p.x + PLAYER_SIZE / 2, p.y - 5);
}

function drawOverlay(title, subtitle) {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000aa';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 32px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  const lines = subtitle.split('\n');
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, H / 2 + 10 + i * 25);
  });
}

// === GAME LOOP ===
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();
</script>

<script>
// ============ STATE ============
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const romanValues = {
  'I': 1, 'V': 5, 'X': 10, 'L': 50,
  'C': 100, 'D': 500, 'M': 1000
};

const arabicToRoman = (n) => {
  const map = [[1000,'M'],[900,'CM'],[500,'D'],[400,'CD'],[100,'C'],[90,'XC'],[50,'L'],[40,'XL'],[10,'X'],[9,'IX'],[5,'V'],[4,'IV'],[1,'I']];
  let result = '';
  for (const [val, sym] of map) {
    while (n >= val) { result += sym; n -= val; }
  }
  return result;
};

const romanToArabic = (s) => {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const curr = romanValues[s[i]];
    const next = i < s.length - 1 ? romanValues[s[i+1]] : 0;
    if (curr < next) total -= curr;
    else total += curr;
  }
  return total;
};

let state = 'start'; // start, playing, won, lost
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let round = 0;
const totalRounds = 10;

let currentQuestion = null;
let options = [];
let selectedOption = null;
let showFeedback = false;
let feedbackTimer = 0;
let correctAnswer = null;

// Animation
let particles = [];
let shakeAmount = 0;
let glowPulse = 0;

// ============ INPUT ============
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);

  if (state === 'start') {
    startGame();
    return;
  }

  if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    state = 'start';
    return;
  }

  if (state === 'playing' && !showFeedback) {
    for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
      const btn = getButtonRect(i);
      if (x >= btn.x && x <= btn.x + btn.w && y >= btn.y && y <= btn.y + btn.h) {
        selectedOption = i;
        checkAnswer(i);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && state === 'start') startGame();
});

// ============ HELPERS ============
function getButtonRect(i) {
  const col = i % 2;
  const row = Math.floor(i / 2);
  const bw = 320, bh = 55;
  const gapX = 30, gapY = 15;
  const startX = (canvas.width - (2 * bw + gapX)) / 2;
  const startY = 240;
  return {
    x: startX + col * (bw + gapX),
    y: startY + row * (bh + gapY),
    w: bw, h: bh
  };
}

function startGame() {
  state = 'playing';
  score = 0;
  lives = 3;
  round = 0;
  particles = [];
  nextQuestion();
}

function nextQuestion() {
  round++;
  if (round > totalRounds) {
    state = 'won';
    return;
  }
  const useRoman = Math.random() > 0.5;
  if (useRoman) {
    const arabic = Math.floor(Math.random() * 999) + 1;
    currentQuestion = { type: 'roman', text: arabicToRoman(arabic), answer: arabic };
  } else {
    const arabic = Math.floor(Math.random() * 999) + 1;
    currentQuestion = { type: 'arabic', text: arabic, answer: arabicToRoman(arabic) };
  }
  correctAnswer = currentQuestion.answer;
  generateOptions();
  selectedOption = null;
  showFeedback = false;
}

function generateOptions() {
  const correct = currentQuestion.answer;
  const opts = [correct];
  while (opts.length < 4) {
    let wrong;
    if (typeof correct === 'number') {
      wrong = Math.floor(Math.random() * 999) + 1;
    } else {
      wrong = arabicToRoman(Math.floor(Math.random() * 999) + 1);
    }
    if (!opts.includes(wrong)) opts.push(wrong);
  }
  options = opts.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
}

function checkAnswer(idx) {
  const chosen = options[idx];
  const isCorrect = chosen === correctAnswer;
  showFeedback = true;
  feedbackTimer = 60;

  if (isCorrect) {
    score += 10;
    spawnParticles(canvas.width / 2, 200, '#ffd700', 20);
  } else {
    lives--;
    shakeAmount = 10;
    spawnParticles(canvas.width / 2, 200, '#ff4444', 15);
  }

  setTimeout(() => {
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = 'lost';
    } else {
      nextQuestion();
    }
  }, 1200);
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 2,
      life: 60,
      maxLife: 60,
      color,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }
}

// ============ UPDATE ============
function update() {
  glowPulse += 0.05;
  if (shakeAmount > 0) shakeAmount *= 0.9;
  if (shakeAmount < 0.1) shakeAmount = 0;

  particles = particles.filter(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15;
    p.life--;
    return p.life > 0;
  });
}

// ============ DRAW ============
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shakeAmount > 0) {
    ctx.translate(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmount,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmount
    );
  }

  // Background
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a2e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#16213e');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#0f3460');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Decorative arch columns
  drawArch();

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  else if (state === 'playing') drawPlaying();
  else if (state === 'won') drawEndScreen(true);
  else if (state === 'lost') drawEndScreen(false);

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawArch() {
  const glow = 0.3 + Math.sin(glowPulse) * 0.15;
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(212, 175, 55, ${glow})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(canvas.width / 2, 30, 350, Math.PI, 0);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Pillars
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(212, 175, 55, ${glow * 0.5})`;
  ctx.fillRect(80, 30, 15, canvas.height - 30);
  ctx.fillRect(canvas.width - 95, 30, 15, canvas.height - 30);

  // Capitals
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(212, 175, 55, ${glow * 0.7})`;
  ctx.fillRect(70, 25, 35, 12);
  ctx.fillRect(canvas.width - 105, 25, 35, 12);

  // Floor line
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(212, 175, 55, ${glow * 0.4})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(40, canvas.height - 20);
  ctx.lineTo(canvas.width - 40, canvas.height - 20);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 42px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('ROMAN NUMERAL QUIZ', canvas.width / 2, 140);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5a3';
  ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('Convert between Roman and Arabic numerals', canvas.width / 2, 185);

  // Start button
  const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(glowPulse * 2) * 0.2;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(212, 175, 55, ${pulse})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - 100, 280, 200, 55, 10);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('START', canvas.width / 2, 315);

  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = '#a0a0c0';
  ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('10 questions • 3 lives • Answer correctly to score', canvas.width / 2, 400);
  ctx.fillText('Click an answer to respond', canvas.width / 2, 430);
}

function drawPlaying() {
  // Score and lives
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 30, 40);
  ctx.fillText(`Round: ${round}/${totalRounds}`, 30, 65);

  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
  let hearts = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) hearts += '♥ ';
  ctx.fillText(hearts, canvas.width - 30, 45);

  // Progress bar
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a4a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(200, 75, 400, 10, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(200, 75, 400 * (round / totalRounds), 10, 5);
  ctx.fill();

  // Question
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5a3';
  ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
  const qType = currentQuestion.type === 'roman' ? 'Convert to Arabic:' : 'Convert to Roman:';
  ctx.fillText(qType, canvas.width / 2, 130);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText(String(currentQuestion.text), canvas.width / 2, 195);

  // Answer buttons
  for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
    const btn = getButtonRect(i);
    let bg = '#2a2a4a';
    let border = '#4a4a7a';

    if (showFeedback) {
      if (options[i] === correctAnswer) {
        bg = '#2d5a2d';
        border = '#4aff4a';
      } else if (selectedOption === i) {
        bg = '#5a2d2d';
        border = '#ff4a4a';
      }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(btn.x, btn.y, btn.w, btn.h, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = border;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(String(options[i]), btn.x + btn.w / 2, btn.y + btn.h / 2 + 8);
  }
}

function drawEndScreen(won) {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#ffd700' : '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 44px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText(won ? 'VICTORY!' : 'DEFEAT', canvas.width / 2, 150);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5a3';
  ctx.font = '24px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, 220);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#a0a0c0';
  ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText(won ? 'You are a master of Roman numerals!' : 'The Romans would be disappointed...', canvas.width / 2, 270);

  const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(glowPulse * 2) * 0.2;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(212, 175, 55, ${pulse})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - 120, 330, 240, 50, 10);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('PLAY AGAIN', canvas.width / 2, 362);
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

  if (state.screen === 'start') {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') startGame();
  } else if (state.screen === 'playing') {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') knitRow();
  } else if (state.screen === 'won' || state.screen === 'lost') {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {

    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Yarn string from ball to needles
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#e74c6f';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ballX + 20, ballY - 25);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(ballX + 80, ballY - 80, scarfX + 40, scarfY + 50, scarfX + 60, scarfY + 10);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Knitted scarf rows
  for (let r = 0; r < state.rowsKnit; r++) {
    const ry = scarfY + (ROWS_TARGET - 1 - r) * rowH;
    const color = YARN_COLORS[r % YARN_COLORS.length];
    // Stitch bumps
    const numStitches = 12;
    const stitchW = 40 / numStitches;
    for (let s = 0; s < numStitches; s++) {
      const stx = scarfX + s * stitchW;
      const bump = 2 + Math.sin(r * 1.5 + s * 0.8) * 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(stx, ry - bump, stitchW - 1, rowH + bump, 3);
      ctx.fill();
      // Highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(stx + 1, ry - bump + 1, stitchW - 3, 4, 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // Row shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
    ctx.fillRect(scarfX, ry + rowH, 40, 1);
  }

  // Empty row slots (dashed)
  for (let r = state.rowsKnit; r < ROWS_TARGET; r++) {
    const ry = scarfY + (ROWS_TARGET - 1 - r) * rowH;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.strokeRect(scarfX, ry, 40, rowH);
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  // Knitting needles
  const needleY = scarfY + (ROWS_TARGET - state.rowsKnit) * rowH - 8;
  const animOff = state.knitAnim > 0 ? Math.sin(state.knitAnim * Math.PI) * 8 : 0;
  // Left needle
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c0c8d8';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(scarfX - 30, needleY + animOff + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(scarfX + 50, needleY - animOff - 5);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Needle tip
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d8e0f0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(scarfX + 50, needleY - animOff - 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Right needle
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(scarfX + 70, needleY + animOff + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(scarfX + 110, needleY - animOff - 5);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(scarfX + 110, needleY - animOff - 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Loop on needle (current stitch)
  if (state.screen === 'playing') {
    const loopColor = YARN_COLORS[state.rowsKnit % YARN_COLORS.length];
    ctx.strokeStyle = loopColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(scarfX + 25, needleY + animOff, 15, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ── HUD ──
  // Timer bar
  const barX = 200, barY = 30, barW = 300, barH = 16;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  const pct = state.timer / state.maxTime;
  const timerColor = pct > 0.5 ? '#7ecbcf' : pct > 0.25 ? '#f0a050' : '#e74c6f';
  if (pct > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW * pct, barH, 8);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '13px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(state.timer) + 's', barX + barW / 2, barY + 12);

  // Row counter
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5a0';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Row ' + state.rowsKnit + ' / ' + ROWS_TARGET, 20, 50);

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#b88ce0';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Georgia';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, canvas.width - 20, 50);

  // Color legend
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.font = '12px Georgia';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  ctx.fillText('Yarn colors:', 20, canvas.height - 15);
  for (let i = 0; i < YARN_COLORS.length; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = YARN_COLORS[i];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(120 + i * 22, canvas.height - 18, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Particles
  state.particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    if (p.rot !== undefined) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.fillRect(-p.size / 2, -p.size / 4, p.size, p.size / 2);
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  });

  // ── OVERLAYS ──
  if (state.screen === 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,10,30,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c6f';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Scarf Knit Row Counter', canvas.width / 2, 160);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5a0';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Knit ' + ROWS_TARGET + ' rows before time runs out!', canvas.width / 2, 210);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.font = '15px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Each row earns 10 pts + time bonus', canvas.width / 2, 245);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7ecbcf';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Georgia';
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.004) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or Click to Start', canvas.width / 2, 310);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    // Mini yarn decoration
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = YARN_COLORS[i];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(canvas.width / 2 - 60 + i * 30, 360, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  if (state.screen === 'won') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,10,30,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0a050';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Scarf Complete!', canvas.width / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5a0';
    ctx.font = '22px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + state.score, canvas.width / 2, 230);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7ecbcf';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Time remaining: ' + Math.ceil(state.timer) + 's', canvas.width / 2, 265);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b88ce0';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Georgia';
    const pulse2 = 0.6 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.004) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse2;
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or Click to Play Again', canvas.width / 2, 330);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  if (state.screen === 'lost') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,10,30,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c6f';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Time is Up!', canvas.width / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5a0';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('You knit ' + state.rowsKnit + ' of ' + ROWS_TARGET + ' rows', canvas.width / 2, 230);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b88ce0';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, canvas.width / 2, 265);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7ecbcf';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Georgia';
    const pulse3 = 0.6 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.004) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse3;
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or Click to Try Again', canvas.width / 2, 330);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ── MAIN LOOP ──
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
  lastTime = timestamp;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
