<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Egg Hunt</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #2a5d3a;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const EGG_COLORS = ['#FF6B6B','#FFD93D','#6BCB77','#4D96FF','#FF8ED4','#FFA85C'];
  const NUM_EGGS = 10;
  const EGG_SIZE = 36;

  let W = 0, H = 0;

  // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  let state = 'start';
  let score = 0;
  let eggs = [];
  let particles = [];
  let clouds = [];
  let flowers = [];
  let player = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 28, bob: 0, moving: false, dir: 0 };
  let mouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  let keys = {};
  let lastTime = 0;

  // ── Init ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H / 2;
    mouse.x = W / 2;
    mouse.y = H / 2;
  }

  function spawnEggs() {
    eggs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_EGGS; i++) {
      let x, y, tries = 0;
      do {
        x = 60 + Math.random() * (W - 120);
        y = 60 + Math.random() * (H - 120);
        tries++;
      } while (Math.hypot(x - player.x, y - player.y) < 100 && tries < 30);
      eggs.push({
        x, y,
        color: EGG_COLORS[i % EGG_COLORS.length],
        wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        collected: false,
        scale: 1
      });
    }
  }

  function spawnClouds() {
    clouds = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: 20 + Math.random() * 60,
        speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        scale: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6
      });
    }
  }

  function spawnFlowers() {
    flowers = [];
    const cols = ['#FF6B9D','#FFD93D','#FF8ED4','#6BCB77','#FFA85C'];
    const count = Math.floor(W * H / 25000);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      flowers.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: H * 0.55 + Math.random() * (H * 0.45),
        color: cols[Math.floor(Math.random() * cols.length)],
        size: 6 + Math.random() * 8,
        stem: 10 + Math.random() * 15
      });
    }
  }

  function resetGame() {
    score = 0;
    particles = [];
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H / 2;
    spawnEggs();
    spawnClouds();
    spawnFlowers();
  }

  // ── Input ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    mouse.x = e.clientX;
    mouse.y = e.clientY;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    mouse.x = t.clientX;
    mouse.y = t.clientY;
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    mouse.x = t.clientX;
    mouse.y = t.clientY;
    handleClick();
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('click', handleClick);

  function handleClick() {
    if (state === 'start') {
      resetGame();
      state = 'playing';
    } else if (state === 'won') {
      resetGame();
      state = 'playing';
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
  window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

  // ── Particles ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function burstParticles(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 14 + Math.random() * 0.3;
      const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 1,
        life: 1,
        color,
        size: 3 + Math.random() * 4
      });
    }
  }

  // ── Update ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // Keyboard movement
    let kx = 0, ky = 0;
    if (keys['ArrowLeft']  || keys['a']) kx -= 1;
    if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) kx += 1;
    if (keys['ArrowUp']    || keys['w']) ky -= 1;
    if (keys['ArrowDown']  || keys['s']) ky += 1;

    if (kx || ky) {
      const len = Math.hypot(kx, ky);
      player.x += (kx / len) * 300 * dt;
      player.y += (ky / len) * 300 * dt;
      player.moving = true;
      player.dir = Math.atan2(ky, kx);
    } else {
      // Mouse follow
      const dx = mouse.x - player.x;
      const dy = mouse.y - player.y;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (dist > 5) {
        player.x += dx * 0.08;
        player.y += dy * 0.08;
        player.moving = true;
        player.dir = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      } else {
        player.moving = false;
      }
    }

    // Clamp
    player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W - player.r, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H - player.r, player.y));

    player.bob += dt * 8;

    // Clouds
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x += c.speed;
      if (c.x - 80 > W) c.x = -80;
    }

    // Egg wobble + collect
    for (const egg of eggs) {
      if (egg.collected) continue;
      egg.wobble += dt * 3;
      egg.scale = 1 + Math.sin(egg.wobble) * 0.08;

      const d = Math.hypot(egg.x - player.x, egg.y - player.y);
      if (d < player.r + EGG_SIZE / 2) {
        egg.collected = true;
        score++;
        burstParticles(egg.x, egg.y, egg.color);
        if (score >= NUM_EGGS) {
          state = 'won';
        }
      }
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.15;
      p.life -= dt * 1.8;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ── Draw helpers ──────────────────────────────────────
  function drawCloud(x, y, scale) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 25 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 25 * scale, y - 8 * scale, 20 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 50 * scale, y, 22 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 25 * scale, y + 5 * scale, 18 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawEgg(egg) {
    if (egg.collected) return;
    const s = egg.scale;
    const w = EGG_SIZE * 0.7 * s;
    const h = EGG_SIZE * s;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(egg.x, egg.y);
    ctx.rotate(Math.sin(egg.wobble) * 0.12);

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, h * 0.48, w * 0.6, h * 0.12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // egg body
    ctx.fillStyle = egg.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, w * 0.55, h * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-w * 0.15, -h * 0.18, w * 0.15, h * 0.15, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // stripes
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, h * 0.05, w * 0.45, h * 0.08, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBunny() {
    const px = player.x;
    const py = player.y;
    const bob = Math.sin(player.bob) * (player.moving ? 4 : 1.5);
    const y = py + bob;
    const r = player.r;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, y);

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.85, r * 0.75, r * 0.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#F5F0E8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.25, r * 0.65, r * 0.55, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FAF5EC';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -r * 0.3, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // ears
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FAF5EC';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-r * 0.22, -r * 0.85, r * 0.12, r * 0.35, -0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r * 0.15, -r * 0.35, r * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    // nose

    ctx.ellipse(r * 0.3, r * 0.65, r * 0.18, r * 0.1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  function drawFlower(f) {

    skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#B8E6F5');

      ctx.font = 'bold 52px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif';

      ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ── Main loop ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function loop(time) {

    lastTime = time;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  resetGame();

  requestAnimationFrame(t => { lastTime = t; loop(t); });
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Triod Timer</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #0b0f1a; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// ---------- STATE ----------
let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
let state = 'start';        // start | playing | won | lost
let timeLeft = 60;          // seconds remaining
let score = 0;              // rings cleared
let rings = [];             // active rings
let spawnTimer = 0;
let maxRings = 5;
let particles = [];
let floaters = [];
let shake = 0;
let elapsed = 0;
let last = 0;
const GOAL = 12;           // rings to clear to win

// ---------- RESIZE ----------
function resize() {
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * dpr;
  canvas.height = H * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }
function dist(x1, y1, x2, y2) { return Math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2); }

// ---------- RING ----------
function makeRing() {
  const r = rand(28, 52);
  const speed = rand(0.45, 0.95);
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const ang = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
  const d = rand(Math.min(W, H) * 0.28, Math.min(W, H) * 0.5);
  const hue = rand(0, 360);
  return {
    x: cx + Math.cos(ang) * d,
    y: cy + Math.sin(ang) * d,
    vx: -Math.cos(ang) * speed * 60,
    vy: -Math.sin(ang) * speed * 60,
    r,
    hue,
    life: rand(5.5, 7.5),
    maxLife: 0,
    pulse: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
    dead: false
  };
}
function spawnRing() {
  const rg = makeRing();
  rg.maxLife = rg.life;
  rings.push(rg);
}

// ---------- PARTICLES ----------
function burst(x, y, hue, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
    const sp = rand(40, 240);
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
      life: rand(0.4, 0.9),
      maxLife: 0,
      size: rand(2, 5),
      hue: hue + rand(-20, 20)
    });
  }
  particles.forEach(p => { if (p.maxLife === 0) p.maxLife = p.life; });
}
function floater(x, y, text, hue) {
  floaters.push({ x, y, text, life: 1.1, maxLife: 1.1, hue });
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
function pointerPos(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX) - rect.left;
  const cy = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY) - rect.top;
  return { x: cx, y: cy };
}
function hitTest(p) {
  for (let i = rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const rg = rings[i];
    const d = dist(p.x, p.y, rg.x, rg.y);
    if (d <= rg.r * 1.25) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}
function handleTap(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (state === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') { resetToStart(); return; }
  if (state === 'playing') {
    const p = pointerPos(e);
    const idx = hitTest(p);
    if (idx >= 0) {
      const rg = rings[idx];
      rings.splice(idx, 1);
      score++;
      shake = 0.35;
      burst(rg.x, rg.y, rg.hue, 22);
      floater(rg.x, rg.y - rg.r, '+' + score, rg.hue);
      if (score >= GOAL) { state = 'won'; }
    }
  }
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', handleTap);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTap, { passive: false });

// ---------- GAME FLOW ----------
function startGame() {
  state = 'playing';
  timeLeft = 60;
  score = 0;
  rings = [];
  particles = [];
  floaters = [];
  spawnTimer = 0;
  maxRings = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnRing();
}
function resetToStart() {
  state = 'start';
  rings = [];
  particles = [];
  floaters = [];
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt) {
  elapsed += dt;
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 1.4);

  // particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.life -= dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 120 * dt;
    p.vx *= 0.98;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
  // floaters
  for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = floaters[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    f.y -= 30 * dt;
    if (f.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // timer
  timeLeft -= dt;
  if (timeLeft <= 0) {
    timeLeft = 0;
    state = 'lost';
    return;
  }

  // difficulty ramps
  maxRings = Math.min(6, 3 + Math.floor((60 - timeLeft) / 15));
  spawnTimer += dt;
  const spawnInterval = clamp(2.2 - (60 - timeLeft) / 40, 0.9, 2.2);
  if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval && rings.length < maxRings) {
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnRing();
  }

  // move rings
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  for (let i = rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const rg = rings[i];
    rg.life -= dt;
    rg.pulse += dt * 3;
    rg.x += rg.vx * dt;
    rg.y += rg.vy * dt;
    // gentle pull back toward center so they never fly off
    const dx = cx - rg.x, dy = cy - rg.y;
    const dd = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    rg.vx += (dx / dd) * 20 * dt;
    rg.vy += (dy / dd) * 20 * dt;
    if (rg.life <= 0) {
      rings.splice(i, 1);
      burst(rg.x, rg.y, rg.hue, 10);
      shake = Math.max(shake, 0.2);
    }
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#101a33');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0d1526');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#070b16');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // faint stars
  ctx.save();
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
    const sy = (i * 89.3) % H;
    const tw = 0.3 + 0.3 * Math.sin(elapsed * 2 + i);
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fb3ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawTripod() {
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) / 720;
  const legLen = 150 * scale;
  const spread = 95 * scale;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';

  // three legs
  const angles = [-Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 6, Math.PI * 5 / 6];
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a4a6b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 10 * scale;
  for (const a of angles) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * legLen, Math.sin(a) * legLen);
    ctx.stroke();
    // foot
    ctx.fillStyle = '#22304d';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(Math.cos(a) * legLen, Math.sin(a) * legLen, 9 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // hub
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1c2740';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 20 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a74a8';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3 * scale;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 20 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRings() {
  for (const rg of rings) {
    const pulse = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(rg.pulse);
    const r = rg.r * pulse;
    const frac = rg.life / rg.maxLife;

    // glow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + 0.25 * frac;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsl(' + rg.hue + ',90%,60%)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 14;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rg.x, rg.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // main ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsl(' + rg.hue + ',95%,65%)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rg.x, rg.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // inner timer arc (shrinks as life drops)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsl(' + ((rg.hue + 180) % 360) + ',90%,75%)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rg.x, rg.y, r * 0.6, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * frac);
    ctx.stroke();

    // center dot
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + rg.hue + ',95%,80%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rg.x, rg.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const a = clamp(p.life / p.maxLife, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + p.hue + ',95%,65%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloaters() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px system-ui, sans-serif';
  for (const f of floaters) {
    const a = clamp(f.life / f.maxLife, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + f.hue + ',95%,75%)';
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  const pad = 22;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8f0ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('TIME  ' + Math.ceil(timeLeft) + 's', pad, pad + 16);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe6a8';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score + ' / ' + GOAL, pad, pad + 46);

  // timer bar
  const bw = Math.min(320, W - pad * 2);
  const bh = 10;
  const bx = pad, by = pad + 62;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
  const frac = timeLeft / 60;
  const barHue = frac > 0.3 ? 140 : (frac > 0.15 ? 40 : 0);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + barHue + ',90%,55%)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * frac, bh);
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,10,20,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;

  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(64, W * 0.12) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(title, cx, cy - 20);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#cdd8f2';
  ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(sub, cx, cy + 24);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
  ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
  const blink = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(elapsed * 4);
  ctx.globalAlpha = blink;
  ctx.fillText('tap / click to ' + (state === 'start' ? 'begin' : 'play again'), cx, cy + 60);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake * 10, shake * 10), rand(-shake * 10, shake * 10));
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawTripod();
  drawRings();
  drawParticles();
  drawFloaters();
  if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();

  if (state === 'start') {

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(t) {
  if (!last) last = t;

<!DOCTYPE html>

   playhead; it always moves forward (playing), you pull it back.
   ============================================================= */
const canvas=document.getElementById("c");
const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");

/* ---------- tiny sfx (optional, safe) ---------- */

    ga.gain.value=g;o.connect(ga);ga.connect(AC.destination);

/* ---------- constants ---------- */
const TRACK_X0=120, TRACK_X1=W-120, TRACK_Y=H/2, TRACK_H=96;
const SP=TRACK_X1-TRACK_X0;

const PLAY_SPEED=120;      // px/s forward
const HOLD_TIME=0.22;      // seconds the reel holds
const REACH=170;           // rewind reach
const REACH2=REACH*REACH;
const START=18, END=SP-18;

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const S={
  state:"start",        // start | play | win | lose
  head:START,
  headV:0,
  holding:false,
  holdTimer:0,
  elapsed:0,
  best:0,
  flash:0,
  shake:0,
  t:0,
  particles:[],
  sparks:[],
  lastBeep:0
};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
function angDiff(a,b){let d=(a-b)%(Math.PI*2);if(d>Math.PI)d-=Math.PI*2;if(d<-Math.PI)d+=Math.PI*2;return d;}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
function setHolding(v){

}
function begin(){

  S.elapsed=0;S.flash=0;S.shake=0;S.particles=[];S.sparks=[];

window.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  if(e.code==="Space"||e.code==="ArrowLeft"||e.code==="KeyA"){
    e.preventDefault();

    else if(S.state==="win"||S.state==="lose"){
      if(S.elapsed>0.6)begin();

window.addEventListener("keyup",e=>{
  if(e.code==="Space"||e.code==="ArrowLeft"||e.code==="KeyA")setHolding(false);

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
  e.preventDefault();

  else if(S.state==="win"||S.state==="lose"){ if(S.elapsed>0.6)begin(); }

canvas.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{ if(S.holding)setHolding(true); });

canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>setHolding(false));

/* ---------- particles ---------- */
function spawnSparks(x,y,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, sp=40+Math.random()*220;
    S.sparks.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-40,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.5,age:0,
      col:Math.random()<0.5?"#ff4d6d":"#ffcf5c"});

}
function spawnConfetti(){
  const cols=["#00e5ff","#ff4d6d","#ffcf5c","#7cf0a0","#ffffff"];
  for(let i=0;i<90;i++){
    S.particles.push({x:W/2+(Math.random()-0.5)*200,y:TRACK_Y-40,
      vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*380,vy:-120-Math.random()*260,
      rot:Math.random()*6,vr:(Math.random()-0.5)*12,
      size:6+Math.random()*10,life:2.4+Math.random()*1.4,age:0,
      col:cols[(Math.random()*cols.length)|0]});

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt){
  S.t+=dt;
  if(S.flash>0)S.flash=Math.max(0,S.flash-dt*3);
  if(S.shake>0)S.shake=Math.max(0,S.shake-dt*10);

  if(S.state==="play"){
    S.elapsed+=dt;
    // hold (rewind) — with a tiny deadzone so it feels mechanical
    if(S.holding){
      S.holdTimer+=dt;
      if(S.holdTimer>HOLD_TIME){
        const d=REWIND_SPEED*dt;
        S.head-=d;
        S.headV=-REWIND_SPEED;
        if(S.head<START){S.head=START;S.headV=0;}
        // rewind sparks along the tape
        if(Math.random()<0.5)spawnSparks(TRACK_X0+S.head,TRACK_Y,1);
        // beeping tick
        if(S.t-S.lastBeep>0.05){beep(120+Math.random()*40,0.03,0.03);S.lastBeep=S.t;}
      }
    } else {
      S.holdTimer=0;
      // always playing forward
      const d=PLAY_SPEED*dt;
      S.head+=d;
      S.headV=PLAY_SPEED;
      if(S.head>END){
        S.head=END;
        // LOSE
        S.state="lose";
        if(S.head>S.best)S.best=S.head;
        S.flash=1;S.shake=1;
        spawnSparks(TRACK_X0+S.head,TRACK_Y,40);
        beep(90,0.5,0.08);
      }
    }
    // WIN if you reach the start
    if(S.state==="play" && S.head<=START+0.5){
      S.state="win";
      if(S.elapsed<S.best||S.best===0)S.best=S.elapsed;
      S.flash=0.6;
      spawnConfetti();
      beep(660,0.12,0.06);setTimeout(()=>beep(880,0.18,0.06),110);
    }
  } else if(S.state==="win"||S.state==="lose"){
    S.elapsed+=dt;
  }

  for(let i=S.sparks.length-1;i>=0;i--){

  for(let i=S.particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=S.particles[i];p.age+=dt;
    p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=520*dt;p.vx*=0.99;p.rot+=p.vr*dt;
    if(p.age>=p.life)S.particles.splice(i,1);

}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function drawReel(cx,cy,r,angle,rim,fill){
  // outer rim
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth=6;ctx.strokeStyle=rim;ctx.stroke();
  // inner hub
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r*0.55,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.35)";ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeStyle=rim;ctx.stroke();
  // spokes
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(cx,cy);ctx.rotate(angle);
  ctx.strokeStyle=rim;ctx.lineWidth=5;
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    ctx.rotate(Math.PI*2/3);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);ctx.lineTo(r*0.55,0);ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // hub center
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r*0.16,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=rim;ctx.fill();
}
function drawMagnet(x,y,active){
  const w=22,h=34;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);
  // U shape

  ctx.moveTo(-w,-h);ctx.lineTo(-w,h);ctx.lineTo(w,h);ctx.lineTo(w,-h);
  ctx.lineTo(w/2,-h);ctx.lineTo(w/2,h/2);ctx.lineTo(-w/2,h/2);ctx.lineTo(-w/2,-h);
  ctx.closePath();
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-h,0,h);
  if(active){g.addColorStop(0,"#ff8fb0");g.addColorStop(1,"#ff2d55");}
  else{g.addColorStop(0,"#5a6478");g.addColorStop(1,"#39404f");}

  ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.4)";ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle=active?"#fff":"#cfd6e4";
  ctx.fillRect(-w,-h, w/2, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(w/2,-h, w/2, 8);
  if(active){
    ctx.shadowColor="#ff2d55";ctx.shadowBlur=24;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

}
function draw(){

  bg.addColorStop(0,"#141a2b");bg.addColorStop(0.5,"#0e1322");bg.addColorStop(1,"#080b14");

  glow.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,229,255,.10)");glow.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,229,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=glow;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.save();
  if(S.shake>0){ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*S.shake*14,(Math.random()-0.5)*S.shake*14);}

  /* ---- track ---- */
  const y0=TRACK_Y-TRACK_H/2,y1=TRACK_Y+TRACK_H/2;

  const tg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y0,0,y1);
  tg.addColorStop(0,"#2a3145");tg.addColorStop(0.5,"#1c2233");tg.addColorStop(1,"#2a3145");
  ctx.fillStyle=tg;roundRect(TRACK_X0-30,y0,SP+60,TRACK_H,14);ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.06)";ctx.stroke();

  // tape stripes
  ctx.save();
  roundRect(TRACK_X0-30,y0,SP+60,TRACK_H,14);ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.05)";ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=TRACK_X0-30;x<TRACK_X1+30;x+=14){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y0);ctx.lineTo(x,y1);ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,200,255,.10)";

  ctx.font="bold 16px 'Courier New',monospace";ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(124,240,160,.9)";

  // END (red)
  ctx.fillStyle="#ff4d6d";

  ctx.textAlign="right";ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,77,109,.9)";
  ctx.fillText("END",TRACK_X1+60,TRACK_Y-38);

  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(px,TRACK_Y+40,34,10,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  // head body
  const hg=ctx.createLinearGradient(px-26,0,px+26,0);
  if(headActive){hg.addColorStop(0,"#00e5ff");hg.addColorStop(1,"#0091ff");}
  else{hg.addColorStop(0,"#5a6478");hg.addColorStop(1,"#39404f");}
  ctx.fillStyle=hg;
  roundRect(px-26,TRACK_Y-42,52,84,10);ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.25)";ctx.stroke();
  // head window
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.5)";
  roundRect(px-16,TRACK_Y-30,32,60,6);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=headActive?"#eaffff":"#9aa4b8";
  ctx.fillRect(px-12,TRACK_Y-4,24,8);
  if(headActive){
    ctx.shadowColor="#00e5ff";ctx.shadowBlur=20;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,TRACK_Y,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }
  // motion streak when moving
  if(headActive&&Math.abs(S.headV)>50){
    const dir=S.headV<0?1:-1;
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(0,229,255,.35)";ctx.lineWidth=3;
    for(let i=1;i<=4;i++){
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+dir*i*16,TRACK_Y-30);ctx.lineTo(px+dir*i*16,TRACK_Y+30);ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  /* ---- REELS (top-left and top-right) ---- */
  const spin=S.state==="play"?S.t*2.2:S.t*0.4;
  const leftAngle=spin;               // left reel: tape comes off (spins forward)
  const rightAngle=-spin;            // right reel: tape winds on (spins back)
  const rr=46;
  drawReel(180,120,rr,leftAngle,"#ffcf5c","#2b2313");
  drawReel(W-180,120,rr,rightAngle,"#00e5ff","#10222b");

  ctx.beginPath();

  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(180,TRACK_Y,TRACK_X0,TRACK_Y);

  ctx.stroke();

  /* ---- SPARKS ---- */

  /* ---- CONFETTI ---- */
  for(const p of S.particles){

  }

  ctx.restore(); // end shake

  /* ---- HUD ---- */
  ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.font="bold 22px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)";
  ctx.fillText("REWIND",24,40);
  ctx.font="14px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(150,170,200,.8)";
  ctx.fillText("hold SPACE / click to pull the tape back to START",24,62);

  // progress bar

  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.08)";roundRect(bx,by,bw,bh,7);ctx.fill();
  const prog=clamp(S.head/SP,0,1);
  const pg=ctx.createLinearGradient(bx,0,bx+bw,0);
  pg.addColorStop(0,"#7cf0a0");pg.addColorStop(0.5,"#00e5ff");pg.addColorStop(1,"#ff4d6d");

  ctx.fillText("tape position",W-24,by+30);

  // best
  if(S.best>0){
    ctx.textAlign="left";ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,207,92,.9)";ctx.font="14px 'Courier New',monospace";
    ctx.fillText("best: "+S.best.toFixed(2)+"s",24,H-24);
  }

  } else if(S.state==="win"){

      "You pulled the tape all the way back. Time: "+S.elapsed.toFixed(2)+"s",
      "PRESS SPACE / CLICK TO REWIND AGAIN");
  } else if(S.state==="lose"){

}
function overlay(title,sub,cta){

    const count = 1 + (Math.random() < 0.3 ? 1 : 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
      const x = fromLeft ? -20 : W + 20;
      const y = H * 0.15 + Math.random() * H * 0.6;
      const speed = 120 + Math.random() * 80;
      const vx = fromLeft ? speed : -speed;
      const vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
      notes.push(createNote(x, y, vx, vy));
    }
  }

  // Check win condition
  if (beatCount >= TOTAL_BEATS && notes.every(n => n.hit || n.missed || n.y > H + 50)) {
    if (lives > 0) {
      state = 'won';
    } else {
      state = 'lost';
    }
    return;
  }

  // Update notes
  for (const note of notes) {
    if (note.hit) {
      note.alpha -= dt * 3;
      continue;
    }
    note.x += note.vx * dt;
    note.y += note.vy * dt;
    note.spin += note.spinSpeed * dt;

    // Check if note went off screen
    if (!note.missed && (note.x < -40 || note.x > W + 40 || note.y > H + 40 || note.y < -40)) {
      note.missed = true;
      lives--;
      // Red particles
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        particles.push(createParticle(note.x, Math.max(0, Math.min(H, note.y)), '#FF4444'));
      }
    }
  }

  // Remove dead notes
  notes = notes.filter(n => n.alpha > 0 && !(n.missed && n.y > H + 50) && !(n.hit && n.alpha <= 0));

  // Update particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life -= dt * 1.5;
    p.alpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
  }
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

// ==================== DRAW ====================
function drawBackground() {
  // Deep purple gradient
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a0a2e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#16213e');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#0f3460');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Subtle stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
    const sy = (i * 97.3) % H;
    const sr = 0.5 + (i % 3) * 0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, sr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawStaffLines() {
  // Draw 5 staff lines
  const staffTop = H * 0.3;
  const staffBottom = H * 0.7;
  const lineSpacing = (staffBottom - staffTop) / 4;

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const y = staffTop + i * lineSpacing;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawEighthNote(x, y, radius, spin, alpha) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(spin * 0.1);

  // Note head (ellipse)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFA500';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, radius * 0.6, radius * 0.7, radius * 0.5, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Stem
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(radius * 0.5, radius * 0.5);
  ctx.lineTo(radius * 0.5, -radius * 1.2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Flag
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6B9D';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FF4477';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(radius * 0.5, -radius * 1.2);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(radius * 1.5, -radius * 0.8, radius * 1.2, -radius * 0.2);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(radius * 1.0, -radius * 0.5, radius * 0.5, -radius * 0.3);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius * p.alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(18, W * 0.025)}px Georgia`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 40);

  // Lives
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6B9D';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  let livesText = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) livesText += '♪ ';
  ctx.fillText(livesText, W - 20, 40);

  // Beat progress
  const progress = Math.min(1, beatCount / TOTAL_BEATS);
  const barW = W * 0.3;
  const barX = (W - barW) / 2;
  const barY = 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ECDC4';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * progress, 8);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, 8);

  // Beat indicator
  const beatDot = 6 + beatPhase * 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(barX + barW + 15, barY + 4, beatDot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(28, W * 0.05)}px Georgia`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Swing the Eighth Notes', W / 2, H * 0.3);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = `${Math.max(16, W * 0.025)}px Georgia`;
  ctx.fillText('Click or tap the eighth notes before they fly away!', W / 2, H * 0.45);
  ctx.fillText('You have 3 lives. Hit all 32 beats to win!', W / 2, H * 0.52);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ECDC4';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(20, W * 0.035)}px Georgia`;
  const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.005) * 0.1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2, H * 0.65);
  ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
  ctx.fillText('♪ Click to Start ♪', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEndScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const isWin = state === 'won';
  ctx.fillStyle = isWin ? '#4ECDC4' : '#FF4444';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(32, W * 0.055)}px Georgia`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(isWin ? '♪ You Nailed It! ♪' : '♪ Missed the Beat! ♪', W / 2, H * 0.35);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = `${Math.max(20, W * 0.035)}px Georgia`;
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H * 0.48);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = `${Math.max(16, W * 0.025)}px Georgia`;
  ctx.fillText('Click to play again', W / 2, H * 0.6);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawStaffLines();

  if (state === 'playing') {
    drawHUD();
  }

  // Draw notes
  for (const note of notes) {
    if (note.hit && note.alpha <= 0) continue;
    drawEighthNote(note.x, note.y, note.radius, note.spin, note.alpha);
  }

  drawParticles();

  if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') drawEndScreen();
}

// ==================== RESIZE ====================
function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ==================== GAME LOOP ====================
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

lastTime = performance.now();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>

<script>
// ===================== STATE =====================
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const RESPONSES = [
  { text: "It is certain", type: "yes" },
  { text: "Yes, definitely", type: "yes" },
  { text: "Without a doubt", type: "yes" },
  { text: "You may rely on it", type: "yes" },
  { text: "As I see it, yes", type: "yes" },
  { text: "Most likely", type: "yes" },
  { text: "Outlook good", type: "yes" },
  { text: "Yes", type: "yes" },
  { text: "Reply hazy, try again", type: "neutral" },
  { text: "Ask again later", type: "neutral" },
  { text: "Better not tell you now", type: "neutral" },
  { text: "Cannot predict now", type: "neutral" },
  { text: "Concentrate and ask again", type: "neutral" },
  { text: "It is decidedly so", type: "yes" },
  { text: "No", type: "no" },
  { text: "Very doubtful", type: "no" },
  { text: "Don't count on it", type: "no" },
  { text: "My sources say no", type: "no" },
  { text: "My reply is no", type: "no" },
  { text: "There is no chance", type: "no" },
  { text: "Outlook not so good", type: "no" }
];

let state = "start"; // start, playing, roundEnd, gameOver
let player1 = { score: 0, color: "#e74c3c", name: "Player 1", key: "F" };
let player2 = { score: 0, color: "#3498db", name: "Player 2", key: "J" };
let currentTurn = 1;
let roundNumber = 1;
const WIN_SCORE = 5;

// Eight ball animation
let ball = {
  x: W / 2,
  y: H / 2 - 40,
  radius: 100,
  shake: 0,
  shakeTimer: 0,
  response: null,
  showResponse: false,
  responseTimer: 0
};

// Particles
let particles = [];

// Stars background
let stars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    size: Math.random() * 2.5 + 0.5,
    twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.005
  });
}

// Floating orbs
let orbs = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
  orbs.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    radius: Math.random() * 20 + 8,
    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
    vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
    hue: Math.random() * 360
  });
}

let message = "";
let messageTimer = 0;
let winner = null;

// ===================== INPUT =====================
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const key = e.key.toUpperCase();

  if (state === "start") {
    if (key === "ENTER" || key === " ") {
      startGame();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (state === "playing") {
    if (currentTurn === 1 && key === player1.key) {
      askQuestion();
    } else if (currentTurn === 2 && key === player2.key) {
      askQuestion();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (state === "roundEnd") {
    if (key === "ENTER" || key === " ") {
      nextRound();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (state === "gameOver") {
    if (key === "ENTER" || key === " ") {
      resetGame();
    }
    return;
  }
});

// ===================== GAME LOGIC =====================
function startGame() {
  player1.score = 0;
  player2.score = 0;
  roundNumber = 1;
  currentTurn = 1;
  state = "playing";
  ball.response = null;
  ball.showResponse = false;
  message = player1.name + " asks first!";
  messageTimer = 120;
}

function askQuestion() {
  const resp = RESPONSES[Math.floor(Math.random() * RESPONSES.length)];
  ball.response = resp;
  ball.shake = 15;
  ball.shakeTimer = 60;
  ball.showResponse = false;
  ball.responseTimer = 0;

  if (resp.type === "yes") {
    if (currentTurn === 1) player1.score++;
    else player2.score++;
    spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, resp.type === "yes" ? "#2ecc71" : "#e74c3c", 20);
  } else if (resp.type === "no") {
    spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, "#e74c3c", 10);
  } else {
    spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, "#f39c12", 8);
  }

  message = resp.text;
  messageTimer = 150;
}

function nextRound() {
  if (player1.score >= WIN_SCORE || player2.score >= WIN_SCORE) {
    state = "gameOver";
    winner = player1.score >= WIN_SCORE ? player1 : player2;
    return;
  }
  roundNumber++;
  currentTurn = currentTurn === 1 ? 2 : 1;
  ball.response = null;
  ball.showResponse = false;
  state = "playing";
  const p = currentTurn === 1 ? player1 : player2;
  message = p.name + " asks! Press " + p.key;
  messageTimer = 120;
}

function resetGame() {
  state = "start";
  player1.score = 0;
  player2.score = 0;
  roundNumber = 1;
  ball.response = null;
  ball.showResponse = false;
  winner = null;
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 60 + Math.random() * 30,
      maxLife: 90,
      color: color,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }
}

// ===================== UPDATE =====================
function update() {
  // Stars twinkle
  stars.forEach(s => {
    s.twinkle += s.speed;
  });

  // Orbs float
  orbs.forEach(o => {
    o.x += o.vx;
    o.y += o.vy;
    o.hue = (o.hue + 0.5) % 360;
    if (o.x < -o.radius) o.x = W + o.radius;
    if (o.x > W + o.radius) o.x = -o.radius;
    if (o.y < -o.radius) o.y = H + o.radius;
    if (o.y > H + o.radius) o.y = -o.radius;
  });

  // Particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Ball shake
  if (ball.shakeTimer > 0) {
    ball.shakeTimer--;
    ball.shake = Math.max(0, ball.shake - 0.3);
    if (ball.shakeTimer === 30) {
      ball.showResponse = true;
    }
  }

  if (messageTimer > 0) messageTimer--;
}

// ===================== DRAW =====================
function draw() {
  // Background gradient
  const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 50, W/2, H/2, W);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, "#2d1b4e");
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, "#1a0a2e");
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, "#0d0518");
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  stars.forEach(s => {
    const alpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(s.twinkle) * 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Floating orbs
  orbs.forEach(o => {
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.radius);
    grad.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${o.hue}, 70%, 60%, 0.15)`);
    grad.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${o.hue}, 70%, 60%, 0)`);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Title
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8d5ff";
  ctx.fillText("✦ Magical Eight Ball Duel ✦", W / 2, 45);

  // Player score panels
  drawScorePanel(player1, 80);
  drawScorePanel(player2, W - 80);

  // Eight Ball
  drawEightBall();

  // Message
  if (messageTimer > 0 && message) {
    const alpha = Math.min(1, messageTimer / 30);
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillText(message, W / 2, H - 50);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // State overlays
  if (state === "start") {
    drawStartScreen();
  } else if (state === "gameOver") {
    drawGameOverScreen();
  }
}

function drawScorePanel(p, x) {
  const w = 140, h = 70;
  const px = x - w / 2;
  const py = 55;

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)";
  roundRect(px, py, w, h, 12);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.strokeStyle = p.color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(px, py, w, h, 12);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  ctx.fillText(p.name, x, py + 25);

  ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.fillText(p.score + " / " + WIN_SCORE, x, py + 55);

  // Active turn indicator
  if (state === "playing" && ((currentTurn === 1 && p === player1) || (currentTurn === 2 && p === player2))) {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, py - 8, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawEightBall() {
  const bx = ball.x + (ball.shake > 0 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * ball.shake : 0);
  const by = ball.y + (ball.shake > 0 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * ball.shake : 0);

  // Glow
  const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, ball.radius * 0.8, bx, by, ball.radius * 1.6);
  glowGrad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.2)");
  glowGrad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(138, 43, 226, 0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx, by, ball.radius * 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Ball body
  const ballGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx - 20, by - 20, 10, bx, by, ball.radius);
  ballGrad.addColorStop(0, "#4a4a4a");
  ballGrad.addColorStop(0.5, "#1a1a1a");
  ballGrad.addColorStop(1, "#000000");
  ctx.fillStyle = ballGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx, by, ball.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Ball rim
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx, by, ball.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();

    });

  } else {

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    ctx.fillText("8", bx, by);

}

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 36px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";

  ctx.fillStyle = player2.color;
  ctx.fillText("Player 2: Press " + player2.key + " to ask", W / 2, H / 2 + 40);

  ctx.fillText("Press ENTER to Start", W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawGameOverScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";

  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8d5ff";
  ctx.fillText("Press ENTER to Play Again", W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ===================== MAIN LOOP =====================
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();

"use strict";

   SECRET DECODER RING — one playable scene
   Spin the outer ring to align the glowing marker with the
   secret glyph. Solve 5 codes before time runs out to win.
   Controls: A/D or Arrow keys (or click left/right side) to

// ---------- CANVAS ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0, CX = 0, CY = 0, R = 0;

function resize() {
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px'; canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  CX = W / 2; CY = H / 2;
  R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.34;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
const TICKS = 24;                 // positions around the ring
const STEP = (Math.PI * 2) / TICKS;
const GLYPHS = ['\u2638','\u2620','\u2639','\u263A','\u263C','\u2622','\u2623','\u2637','\u2636','\u262A','\u262B','\u262C','\u262D','\u262E','\u262F','\u2630','\u2631','\u2632','\u2633','\u2634','\u2635','\u2636','\u2637','\u2638'];
const CODES = 5;
const TIME = 30;                  // seconds per code
const SPIN = 0.05;               // radians per frame while held

// ---------- STATE ----------
const state = {
  phase: 'start',     // start | playing | win | lose
  angle: 0,           // current ring rotation
  target: 0,          // target tick index
  code: 0,            // current code number (0-based)
  score: 0,
  time: TIME,
  spinDir: 0,        // -1,0,1
  flash: 0,          // success flash timer
  shake: 0,          // fail shake timer
  hintPulse: 0,
  last: performance.now()
};

// ---------- INPUT ----------
let keyL = false, keyR = false;

function pressLeft()  { state.spinDir = -1; }
function pressRight() { state.spinDir =  1; }
function release()    { state.spinDir =  0; }

function commit() {
  if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;
  const idx = currentTick();
  if (idx === state.target) {
    state.score++;
    state.flash = 1;
    if (state.code + 1 >= CODES) { state.phase = 'win'; }
    else {
      state.code++;
      state.time = TIME;
      state.target = randomTarget();
    }
  } else {
    state.shake = 1;
    state.time = Math.max(0, state.time - 3);
  }
}

function startGame() {
  state.phase = 'playing';
  state.code = 0;
  state.score = 0;
  state.time = TIME;
  state.angle = 0;
  state.target = randomTarget();
  state.flash = 0; state.shake = 0;
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'a' || k === 'arrowleft')  { keyL = true;  state.spinDir = -1; }
  if (k === 'd' || k === 'arrowright') { keyR = true;  state.spinDir =  1; }
  if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') {
    if (state.phase === 'start') startGame();
    else if (state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') { state.phase = 'start'; }
    else commit();
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'a' || k === 'arrowleft')  { keyL = false; if (state.spinDir === -1) state.spinDir = 0; }
  if (k === 'd' || k === 'arrowright') { keyR = false; if (state.spinDir ===  1) state.spinDir = 0; }
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  if (state.phase === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') { state.phase = 'start'; return; }
  const x = e.clientX - CX;
  if (x < 0) state.spinDir = -1; else state.spinDir = 1;

canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { state.spinDir = 0; });
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  if (state.phase === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') { state.phase = 'start'; return; }
  const t = e.touches[0];
  const x = t.clientX - CX;
  if (x < 0) state.spinDir = -1; else state.spinDir = 1;

canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { state.spinDir = 0; });

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function randomTarget() { return Math.floor(Math.random() * TICKS); }
function currentTick() {
  let idx = Math.round((-state.angle / STEP));
  idx = ((idx % TICKS) + TICKS) % TICKS;
  return idx;
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt) {
  state.hintPulse += dt * 3;
  if (state.phase === 'playing') {
    if (state.spinDir !== 0) state.angle += state.spinDir * SPIN;
    state.time -= dt;
    if (state.time <= 0) { state.time = 0; state.phase = 'lose'; }
  }
  if (state.flash > 0) state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 2);
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 3);
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY, R * 0.2, CX, CY, Math.max(W, H));
  g.addColorStop(0, '#141a30');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0e1e');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#04060d');

  // faint drifting star dust
  const t = state.hintPulse * 0.15;

  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const a = (i / 40) * Math.PI * 2 + t;
    const rad = R * (1.15 + 0.25 * Math.sin(i * 1.7 + t));
    const x = CX + Math.cos(a) * rad;
    const y = CY + Math.sin(a) * rad;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15 + 0.1 * Math.sin(i + t * 2);

}

function drawRing() {
  const sh = state.shake;

  const oy = sh ? Math.cos(state.hintPulse * 37) * sh * 8 : 0;

  gg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,30,70,0.4)');

  rg.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a2140');

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,150,220,0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < TICKS; i++) {
    const a = i * STEP;
    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.shadowColor = isTarget ? '#ff5f7a' : 'transparent';
    ctx.shadowBlur = isTarget ? 14 : 0;

    ctx.restore();

  ctx.restore();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(CX, CY, innerR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  const ig = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX - innerR * 0.3, CY - innerR * 0.3, innerR * 0.1, CX, CY, innerR);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#5fd0ff';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#5fd0ff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px, py - R * 0.12);
  ctx.lineTo(px - R * 0.06, py + R * 0.02);
  ctx.lineTo(px + R * 0.06, py + R * 0.02);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // success flash ring
  if (state.flash > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#7dffb0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#7dffb0';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(CX, CY, innerR + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore(); // undo shake
}

function drawHUD() {
  // top-left: code progress
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fb0ff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(R * 0.09)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('CODE', 24, 40);
  ctx.font = `${Math.round(R * 0.16)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf1ff';
  ctx.fillText(`${state.code + 1} / ${CODES}`, 24, 74);

  // top-right: timer
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fb0ff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(R * 0.09)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('TIME', W - 24, 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = tcol;
  ctx.font = `${Math.round(R * 0.16)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;

  // center: current secret glyph
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf1ff';
  ctx.font = `${Math.round(R * 0.2)}px serif`;
  ctx.fillText(GLYPHS[state.target % GLYPHS.length], CX, CY);

  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,175,235,0.7)';
  ctx.font = `${Math.round(R * 0.06)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('A / D or \u2190 \u2192 to spin   \u00B7   SPACE to lock in', CX, H - 24);
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,6,13,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(R * 0.24)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(title, CX, CY - R * 0.15);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cdd8ff';
  ctx.font = `${Math.round(R * 0.09)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(sub, CX, CY + R * 0.12);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,175,235,0.7)';
  ctx.font = `${Math.round(R * 0.06)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('press SPACE or click to continue', CX, CY + R * 0.32);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawRing();
  drawHUD();
  if (state.phase === 'start')
    drawOverlay('SECRET DECODER RING', 'Align the glowing marker with the secret glyph. Solve 5 codes before time runs out.', '#5fd0ff');
  else if (state.phase === 'win')
    drawOverlay('DECODED!', `You solved all ${CODES} codes.  \u2726  Mission complete.`, '#7dffb0');
  else if (state.phase === 'lose')
    drawOverlay('TIME UP', `You decoded ${state.score} of ${CODES} codes.`, '#ff5f7a');
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.last) / 1000);
  state.last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  function drawOracle(){

    // based on sin of spin angle, and flipping the face.
    var spin = state.coinSpin;
    var squeeze = Math.cos(spin);       // -1..1, width factor
    var widthFactor = 0.25 + Math.abs(squeeze) * 0.75;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, w + r * 0.06, r * 1.05, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

      faceGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c9a24a');
    } else {
      faceGrad.addColorStop(0, '#cdeef5');
      faceGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#7fd1e0');
      faceGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4f8a96');
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = faceGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, w, r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    // Edge ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = state.coinFace === 'heads' ? '#8a6a25' : '#2f5560';

    ctx.ellipse(x, y, w, r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    // Symbol on face (only visible when mostly facing us)
    if (widthFactor > 0.55){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, y);
      ctx.scale(widthFactor, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = state.coinFace === 'heads' ? '#8a6a25' : '#2f5560';
      if (state.coinFace === 'heads'){

        var s = r * 0.45;
        for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++){
          var ang = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
          var rr = (i % 2 === 0) ? s : s * 0.45;
          var px = Math.cos(ang) * rr;
          var py = Math.sin(ang) * rr;
          if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);

    }
  }

  function draw(){
    drawBackground();
    drawOracle();
    drawCoin();

  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  function handleAction(){

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  function loop(ts){
    if (!state.last) state.last = ts;
    var dt = (ts - state.last) / 1000;
    state.last = ts;
    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;   // clamp big gaps

    draw();

  }

const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');

      const y = boardTop + spacingY * r;

    starField.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,

  ball.vy += GRAVITY * dt;

        life: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4,
        color: bucketColors[bucketIdx]

    gamePhase = 'done';

// ==================== DRAW ====================
function draw() {

  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (const s of starField) {
    const a = s.alpha * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.phase));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 220, 255, ${a})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  drawBoardFrame();

  // Buckets
  drawBuckets();

  // Pegs
  drawPegs();

  // Particles
  drawParticles();

  // Ball
  if (ball) drawBall();

  // Score popups
  drawScorePopups();

  // UI overlay
  drawUI();
}

function drawBoardFrame() {
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 140, 255, 0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  const r = 12;
  const x = boardLeft - 15;
  const y = boardTop - 70;
  const w = boardRight - boardLeft + 30;
  const h = bucketY - boardTop + 100;

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Inner glow
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 140, 255, 0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 8;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawBuckets() {
  for (let i = 0; i < bucketCount; i++) {
    const x = boardLeft + i * bucketWidth;
    const w = bucketWidth;
    const h = 30;
    const y = bucketY;

    // Bucket body
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h);
    grad.addColorStop(0, bucketColors[i]);
    grad.addColorStop(1, shadeColor(bucketColors[i], -30));
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 2, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - 2, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - 6, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y + h);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Bucket top highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y, w - 4, 3);

    // Score text
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(10, Math.min(14, w * 0.4))}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(bucketScores[i], x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 2);

    // Side accent
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 3, 2, h - 3);
  }
}

function drawPegs() {
  for (const peg of pegs) {
    const glow = peg.hit * pegGlow;
    const r = pegRadius;

    // Outer glow
    if (glow > 0.01) {
      const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(peg.x, peg.y, r * 0.5, peg.x, peg.y, r * 3);
      glowGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 220, 100, ${glow * 0.6})`);
      glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 220, 100, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(peg.x, peg.y, r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Peg body
    const pegGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(peg.x - r * 0.3, peg.y - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, peg.x, peg.y, r);
    if (glow > 0.3) {
      pegGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fff8e0');
      pegGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffcc44');
      pegGrad.addColorStop(1, '#cc8800');
    } else {
      pegGrad.addColorStop(0, '#a0c0ff');
      pegGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#5577cc');
      pegGrad.addColorStop(1, '#224488');

    ctx.arc(peg.x, peg.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.arc(peg.x - r * 0.25, peg.y - r * 0.25, r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = Math.min(1, p.life * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2 + p.life * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

}

function drawBall() {
  // Trail
  for (let i = 0; i < ball.trail.length; i++) {
    const t = ball.trail[i];
    const alpha = (i / ball.trail.length) * 0.4;
    const r = ball.r * (0.5 + 0.5 * i / ball.trail.length);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 200, 50, ${alpha})`;

    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  const ballGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    ball.x - ball.r * 0.3, ball.y - ball.r * 0.3, ball.r * 0.1,
    ball.x, ball.y, ball.r
  );
  ballGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fff8e0');
  ballGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#ffcc33');
  ballGrad.addColorStop(0.8, '#ff9900');
  ballGrad.addColorStop(1, '#cc6600');
  ctx.fillStyle = ballGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Specular
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x - ball.r * 0.3, ball.y - ball.r * 0.3, ball.r * 0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawScorePopups() {
  for (const sp of scorePopups) {
    const alpha = Math.min(1, sp.life);
    const scale = 1 + (1.5 - sp.life) * 0.3;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = sp.color;
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(24 * scale)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(sp.text, sp.x, sp.y);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawUI() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE', 30, 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(score.toString(), 30, 52);

  // Drop count
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(`Drop ${dropCount} / ${MAX_DROPS}`, W - 30, 25);

  // Game over overlay
  if (gamePhase === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2);

    // Rating
    let rating = 'Try Again!';
    if (score >= 3000) rating = 'Champion! 🏆';
    else if (score >= 2000) rating = 'Great! ⭐';
    else if (score >= 1000) rating = 'Nice! 👍';
    else if (score >= 500) rating = 'Not Bad!';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#a0c0ff';
    ctx.font = '22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(rating, W / 2, H / 2 + 50);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
  }

  // Ready prompt
  if (gamePhase === 'ready' && dropCount === 0) {
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(time * 3);
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('Move mouse and click to drop the ball!', W / 2, H * 0.12);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function shadeColor(color, percent) {
  const num = parseInt(color.replace('#', ''), 16);
  const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num >> 16) + percent));
  const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num >> 8) & 0x00FF) + percent));
  const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num & 0x0000FF) + percent));
  return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
}

// ==================== GAME RESET ====================
function resetGame() {
  score = 0;
  dropCount = 0;
  gamePhase = 'ready';
  ball = null;
  particles = [];
  scorePopups = [];
  for (const peg of pegs) peg.hit = 0;
}

// Override click to handle game over
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (gamePhase === 'gameover') {
    resetGame();
  }
});

// ==================== MAIN LOOP ====================
let lastTime = 0;

function loop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ==================== START ====================
resize();
requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
  lastTime = t;
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
});
</script>

  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.fillText('Press C or R to play again', canvas.width / 2, 530);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  if (state === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen();
  } else if (state === 'playing') {
    drawBackground();
    drawTitle();
    drawScale();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
  } else if (state === 'gameover') {
    drawGameOver();
    drawParticles();
  } else if (state === 'win') {
    drawWin();
    drawParticles();
  }
}

// === MAIN LOOP ===
let lastTime = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = now - lastTime;
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<title>Bobsled Turn</title>

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body { background: #0a0e1a; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; }

// ===================== STATE =====================
const W = 900, H = 600;
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let state = 'start'; // 'start', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
let score = 0;
let turnCount = 0;
let sled = { x: 120, y: H/2, angle: 0, speed: 0 };
let gate = { x: 780, y: H/2, width: 90 };
let steer = 0; // -1 left, 0 none, 1 right
let time = 0;
let particles = [];

// ===================== INPUT =====================
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (state === 'start' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0; turnCount = 0;
    sled = { x: 120, y: H/2, angle: 0, speed: 0 };
    gate = { x: 780, y: H/2, width: 90 };
    particles = [];
    return;
  }
  if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      state = 'start';
      return;
    }
  }
  if (state === 'playing') {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') steer = -1;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') steer = 1;
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') { if (steer === -1) steer = 0; }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') { if (steer === 1) steer = 0; }
});

// ===================== UPDATE =====================
function update() {
  time += 0.016;
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Steer the sled
  if (steer !== 0) {
    sled.angle += steer * 0.045;
    sled.angle = Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.6, sled.angle));
    turnCount++;
    score += 1;
  } else {
    sled.angle *= 0.92;
  }

  // Move sled
  sled.speed = 3.2;
  sled.x += Math.cos(sled.angle) * sled.speed;
  sled.y += Math.sin(sled.angle) * sled.speed;

  // Wall collision
  const margin = 50;
  if (sled.y < margin || sled.y > H - margin) {
    state = 'lost';
    return;
  }

  // Check gate
  if (sled.x >= gate.x - 10) {
    if (Math.abs(sled.y - gate.y) < gate.width / 2) {
      state = 'won';
      score += 500;
    } else {
      state = 'lost';
    }
  }

  // Particles
  if (steer !== 0 && Math.random() > 0.4) {
    particles.push({
      x: sled.x - Math.cos(sled.angle) * 20,
      y: sled.y - Math.sin(sled.angle) * 20,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
      life: 1
    });
  }
  particles = particles.filter(p => {
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.life -= 0.03;
    return p.life > 0;
  });
}

// ===================== DRAW =====================
function draw() {
  // Sky / background gradient
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#0b1026');
  bg.addColorStop(0.4, '#141e3c');
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#1a2544');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Distant mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1e2d52';
  drawMountain(100, 180, 200, 100);
  drawMountain(350, 150, 250, 120);
  drawMountain(650, 170, 220, 90);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#253a6b';
  drawMountain(200, 200, 180, 80);
  drawMountain(500, 190, 200, 90);
  drawMountain(750, 210, 150, 70);

  // Track / ice surface
  const trackTop = 50;
  const trackBot = H - 50;
  const trackGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, trackTop, 0, trackBot);
  trackGrad.addColorStop(0, '#a8d8f0');
  trackGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#d4eef8');
  trackGrad.addColorStop(1, '#a8d8f0');
  ctx.fillStyle = trackGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(30, trackTop, W - 60, trackBot - trackTop, 12);
  ctx.fill();

  // Track lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,180,220,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const y = trackTop + 30 + i * 55;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(40, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W - 40, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Wall / barrier
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2233';
  ctx.fillRect(30, trackTop - 8, W - 60, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(30, trackBot, W - 60, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  for (let x = 40; x < W - 40; x += 30) {
    ctx.fillRect(x, trackTop - 8, 15, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(x, trackBot, 15, 8);
  }

  // Gate
  const gTop = gate.y - gate.width / 2;
  const gBot = gate.y + gate.width / 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
  ctx.fillRect(gate.x - 5, gTop, 10, gBot - gTop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8800';
  ctx.fillRect(gate.x - 5, gTop, 10, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(gate.x - 5, gBot - 8, 10, 8);
  // Gate glow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,0,0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(gate.x - 20, gTop, 40, gBot - gTop);

  // Particles (ice spray)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,230,255,0.7)';
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2 * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Sled
  drawSled(sled.x, sled.y, sled.angle);

  // UI
  drawUI();
}

function drawMountain(x, baseY, width, height) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - width/2, baseY);
  ctx.lineTo(x, baseY - height);
  ctx.lineTo(x + width/2, baseY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawSled(x, y, angle) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(angle);

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 8, 30, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Sled body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3a6a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-25, -12);
  ctx.lineTo(25, -12);
  ctx.lineTo(30, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(25, 12);
  ctx.lineTo(-25, 12);
  ctx.lineTo(-30, 0);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Sled highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a5a9a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-20, -10);
  ctx.lineTo(20, -10);
  ctx.lineTo(24, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(20, 10);
  ctx.lineTo(-20, 10);
  ctx.lineTo(-24, 0);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Runners
  ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
  ctx.fillRect(-28, 12, 56, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(-28, -15, 56, 3);

  // Crew (two figures)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-8, -2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(8, -2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Helmet
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2233';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-8, -4, 5, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(8, -4, 5, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawUI() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(W/2 - 120, 8, 240, 36, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, W/2, 32);

  if (state === 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W/2 - 250, H/2 - 80, 500, 160, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('BOBSLED TURN', W/2, H/2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Steer through the gate!', W/2, H/2 + 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Arrow keys / A D to steer', W/2, H/2 + 35);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to start', W/2, H/2 + 60);
  }

  if (state === 'won') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W/2 - 200, H/2 - 60, 400, 120, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff88';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('GATE CLEARED!', W/2, H/2 - 15);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 15);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '14px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', W/2, H/2 + 40);
  }

  if (state === 'lost') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W/2 - 200, H/2 - 60, 400, 120, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('CRASHED!', W/2, H/2 - 15);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 15);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '14px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to retry', W/2, H/2 + 40);
  }
}

// ===================== GAME LOOP =====================
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

<head>

<title>Marble Shootout</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 100vh;

</style>
