<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="900" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ============ STATE ============
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const STATE = {
  screen: 'title', // 'title', 'playing', 'gameover'
  score: [0, 0],
  current: 0,
  marbles: [],
  winner: null,
  target: { x: W/2, y: H/2 },
  targetRadius: 30,
  moveTimer: 0,
  moveInterval: 2.0,
  shotsFired: 0,
  maxShots: 15,
  particles: [],
  message: '',
  messageTimer: 0
};

const playerColors = ['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4'];
const playerNames = ['Player 1', 'Player 2'];

// ============ INPUT ============
const keys = {};
let mouseX = W/2, mouseY = H/2, mouseDown = false;

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (STATE.screen === 'title' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    startGame();
  }
  if (STATE.screen === 'gameover' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    STATE.screen = 'title';
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
  mouseY = (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
  mouseDown = true;
  if (STATE.screen === 'title') startGame();
  if (STATE.screen === 'gameover') STATE.screen = 'title';
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {
  mouseDown = false;
  if (STATE.screen === 'playing') shoot();
});

// ============ GAME LOGIC ============
function startGame() {
  STATE.score = [0, 0];
  STATE.current = 0;
  STATE.marbles = [];
  STATE.winner = null;
  STATE.shotsFired = 0;
  STATE.particles = [];
  STATE.moveTimer = 0;
  STATE.target = { x: W/2, y: H/2 };
  STATE.screen = 'playing';
  STATE.message = playerNames[0] + "'s turn!";
  STATE.messageTimer = 2;
}

function shoot() {
  const p = STATE.current;
  const startX = p === 0 ? 60 : W - 60;
  const startY = H/2;
  const dx = mouseX - startX;
  const dy = mouseY - startY;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
  if (dist < 10) return;

  const speed = 500;
  const vx = (dx/dist) * speed;
  const vy = (dy/dist) * speed;

  STATE.marbles.push({
    x: startX, y: startY,
    vx: vx, vy: vy,
    r: 12,
    color: playerColors[p],
    trail: []
  });
  STATE.shotsFired++;
  STATE.message = '';
  STATE.messageTimer = 0;
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 50 + Math.random() * 200;
    STATE.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      r: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
      color: color,
      life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
      maxLife: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5
    });
  }
}

function checkHit(m) {
  const t = STATE.target;
  const dx = m.x - t.x;
  const dy = m.y - t.y;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
  return dist < (m.r + STATE.targetRadius);
}

function endTurn() {
  STATE.current = 1 - STATE.current;
  if (STATE.shotsFired >= STATE.maxShots) {
    if (STATE.score[0] > STATE.score[1]) STATE.winner = 0;
    else if (STATE.score[1] > STATE.score[0]) STATE.winner = 1;
    else STATE.winner = -1;
    STATE.screen = 'gameover';
    return;
  }
  STATE.message = playerNames[STATE.current] + "'s turn!";
  STATE.messageTimer = 2;
}

// ============ UPDATE ============
function update(dt) {
  if (STATE.screen !== 'playing') return;

  // Move target
  STATE.moveTimer += dt;
  if (STATE.moveTimer >= STATE.moveInterval) {
    STATE.moveTimer = 0;
    STATE.moveInterval = 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
    STATE.target.x = 150 + Math.random() * (W - 300);
    STATE.target.y = 80 + Math.random() * (H - 160);
  }

  // Message timer
  if (STATE.messageTimer > 0) STATE.messageTimer -= dt;

  // Update marbles
  for (let i = STATE.marbles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = STATE.marbles[i];
    m.trail.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y });
    if (m.trail.length > 20) m.trail.shift();

    m.x += m.vx * dt;
    m.y += m.vy * dt;
    m.vx *= 0.998;
    m.vy *= 0.998;

    // Bounce off walls
    if (m.x < m.r) { m.x = m.r; m.vx = Math.abs(m.vx); }
    if (m.x > W - m.r) { m.x = W - m.r; m.vx = -Math.abs(m.vx); }
    if (m.y < m.r) { m.y = m.r; m.vy = Math.abs(m.vy); }
    if (m.y > H - m.r) { m.y = H - m.r; m.vy = -Math.abs(m.vy); }

    // Check hit on target
    if (checkHit(m)) {
      STATE.score[m.color === playerColors[0] ? 0 : 1]++;
      spawnParticles(m.x, m.y, '#ffd700', 20);
      spawnParticles(m.x, m.y, m.color, 15);
      STATE.marbles.splice(i, 1);
      STATE.message = 'HIT! ' + playerNames[0] + ' ' + STATE.score[0] + ' - ' + STATE.score[1] + ' ' + playerNames[1];
      STATE.messageTimer = 2;
      setTimeout(() => { if (STATE.screen === 'playing') endTurn(); }, 800);
      continue;
    }

    // Remove if too slow
    const speed = Math.sqrt(m.vx*m.vx + m.vy*m.vy);
    if (speed < 15) {
      spawnParticles(m.x, m.y, m.color, 8);
      STATE.marbles.splice(i, 1);
      if (STATE.screen === 'playing') endTurn();
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = STATE.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = STATE.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 200 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) STATE.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ============ DRAW ============
function drawBackground() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#16213e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0f3460');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a2e');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Side zones
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,107,107,0.05)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 120, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(78,205,196,0.05)';
  ctx.fillRect(W-120, 0, 120, H);

  // Side labels
  ctx.font = '14px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,107,107,0.3)';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('P1 ZONE', 60, H/2);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(78,205,196,0.3)';
  ctx.fillText('P2 ZONE', W-60, H/2);
}

function drawTarget() {
  const t = STATE.target;
  const r = STATE.targetRadius;
  const time = Date.now() / 1000;
  const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(time * 3) * 0.1;

  // Outer glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(t.x, t.y, r * 0.5, t.x, t.y, r * 2 * pulse);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,215,0,0.3)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,215,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, r * 2 * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Target rings
  const rings = [
    { r: r, color: '#ff4444' },
    { r: r * 0.75, color: '#ffffff' },
    { r: r * 0.5, color: '#ff4444' },
    { r: r * 0.25, color: '#ffd700' }
  ];
  rings.forEach(ring => {
    ctx.fillStyle = ring.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, ring.r * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Crosshair
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(t.x - r * 1.5, t.y);
  ctx.lineTo(t.x + r * 1.5, t.y);
  ctx.moveTo(t.x, t.y - r * 1.5);
  ctx.lineTo(t.x, t.y + r * 1.5);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawMarbles() {
  STATE.marbles.forEach(m => {
    // Trail
    for (let i = 0; i < m.trail.length; i++) {
      const alpha = (i / m.trail.length) * 0.3;
      const size = (i / m.trail.length) * m.r;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color.replace(')', ',' + alpha + ')').replace('rgb', 'rgba').replace('#', '');
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.trail[i].x, m.trail[i].y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Marble body
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x - 3, m.y - 3, 1, m.x, m.y, m.r);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    grad.addColorStop(0.3, m.color);
    grad.addColorStop(1, shadeColor(m.color, -40));
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.x - m.r * 0.3, m.y - m.r * 0.3, m.r * 0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function drawParticles() {
  STATE.particles.forEach(p => {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawAimLine() {
  if (STATE.screen !== 'playing') return;
  const p = STATE.current;
  const startX = p === 0 ? 60 : W - 60;
  const startY = H/2;
  const dx = mouseX - startX;
  const dy = mouseY - startY;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
  if (dist < 10) return;

  const nx = dx/dist, ny = dy/dist;
  ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = playerColors[p] + '80';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
  ctx.lineTo(startX + nx * 150, startY + ny * 150);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Player marker
  ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[p];
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(startX, startY, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(p === 0 ? 'P1' : 'P2', startX, startY + 4);
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[0];
  ctx.fillText(STATE.score[0] + '', W/2 - 60, 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillText('-', W/2, 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[1];
  ctx.fillText(STATE.score[1] + '', W/2 + 60, 35);

  // Player names
  ctx.font = '12px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[0];
  ctx.fillText('P1', W/2 - 60, 52);
  ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[1];
  ctx.fillText('P2', W/2 + 60, 52);

  // Shots remaining
  ctx.font = '14px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.fillText('Shots: ' + STATE.shotsFired + '/' + STATE.maxShots, W/2, H - 15);

  // Current player indicator
  if (STATE.messageTimer > 0) {
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[STATE.current];
    ctx.fillText(STATE.message, W/2, H/2 - 50);
  }
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.fillText('MARBLE SHOOTOUT', W/2, H/2 - 80);

  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillText('Two players take turns shooting marbles at the target', W/2, H/2 - 20);
  ctx.fillText('Most hits in ' + STATE.maxShots + ' shots wins!', W/2, H/2 + 10);

  ctx.font = '16px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[0];
  ctx.fillText('P1 shoots from the left', W/2, H/2 + 50);
  ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[1];
  ctx.fillText('P2 shoots from the right', W/2, H/2 + 75);

  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) > 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to start', W/2, H/2 + 130);
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.font = 'bold 42px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  if (STATE.winner === -1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.fillText("IT'S A TIE!", W/2, H/2 - 40);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = playerColors[STATE.winner];
    ctx.fillText(playerNames[STATE.winner] + ' WINS!', W/2, H/2 - 40);
  }

  ctx.font = '28px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillText(STATE.score[0] + ' - ' + STATE.score[1], W/2, H/2 + 10);

  ctx.font = '18px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) > 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to return to title', W/2, H/2 + 60);
}

function shadeColor(hex, percent) {
  const num = parseInt(hex.replace('#',''), 16);
  const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num >> 16) + percent));
  const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num >> 8) & 0x00FF) + percent));
  const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num & 0x0000FF) + percent));
  return '#' + (0x1000000 + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawTarget();
  drawMarbles();
  drawParticles();
  drawAimLine();
  drawHUD();
  if (STATE.screen === 'title') drawTitle();
  if (STATE.screen === 'gameover') drawGameOver();
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
/* ===================== SETUP ===================== */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize() {
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * DPR; canvas.height = H * DPR;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px'; canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ===================== STATE ===================== */
const P = [
  { name: 'HOME', color: '#ff4d6d', accent: '#ff8fa3', digits: [0,0,0], target: 0,
    keys: { inc: ['KeyA','KeyD','KeyF','KeyG','KeyH','KeyJ','KeyK','KeyL'],
             dec: ['KeyQ','KeyE','KeyR','KeyT','KeyY','KeyU','KeyI','KeyO'] } },
  { name: 'AWAY', color: '#38bdf8', accent: '#7dd3fc', digits: [0,0,0], target: 0,
    keys: { inc: ['Digit1','Digit2','Digit3','Digit4','Digit5','Digit6','Digit7','Digit8'],
             dec: ['Digit9','Digit0','Comma','Period','Slash','Backslash','Semicolon','Quote'] } }
];
const state = {
  mode: 'menu',        // menu | play | win
  score: 0,
  time: 0,
  winTeam: 0,
  last: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  flashColor: '#ffffff',
  msg: '',
  msgTimer: 0
};
let confetti = [];

/* ===================== HELPERS ===================== */
function rr(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function setScore(team, val) {
  const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(999, val));
  const s = String(v).padStart(3, '0').split('').map(Number);
  team.digits = s;
}
function flash(color, t) { state.flash = 1; state.flashColor = color; state.msgTimer = t; }
function say(msg, t) { state.msg = msg; state.msgTimer = t; }

/* ===================== INPUT ===================== */
const pressed = {};
function handleKey(e, down) {
  const c = e.code;
  if (down) pressed[c] = true; else pressed[c] = false;
  if (state.mode === 'menu') {
    if (down && (c === 'Space' || c === 'Enter')) { startGame(); e.preventDefault(); }
    return;
  }
  if (state.mode === 'win') {
    if (down && (c === 'Space' || c === 'Enter')) { state.mode = 'menu'; e.preventDefault(); }
    return;
  }
  // play mode
  if (down) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      if (P[i].keys.inc.includes(c)) {
        P[i].target = Math.min(999, P[i].target + 1);
        setScore(P[i], P[i].target);
        state.score += 10;
        flash(P[i].accent, 0.25);
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      if (P[i].keys.dec.includes(c)) {
        if (P[i].target > 0) {
          P[i].target = Math.max(0, P[i].target - 1);
          setScore(P[i], P[i].target);
          state.score += 5;
          flash(P[i].accent, 0.2);
        }
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    }
  }
}
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => handleKey(e, true));
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => handleKey(e, false));
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (state.mode === 'menu') startGame();
  else if (state.mode === 'win') state.mode = 'menu';
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
  if (state.mode === 'menu') startGame();
  else if (state.mode === 'win') state.mode = 'menu';
}, { passive: true });

function startGame() {
  state.mode = 'play';
  state.score = 0;
  state.time = 0;
  state.winTeam = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = 0;
  state.msg = '';
  state.msgTimer = 0;
  confetti = [];
  setScore(P[0], 0);
  setScore(P[1], 0);
}

/* ===================== UPDATE ===================== */
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;
  state.shake *= Math.pow(0.001, dt);
  if (state.shake < 0.05) state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 3);
  if (state.msgTimer > 0) state.msgTimer -= dt;

  if (state.mode === 'play') {
    // confetti
    for (let i = confetti.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = confetti[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 220 * dt;
      p.rot += p.vr * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) confetti.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (P[0].target >= 100) endGame(0);
    else if (P[1].target >= 100) endGame(1);

}
function endGame(team) {
  state.mode = 'win';
  state.winTeam = team;
  state.shake = 14;
  state.flash = 1;
  state.flashColor = P[team].accent;
  say(P[team].name + ' WINS', 5);
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H * 0.32;
  for (let i = 0; i < 130; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = 80 + Math.random() * 320;
    confetti.push({
      x: cx, y: cy,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 120,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
      size: 5 + Math.random() * 8,
      color: [P[team].color, P[team].accent, '#fbbf24', '#ffffff'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)],
      life: 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5

/* ===================== DRAW ===================== */
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.4, 40, W / 2, H * 0.4, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#141a2e');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0e1c');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#04060d');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // floor
  const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.72, 0, H);
  fg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(20,28,54,0)');
  fg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(8,12,26,0.9)');
  ctx.fillStyle = fg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.72, W, H * 0.28);
}

function drawLights() {
  const t = state.time;
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const x = W * (i === 0 ? 0.24 : 0.76);
    const y = H * 0.05;
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 0.15;
    const col = i === 0 ? '120,180,255' : '255,150,120';
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, H * 0.55);
    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + col + ',' + (0.22 * pulse) + ')');
    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + col + ',0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, W * 0.28, H * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawDigit(x, y, w, h, val, color, glow) {
  // housing
  ctx.fillStyle = '#05070f';
  rr(x, y, w, h, w * 0.16);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  rr(x, y, w, h, w * 0.16);
  ctx.stroke();
  // glow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = '700 ' + (h * 0.62) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(String(val), x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + h * 0.03);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawScoreboard() {
  const bw = Math.min(W * 0.82, 900);
  const bh = Math.min(H * 0.52, 420);
  const bx = (W - bw) / 2;
  const by = H * 0.16;

  // back panel
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, by, 0, by + bh);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1b2238');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0d1224');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  rr(bx, by, bw, bh, 22);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,160,255,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  rr(bx, by, bw, bh, 22);
  ctx.stroke();
  // top accent line
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,160,255,0.5)';
  rr(bx + 20, by + 10, bw - 40, 3, 1.5);
  ctx.fill();

  const title = 'SCOREBOARD';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb4e6';
  ctx.font = '700 ' + Math.round(bh * 0.075) + 'px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

/* ===================== LOOP ===================== */
function loop(ts) {
  if (!state.last) state.last = ts;
  let dt = (ts - state.last) / 1000;
  state.last = ts;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  };

  const keys = { up:false, down:false, left:false, right:false };

    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const p0 = control[(i-1+n)%n];
      const p1 = control[i];
      const p2 = control[(i+1)%n];
      const p3 = control[(i+2)%n];
      for(let j=0;j<per;j++){
        const t = j/per;
        const t2=t*t, t3=t2*t;
        const x = 0.5*((2*p1.x) + (-p0.x+p2.x)*t + (2*p0.x-5*p1.x+4*p2.x-p3.x)*t2 + (-p0.x+3*p1.x-3*p2.x+p3.x)*t3);
        const y = 0.5*((2*p1.y) + (-p0.y+p2.y)*t + (2*p0.y-5*p1.y+4*p2.y-p3.y)*t2 + (-p0.y+3*p1.y-3*p2.y+p3.y)*t3);

    x: state.player.x + state.player.w / 2,
    y: state.player.y,
    vy: -8,

  });

function update() {
  state.frame++;
  state.titlePulse += 0.05;

  if (state.screen !== 'playing') return;

  // Player movement
  if (state.keys['arrowleft'] || state.keys['a']) {
    state.player.x -= state.player.speed;
  }
  if (state.keys['arrowright'] || state.keys['d']) {
    state.player.x += state.player.speed;

  state.player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(800 - state.player.w, state.player.x));

  state.heat = Math.max(0, state.heat - 0.3);

  // Spawn enemies
  state.spawnTimer++;
  if (state.spawnTimer >= state.spawnInterval) {
    state.spawnTimer = 0;
    const type = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 'big' : 'small';
    state.enemies.push({
      x: Math.random() * 750 + 25,
      y: -30,
      w: type === 'big' ? 50 : 30,
      h: type === 'big' ? 50 : 30,
      type: type,
      speed: state.enemySpeed * (type === 'big' ? 0.7 : 1),

      hp: type === 'big' ? 3 : 1
    });

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = state.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = state.enemies[i];
    e.y += e.speed;
    e.wobble += 0.05;
    e.x += Math.sin(e.wobble) * 0.5;

    // Check if enemy reached bottom
    if (e.y > 500) {
      state.enemies.splice(i, 1);

        state.shots.splice(i, 1);
        spawnParticles(s.x, s.y, '#ffaa33', 5);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          state.enemies.splice(j, 1);
          state.score += e.type === 'big' ? 30 : 10;
          spawnParticles(e.x + e.w / 2, e.y + e.h / 2, '#ff6644', 8);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.life -= 0.02;
    if (p.life <= 0) {

  }

  // Win condition
  if (state.score >= 200) {
    state.screen = 'win';
  }

  // Difficulty ramp
  if (state.frame % 300 === 0) {

    state.spawnInterval = Math.max(40, state.spawnInterval - 5);

}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {

function draw() {

function drawHeatSheet() {
  const hs = state.heatSheet;

  // Background bar
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a3a';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4488ff';

  if (heatPct > 0) {

    heatGrad.addColorStop(0, '#44ff88');
    heatGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffaa33');

  // Label

}

function drawPlayer() {
  const p = state.player;
  const cx = p.x + p.w / 2;
  const cy = p.y + p.h / 2;

  // Engine glow
  const glowSize = 15 + Math.sin(state.frame * 0.15) * 3;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(68, 200, 255, 0.3)';

  ctx.arc(cx, cy + p.h / 2 + 5, glowSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Ship body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#44aaff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, p.y - 5);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + p.h);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy - 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#2266aa';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y + p.h);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x - 8, p.y + p.h + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x + 5, p.y + p.h);

  ctx.moveTo(p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w + 8, p.y + p.h + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w - 5, p.y + p.h);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const cx = e.x + e.w / 2;
  const cy = e.y + e.h / 2;

  if (e.type === 'big') {

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, e.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa55';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, e.w / 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Angry eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx - 8, cy - 5, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cx + 8, cy - 5, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff2222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx - 8, cy - 5, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cx + 8, cy - 5, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Spikes
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + state.frame * 0.02;
      const sx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * (e.w / 2 + 5);
      const sy = cy + Math.sin(angle) * (e.h / 2 + 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7744';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  } else {
    // Small enemy - purple
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aa44ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, e.y);
    ctx.lineTo(e.x, cy + e.h / 3);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, e.y + e.h);
    ctx.lineTo(e.x + e.w, cy + e.h / 3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#dd88ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, e.w / 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${state.score}`, 20, 30);

  // Lives
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6688';
  ctx.font = '18px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  let hearts = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) hearts += '❤️ ';
  ctx.fillText(hearts, 780, 30);
}

function drawEndScreen(text, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 500);

  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(text, 400, 200);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${state.score}`, 400, 260);

  if (Math.sin(state.titlePulse * 2) > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to play again', 400, 340);
  }
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
function gameLoop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>

window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (!keys[k]) {
    keys[k] = true;
    if (state === 'start' && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) {
      state = 'playing';
      resetGame();
    }
    if (state === 'gameover' && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) {
      state = 'start';
    }

});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;

// ===================== UPDATE =====================
function update(dt) {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Timer
  timeLeft -= dt;
  if (timeLeft <= 0) {
    timeLeft = 0;
    state = 'gameover';
    return;
  }

  // Check win
  if (score.p1 >= WIN_SCORE || score.p2 >= WIN_SCORE) {
    state = 'gameover';
    return;
  }

  // Move mittens
  const speed = 220;
  for (let m of mittens) {
    if (m.dead) continue;
    if (m.player === 1) {
      if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) m.x += speed * dt;
      if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) m.x -= speed * dt;
      if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) m.y -= speed * dt;
      if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) m.y += speed * dt;
      // Clamp to left half
      m.x = Math.max(40, Math.min(MIDDLE_X - 10, m.x));
    } else {
      if (keys['l']) m.x -= speed * dt;
      if (keys['j']) m.x += speed * dt;
      if (keys['i']) m.y -= speed * dt;
      if (keys['k']) m.y += speed * dt;
      // Clamp to right half
      m.x = Math.max(MIDDLE_X + 10, Math.min(W - 40, m.x));
    }
    m.y = Math.max(50, Math.min(H - 50, m.y));
    // Bob
    m.bobPhase += m.bobSpeed * dt;
    m.scoreFlash = Math.max(0, m.scoreFlash - dt * 2);
  }

  // Check if both in the middle zone
  const m1 = mittens[0], m2 = mittens[1];
  if (!m1.dead && !m2.dead) {
    const inZone1 = Math.hypot(m1.x - MIDDLE_X, m1.y - MIDDLE_Y) < MIDDLE_R;
    const inZone2 = Math.hypot(m2.x - MIDDLE_X, m2.y - MIDDLE_Y) < MIDDLE_R;
    if (inZone1 && inZone2) {
      // Match! Award point to both (cooperative) — actually let's do competitive:
      // Each player gets a point if they reach the center first.
      // Simpler: both reach center = both get a point. First to WIN_SCORE wins.
      // Actually, let's make it: the player who gets to center first scores.
      // But they're both in the zone simultaneously. Let's just give both a point.
      score.p1++;
      score.p2++;
      m1.scoreFlash = 1;
      m2.scoreFlash = 1;
      m1.dead = true;
      m2.dead = true;

}

// ===================== DRAW =====================
function drawBackground() {
  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1530');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2d2050');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1530');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
    const sy = (i * 97.3) % (H * 0.5);
    const sr = 1 + (i % 3) * 0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, sr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Ground
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H - 80, 0, H);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1b4332');

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';

    const px = (i * 79) % W;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px, py, 20 + (i % 3) * 10, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

  // Middle zone circle
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(MIDDLE_X, MIDDLE_Y, MIDDLE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.restore();

  // Middle zone glow
  const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(MIDDLE_X, MIDDLE_Y, 0, MIDDLE_X, MIDDLE_Y, MIDDLE_R);
  glowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)');
  glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(MIDDLE_X, MIDDLE_Y, MIDDLE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Divider line
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 8]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(MIDDLE_X, 40);
  ctx.lineTo(MIDDLE_X, H - 40);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

function drawMitten(m) {
  if (m.dead) return;
  const c = COLORS[m.colorIdx];
  const s = m.size;
  const bobY = Math.sin(m.bobPhase) * m.amplitude * 0.3;
  const x = m.x;
  const y = m.y + bobY;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';

  ctx.beginPath();

  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.15, -s * 0.55);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s * 0.5, -s * 0.5, s * 0.5, -s * 0.1);
  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.45, s * 0.5);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, s * 0.65, -s * 0.45, s * 0.5);
  ctx.fill();

  // Thumb
  ctx.fillStyle = c.main;
  ctx.beginPath();
  if (m.player === 1) {
    // Thumb on left side
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.4, -s * 0.05);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-s * 0.75, -s * 0.15, -s * 0.7, -s * 0.35);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-s * 0.65, -s * 0.5, -s * 0.45, -s * 0.4);

  } else {

    ctx.moveTo(s * 0.4, -s * 0.05);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s * 0.75, -s * 0.15, s * 0.7, -s * 0.35);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s * 0.65, -s * 0.5, s * 0.45, -s * 0.4);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  ctx.fill();

  // Cuff
  ctx.fillStyle = c.dark;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.5, s * 0.45);
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.45, s * 0.65);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, s * 0.8, s * 0.45, s * 0.65);
  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.5, s * 0.45);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = c.light;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.15, s * 0.15, s * 0.25, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  if (m.scoreFlash > 0) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${m.scoreFlash})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, s * (1.2 - m.scoreFlash * 0.5), 0, Math.PI * 2);

  }

}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    msg = 'PLAYER 1 WINS!';
    color = '#74c0fc';
  } else if (score.p2 > score.p1) {
    msg = 'PLAYER 2 WINS!';
    color = '#ffd166';
  } else {
    msg = 'DRAW!';
    color = '#c77dff';
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.font = '24px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(score.p1 + ' - ' + score.p2, W / 2, H / 2 + 15);

  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${pulse})`;
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawBackground();

  for (let m of mittens) {
    drawMitten(m);
  }

  drawHUD();

  if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (state === 'gameover') drawGameOver();
}

// ===================== GAME LOOP =====================
function loop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// Polyfill roundRect if needed
if (!ctx.roundRect) {
  CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
    if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
    const [tl, tr, br, bl] = r;
    this.moveTo(x + tl, y);
    this.lineTo(x + w - tr, y);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + tr);
    this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - br);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - br, y + h);
    this.lineTo(x + bl, y + h);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - bl);
    this.lineTo(x, y + tl);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + tl, y);
    this.closePath();
  };
}

lastTime = performance.now();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  function draw() {

    const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2;

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GRAND CLOCK', cx, cy - r * 1.25);
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(timestamp) {
    const dt = lastTime ? (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000 : 0;
    lastTime = timestamp;

      if (manualSeconds >= 60) {
        manualSeconds -= 60;

    }

  }

  function loop(timestamp) {

  const state = {
    mode: 'start',      // start | play | over
    water: 0,
    target: 0,
    level: 1,
    timeLeft: 0,
    combo: 0,
    lastClick: 0,
    particles: [],
    ripples: [],
    bubbles: [],
    splashes: [],
    floatTexts: [],
    shake: 0,
    t: 0
  };

  const COMBO_WINDOW = 650;   // ms between clicks to keep combo
  const START_TIME = 15;      // seconds per level
  const START_TARGET = 6;      // clicks per level
  const MAX_BUBBLES = 26;

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function rand(a, b){ return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function clamp(v, a, b){ return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }

  function spawnBubble(){
    state.bubbles.push({
      x: rand(0.12, 0.88) * W,

      vy: rand(28, 70),
      wob: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),

    });
  }

  function resetBubbles(){

    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BUBBLES; i++){
      const b = {
        x: rand(0.12, 0.88) * W,
        y: rand(0, H),
        r: rand(5, 16),
        vy: rand(28, 70),
        wob: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
        wobSpd: rand(1.2, 3),
        wobAmp: rand(8, 22),
        life: 1
      };
      state.bubbles.push(b);
    }
  }

  function startGame(){
    state.mode = 'play';
    state.level = 1;
    state.water = 0;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.lastClick = 0;
    state.particles = [];
    state.ripples = [];
    state.splashes = [];
    state.floatTexts = [];
    state.shake = 0;

  function startLevel(){
    state.target = START_TARGET + (state.level - 1) * 3;
    state.water = 0;
    state.timeLeft = START_TIME;
    state.combo = 0;
  }

  function onCollect(x, y){
    const now = state.t;
    if (now - state.lastClick < COMBO_WINDOW) state.combo++;
    else state.combo = 0;
    state.lastClick = now;

    const gain = 1 + Math.floor(state.combo / 3);
    state.water += gain;

    // combo burst
    const n = 10 + Math.min(state.combo, 20);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
      const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      const sp = rand(60, 260);
      state.particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 40,
        r: rand(2, 6),
        life: rand(0.5, 1.0),
        hue: rand(180, 210)
      });
    }
    // ripple
    state.ripples.push({ x, y, r: 6, max: rand(90, 150), life: 1 });
    // float text
    const txt = state.combo >= 3 ? '+' + gain + '  x' + (state.combo + 1) : '+' + gain;
    state.floatTexts.push({ x, y, txt, life: 1, big: state.combo >= 3 });

    if (state.water >= state.target){
      state.level++;
      startLevel();
      state.shake = 10;
      // celebration splash
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++){
        const a = rand(-Math.PI, 0);
        const sp = rand(120, 320);
        state.particles.push({
          x: W / 2, y: H * 0.5,
          vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
          vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
          r: rand(3, 8),
          life: rand(0.6, 1.2),
          hue: rand(180, 215)
        });

  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  function handlePointer(e){
    if (state.mode === 'start'){
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state.mode === 'over'){
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state.mode === 'play'){
      let cx, cy;
      if (e.touches){
        cx = e.touches[0].clientX; cy = e.touches[0].clientY;
      } else {
        cx = e.clientX; cy = e.clientY;
      }
      onCollect(cx, cy);

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    handlePointer(e);
  }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter'){
      if (state.mode !== 'play'){
        startGame();
      }
    }
  });

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update(dt){
    state.t += dt * 1000;

    // ambient bubbles
    for (const b of state.bubbles){
      b.y -= b.vy * dt;
      b.wob += b.wobSpd * dt;
      if (b.y < -20){
        b.y = H + rand(0, 30);
        b.x = rand(0.12, 0.88) * W;
        b.r = rand(5, 16);
        b.vy = rand(28, 70);
      }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const p = state.particles[i];
      p.vy += 420 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= dt * 1.2;
      if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // ripples
    for (let i = state.ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const r = state.ripples[i];
      r.r += (r.max - r.r) * dt * 3 + 40 * dt;
      r.life -= dt * 1.4;
      if (r.life <= 0) state.ripples.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // float texts
    for (let i = state.floatTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const f = state.floatTexts[i];
      f.y -= 40 * dt;
      f.life -= dt * 0.9;
      if (f.life <= 0) state.floatTexts.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // shake decay
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 40);

    // timer
    if (state.mode === 'play'){
      state.timeLeft -= dt;
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0){
        state.timeLeft = 0;

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawBackground(){

    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#123a5c');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0d2f4c');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#071e30');

      ctx.save();

      bg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');
      bg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(180,230,255,0.25)');
      bg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,200,255,0.05)');
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

  }

  function drawStation(){
    const cx = W / 2;

    const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.16;

    if (state.shake > 0){

    const botY = baseY + R * 1.5;

    ctx.moveTo(cx, topY);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + R * 1.15, topY + R * 1.2, cx + R * 1.15, botY, cx, botY);

    dg.addColorStop(0, '#bfeeff');
    dg.addColorStop(0.5, '#57c6f0');
    dg.addColorStop(1, '#1f8fc4');
    ctx.fillStyle = dg;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,200,255,0.6)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx - R * 0.45, baseY - R * 0.5, R * 0.22, R * 0.5, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.fill();

    // nozzle / tap at bottom
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2aa9d8';
    ctx.fillRect(cx - R * 0.18, botY - 4, R * 0.36, R * 0.35);

      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - ringR, ringCy, cx + ringR, ringCy);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#7ff0c8');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#37c9ff');
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, ringCy, ringR, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + frac * Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(R * 0.7) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('tap fast for combos', W - 20, 32);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fe0ff';
    ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('water: ' + state.water + ' / ' + state.target, W - 20, 52);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStart(){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(Math.min(W, H) * 0.09) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('WATER STATION', W / 2, H * 0.22);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fe0ff';
    ctx.font = '20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Tap / click the water drop to fill it', W / 2, H * 0.3);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
    ctx.fillText('Tap fast for combos and bonus water', W / 2, H * 0.34);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
    ctx.fillText('Fill each level before the timer runs out', W / 2, H * 0.38);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.t * 0.005) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#37c9ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('CLICK TO START', W / 2, H * 0.78);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOver(){
    ctx.save();
    // dim
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,18,30,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(Math.min(W, H) * 0.09) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('TIME UP', W / 2, H * 0.28);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('You reached level ' + state.level, W / 2, H * 0.4);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fe0ff';
    ctx.font = '20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Water collected: ' + state.water, W / 2, H * 0.46);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.t * 0.005) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#37c9ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN', W / 2, H * 0.72);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBackground();
    drawStation();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
    if (state.mode === 'start') drawStart();
    if (state.mode === 'over') drawOver();
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp big gaps
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();

  timer: 0,
  countDuration: 1.0,
  zeroFlash: 0,
  doneTime: 0,
  particles: [],
  stars: [],
  ripples: [],
  pulse: 0,
  shakeX: 0,
  shakeY: 0,
};

// ── Stars (background) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
  state.stars.push({
    x: Math.random(),
    y: Math.random(),
    size: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
    twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
  });
}

// ── Particle helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function spawnBurst(x, y, color, count, speed) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const spd = Math.random() * speed + speed * 0.3;
    state.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd,
      life: 1,
      decay: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.015,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
      color,
    });
  }
}

function spawnRipple(x, y, color) {
  state.ripples.push({ x, y, radius: 10, maxRadius: 200, life: 1, color });
}

// ── Input ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function startCountdown() {
  state.phase = 'counting';
  state.count = 10;
  state.timer = 0;
  state.particles = [];
  state.ripples = [];
}

canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (state.phase === 'title') {
    startCountdown();
  } else if (state.phase === 'done') {
    state.phase = 'title';
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
    if (state.phase === 'title') {
      startCountdown();
    } else if (state.phase === 'done') {
      state.phase = 'title';
    }
  }
});

// ── Update ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let lastTime = performance.now();

function update(dt) {
  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2;

  // Twinkle stars
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    s.twinkle += s.speed * dt;
  }

  if (state.phase === 'counting') {
    state.timer += dt;
    state.pulse = state.timer / state.countDuration;

    const newCount = 10 - Math.floor(state.timer / state.countDuration);

    if (newCount !== state.count && newCount >= 0) {
      state.count = Math.max(newCount, 0);
      if (state.count > 0) {
        const colors = ['#ff6b6b','#ffd93d','#6bcb77','#4d96ff','#ff6bcb'];
        const c = colors[state.count % colors.length];
        spawnBurst(cx, cy, c, 20, 200);
        spawnRipple(cx, cy, c);
        state.shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
        state.shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
      }
      if (state.count === 0) {
        state.phase = 'zero';
        state.zeroFlash = 0;
        spawnBurst(cx, cy, '#ffffff', 60, 300);
        spawnBurst(cx, cy, '#ff6b6b', 40, 250);
        spawnBurst(cx, cy, '#ffd93d', 40, 250);
        spawnRipple(cx, cy, '#ffffff');
        spawnRipple(cx, cy, '#ff6b6b');
        state.shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15;
        state.shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15;
      }
    }

    // Decay shake
    state.shakeX *= 0.85;
    state.shakeY *= 0.85;
  }

  if (state.phase === 'zero') {
    state.zeroFlash += dt;
    state.shakeX *= 0.9;
    state.shakeY *= 0.9;
    if (state.zeroFlash > 2.5) {
      state.phase = 'done';
      state.doneTime = 0;
    }
  }

  if (state.phase === 'done') {
    state.doneTime += dt;
    state.shakeX *= 0.9;
    state.shakeY *= 0.9;
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 80 * dt;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update ripples
  for (let i = state.ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const r = state.ripples[i];
    r.radius += 300 * dt;
    r.life -= dt * 0.8;
    if (r.life <= 0) state.ripples.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ── Draw helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawBackground() {
  const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(w/2, h/2, 0, w/2, h/2, Math.max(w,h)*0.7);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1f3a');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0f1225');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#060812');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Stars
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.twinkle));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 210, 255, ${alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x * w, s.y * h, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawRing(cx, cy, radius, progress, color, lineWidth) {
  const startAngle = -Math.PI / 2;
  const endAngle = startAngle + progress * Math.PI * 2;

  // Background ring
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Progress arc
  if (progress > 0) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, startAngle, endAngle);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();

    // Glow
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, startAngle, endAngle);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color.replace(')', ',0.3)').replace('rgb', 'rgba');
    ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth + 8;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawNumber(cx, cy, num, scale, color, alpha) {
  const fontSize = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.25 * scale;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  // Glow
  ctx.shadowColor = color;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(num, cx, cy);

  // Crisp text on top
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(num, cx, cy);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawRipples() {
  for (const r of state.ripples) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = r.life * 0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3 * r.life;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawTitle() {
  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2;
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;

  // Pulsing ring
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2);
  const ringRadius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.2 + pulse * 10;

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, ringRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100, 140, 255, ${0.3 + pulse * 0.3})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, ringRadius + 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100, 140, 255, ${0.1 + pulse * 0.1})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Title text
  const titleSize = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.08;
  ctx.font = `bold ${titleSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#4d96ff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4d96ff';
  ctx.fillText('COUNTDOWN', cx, cy - titleSize * 0.3);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Subtitle
  const subSize = titleSize * 0.4;
  const blink = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 3);
  ctx.font = `${subSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.4 + blink * 0.4})`;
  ctx.fillText('click or press space to start', cx, cy + titleSize * 0.8);

  // Decorative numbers floating
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const angle = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2 + t * 0.3;
    const r = ringRadius + 30 + Math.sin(t + i) * 5;
    const nx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
    const ny = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
    const numSize = titleSize * 0.3;
    ctx.font = `${numSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.15 + 0.1 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i)})`;
    ctx.fillText(String(i + 1), nx, ny);
  }
}

function drawCounting() {
  const cx = canvas.width / 2 + state.shakeX;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2 + state.shakeY;
  const progress = state.pulse;
  const ringRadius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.25;
  const ringWidth = ringRadius * 0.08;

  const colors = ['#ff6b6b','#ffd93d','#6bcb77','#4d96ff','#ff6bcb'];
  const color = colors[state.count % colors.length];

  // Ring
  drawRing(cx, cy, ringRadius, progress, color, ringWidth);

  // Number
  const scale = 1 + (1 - progress) * 0.15;
  const alpha = 1 - Math.max(0, (progress - 0.8) * 5);
  drawNumber(cx, cy, state.count, scale, color, Math.max(alpha, 0.1));

  // Progress bar at bottom
  const barW = Math.min(canvas.width * 0.4, 400);
  const barH = 8;
  const barX = cx - barW / 2;
  const barY = canvas.height * 0.85;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * (1 - progress), barH);

  // Label
  const labelSize = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.03;
  ctx.font = `${labelSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(`${state.count} / 10`, cx, barY - labelSize * 0.5);
}

function drawZero() {
  const cx = canvas.width / 2 + state.shakeX;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2 + state.shakeY;
  const t = state.zeroFlash;

  // Flash overlay
  if (t < 0.3) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(1 - t / 0.3) * 0.5})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  }

  // Big zero
  const scale = 1 + t * 0.5;
  const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - t / 2);
  drawNumber(cx, cy, 0, scale, '#ffffff', alpha);

  // "GO!" text appears
  if (t > 0.5) {
    const goAlpha = Math.min(1, (t - 0.5) * 3);
    const goSize = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.15;
    ctx.font = `bold ${goSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6b6b';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,107,107,${goAlpha})`;
    ctx.fillText('GO!', cx, cy + goSize * 0.8);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
}

function drawDone() {
  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2;
  const t = state.doneTime;
  const alpha = Math.min(1, t * 2);

  const titleSize = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.06;
  ctx.font = `bold ${titleSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
  ctx.fillText('DONE', cx, cy - titleSize * 0.3);

  const subSize = titleSize * 0.4;
  const blink = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 3);
  ctx.font = `${subSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha * (0.4 + blink * 0.4)})`;
  ctx.fillText('click or press space to restart', cx, cy + titleSize * 0.8);
}

// ── Draw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawRipples();
  drawParticles();

  if (state.phase === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
  } else if (state.phase === 'counting') {
    drawCounting();
  } else if (state.phase === 'zero') {
    drawZero();
  } else if (state.phase === 'done') {
    drawDone();
  }
}

// ── Game Loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Personal Record Flash</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #05070f; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ============ CANVAS ============ */
var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
var W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
function resize(){
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px'; canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ============ STATE ============ */
var state = 'start'; // start | playing | win | lose
var score = 0;
var best = 0;
var target = 25;
var elapsed = 0;
var holdTime = 0;
var holdProgress = 0;
var combo = 1;
var comboTimer = 0;
var miss = 0;
var maxMiss = 3;
var flashes = [];   // captured flashes
var particles = [];
var confetti = [];
var shake = 0;
var winFlash = 0;
var loseFlash = 0;
var bestFlash = 0;
var time = 0;

// runner
var runner = { x: 0, y: 0, phase: 0 };

// flash generation
var flashTimer = 0;
var flashInterval = 1.1;

function reset(){
  score = 0; best = 0; elapsed = 0;
  holdTime = 0; holdProgress = 0;
  combo = 1; comboTimer = 0; miss = 0;
  flashes = []; particles = []; confetti = [];
  flashTimer = 0.4;
  shake = 0; winFlash = 0; loseFlash = 0; bestFlash = 0;
}

function spawnFlash(){
  var x = 120 + Math.random() * (W - 240);
  var y = H * 0.18 + Math.random() * (H * 0.42);
  flashes.push({
    x: x, y: y,
    r: 34 + Math.random() * 22,
    hue: 45 + Math.random() * 30,
    life: 0, maxLife: 2.4,
    captured: false,
    pulse: Math.random() * 6.28
  });
}

/* ============ INPUT ============ */
function flashAt(mx, my){
  for (var i = flashes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    var f = flashes[i];
    if (f.captured) continue;
    var dx = mx - f.x, dy = my - f.y;
    if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= f.r*f.r){
      captureFlash(f);
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
function captureFlash(f){
  f.captured = true;
  f.capturedAt = time;
  holdTime += 0.18;
  holdProgress = Math.min(1, holdTime / 1.6);
  comboTimer = 2.2;
  combo = Math.min(5, combo + 0.25);
  var pts = Math.round(10 * combo);
  score += pts;
  if (score > best) best = score;
  burst(f.x, f.y, f.hue, 14);
  spawnFloat(f.x, f.y, '+' + pts);
  if (score >= target && state === 'playing') triggerWin();
}
function missFlash(){
  combo = 1; comboTimer = 0;
  miss++;
  burst(W/2, H*0.5, 0, 0);
  if (miss >= maxMiss && state === 'playing') triggerLose();
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
  var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (state === 'playing') flashAt(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose'){
    reset(); state = 'playing'; return;
  }
  var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (state === 'playing') flashAt(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose'){
    reset(); state = 'playing'; return;
  }
  var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  var t = e.touches[0];
  flashAt(t.clientX - r.left, t.clientY - r.top);
}, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  e.preventDefault();
  var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  var t = e.touches[0];
  flashAt(t.clientX - r.left, t.clientY - r.top);
}, {passive:false});
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space'){
    if (state === 'start' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose'){
      reset(); state = 'playing';
    }
  }
});

/* ============ HELPERS ============ */
function burst(x, y, hue, n){
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){
    var a = Math.random() * 6.28, sp = 60 + Math.random() * 220;
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(a)*sp, vy: Math.sin(a)*sp - 40,
      life: 0, maxLife: 0.5 + Math.random()*0.6,
      hue: hue, size: 2 + Math.random()*4
    });
  }
}
var floats = [];
function spawnFloat(x, y, text){
  floats.push({ x: x, y: y, text: text, life: 0, maxLife: 1.0 });
}
function triggerWin(){
  state = 'win'; winFlash = 1;
  for (var i = 0; i < 140; i++){
    confetti.push({
      x: Math.random()*W, y: -20 - Math.random()*H*0.5,
      vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*60, vy: 80 + Math.random()*160,
      rot: Math.random()*6.28, vr: (Math.random()-0.5)*8,
      hue: Math.random()*360, size: 5 + Math.random()*7
    });
  }
}
function triggerLose(){
  state = 'lose'; loseFlash = 1;
}

/* ============ UPDATE ============ */
function update(dt){
  time += dt;
  if (state === 'playing'){
    elapsed += dt;
    // difficulty ramp
    flashInterval = Math.max(0.55, 1.1 - elapsed * 0.015);
    flashTimer += dt;
    if (flashTimer >= flashInterval){ flashTimer = 0; spawnFlash(); }

    // combo decay
    if (comboTimer > 0){ comboTimer -= dt; if (comboTimer <= 0) combo = 1; }

    // expire flashes
    for (var i = flashes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      var f = flashes[i];
      f.life += dt; f.pulse += dt * 4;
      if (f.captured){
        if (time - f.capturedAt > 0.4) flashes.splice(i,1);
      } else if (f.life > f.maxLife){
        flashes.splice(i,1);
        missFlash();
      }
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    var p = particles[i];
    p.life += dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 320 * dt;
    if (p.life > p.maxLife) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
  // floats
  for (var i = floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    var fl = floats[i];
    fl.life += dt; fl.y -= 40 * dt;
    if (fl.life > fl.maxLife) floats.splice(i,1);
  }
  // confetti
  for (var i = confetti.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    var c = confetti[i];
    c.x += c.vx * dt; c.y += c.vy * dt; c.rot += c.vr * dt;
    if (c.y > H + 30) confetti.splice(i,1);
  }
  // decays
  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 3);
  if (winFlash > 0) winFlash = Math.max(0, winFlash - dt * 0.8);
  if (loseFlash > 0) loseFlash = Math.max(0, loseFlash - dt * 0.8);
  if (bestFlash > 0) bestFlash = Math.max(0, bestFlash - dt * 0.8);
  runner.phase += dt * 10;
}

/* ============ DRAW ============ */
function drawBackground(){
  // sky gradient
  var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1024');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#141a33');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#05070f');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  for (var i = 0; i < 60; i++){
    var sx = (i * 97) % W;
    var sy = (i * 53) % (H * 0.5);
    var tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 1.5 + i));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw * 0.8;
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // distant hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0c1330';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H*0.72);
  for (var x = 0; x <= W; x += 40){
    ctx.lineTo(x, H*0.72 - 30*Math.sin(x*0.01 + 1));
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // track
  var tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H*0.8, 0, H);
  tg.addColorStop(0, '#1a1120');
  tg.addColorStop(1, '#0a0610');
  ctx.fillStyle = tg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H*0.8, W, H*0.2);
  // lane lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,120,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (var l = 0; l < 4; l++){
    var ly = H*0.84 + l * (H*0.05);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, ly); ctx.lineTo(W, ly); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // start line
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(W*0.1, H*0.8, 6, H*0.2);
}

function drawFlash(f){
  var fade;
  if (f.captured){
    fade = Math.max(0, 1 - (time - f.capturedAt)/0.4);
    var grow = 1 + (time - f.capturedAt) * 3;
    ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + f.hue + ',100%,70%)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r * grow, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    return;
  }
  fade = 1 - f.life / f.maxLife;
  if (fade < 0) fade = 0;
  var pulse = 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(f.pulse);
  var r = f.r * pulse;
  // glow
  var gl = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 0, f.x, f.y, r*1.8);
  gl.addColorStop(0, 'hsla(' + f.hue + ',100%,85%,' + (0.9*fade) + ')');
  gl.addColorStop(0.5, 'hsla(' + f.hue + ',100%,60%,' + (0.4*fade) + ')');
  gl.addColorStop(1, 'hsla(' + f.hue + ',100%,50%,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gl;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, r*1.8, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  // core
  ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + f.hue + ',100%,92%)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, r*0.55, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  // ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + f.hue + ',100%,80%,' + fade + ')';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, r, 0, 6.28); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawRunner(){
  var rx = W * 0.14;
  var ry = H * 0.86;
  runner.x = rx; runner.y = ry;
  var bob = Math.sin(runner.phase) * 4;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(rx, ry + bob);
  // legs
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff9a3c'; ctx.lineWidth = 6; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  var leg = Math.sin(runner.phase) * 14;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 8); ctx.lineTo(-leg, 26); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 8); ctx.lineTo(leg, 26); ctx.stroke();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-8, -14, 16, 24, 5); ctx.fill();
  // arms
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff9a3c'; ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  var arm = Math.cos(runner.phase) * 12;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-2, -6); ctx.lineTo(-14 + arm, 4); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(2, -6); ctx.lineTo(14 - arm, 4); ctx.stroke();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe0b0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -22, 8, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles(){
  for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++){
    var p = particles[i];
    var a = 1 - p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, a);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + p.hue + ',100%,70%)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * a, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
function drawFloats(){
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  for (var i = 0; i < floats.length; i++){
    var f = floats[i];
    var a = 1 - f.life / f.maxLife;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, a);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2b0';
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
function drawConfetti(){
  for (var i = 0; i < confetti.length; i++){
    var c = confetti[i];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y); ctx.rotate(c.rot);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + c.hue + ',90%,65%)';
    ctx.fillRect(-c.size/2, -c.size/2, c.size, c.size*0.6);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, 24, 44);
  ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
  ctx.fillText('TARGET  ' + target, 24, 70);
  // best
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = bestFlash > 0 ? '#fff2b0' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.fillText('BEST  ' + best, W - 24, 44);
  // misses as hearts
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  for (var i = 0; i < maxMiss; i++){
    ctx.fillStyle = i < (maxMiss - miss) ? '#ff5b6e' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.font = '22px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('\u2665', W - 24 - i * 26, 74);
  }
  // progress bar
  var bw = Math.min(360, W * 0.5);
  var bx = W/2 - bw/2, by = 24, bh = 12;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 6); ctx.fill();
  var prog = Math.min(1, score / target);
  if (prog > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw * prog, bh, 6); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 6); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GOAL', W/2, by + bh + 16);
}

function drawCenter(title, sub, color, flash){
  if (flash > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (flash * 0.5) + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(64, W*0.08) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H*0.42);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H*0.5);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake*10, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake*10);
  }
  drawBackground();
  for (var i = 0; i < flashes.length; i++) drawFlash(flashes[i]);
  drawParticles();
  drawRunner();
  drawFloats();
  drawConfetti();
  ctx.restore();

  if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();

  if (state === 'start'){
    drawCenter('PERSONAL RECORD', 'Flash  \u2022  Capture the light  \u2022  Reach ' + target, '#ffd24a', 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Move or click through the flashes before they fade. Miss 3 and it\u2019s over.', W/2, H*0.58);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2b0';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click / Tap / Press Space to start', W/2, H*0.66);
  } else if (state === 'win'){
    drawCenter('NEW PERSONAL RECORD!', 'You reached the goal with ' + score + ' points', '#7dff9b', winFlash);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
    ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to run it again', W/2, H*0.58);
  } else if (state === 'lose'){
    drawCenter('RECORD MISSED', 'The light faded \u2014 you scored ' + score, '#ff5b6e', loseFlash);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
    ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to try again', W/2, H*0.58);
  }
}

/* ============ LOOP ============ */
var last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  var dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chore Spinner</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    color: #fff;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

    display: block;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ==================== STATE ====================
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = 500, H = 600;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

const chores = [
  'Dishes', 'Vacuum', 'Laundry', 'Dust',
  'Mop', 'Dishes', 'Windows', 'Sweep',
  'Dishes', 'Trash', 'Dishes', 'Iron'
];

const colors = [
  '#e94560', '#f5a623', '#4ecdc4', '#7c6ff7',
  '#ff6b9d', '#4ecdc4', '#f5a623', '#e94560',
  '#4ecdc4', '#7c6ff7', '#f5a623', '#ff6b9d'
];

let state = 'idle'; // idle | spinning | done
let angle = 0;
let spinSpeed = 0;
let targetAngle = 0;
let selectedChore = '';
let particles = [];
let time = 0;

const cx = W / 2;
const cy = 240;
const radius = 160;
const numSlices = chores.length;
const sliceAngle = (2 * Math.PI) / numSlices;

// ==================== INPUT ====================
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (state === 'idle') {
    state = 'spinning';
    const extra = Math.random() * Math.PI * 4 + Math.PI * 4;
    targetAngle = angle + extra;
    spinSpeed = 0;
  } else if (state === 'done') {
    state = 'idle';
    selectedChore = '';
    particles = [];
  }
});

// ==================== UPDATE ====================
function update(dt) {
  time += dt;

  if (state === 'spinning') {
    const diff = targetAngle - angle;
    if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.001) {
      angle = targetAngle;
      state = 'done';
      const idx = getSliceIndex(angle);
      selectedChore = chores[idx];
      spawnParticles();
    } else {
      const t = 0.02;
      const newAngle = angle + diff * t * (1 + 2 * dt);
      angle = newAngle;
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 300 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function getSliceIndex(a) {
  const norm = ((a % (2 * Math.PI)) + 2 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI);
  const idx = Math.floor(norm / sliceAngle) % numSlices;
  return idx;
}

function spawnParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * 2 * Math.PI;
    const speed = 80 + Math.random() * 160;
    particles.push({
      x: cx, y: cy,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * speed - 60,
      life: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.6,
      color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 5
    });
  }
}

// ==================== DRAW ====================
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Background gradient
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a2e');
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#16213e');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Decorative background circles
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.06;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const bx = 60 + (i * 80) % W;
    const by = 50 + (i * 120) % H;
    const br = 30 + (i * 15) % 50;
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[i % colors.length];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bx, by, br, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('CHORE SPINNER', cx, 50);

  ctx.font = '15px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
  ctx.fillText('Click the wheel to spin', cx, 75);

  // Wheel shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx + 4, cy + 4, radius + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Wheel outer ring
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2d2d44';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Draw slices
  for (let i = 0; i < numSlices; i++) {
    const startA = angle + i * sliceAngle;
    const endA = startA + sliceAngle;

    ctx.fillStyle = colors[i];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, startA, endA);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Slice border
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Label
    const midA = startA + sliceAngle / 2;
    const lx = cx + Math.cos(midA) * radius * 0.6;
    const ly = cy + Math.sin(midA) * radius * 0.6;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(lx, ly);
    ctx.rotate(midA + Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(chores[i], 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Center circle
  const cc = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, 35);
  cc.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
  cc.addColorStop(1, '#ddd');
  ctx.fillStyle = cc;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#999';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Pointer / needle at top
  const pointerY = cy - radius - 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, pointerY + 20);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - 12, pointerY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + 12, pointerY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Result text
  if (state === 'done' && selectedChore) {
    const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(time * 4) * 0.05;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy + radius + 60);
    ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    const tw = ctx.measureText(selectedChore).width;
    roundRect(-tw/2 - 20, -25, tw + 40, 50, 12);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = colors[getSliceIndex(angle)];
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(-tw/2 - 20, -25, tw + 40, 50, 12);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(selectedChore, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '14px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Click to spin again', cx, cy + radius + 100);
  }

  // Particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ==================== LOOP ====================
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(ts) {
  const dt = Math.min((ts - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = ts;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame((ts) => { lastTime = ts; loop(ts); });
</script>
</body>

<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #2b3a55, #131b2b);
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }
</style>
