<canvas id="scene" width="760" height="520"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var canvas = document.getElementById("scene");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  var cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2 - 8, R = 168;

  // ---- State ----
  var slices = [
    { name: "Strawberry", value: 45, base: 0,    color: "#e8556d", light: "#f28aa0" },
    { name: "Blueberry",  value: 30, base: 0,    color: "#5b7bd6", light: "#8ea6ef" },
    { name: "Lemon",      value: 25, base: 0,    color: "#f2c14e", light: "#f7d98a" }
  ];
  var total = slices.reduce(function (s, x) { return s + x.value; }, 0);
  var startAngle = -Math.PI / 2;
  slices.forEach(function (s) {
    s.start = startAngle;
    s.end = startAngle + (s.value / total) * Math.PI * 2;
    startAngle = s.end;
    s.mid = (s.start + s.end) / 2;
  });

  var t = 0;
  var hover = -1;
  var selected = -1;
  var pointer = { x: cx, y: cy };

  // ---- Helpers ----
  function polar(angle, r) {
    return { x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * r, y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * r };
  }
  function distToSegment(px, py, a, b) {
    var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
    var len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    var tval = len2 ? ((px - a.x) * dx + (py - a.y) * dy) / len2 : 0;
    tval = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tval));
    var qx = a.x + tval * dx, qy = a.y + tval * dy;
    return Math.hypot(px - qx, py - qy);
  }
  function sliceAt(x, y) {
    var dx = x - cx, dy = y - cy;
    if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > R + 12) return -1;
    var ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    for (var i = 0; i < slices.length; i++) {
      var s = slices[i];
      var a = s.start, b = s.end;
      if (a < b) { if (ang >= a && ang <= b) return i; }
      else { if (ang >= a || ang <= b) return i; }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  // ---- Input ----
  function toCanvas(e) {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width), y: (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height) };
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
    var p = toCanvas(e);
    pointer = p;
    hover = sliceAt(p.x, p.y);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { hover = -1; });
  canvas.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var p = toCanvas(e);
    var i = sliceAt(p.x, p.y);
    if (i >= 0) selected = (selected === i) ? -1 : i;
    else selected = -1;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
    if (e.touches.length) {
      var p = toCanvas(e.touches[0]);
      pointer = p;
      hover = sliceAt(p.x, p.y);
      selected = (hover === selected) ? -1 : hover;
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(dt) {
    t += dt;
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function draw() {
    // table / background
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    var bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy - 40, 40, cx, cy, 420);
    bg.addColorStop(0, "#3d5178");
    bg.addColorStop(1, "#161f33");
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // plate
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 26, R + 46, (R + 46) * 0.92, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f3efe6";
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 26;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 14;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 22, R + 30, (R + 30) * 0.92, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fbf8f1";
    ctx.fill();

    // soft shadow under pie
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 14, R + 8, (R + 8) * 0.95, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.10)";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // slices
    slices.forEach(function (s, i) {
      var isSel = selected === i;
      var isHov = hover === i;
      var lift = isSel ? 26 : (isHov ? 12 : 0);
      var ox = Math.cos(s.mid) * lift;
      var oy = Math.sin(s.mid) * lift;

      // side (extrusion) for 3D feel
      var depth = 16;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx + ox, cy + oy);
      ctx.arc(cx + ox, cy + oy, R, s.start, s.end, false);
      ctx.closePath();
      // extrude
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(polar(s.start, R).x + ox, polar(s.start, R).y + oy);
      ctx.lineTo(polar(s.start, R).x + ox, polar(s.start, R).y + oy + depth);
      ctx.lineTo(polar(s.end, R).x + ox, polar(s.end, R).y + oy + depth);
      ctx.lineTo(polar(s.end, R).x + ox, polar(s.end, R).y + oy);
      ctx.arc(cx + ox, cy + oy, R, s.end, s.start, true);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = shade(s.color, -28);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      // top face
      var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + ox, cy + oy - 30, 20, cx + ox, cy + oy, R);
      g.addColorStop(0, s.light);
      g.addColorStop(1, s.color);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx + ox, cy + oy);
      ctx.arc(cx + ox, cy + oy, R, s.start, s.end, false);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fill();

      // crust edge
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx + ox, cy + oy);
      ctx.arc(cx + ox, cy + oy, R, s.start, s.end, false);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeStyle = shade(s.color, -40);
      ctx.stroke();
    });

    // center dot
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.fill();

    // labels
    slices.forEach(function (s, i) {
      var isSel = selected === i;
      var isHov = hover === i;
      var lift = isSel ? 26 : (isHov ? 12 : 0);
      var lp = polar(s.mid, R * 0.62);
      var x = lp.x + Math.cos(s.mid) * lift;
      var y = lp.y + Math.sin(s.mid) * lift;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.font = "bold 20px Georgia, serif";
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
      ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.fillText(s.name, x, y - 8);
      ctx.font = "16px Georgia, serif";
      ctx.fillText(Math.round((s.value / total) * 100) + "%", x, y + 14);
      ctx.restore();
    });

    // title
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4efe4";
    ctx.font = "bold 30px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText("Three-Slice Pie", cx, 46);
    ctx.font = "15px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,239,228,0.7)";
    ctx.fillText("Click a slice to lift it · hover to preview", cx, 70);
    ctx.restore();

    // info panel
    drawInfo();
  }

  function drawInfo() {
    var idx = selected >= 0 ? selected : hover;
    var s = idx >= 0 ? slices[idx] : null;
    var panel = { x: W - 236, y: H - 96, w: 210, h: 70 };
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,28,44,0.85)";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    roundRect(panel.x, panel.y, panel.w, panel.h, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    if (s) {
      ctx.fillStyle = s.light;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(panel.x + 22, panel.y + panel.h / 2, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f4efe4";
      ctx.font = "bold 17px Georgia, serif";
      ctx.fillText(s.name, panel.x + 40, panel.y + 24);
      ctx.font = "14px Georgia, serif";
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,239,228,0.75)";
      ctx.fillText("Value: " + s.value + "  ·  " + Math.round((s.value / total) * 100) + "%", panel.x + 40, panel.y + 48);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,239,228,0.7)";
      ctx.font = "15px Georgia, serif";
      ctx.fillText("No slice selected", panel.x + 22, panel.y + panel.h / 2);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function shade(hex, amt) {
    var n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    var r = (n >> 16) + amt, g = ((n >> 8) & 0xff) + amt, b = (n & 0xff) + amt;
    r = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, r));
    g = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, g));
    b = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, b));
    return "rgb(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ")";
  }

  // ---- Loop ----
  var last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Midnight Countdown</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body {
    background: #0a0e1a;
    font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
// ===== State =====
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W, H;
let phase = 'title'; // title | countdown | midnight
let targetMidnight = new Date();
targetMidnight.setHours(24, 0, 0, 0);
let startTime = Date.now();
let titleStart = Date.now();
let midnightFlash = 0;
let lastSec = -1;

// stars
let stars = [];
function genStars() {
  stars = [];
  const count = Math.floor(W * H / 3500);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H * 0.65,
      r: Math.random() * 1.8 + 0.3,
      tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      sp: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.005
    });
  }
}

function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  genStars();
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ===== Input =====
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (phase === 'title') {
    phase = 'countdown';
    startTime = Date.now();
  } else if (phase === 'midnight') {
    phase = 'title';
    titleStart = Date.now();
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
    if (phase === 'title') {
      phase = 'countdown';
      startTime = Date.now();
    } else if (phase === 'midnight') {
      phase = 'title';
      titleStart = Date.now();
    }
  }
});

// ===== Helpers =====
function easeOut(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }
function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

// ===== Update =====
function update() {
  const now = Date.now();

  if (phase === 'countdown') {
    const diff = targetMidnight.getTime() - now;
    if (diff <= 0) {
      phase = 'midnight';
      midnightFlash = now;
    }
  }

  // twinkle
  for (const s of stars) {
    s.tw += s.sp;
  }
}

// ===== Draw =====
function drawSky() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#05081a');
  g.addColorStop(0.35, '#0d1230');
  g.addColorStop(0.65, '#1a1040');
  g.addColorStop(0.85, '#2a1545');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#3a1a50');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawStars() {
  for (const s of stars) {
    const a = 0.3 + 0.7 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.tw));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220, 230, 255, ${a})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawMoon() {
  const mx = W * 0.82;
  const my = H * 0.15;
  const mr = Math.min(W, H) * 0.06;

  // glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx, my, mr * 0.5, mx, my, mr * 3);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(200, 210, 255, 0.25)');
  glow.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(150, 160, 220, 0.08)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100, 100, 180, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(mx, my, mr * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // moon body
  const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx - mr * 0.2, my - mr * 0.2, mr * 0.1, mx, my, mr);
  mg.addColorStop(0, '#f0f0ff');
  mg.addColorStop(0.6, '#d0d0e8');
  mg.addColorStop(1, '#a0a0c0');
  ctx.fillStyle = mg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(mx, my, mr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // craters
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120, 120, 160, 0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx - mr * 0.25, my - mr * 0.15, mr * 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + mr * 0.2, my + mr * 0.25, mr * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + mr * 0.35, my - mr * 0.3, mr * 0.08, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

function drawCity() {
  const baseY = H * 0.72;
  const buildingCount = Math.floor(W / 30);

  // far buildings (darker)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0e0e22';
  for (let i = 0; i < buildingCount; i++) {
    const bw = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
    const bh = 40 + Math.random() * 120;
    const bx = (i / buildingCount) * W + Math.random() * 10;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, baseY - bh, bw, bh + H * 0.3);
  }

  // near buildings
  for (let i = 0; i < buildingCount * 0.7; i++) {
    const bw = 25 + Math.random() * 40;
    const bh = 60 + Math.random() * 180;
    const bx = (i / (buildingCount * 0.7)) * W + Math.random() * 15;
    const by = baseY - bh;

    // building body
    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, by, bx + bw, by);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#151530');
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a40');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh + H * 0.3);

    // windows
    const cols = Math.floor(bw / 12);
    const rows = Math.floor(bh / 18);
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        if (Math.random() > 0.45) {
          const wx = bx + 4 + c * 12;
          const wy = by + 6 + r * 18;
          const warm = Math.random() > 0.5;
          ctx.fillStyle = warm ? 'rgba(255, 220, 100, 0.7)' : 'rgba(150, 200, 255, 0.5)';
          ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 6, 8);
        }
      }
    }

    // roof detail
    if (Math.random() > 0.6) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#202050';
      ctx.fillRect(bx + bw * 0.3, by - 8, bw * 0.4, 8);
    }
  }

  // ground
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, baseY, 0, H);
  gg.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a1e');
  gg.addColorStop(1, '#050510');
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, baseY, W, H - baseY);
}

function drawClockTower() {
  const cx = W * 0.5;
  const baseY = H * 0.72;
  const towerW = Math.min(W, H) * 0.08;
  const towerH = H * 0.35;
  const topY = baseY - towerH;

  // tower body
  const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - towerW, 0, cx + towerW, 0);
  tg.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a3a');
  tg.addColorStop(0.5, '#252550');
  tg.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a3a');
  ctx.fillStyle = tg;
  ctx.fillRect(cx - towerW, topY, towerW * 2, towerH);

  // tower top (pyramid)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a55';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - towerW * 1.2, topY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx, topY - towerH * 0.25);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + towerW * 1.2, topY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // clock face
  const clockR = towerW * 0.7;
  const clockY = topY + towerH * 0.2;
  const now = new Date();
  const h = now.getHours() % 12;
  const m = now.getMinutes();
  const s = now.getSeconds();

  // clock background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0d25';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, clockY, clockR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // clock ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a80';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, clockY, clockR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // hour marks
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
    const inner = clockR * 0.82;
    const outer = clockR * 0.95;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a6aa0';
    ctx.lineWidth = i % 3 === 0 ? 3 : 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * inner, clockY + Math.sin(a) * inner);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * outer, clockY + Math.sin(a) * outer);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // hour hand
  const ha = ((h + m / 60) / 12) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c0c0e0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, clockY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(ha) * clockR * 0.5, clockY + Math.sin(ha) * clockR * 0.5);
  ctx.stroke();

  // minute hand
  const ma = ((m + s / 60) / 60) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#d0d0f0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, clockY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(ma) * clockR * 0.7, clockY + Math.sin(ma) * clockR * 0.7);
  ctx.stroke();

  // second hand
  const sa = (s / 60) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff4466';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, clockY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(sa) * clockR * 0.78, clockY + Math.sin(sa) * clockR * 0.78);
  ctx.stroke();

  // center dot
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4466';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, clockY, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // tower windows
  const winRows = 5;
  for (let r = 1; r < winRows; r++) {
    const wy = topY + towerH * 0.35 + r * (towerH * 0.12);
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
      const wx = cx - towerW * 0.5 + c * towerW * 0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.4 ? 'rgba(255, 220, 100, 0.5)' : 'rgba(80, 80, 140, 0.3)';
      ctx.fillRect(wx - 5, wy, 10, 14);
    }
  }
}

function drawCountdownText() {
  const now = Date.now();
  const diff = targetMidnight.getTime() - now;

  if (diff <= 0) return;

  const totalSec = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
  const hrs = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
  const mins = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
  const secs = totalSec % 60;

  const text = `${pad(hrs)}:${pad(mins)}:${pad(secs)}`;
  const fontSize = Math.min(W * 0.08, H * 0.12);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  // glow
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.6)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30;

  ctx.fillStyle = '#e0e8ff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(text, W * 0.5, H * 0.42);

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // label
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180, 190, 230, 0.7)';
  ctx.font = `${fontSize * 0.3}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('UNTIL MIDNIGHT', W * 0.5, H * 0.42 + fontSize * 0.7);
}

function drawTitle() {
  const elapsed = Date.now() - titleStart;
  const t = Math.min(elapsed / 800, 1);
  const e = easeOut(t);
  const alpha = e;
  const yOff = (1 - e) * 30;

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  const fontSize = Math.min(W * 0.06, H * 0.08);

  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(150, 100, 255, 0.5)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;

  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220, 210, 255, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('MIDNIGHT COUNTDOWN', W * 0.5, H * 0.35 + yOff);

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  const subSize = fontSize * 0.4;
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(elapsed * 0.003);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160, 170, 220, ${alpha * (0.5 + pulse * 0.5)})`;
  ctx.font = `${subSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('[ CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO BEGIN ]', W * 0.5, H * 0.35 + fontSize * 1.2 + yOff);

  // show current time
  const now = new Date();
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(140, 150, 200, ${alpha * 0.6})`;
  ctx.font = `${subSize * 0.8}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(`CURRENT TIME: ${pad(now.getHours())}:${pad(now.getMinutes())}:${pad(now.getSeconds())}`, W * 0.5, H * 0.35 + fontSize * 2 + yOff);
}

function drawMidnight() {
  const elapsed = Date.now() - midnightFlash;
  const t = Math.min(elapsed / 2000, 1);
  const e = easeOut(t);
  const alpha = 1 - Math.max(0, (elapsed - 1500) / 500);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  const fontSize = Math.min(W * 0.1, H * 0.15);

  // flash effect
  if (elapsed < 500) {
    const flashAlpha = (1 - elapsed / 500) * 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 200, 255, ${flashAlpha})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 200, 100, 0.8)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 40;

  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 230, 180, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('MIDNIGHT', W * 0.5, H * 0.4);

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  const subSize = fontSize * 0.35;
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(elapsed * 0.004);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 180, 150, ${alpha * (0.4 + pulse * 0.4)})`;
  ctx.font = `${subSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('[ CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO RESET ]', W * 0.5, H * 0.4 + fontSize * 0.9);

  // celebration particles
  if (elapsed < 3000) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const px = W * 0.5 + Math.cos(i * 0.7 + elapsed * 0.001) * (100 + i * 8);
      const py = H * 0.4 + Math.sin(i * 0.9 + elapsed * 0.0015) * (50 + i * 5);
      const colors = ['#ff6688', '#ffaa44', '#66ddff', '#bb88ff', '#ffdd66'];
      ctx.fillStyle = colors[i % colors.length];
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(px, py, 2 + Math.sin(i + elapsed * 0.005) * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

// ===== Main Loop =====
function draw() {
  drawSky();
  drawStars();
  drawMoon();
  drawCity();
  drawClockTower();

  if (phase === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
  } else if (phase === 'countdown') {
    drawCountdownText();
  } else if (phase === 'midnight') {
    drawMidnight();
  }
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Grandfather Clock</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #0a0d12; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

// ---------- STATE ----------
let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
const state = {
  started: false,
  time: 0,
  angle: 0,            // rad, 0 = straight down
  omega: 0,            // rad/s
  length: 1,           // metres
  bobRadius: 0.05,     // metres
  g: 9.81,
  b: 0.05,            // damping
  tickPhase: 0,
  sound: true,
  seconds: 0,
  minutes: 0,
  hours: 0
};

// ---------- AUDIO (chimes) ----------
let audioCtx = null;
function ensureAudio() {
  if (!audioCtx) {
    try { audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (e) {}
  }
  if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === "suspended") audioCtx.resume();
}
function chime(freq, dur) {
  if (!state.sound || !audioCtx) return;
  const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
  const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const o2 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = freq;
  o2.type = "sine"; o2.frequency.value = freq * 2.003;
  const g2 = audioCtx.createGain(); g2.gain.value = 0.25;
  o.connect(gain); o2.connect(g2); g2.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.25, t + 0.01);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
  o.start(t); o2.start(t);
  o.stop(t + dur + 0.05); o2.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
}
function tick() { chime(1800, 0.05); }
function tock() { chime(1200, 0.05); }

// ---------- RESIZE ----------
function resize() {
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W + "px"; canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

// ---------- INPUT ----------
function start() {
  if (state.started) return;
  ensureAudio();
  state.started = true;
  state.omega = 0;
  state.angle = 0.35; // start with a swing
}
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
  ensureAudio();
  // If not started, any click starts.
  if (!state.started) { start(); return; }
  // Click near the bob to give it a push (kick).
  const p = bobScreen();
  const dx = e.clientX - p.x, dy = e.clientY - p.y;
  if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 90) {
    // push in direction of horizontal click
    const dir = dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
    state.omega += dir * 0.5;
  }
});
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === " " || e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); start(); }
  if (e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") state.sound = !state.sound;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") state.omega += 0.3;
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") state.omega -= 0.3;
});

// ---------- PHYSICS ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (!state.started) return;
  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
  // Sub-step for stability
  const steps = 4;
  const h = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const alpha = -(state.g / state.length) * Math.sin(state.angle) - state.b * state.omega;
    state.omega += alpha * h;
    state.angle += state.omega * h;
  }

  // Tick / tock on zero crossings
  const prev = state.tickPhase;
  state.tickPhase = state.angle >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
  if (prev !== state.tickPhase && Math.abs(state.omega) > 0.05) {
    if (state.tickPhase > 0) tick(); else tock();
  }

  // Advance clock time: one full period ~ 2s => one "second" per half swing
  state.time += dt;
  const newSeconds = Math.floor(state.time);
  if (newSeconds > state.seconds) {
    state.seconds = newSeconds;
    state.minutes = Math.floor(state.seconds / 60);
    state.hours = Math.floor(state.minutes / 60) % 12;
  }
}

// ---------- GEOMETRY HELPERS ----------
function clockCenter() { return { x: W / 2, y: H * 0.34 }; }
function clockRadius() { return Math.min(W, H) * 0.13; }
function pivot() { return { x: W / 2, y: H * 0.47 }; }
function bobScreen() {
  const p = pivot();
  const L = H * 0.30;
  return { x: p.x + L * Math.sin(state.angle), y: p.y + L * Math.cos(state.angle), L: L };
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground() {
  // Room gradient
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#1a2233");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#232c40");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#151a26");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Soft window light from left
  const wg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.18, H * 0.28, 20, W * 0.18, H * 0.28, H * 0.7);
  wg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,150,210,0.18)");
  wg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,150,210,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = wg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Floor
  ctx.fillStyle = "#12161f";
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.82, W, H * 0.18);
  // Floor boards
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const y = H * 0.82 + (H * 0.18) * (i / 12);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawCase() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  const top = H * 0.10;
  const bottom = H * 0.86;
  const caseW = Math.min(W * 0.42, H * 0.42);
  const x = cx - caseW / 2;

  // Pedestal
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a2415";
  ctx.fillRect(cx - caseW * 0.62, bottom, caseW * 1.24, H * 0.05);

  // Main case body
  const wood = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + caseW, 0);
  wood.addColorStop(0, "#4a2e18");
  wood.addColorStop(0.5, "#6b4322");
  wood.addColorStop(1, "#3c2513");
  ctx.fillStyle = wood;
  roundRect(x, top, caseW, bottom - top, 14);
  ctx.fill();

  // Case edge highlight
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,170,0.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  roundRect(x + 4, top + 4, caseW - 8, bottom - top - 8, 10);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Top crown (dome)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5a3a20";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 6, top);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, top - H * 0.09, x + caseW + 6, top);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7a5230";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, top - H * 0.055, caseW * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Inner dark face backing
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1c140c";
  roundRect(x + caseW * 0.08, top + H * 0.02, caseW * 0.84, bottom - top - H * 0.05, 8);
  ctx.fill();
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawClockFace() {
  const c = clockCenter();
  const r = clockRadius();

  // Face background
  const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, r * 0.2, c.x, c.y, r);
  fg.addColorStop(0, "#f4ecd6");
  fg.addColorStop(1, "#d8c9a0");
  ctx.fillStyle = fg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Outer brass ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#b8862f";
  ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.06;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, r * 0.98, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a5f1e";
  ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.02;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, r * 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();

  // Hour markers
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
    const inner = r * 0.80, outer = r * 0.9;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a2a14";
    ctx.lineWidth = i % 3 === 0 ? r * 0.035 : r * 0.02;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x + inner * Math.cos(a), c.y + inner * Math.sin(a));
    ctx.lineTo(c.x + outer * Math.cos(a), c.y + outer * Math.sin(a));
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Numerals
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a1e10";
  ctx.font = "bold " + Math.round(r * 0.16) + "px Georgia, serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  for (let n = 1; n <= 12; n++) {
    const a = (n / 12) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
    const rr = r * 0.66;
    ctx.fillText(String(n), c.x + rr * Math.cos(a), c.y + rr * Math.sin(a));
  }

  // Hands
  const hAng = ((state.hours % 12) / 12) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
  const mAng = ((state.minutes % 60) / 60) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;

  // Hour hand
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#241a0e";
  ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.05; ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y);
  ctx.lineTo(c.x + r * 0.45 * Math.cos(hAng), c.y + r * 0.45 * Math.sin(hAng));
  ctx.stroke();
  // Minute hand
  ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.035;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y);
  ctx.lineTo(c.x + r * 0.66 * Math.cos(mAng), c.y + r * 0.66 * Math.sin(mAng));
  ctx.stroke();
  // Center pin
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8a5f1e";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, r * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

function drawPendulum() {
  const p = pivot();
  const b = bobScreen();

  // Rod
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#caa24a";
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, H * 0.004);
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
  ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,240,200,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
  ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Pivot mount
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8a5f1e";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, Math.max(6, H * 0.008), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Bob (brass disc)
  const br = Math.max(14, H * 0.035);
  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x - br * 0.3, b.y - br * 0.3, br * 0.1, b.x, b.y, br);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "#f4d98a");
  bg.addColorStop(0.6, "#c99a3a");
  bg.addColorStop(1, "#8a5f1e");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, br, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#6e4a18";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, br, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  // Bob highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(b.x - br * 0.35, b.y - br * 0.4, br * 0.22, br * 0.14, -0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

function drawUI() {
  // Top title
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,220,160,0.9)";
  ctx.font = "bold " + Math.round(H * 0.03) + "px Georgia, serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.fillText("GRANDFATHER CLOCK", W / 2, H * 0.02);

  // Digital time
  const hh = String(state.hours).padStart(2, "0");
  const mm = String(state.minutes).padStart(2, "0");
  const ss = String(state.seconds).padStart(2, "0");
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f4ecd6";
  ctx.font = "bold " + Math.round(H * 0.028) + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText(hh + ":" + mm + ":" + ss, W / 2, H * 0.88);

  // Controls hint
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(200,200,210,0.55)";
  ctx.font = Math.round(H * 0.016) + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Click the bob to push  ·  Space to start  ·  S for sound", W / 2, H * 0.94);

  // Start prompt
  if (!state.started) {
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(state.time * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,220,160," + pulse + ")";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.round(H * 0.035) + "px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("Click anywhere to start the clock", W / 2, H * 0.62);
  }
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawCase();
  drawClockFace();
  drawPendulum();
  drawUI();
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (!state.started) state.time += dt; // keep UI pulsing
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------- INIT ----------
resize();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

// ===== CANVAS SETUP =====
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
function resize(){
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ===== GAME STATE =====
const G = 2200;            // gravity px/s^2
const DAMPING = 0.985;     // velocity damping
const FRICTION = 0.99;
const BASE_Y_OFFSET = 60;
const MIN_OVERLAP = 12;     // px needed to keep a block on
const MAX_ANGLE = 0.42;     // rad, ~24 deg -> topple

const state = {
  blocks: [],               // placed, resting blocks
  current: null,           // the moving block
  dir: 1,                 // swing direction
  swingSpeed: 1.8,       // radians / second
  score: 0,
  best: 0,
  phase: 'start',        // start | playing | over
  particles: [],
  shake: 0,
  time: 0
};

// ===== BLOCK FACTORY =====
function makeBlock(x, y, w, h, color, isBase){
  return {
    x, y, w, h,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    angle: 0,
    angularVel: 0,
    color: color,
    isBase: !!isBase,
    settled: true,
    falling: false
  };
}

// palette
const PALETTE = ['#e07b54','#f2c14e','#5fb8a5','#7e9cc9','#c96f9d','#9bc26f','#e0a154','#6fc2d1','#d17a6f','#8fbf9f'];

// ===== INIT GAME =====
function initGame(){
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;
  const baseW = Math.min(240, W*0.4);
  const baseH = 50;
  const baseX = W/2;
  const baseY = H - BASE_Y_OFFSET - baseH/2;

  state.blocks = [];
  state.blocks.push(makeBlock(baseX, baseY, baseW, baseH, '#4a5a6a', true));
  state.current = null;
  state.dir = 1;
  state.swingSpeed = 1.8;
  state.score = 0;
  state.particles = [];
  state.shake = 0;
  state.phase = 'playing';
  spawnBlock();
}

// ===== SPAWN NEXT BLOCK =====
function spawnBlock(){
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;
  const top = state.blocks[0]; // top block
  const bw = Math.max(50, top.w - 6);
  const bh = 34;
  const cx = W/2;
  const cy = 70;
  const color = PALETTE[state.score % PALETTE.length];
  state.current = makeBlock(cx, cy, bw, bh, color, false);
  state.current.settled = false;
  state.current.falling = false;
}

// ===== INPUT =====
let actionQueued = false;
function doAction(){
  if(state.phase === 'start'){
    initGame();
    return;
  }
  if(state.phase === 'over'){
    initGame();
    return;
  }
  if(state.phase === 'playing' && state.current && !state.current.falling){
    // drop
    state.current.falling = true;
    state.current.settled = false;
    actionQueued = false;
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if(e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'ArrowDown'){
    e.preventDefault();
    doAction();
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  doAction();
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  doAction();
}, {passive:false});

// ===== PHYSICS UPDATE =====
function update(dt){
  state.time += dt;

  if(state.phase !== 'playing') return;

  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;
  const cur = state.current;

  // --- swing current block horizontally ---
  if(cur && !cur.falling){
    const range = W*0.32;
    const cx = W/2 + Math.sin(state.time * state.swingSpeed) * range;
    cur.x = cx;
  }

  // --- falling block: apply gravity ---
  if(cur && cur.falling){
    cur.vy += G * dt;
    cur.y += cur.vy * dt;

    // check landing on top block
    const top = state.blocks[0];
    const landY = top.y - top.h/2 - cur.h/2;

    if(cur.y >= landY){
      cur.y = landY;
      cur.vy = 0;

      // horizontal overlap check
      const left = Math.max(cur.x - cur.w/2, top.x - top.w/2);
      const right = Math.min(cur.x + cur.w/2, top.x + top.w/2);
      const overlap = right - left;

      if(overlap < MIN_OVERLAP){
        // missed! block falls
        cur.settled = false;
        cur.falling = true;
        // it will keep falling off screen
        checkMiss();
      } else {
        // landed — add to stack
        state.blocks.unshift(cur);
        state.score++;
        if(state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
        state.shake = 4;
        // spawn particles
        spawnParticles(cur.x, cur.y - cur.h/2, cur.color);
        // speed up swing slightly
        state.swingSpeed = Math.min(3.5, 1.8 + state.score * 0.06);
        spawnBlock();
      }
    }

    // off screen
    if(cur && cur.y > H + 100){
      checkMiss();
    }
  }

  // --- particles ---
  for(let i = state.particles.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += G * 0.3 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if(p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  // --- shake decay ---
  state.shake *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
  if(state.shake < 0.3) state.shake = 0;
}

function checkMiss(){
  state.phase = 'over';
  state.current = null;
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color){
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const sp = 100 + Math.random()*200;
    state.particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a)*sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a)*sp - 100,
      life: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.4,
      maxLife: 0.8,
      size: 3 + Math.random()*4,
      color: color
    });
  }
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function draw(){
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // --- sky gradient background ---
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  sky.addColorStop(0,'#1a2733');
  sky.addColorStop(0.5,'#2a3f55');
  sky.addColorStop(0.85,'#3d5a70');
  sky.addColorStop(1,'#4a6a80');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // --- stars ---
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const sx = (i*137.5 + 50) % W;
    const sy = (i*89.3 + 20) % (H*0.5);
    const r = 0.5 + (i%3)*0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // --- distant mountains ---
  drawMountains(W, H);

  // --- ground ---
  const groundY = H - BASE_Y_OFFSET;
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
  gg.addColorStop(0,'#3a4a3a');
  gg.addColorStop(1,'#2a3a2a');
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);

  // ground line
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a7a5a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
  ctx.lineTo(W, groundY);
  ctx.stroke();

  // --- shake offset ---
  let ox = 0, oy = 0;
  if(state.shake > 0){
    ox = (Math.random()-0.5) * state.shake * 2;
    oy = (Math.random()-0.5) * state.shake * 2;
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(ox, oy);

  // --- draw all placed blocks ---
  for(let i=0;i<state.blocks.length;i++){
    drawBlock(state.blocks[i]);
  }

  // --- draw current block ---
  if(state.current){
    drawBlock(state.current);
    // drop guide line
    if(!state.current.falling){
      const top = state.blocks[0];
      const landY = top.y - top.h/2 - state.current.h/2;
      ctx.setLineDash([6,6]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(state.current.x, state.current.y + state.current.h/2);
      ctx.lineTo(state.current.x, landY);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
  }

  // --- particles ---
  for(let i=0;i<state.particles.length;i++){
    const p = state.particles[i];
    const alpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.restore();

  // --- HUD ---
  drawHUD(W, H);

  // --- overlays ---
  if(state.phase === 'start') drawStartScreen(W, H);
  if(state.phase === 'over') drawOverScreen(W, H);
}

function drawMountains(W, H){
  const baseY = H - BASE_Y_OFFSET;
  // far range
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a50';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, baseY);
  for(let x=0; x<=W; x+=4){
    const h = Math.sin(x*0.008)*40 + Math.sin(x*0.02)*20 + 60;
    ctx.lineTo(x, baseY - h);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, baseY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // near range
  ctx.fillStyle = '#354a62';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, baseY);
  for(let x=0; x<=W; x+=4){
    const h = Math.sin(x*0.012+2)*30 + Math.sin(x*0.025+1)*15 + 35;
    ctx.lineTo(x, baseY - h);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, baseY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBlock(b){
  const x = b.x;
  const y = b.y;
  const w = b.w;
  const h = b.h;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.fillRect(-w/2 + 3, -h/2 + 3, w, h);

  // main face
  ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
  ctx.fillRect(-w/2, -h/2, w, h);

  // top highlight
  const hl = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -h/2, 0, -h/2 + h*0.35);
  hl.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)');
  hl.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = hl;
  ctx.fillRect(-w/2, -h/2, w, h*0.35);

  // bottom shade
  const sh = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, h/2 - h*0.3, 0, h/2);
  sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sh;
  ctx.fillRect(-w/2, h/2 - h*0.3, w, h*0.3);

  // border
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.strokeRect(-w/2, -h/2, w, h);

  // inner lines for base
  if(b.isBase){
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-w/2 + 8, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(w/2 - 8, 0);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD(W, H){
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(W/2 - 80, 12, 160, 44);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, W/2, 34);

  // best
  if(state.best > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = '14px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('BEST: ' + state.best, W/2, 62);
  }
}

function drawStartScreen(W, H){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c14e';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('TOWER STACKER', W/2, H*0.3);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Drop blocks to build the tallest tower', W/2, H*0.42);
  ctx.fillText('Miss the stack and you lose!', W/2, H*0.48);

  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5fb8a5';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('CLICK or PRESS SPACE to START', W/2, H*0.6);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawOverScreen(W, H){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#e07b54';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('TOWER FELL!', W/2, H*0.3);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '28px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, W/2, H*0.42);

  if(state.score >= state.best && state.score > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c14e';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('NEW BEST!', W/2, H*0.5);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.font = '20px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + state.best, W/2, H*0.5);
  }

  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5fb8a5';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('CLICK or PRESS SPACE to PLAY AGAIN', W/2, H*0.62);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ===== MAIN LOOP =====
let lastTime = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
  lastTime = now;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Drone Delivery</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #0b1a2b; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ============================ STATE ============================ */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0;

const state = {
  mode: "start",          // start | playing | gameover
  score: 0,
  target: 10,             // packages to deliver to win
  time: 0,
  shake: 0
};

const drone = {
  x: 0, y: 0,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  w: 46, h: 20,
  angle: 0,
  propSpin: 0,
  carrying: false,
  trail: []
};

const keys = {};
let packages = [];
let obstacles = [];
let pickups = [];
let clouds = [];
let buildings = [];

const CFG = {
  accel: 2600,
  maxSpeed: 360,
  friction: 0.86,
  hitDmg: 1,
  invuln: 1.2
};
let invulnTimer = 0;

/* ============================ SETUP / RESIZE ============================ */
function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  buildWorld();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

function buildWorld() {
  // Buildings (parallax skyline)
  buildings = [];
  const n = Math.max(6, Math.floor(W / 120));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const bw = 60 + Math.random() * 90;
    buildings.push({
      x: i * (W / n) + Math.random() * 30,
      w: bw,
      h: 120 + Math.random() * 220,
      hue: 200 + Math.random() * 40
    });
  }

  // Clouds
  clouds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    clouds.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: 40 + Math.random() * (H * 0.4),
      r: 30 + Math.random() * 40,
      spd: 8 + Math.random() * 14
    });
  }

  // Obstacles (rotating propeller hazards)
  obstacles = [];
  const onCount = Math.max(3, Math.floor(H / 220));
  for (let i = 0; i < onCount; i++) {
    obstacles.push({
      x: 120 + Math.random() * (W - 240),
      y: 120 + Math.random() * (H - 260),
      r: 34 + Math.random() * 18,
      spin: 0,
      spd: 2 + Math.random() * 3
    });
  }

  // Package pickup
  pickups = [];
  const p = 120 + Math.random() * (W - 240);
  pickups.push({ x: p, y: H - 90, r: 26, bob: 0 });

  // Delivery target
  const t = 120 + Math.random() * (W - 240);
  packages = [{ x: t, y: 110, r: 30, bob: 0, landed: false }];
}

function resetDrone() {
  drone.x = W / 2;
  drone.y = H * 0.6;
  drone.vx = 0; drone.vy = 0;
  drone.angle = 0;
  drone.carrying = false;
  drone.trail.length = 0;
}

function startGame() {
  state.mode = "playing";
  state.score = 0;
  state.time = 0;
  invulnTimer = 0;
  resetDrone();
  buildWorld();
}

/* ============================ INPUT ============================ */
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (state.mode === "start" && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) startGame();
  else if (state.mode === "gameover" && (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R")) startGame();
  if (["arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"," "].includes(e.key.toLowerCase())) e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

/* ============================ UPDATE ============================ */
function update(dt) {
  if (state.mode !== "playing") return;
  state.time += dt;
  if (invulnTimer > 0) invulnTimer -= dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake -= dt * 30;

  // --- Drone control ---
  let ax = 0, ay = 0;
  if (keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"]) ax -= CFG.accel;
  if (keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"]) ax += CFG.accel;
  if (keys["w"] || keys["arrowup"]) ay -= CFG.accel;
  if (keys["s"] || keys["arrowdown"]) ay += CFG.accel;

  drone.vx += ax * dt;
  drone.vy += ay * dt;
  drone.vx *= CFG.friction;
  drone.vy *= CFG.friction;

  const spd = Math.hypot(drone.vx, drone.vy);
  if (spd > CFG.maxSpeed) {
    drone.vx = drone.vx / spd * CFG.maxSpeed;
    drone.vy = drone.vy / spd * CFG.maxSpeed;
  }

  drone.x += drone.vx * dt;
  drone.y += drone.vy * dt;

  // keep in bounds
  const m = drone.w / 2;
  if (drone.x < m) { drone.x = m; drone.vx = Math.abs(drone.vx) * 0.4; }
  if (drone.x > W - m) { drone.x = W - m; drone.vx = -Math.abs(drone.vx) * 0.4; }
  if (drone.y < m + 20) { drone.y = m + 20; drone.vy = Math.abs(drone.vy) * 0.4; }
  if (drone.y > H - m) { drone.y = H - m; drone.vy = -Math.abs(drone.vy) * 0.4; }

  drone.angle = Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, drone.vx / CFG.maxSpeed));
  drone.propSpin += dt * 40;

  // trail
  drone.trail.push({ x: drone.x, y: drone.y, a: 0.5 });
  if (drone.trail.length > 24) drone.trail.shift();
  for (const t of drone.trail) t.a -= dt * 0.8;

  // --- Pickups ---
  for (let i = pickups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = pickups[i];
    p.bob += dt;
    const dy = p.y + Math.sin(p.bob * 3) * 6;
    if (Math.hypot(drone.x - p.x, drone.y - dy) < p.r + drone.w * 0.5 && !drone.carrying) {
      drone.carrying = true;
      pickups.splice(i, 1);
      spawnPickup();
    }
  }

  // --- Delivery target ---
  const pkg = packages[0];
  pkg.bob += dt;
  const pkgY = pkg.y + Math.sin(pkg.bob * 2.5) * 8;
  if (drone.carrying && Math.hypot(drone.x - pkg.x, drone.y - pkgY) < pkg.r + drone.w * 0.5) {
    drone.carrying = false;
    state.score++;
    state.shake = 4;
    if (state.score >= state.target) {
      state.mode = "gameover";   // win
    } else {
      spawnPickup();
      spawnTarget();
    }
  }

  // --- Obstacles (collision) ---
  if (invulnTimer <= 0) {
    for (const o of obstacles) {
      o.spin += dt * o.spd;
      if (Math.hypot(drone.x - o.x, drone.y - o.y) < o.r + drone.w * 0.35) {
        // crash
        state.mode = "gameover";
        state.shake = 10;
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Clouds drift ---
  for (const c of clouds) {
    c.x += c.spd * dt;
    if (c.x - c.r > W) { c.x = -c.r; c.y = 40 + Math.random() * (H * 0.4); }
  }
}

function spawnPickup() {
  const p = 120 + Math.random() * (W - 240);
  pickups.push({ x: p, y: H - 90, r: 26, bob: Math.random() * 3 });
}
function spawnTarget() {
  const t = 120 + Math.random() * (W - 240);
  packages[0] = { x: t, y: 110, r: 30, bob: Math.random() * 3, landed: false };
}

/* ============================ DRAW ============================ */
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake);
  }

  drawSky();
  drawBuildings();
  drawClouds();
  drawGround();
  drawPickups();
  drawTarget();
  drawObstacles();
  drawDrone();

  ctx.restore();

  drawHUD();
  if (state.mode === "start") drawStart();
  if (state.mode === "gameover") drawEnd();
}

function drawSky() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#2a5b8c");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#5b93c4");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#a9d3e8");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // sun
  const sx = W * 0.8, sy = H * 0.18;
  const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 5, sx, sy, 90);
  sg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,240,190,0.95)");
  sg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,240,190,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 90, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

function drawBuildings() {
  for (const b of buildings) {
    const top = H * 0.72 - b.h;
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${b.hue}, 30%, 38%)`;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, top, b.w, b.h);
    // windows
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,230,150,0.55)";
    const rows = Math.floor(b.h / 26);
    const cols = Math.floor(b.w / 22);
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        if ((r * 7 + c * 3) % 3 === 0)
          ctx.fillRect(b.x + 6 + c * 22, top + 8 + r * 26, 9, 12);
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawClouds() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
  for (const c of clouds) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(c.x + c.r * 0.7, c.y + 6, c.r * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(c.x - c.r * 0.7, c.y + 8, c.r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawGround() {
  // road
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3f47";
  ctx.fillRect(0, H - 60, W, 60);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#f2d44a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.setLineDash([26, 22]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H - 30);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H - 30);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

function drawPickups() {
  for (const p of pickups) {
    const y = p.y + Math.sin(p.bob * 3) * 6;
    // glow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,180,60,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, y, p.r + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    drawBox(p.x, y, 22);
    // down arrow
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x, y - p.r - 20);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x - 10, y - p.r - 34);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x + 10, y - p.r - 34);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawTarget() {
  const pkg = packages[0];
  const y = pkg.y + Math.sin(pkg.bob * 2.5) * 8;
  // delivery pad (rooftop)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2f6b4f";
  ctx.fillRect(pkg.x - 55, y + 26, 110, 26);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4a37";
  ctx.fillRect(pkg.x - 55, y + 26, 110, 6);
  // beacon
  const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(pkg.bob * 4) * 0.5;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(80,220,140,${0.3 + pulse * 0.4})`;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pkg.x, y, pkg.r + 14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#50d c".replace(" ", "80"); // fallback
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#50dc8c";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pkg.x, y, pkg.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  // H marker
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eafff0";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("H", pkg.x, y);
}

function drawBox(x, y, s) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#c98a4b";
  ctx.fillRect(x - s, y - s, s * 2, s * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#a5672f";
  ctx.fillRect(x - s, y - s, s * 2, 6);
  ctx.fillRect(x - s, y + s - 6, s * 2, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f0d9b5";
  ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - s, 8, s * 2);
  ctx.fillRect(x - s, y - 4, s * 2, 8);
}

function drawObstacles() {
  for (const o of obstacles) {
    // danger ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,80,80,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    // hub
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2b2f36";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // blades
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(o.x, o.y);
    ctx.rotate(o.spin);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e0453a";
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      ctx.rotate((Math.PI * 2) / 3);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(o.r * 0.55, 0, o.r * 0.5, o.r * 0.16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawDrone() {
  const d = drone;
  // trail
  for (let i = 0; i < d.trail.length; i++) {
    const t = d.trail[i];
    if (t.a <= 0) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(120,200,255,${t.a * 0.4})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  const blink = invulnTimer > 0 && Math.floor(state.time * 12) % 2 === 0;
  if (blink) return;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(d.x, d.y);
  ctx.rotate(d.angle);

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 14, d.w * 0.5, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // arms
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b2f36";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-d.w * 0.5, -6); ctx.lineTo(-d.w * 0.5, 6);
  ctx.moveTo(d.w * 0.5, -6); ctx.lineTo(d.w * 0.5, 6);
  ctx.stroke();

  // props
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(150,200,255,0.6)";
  for (const px of [-d.w * 0.5, d.w * 0.5]) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, 0);
    ctx.rotate(d.propSpin);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 16, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8452f";
  roundRect(-14, -10, 28, 20, 6); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff7a5c";
  roundRect(-14, -10, 28, 9, 6); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit light
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(8, 0, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // carried package
  if (d.carrying) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c98a4b";
    ctx.fillRect(-10, 12, 20, 18);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f0d9b5";
    ctx.fillRect(-2, 12, 4, 18);
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
  roundRect(16, 16, 210, 54, 10); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 20px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Delivered", 30, 24);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText(state.score + " / " + state.target, 30, 44);

  // status
  ctx.fillStyle = drone.carrying ? "#50dc8c" : "#8ab4d4";
  ctx.font = "14px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText(drone.carrying ? "● Carrying package" : "○ Find a package", 30, 78);
}

function drawStart() {
  overlay();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 52px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("DRONE DELIVERY", W / 2, H * 0.34);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
  ctx.font = "22px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Pick up packages below, drop them at the rooftop 'H'.", W / 2, H * 0.44);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe6f5";
  ctx.font = "18px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Avoid the spinning propellers. Deliver " + state.target + " to win.", W / 2, H * 0.50);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Controls:  W A S D  or  Arrow Keys", W / 2, H * 0.58);
  const b = 0.5 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.5;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.5 + b * 0.5})`;
  ctx.font = "bold 24px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Press  SPACE  to start", W / 2, H * 0.68);
}

function drawEnd() {
  overlay();
  const win = state.score >= state.target;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = win ? "#50dc8c" : "#ff5b5b";
  ctx.font = "bold 52px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText(win ? "ALL DELIVERED!" : "DRONE DOWN", W / 2, H * 0.40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "24px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Packages delivered:  " + state.score + " / " + state.target, W / 2, H * 0.50);
  const b = 0.5 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.5;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.5 + b * 0.5})`;
  ctx.font = "bold 22px Segoe UI, Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Press  R  to play again", W / 2, H * 0.60);
}

function overlay() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,20,34,0.62)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

/* ============================ LOOP ============================ */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;   // clamp for stability
  state.time += dt;               // keep time moving for animations on all screens
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

resize();
resetDrone();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Stack</title>
<style>
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#081428;font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif}
  #game{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
/* ---------- Canvas ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
function resize(){
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W*DPR; canvas.height = H*DPR;
  canvas.style.width=W+"px"; canvas.style.height=H+"px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize",resize);
resize();

/* ---------- Constants ---------- */
const GRAV=2600, MAXH=999;
const HUE0=175, HUE1=345, HSTEP=5.5;
const TAU=Math.PI*2;
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;

/* ---------- State ---------- */
let state="title";        // title | playing | falling | over
let blocks=[];
let current=null;
let score=0, best=0, combo=0, maxCombo=0;
let cameraY=0, targetCam=0;
let shake=0, flash=0;
let overTimer=0, overReason="";
let particles=[], floaters=[], stars=[], clouds=[];
let time=0, last=0;

function loadBest(){ try{best=+localStorage.getItem("stack_best")||0;}catch(e){best=0;} }
function saveBest(){ try{localStorage.setItem("stack_best",best);}catch(e){} }
loadBest();

function makeStars(){
  stars=[];
  for(let i=0;i<150;i++)
    stars.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),s:Math.random()*1.6+0.4,tw:Math.random()*TAU,sp:Math.random()*1.5+0.5});
}
function makeClouds(){
  clouds=[];
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++)
    clouds.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:H*(0.55+Math.random()*0.4),w:120+Math.random()*160,h:34+Math.random()*26,sp:6+Math.random()*10});
}
makeStars(); makeClouds();

/* ---------- Block helpers ---------- */
function blockColor(i){
  const h=(HUE0+i*HSTEP)%360;
  return {
    top:`hsl(${h} 72% 66%)`,
    face:`hsl(${h} 55% 42%)`,
    side:`hsl(${h} 58% 28%)`,
    light:`hsl(${h} 80% 80%)`
  };
}
function makeBlock(x,y,w,falling){
  return {
    x, y, w, h:26,
    falling:!!falling,
    vx:0, vy:0,
    angle:0, va:0,
    color:blockColor(blocks.length),
    landed:false
  };
}

/* ---------- Particles ---------- */
function burst(x,y,color,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*TAU, sp=60+Math.random()*260;
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-120,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.5,
      max:0.5+Math.random()*0.5,size:2+Math.random()*4,color});
  }
}
function addFloater(x,y,txt,color,big){
  floaters.push({x,y,vy:-40,life:1.2,max:1.2,txt,color,big:!!big});
}

/* ---------- Game flow ---------- */
function start(){
  blocks=[makeBlock(W/2,H-40,Math.min(W*0.55,300))];
  blocks[0].landed=true;
  current=null;
  score=0; combo=0; maxCombo=0;
  cameraY=0; targetCam=0;
  state="playing";
  spawnNext();
}
function spawnNext(){
  const base=blocks[blocks.length-1];
  const w=Math.max(70, base.w*0.965);
  current=makeBlock(W/2, base.y-46, w);
  current.baseW=w;
  current.axis=1.3;
  current.t=0;
}
function place(){
  if(!current) return;
  const base=blocks[blocks.length-1];
  const left=Math.max(current.x-current.w/2, base.x-base.w/2);
  const right=Math.min(current.x+current.w/2, base.x+base.w/2);
  const overlap=right-left;
  if(overlap<=2){
    current.falling=true;
    current.vx=(current.x<base.x?-1:1)*(120+Math.random()*120);
    current.va=(current.x<base.x?-1:1)*(3+Math.random()*3);
    blocks.push(current);
    current=null;
    state="falling";
    return;
  }
  const cx=(left+right)/2;
  const off=Math.abs(current.x-cx);
  const perfect=off<5;
  let gained=1;
  if(perfect){
    combo++; maxCombo=Math.max(maxCombo,combo);
    gained+=combo;
    score+=gained;
    flash=1;
    addFloater(cx, current.y-30, combo>1?("PERFECT x"+combo):"PERFECT", "#fff", true);
    burst(cx, current.y, current.color.light, 26);
  }else{
    combo=0;
    score+=1;
    addFloater(cx, current.y-30, "+1", "#cfe8ff", false);
    burst(cx, current.y, current.color.light, 8);
  }
  const bw=overlap;
  const nb=makeBlock(cx, current.y, bw);
  nb.color=current.color;
  nb.landed=true;
  blocks.push(nb);
  current=null;
  if(score>=MAXH){
    state="over"; overReason="win"; overTimer=0;
    if(score>best){best=score;saveBest();}
    return;
  }
  spawnNext();
  updateCamera();
}
function onFallDone(){
  state="over"; overReason="lose"; overTimer=0;
  if(score>best){best=score;saveBest();}
}
function updateCamera(){
  const top=blocks[blocks.length-1];
  targetCam=clamp(top.y-H*0.5, 0, Infinity);
}

/* ---------- Input ---------- */
function primary(){
  if(state==="title") start();
  else if(state==="playing"&&current) place();
  else if(state==="over") start();
}
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{e.preventDefault();primary();});
window.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  if(e.code==="Space"||e.code==="Enter"){e.preventDefault();primary();}
});
window.addEventListener("touchstart",e=>{if(state!=="playing")e.preventDefault();},{passive:false});

/* ---------- Update ---------- */
function update(dt){
  time+=dt;
  // camera
  cameraY=lerp(cameraY,targetCam, 1-Math.pow(0.001,dt));
  // clouds
  for(const c of clouds){ c.x+=c.sp*dt; if(c.x-c.w>W) c.x=-c.w; }
  // particles
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.vy+=GRAV*0.55*dt; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
  // floaters
  for(let i=floaters.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const f=floaters[i]; f.y+=f.vy*dt; f.vy*=0.96; f.life-=dt;
    if(f.life<=0) floaters.splice(i,1);
  }
  shake*=Math.pow(0.0005,dt);
  flash*=Math.pow(0.0005,dt);

  if(state==="playing"&&current){
    current.t+=dt;
    current.x=W/2 + Math.sin(current.t*current.axis)*current.axis*200;
  }

  if(state==="falling"){
    let done=true;
    for(const b of blocks){
      if(!b.landed){
        done=false;
        b.vy+=GRAV*dt; b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt; b.angle+=b.va*dt;
        if(b.y> H*2) b.landed=true;
      }
    }
    if(done) onFallDone();
  }

  if(state==="over") overTimer+=dt;
}

/* ---------- Draw helpers ---------- */
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  r=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);

  g.addColorStop(1,"#f2a95f");

  ctx.fillText("— TAP TO PLAY AGAIN —", W/2, H*0.58);
}

/* ---------- Draw ---------- */
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  drawSky();
  ctx.save();
  const sx=(Math.random()-0.5)*shake, sy=(Math.random()-0.5)*shake;
  ctx.translate(sx, cameraY+sy);
  drawGround();
  for(const b of blocks) drawBlock(b);
  if(current) drawBlock(current);
  ctx.restore();
  // screen-space layers
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color; ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y+cameraY, p.size, p.size);
  }

    ctx.font=(f.big?"800 30px":"700 20px")+" 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";

  if(flash>0.01){ ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${flash*0.5})`; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }
  if(state!=="title") drawHud();
  if(state==="title") drawTitle();

}

/* ---------- Loop ---------- */
function loop(now){
  if(!last) last=now;
  let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

<script>
(function() {
  var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  var renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas: canvas, antialias: true});
  renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;

  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x1a0505);
  scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x1a0505, 10, 60);

  var camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(70, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 100);
  camera.position.set(0, 2, 0);

    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(80, 80),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x2a1515, roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0.1})
  );

  goal.castShadow = true;
  scene.add(goal);

    {x: 8, z: -10, h: 5},
    {x: -5, z: -18, h: 4},
    {x: 5, z: -18, h: 4},

    );

  function update(dt) {

      var b = bullets[i];

      enemies.forEach(function(e) {
        if (!e.alive) return;

          hit = true;
          if (e.health <= 0) {
            e.alive = false;
            e.mesh.visible = false;

          }

    if (gdist < 2.5) {

      state.score += 500;

      if (state.shake < 0) state.shake = 0;

  // Draw HUD

    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, 20, 30);

    if (state.mode === 'start') {

      ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('DOOM ETERNAL', w/2, h/2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '18px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('WASD to move | Mouse to look | SPACE to shoot', w/2, h/2 + 10);
      ctx.fillText('Reach the green portal to win. Avoid the green demons.', w/2, h/2 + 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to start', w/2, h/2 + 80);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff44';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', w/2, h/2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '20px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + state.score, w/2, h/2 + 20);
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', w/2, h/2 + 50);
    } else if (state.mode === 'lost') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('YOU DIED', w/2, h/2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '20px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, w/2, h/2 + 20);
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to try again', w/2, h/2 + 50);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // 2D canvas for HUD
  var hudCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  hudCanvas.style.position = 'fixed';
  hudCanvas.style.top = '0';
  hudCanvas.style.left = '0';
  hudCanvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(hudCanvas);
  var ctx = hudCanvas.getContext('2d');
  function resizeHud() {
    hudCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    hudCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resizeHud();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeHud);

  // Loop
  function loop() {
    var now = performance.now();
    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
    state.lastTime = now;

    update(dt);

    // Shake
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      camera.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake;
      camera.position.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake;
    }

    // Animate goal pulse
    goal.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.5 + Math.sin(now * 0.005) * 0.3;

    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    drawHUD();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
