<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mega-Bug</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0a0a12;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = 480;
  const H = 320;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  // ---- State ----
  const state = {
    mode: 'title', // 'title' | 'play' | 'dead'
    score: 0,
    hi: 0,
    lives: 3,
    tick: 0,
    shake: 0,
    flash: 0,
    spawnTimer: 0
  };

  const player = {
    x: W / 2,
    y: H - 60,
    w: 18,
    h: 16,
    speed: 3.2,
    fireCd: 0,
    inv: 0
  };

  let bullets = [];
  let enemies = [];
  let stars = [];
  let particles = [];
  let starsInit = false;

  // ---- Input ----
  const keys = {};
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();
    if (state.mode === 'title' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
      startGame();
    } else if (state.mode === 'dead' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
      state.mode = 'title';
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  // ---- Helpers ----
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function rectHit(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh) {
    return ax < bx + bw && ax + aw > bx && ay < by + bh && ay + ah > by;
  }

  function makeStars() {
    stars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      stars.push({ x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, H), s: Math.random() < 0.2 ? 2 : 1, sp: rand(0.1, 0.5) });
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    state.mode = 'play';
    state.score = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.tick = 0;
    state.spawnTimer = 0;
    bullets = [];
    enemies = [];
    particles = [];
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.inv = 0;
    if (!starsInit) { makeStars(); starsInit = true; }
  }

  function spawnEnemy() {
    const type = Math.random();
    let e;
    if (type < 0.5) {
      // small bug
      e = { x: rand(20, W - 40), y: -20, w: 16, h: 14, vx: rand(-0.8, 0.8), vy: rand(0.8, 1.6), kind: 'bug', t: rand(0, 10) };
    } else if (type < 0.85) {
      // wide bug
      e = { x: rand(20, W - 50), y: -24, w: 24, h: 18, vx: rand(-1.2, 1.2), vy: rand(0.6, 1.2), kind: 'wide', t: rand(0, 10) };
    } else {
      // big beetle
      e = { x: rand(30, W - 60), y: -30, w: 30, h: 26, vx: rand(-0.5, 0.5), vy: rand(0.5, 0.9), kind: 'big', t: rand(0, 10) };
    }
    enemies.push(e);
  }

  function fireBullet() {
    if (player.fireCd > 0) return;
    bullets.push({ x: player.x + player.w / 2 - 2, y: player.y - 8, w: 4, h: 10, vy: -5.5 });
    player.fireCd = 9;
  }

  function explode(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: rand(-2.5, 2.5),
        vy: rand(-2.5, 2.5),
        life: rand(15, 30),
        color: color
      });
    }
  }

  function killEnemy(e, i) {
    let pts = 50;
    if (e.kind === 'wide') pts = 100;
    if (e.kind === 'big') pts = 200;
    state.score += pts;
    explode(e.x + e.w / 2, e.y + e.h / 2, e.kind === 'big' ? '#ff8800' : '#ffff00', 14);
    state.shake = 4;
    enemies.splice(i, 1);
  }

  function hitPlayer() {
    if (player.inv > 0) return;
    state.lives--;
    state.shake = 8;
    state.flash = 8;
    explode(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, '#ff2222', 20);
    if (state.lives <= 0) {
      state.mode = 'dead';
      if (state.score > state.hi) state.hi = state.score;
    } else {
      player.inv = 90;
      player.x = W / 2;
    }
  }

  // ---- Update ----
  function update() {
    state.tick++;
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake *= 0.85;
    if (state.flash > 0) state.flash--;

    // stars always drift
    for (let s of stars) {
      s.y += s.sp;
      if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = rand(0, W); }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.08;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (state.mode !== 'play') return;

    // player
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) player.x -= player.speed;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) player.x += player.speed;
    if (player.x < 4) player.x = 4;
    if (player.x + player.w > W - 4) player.x = W - 4 - player.w;
    if (player.fireCd > 0) player.fireCd--;
    if (player.inv > 0) player.inv--;
    if (keys[' '] || keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) fireBullet();

    // spawn
    state.spawnTimer--;
    if (state.spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnEnemy();
      state.spawnTimer = Math.max(18, 55 - Math.floor(state.score / 300));
    }

    // bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.y += b.vy;
      if (b.y + b.h < 0) { bullets.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const e = enemies[j];
        if (rectHit(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)) {
          bullets.splice(i, 1);
          killEnemy(e, j);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // enemies
    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const e = enemies[i];
      e.t += 0.15;
      e.x += e.vx + Math.sin(e.t) * 0.6;
      e.y += e.vy;
      if (e.x < 2) { e.x = 2; e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx); }
      if (e.x + e.w > W - 2) { e.x = W - 2 - e.w; e.vx = -Math.abs(e.vx); }
      if (e.y > H + 30) { enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      if (rectHit(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)) {
        hitPlayer();
        enemies.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function px(x, y, w, h, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(w), Math.round(h));
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // deep space gradient via bands
    const bands = ['#0a0a24', '#12123a', '#1a1a4a', '#221a5a'];
    for (let i = 0; i < bands.length; i++) {
      px(0, (H / bands.length) * i, W, H / bands.length, bands[i]);
    }
    // stars
    for (const s of stars) {
      px(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s, s.s === 2 ? '#ffffff' : '#9aa0ff');
    }
    // planet
    px(W - 90, 30, 40, 40, '#5a3a7a');
    px(W - 86, 26, 32, 48, '#5a3a7a');
    px(W - 82, 22, 24, 56, '#6a4a8a');
    px(W - 78, 18, 16, 64, '#7a5a9a');
    px(W - 74, 14, 8, 72, '#8a6aaa');
    px(W - 70, 12, 4, 76, '#9a7aba');
    // ring
    px(W - 100, 52, 60, 3, '#c0a0e0');
    px(W - 96, 55, 52, 2, '#a080c0');
  }

  function drawBug(e) {
    const cx = e.x, cy = e.y;
    const wing = Math.sin(e.t * 3) > 0 ? 2 : 0;
    if (e.kind === 'bug') {
      // legs
      px(cx - 2, cy + 6, 2, 6, '#223300');
      px(cx + e.w, cy + 6, 2, 6, '#223300');
      px(cx + 4, cy + 10, 2, 5, '#223300');
      px(cx + e.w - 6, cy + 10, 2, 5, '#223300');
      // body
      px(cx, cy + 4, e.w, e.h - 4, '#3a7a1a');
      px(cx + 2, cy + 2, e.w - 4, e.h, '#4a9a2a');
      // wing
      px(cx - wing, cy, 4, 6, '#6ac03a');
      px(cx + e.w - 4 + wing, cy, 4, 6, '#6ac03a');
      // head
      px(cx + 4, cy - 2, e.w - 8, 5, '#2a5a10');
      // eyes
      px(cx + 5, cy - 1, 2, 2, '#ff2222');
      px(cx + e.w - 7, cy - 1, 2, 2, '#ff2222');
      // spot
      px(cx + 6, cy + 6, 2, 2, '#ffdd00');
      px(cx + e.w - 8, cy + 6, 2, 2, '#ffdd00');
    } else if (e.kind === 'wide') {
      px(cx - 2, cy + 8, 3, 7, '#223300');
      px(cx + e.w, cy + 8, 3, 7, '#223300');
      px(cx + 6, cy + 12, 3, 6, '#223300');
      px(cx + e.w - 9, cy + 12, 3, 6, '#223300');
      px(cx, cy + 5, e.w, e.h - 5, '#8a2a1a');
      px(cx + 3, cy + 2, e.w - 6, e.h, '#aa3a2a');
      px(cx - wing, cy, 5, 7, '#cc5a3a');
      px(cx + e.w - 5 + wing, cy, 5, 7, '#cc5a3a');
      px(cx + 7, cy - 2, e.w - 14, 6, '#6a1a10');
      px(cx + 9, cy, 3, 3, '#ffff00');
      px(cx + e.w - 12, cy, 3, 3, '#ffff00');
      px(cx + 10, cy + 8, 3, 3, '#ffdd00');
      px(cx + e.w - 13, cy + 8, 3, 3, '#ffdd00');
    } else {
      // big beetle
      px(cx - 3, cy + 10, 4, 8, '#1a2a00');
      px(cx + e.w, cy + 10, 4, 8, '#1a2a00');
      px(cx + 8, cy + 16, 4, 7, '#1a2a00');
      px(cx + e.w - 12, cy + 16, 4, 7, '#1a2a00');
      px(cx, cy + 6, e.w, e.h - 6, '#1a4a5a');
      px(cx + 4, cy + 2, e.w - 8, e.h, '#2a6a7a');
      px(cx - wing, cy, 6, 9, '#3a8a9a');
      px(cx + e.w - 6 + wing, cy, 6, 9, '#3a8a9a');
      px(cx + 9, cy - 3, e.w - 18, 8, '#0a2a3a');
      px(cx + 12, cy - 1, 4, 4, '#ff2222');
      px(cx + e.w - 16, cy - 1, 4, 4, '#ff2222');
      px(cx + 12, cy + 10, 4, 4, '#ffdd00');
      px(cx + e.w - 16, cy + 10, 4, 4, '#ffdd00');
      px(cx + 14, cy + 14, e.w - 28, 3, '#ff8800');
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    if (player.inv > 0 && Math.floor(state.tick / 4) % 2 === 0) return;
    const x = player.x, y = player.y;
    // legs
    px(x + 2, y + 14, 3, 4, '#1a2a4a');
    px(x + player.w - 5, y + 14, 3, 4, '#1a2a4a');
    // body
    px(x, y + 4, player.w, player.h - 4, '#2a4a8a');
    px(x + 2, y + 2, player.w - 4, player.h, '#3a6aaa');
    // wings
    px(x - 2, y + 6, 3, 5, '#6a9ad0');
    px(x + player.w - 1, y + 6, 3, 5, '#6a9ad0');
    // head
    px(x + 4, y - 2, player.w - 8, 5, '#1a3a6a');
    // eyes
    px(x + 5, y, 2, 2, '#ffffff');
    px(x + player.w - 7, y, 2, 2, '#ffffff');
    // cannon
    px(x + player.w / 2 - 2, y - 6, 4, 5, '#ffdd00');
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + state.score, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillText('HI ' + state.hi, W - 70, 8);
    // lives as little ships
    for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) {
      const lx = 8 + i * 20;
      const ly = H - 16;
      px(lx, ly, 12, 8, '#3a6aaa');
      px(lx + 2, ly - 2, 8, 4, '#1a3a6a');
      px(lx + 5, ly - 5, 2, 3, '#ffdd00');
    }
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    drawBackground();
    // title
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    const title = 'MEGA-BUG';
    ctx.font = 'bold 34px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff2222';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2 + 2, H / 2 - 30 + 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd00';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

    // a big bug on title
    const big = { x: W / 2 - 25, y: H / 2 + 10, w: 50, h: 40, kind: 'big', t: state.tick * 0.05 };
    drawBug(big);

    ctx.font = 'bold 14px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    if (Math.floor(state.tick / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9aa0ff';
    ctx.font = '12px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('ARROWS / A D  MOVE     SPACE  FIRE', W / 2, H - 24);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawDead() {
    drawBackground();
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff2222';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd00';
    ctx.fillText('HI     ' + state.hi, W / 2, H / 2 + 34);
    if (Math.floor(state.tick / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#9aa0ff';
      ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE FOR TITLE', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake, state.shake), rand(-state.shake, state.shake));
    }

    if (state.mode === 'title') {
      drawTitle();
    } else if (state.mode === 'dead') {
      drawDead();
    } else {
      drawBackground();
      for (const e of enemies) drawBug(e);
      // bullets
      for (const b of bullets) {
        px(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, '#ffdd00');
        px(b.x + 1, b.y, 2, b.h, '#ffffff');
      }
      drawPlayer();
      // particles
      for (const p of particles) {
        px(p.x, p.y, 3, 3, p.color);
      }
      drawHUD();
    }

    // damage flash
    if (state.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,' + (state.flash / 20) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---- Loop ----
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  makeStars();
  starsInit = true;
  loop();
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Donkey Kong 3</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}

<canvas id="c" width="320" height="224"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var canvas=document.getElementById("c");
var ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;

// ---- palette (chunky 6+ colors) ----
var BG="#000000", STEEL="#2a2a3a", STEEL2="#4a4a5e", ORANGE="#ff7f27",
    YELLOW="#ffd23b", GREEN="#37d06b", RED="#ff3b30", WHITE="#ffffff",
    BROWN="#b5651d", DARK="#120a05";

// ---- game constants ----
var W=320,H=224;
var GROUND=200;
var GRAV=0.22;
var P_W=12,P_H=16;
var MAXHP=3;
var JUMP_V=-4.6;
var MOVE=1.5;

// ---- state ----
var state="start"; // start | playing | win | lose
var score=0, lives=MAXHP;
var player={x:20,y:GROUND-P_H,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:true,face:1,anim:0};
var barrels=[];
var barrelsX=[120,220];
var barrelTimer=0, barrelInterval=90;
var monkey={x:250,y:GROUND-22,anim:0};
var clouds=[{x:40,y:30,s:14},{x:150,y:52,s:10},{x:250,y:26,s:16}];
var rain=[];
for(var i=0;i<40;i++) rain.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H});
var message="";
var messageTimer=0;

// ---- input ----
var keys={left:false,right:false,jump:false};
function keymap(e){
  var k=e.keyCode;
  if(k===37||k===65) return "left";
  if(k===39||k===68) return "right";
  if(k===32||k===38||k===87) return "jump";
  return null;
}
window.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
  var m=keymap(e);
  if(m){ keys[m]=true; e.preventDefault(); }
  if(state==="start" && (e.keyCode===13||e.keyCode===32)) startGame();
  if((state==="win"||state==="lose") && e.keyCode===13) startGame();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup",function(e){
  var m=keymap(e);
  if(m){ keys[m]=false; e.preventDefault(); }
});

function startGame(){
  state="playing";
  score=0; lives=MAXHP;
  player.x=20; player.y=GROUND-P_H; player.vx=0; player.vy=0; player.onGround=true;
  barrels=[]; barrelTimer=0;
  message=""; messageTimer=0;
}

// ---- update ----
function update(){
  if(state!=="playing") return;

  // player movement
  player.vx=0;
  if(keys.left){ player.vx=-MOVE; player.face=-1; }
  if(keys.right){ player.vx=MOVE; player.face=1; }
  if(keys.jump && player.onGround){ player.vy=JUMP_V; player.onGround=false; }

  player.x+=player.vx;
  if(player.x<2) player.x=2;
  if(player.x>W-P_W-2) player.x=W-P_W-2;

  player.vy+=GRAV;
  player.y+=player.vy;
  if(player.y>=GROUND-P_H){ player.y=GROUND-P_H; player.vy=0; player.onGround=true; }
  if(player.vx!==0) player.anim+=0.3; else player.anim=0;

  // spawn barrels
  barrelTimer++;
  if(barrelTimer>=barrelInterval){
    barrelTimer=0;
    barrels.push({x:barrelsX[Math.floor(Math.random()*2)],y:GROUND-14,vx:-1.4,rot:0});
    barrelInterval=Math.max(55,barrelInterval-2);
  }

  // update barrels
  for(var i=barrels.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var b=barrels[i];
    b.x+=b.vx; b.rot+=0.25;
    if(b.x<-20){ barrels.splice(i,1); score+=10; }
    // collide with player
    if(rectHit(b.x,b.y,14,14, player.x,player.y,P_W,P_H)){
      barrels.splice(i,1);
      lives--;
      message="OOF!"; messageTimer=40;
      player.vy=-3;
      if(lives<=0){ state="lose"; message="GAME OVER"; }
    }
  }

  // monkey animation
  monkey.anim+=0.08;

  if(messageTimer>0) messageTimer--;
}

function rectHit(x1,y1,w1,h1,x2,y2,w2,h2){
  return x1<x2+w2 && x1+w1>x2 && y1<y2+h2 && y1+h1>y2;
}

// ---- pixel helpers ----
function px(x,y,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(x,y,1,1); }
function blk(x,y,w,h,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h); }

// ---- draw player (Ralph) ----
function drawPlayer(){
  var x=Math.round(player.x), y=Math.round(player.y);
  var f=player.face;
  // legs
  var step=(Math.floor(player.anim)%2) && !player.onGround===false ? 1:0;
  blk(x+2,y+12,3,4,GREEN); blk(x+7,y+12,3,4,GREEN);
  // body (green overalls)
  blk(x+2,y+6,8,7,GREEN);
  // shirt
  blk(x+3,y+4,6,3,YELLOW);
  // head
  blk(x+3,y+0,6,4,BROWN);
  // face
  blk(x+(f>0?6:4),y+1,2,2,WHITE);
  px(x+(f>0?7:5),y+2,RED);
  // arms
  blk(x+(f>0?8:0),y+7,2,4,GREEN);
}

// ---- draw monkey (Donkey Kong) ----
function drawMonkey(){
  var x=Math.round(monkey.x), y=Math.round(monkey.y);
  var bounce=Math.floor(Math.sin(monkey.anim)*2);
  // body
  blk(x+2,y+6,10,8,BROWN);
  // chest
  blk(x+5,y+8,4,5,YELLOW);
  // head
  blk(x+3,y+0,8,6,BROWN);
  // face
  blk(x+5,y+2,4,3,ORANGE);
  px(x+6,y+3,WHITE); px(x+8,y+3,WHITE);
  // arms
  blk(x+0,y+7+bounce,3,5,BROWN);
  blk(x+12,y+7-bounce,3,5,BROWN);
  // legs
  blk(x+3,y+14,3,4,BROWN); blk(x+9,y+14,3,4,BROWN);
}

// ---- draw barrel ----
function drawBarrel(b){
  var x=Math.round(b.x), y=Math.round(b.y);
  // rolling circle look with 4-color ring
  blk(x+2,y+1,10,2,ORANGE);
  blk(x+1,y+3,12,8,ORANGE);
  blk(x+2,y+11,10,2,ORANGE);
  // steel bands
  blk(x+1,y+5,12,1,STEEL2);
  blk(x+1,y+8,12,1,STEEL2);
  // highlight
  px(x+3,y+3,WHITE);
  // motion dots (rolling)
  var r=Math.floor(b.rot*4)%12;
  px(x+2+(r%10),y+2,STEEL2);
}

// ---- background: sky, clouds, rain, ground, girders ----
function drawBackground(){
  // dark stormy sky gradient via bands
  blk(0,0,W,40,"#05070f");
  blk(0,40,W,30,"#080b18");
  blk(0,70,W,130,"#0b0f20");
  // clouds
  for(var i=0;i<clouds.length;i++){
    var c=clouds[i];
    blk(Math.round(c.x),Math.round(c.y),c.s*2,6,STEEL2);
    blk(Math.round(c.x)+3,Math.round(c.y)-4,c.s,6,STEEL2);
    blk(Math.round(c.x)+c.s,Math.round(c.y)+4,c.s,5,STEEL);
    c.x+=0.15; if(c.x>W+20) c.x=-30;
  }
  // rain
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,150,200,0.35)";
  for(var j=0;j<rain.length;j++){
    var r=rain[j];
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(r.x),Math.round(r.y),1,4);
    r.y+=3; r.x-=0.5;
    if(r.y>H){ r.y=-4; r.x=Math.random()*W; }
  }
  // ground
  blk(0,GROUND,W,H-GROUND,STEEL);
  for(var gx=0;gx<W;gx+=16){
    blk(gx,GROUND,1,4,STEEL2);
    blk(gx,GROUND+6,1,2,STEEL2);
  }
  // girders (scaffolding)
  for(var g=0; g<3; g++){
    var gx2=40+g*100;
    blk(gx2,90,4,GROUND-90,STEEL2);
    blk(gx2+30,90,4,GROUND-90,STEEL2);
    blk(gx2,120,38,3,STEEL2);
    blk(gx2,160,38,3,STEEL2);
    blk(gx2,120,38,1,STEEL);
  }
}

// ---- HUD ----
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle=WHITE; ctx.font="10px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE "+score,6,12);
  ctx.fillText("LIVES",6,24);
  for(var i=0;i<lives;i++) blk(34+i*10,18,7,7,RED);
  ctx.fillStyle=ORANGE;
  ctx.fillText("DONKEY KONG 3",150,12);
}

// ---- screens ----
function drawStart(){
  ctx.fillStyle=ORANGE; ctx.font="20px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("DONKEY KONG",70,70);
  ctx.fillStyle=YELLOW; ctx.font="14px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("3",150,90);
  ctx.fillStyle=WHITE; ctx.font="10px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("DODGE THE BARRELS",70,120);
  ctx.fillText("ARROWS / WASD = MOVE",60,138);
  ctx.fillText("SPACE / W = JUMP",80,152);
  if(Math.floor(Date.now()/500)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle=GREEN; ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO START",80,180);
  }
}
function drawEnd(win){
  ctx.fillStyle=win?GREEN:RED; ctx.font="20px monospace";
  ctx.fillText(win?"YOU WIN!":"GAME OVER",80,100);
  ctx.fillStyle=WHITE; ctx.font="12px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE "+score,110,125);
  ctx.fillStyle=YELLOW; ctx.font="10px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO RESTART",80,150);
}

// ---- main draw ----
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  drawBackground();
  if(state==="start"){
    drawMonkey();
    drawPlayer();
    drawStart();
    return;
  }
  drawMonkey();
  for(var i=0;i<barrels.length;i++) drawBarrel(barrels[i]);
  drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();
  if(messageTimer>0){
    ctx.fillStyle=RED; ctx.font="16px monospace";
    ctx.fillText(message,130,110);
  }
  if(state==="win") drawEnd(true);
  if(state==="lose") drawEnd(false);
}

// ---- win check (survive / score threshold) ----
function checkWin(){
  if(state==="playing" && score>=200){
    state="win";
  }
}

// ---- loop ----
function loop(){
  update();
  checkWin();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bounceoids</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    height: 100%;
    background: #000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #game {
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255,0,255,0.35);
    border: 3px solid #2a2a2a;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="320" height="240"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ============================
   STATE
   ============================ */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

// solid 8-bit palette (about six colors + shades)
const C = {
  bg:    '#12002b',
  bg2:   '#1f0b45',
  grid:  '#3a1a6e',
  wall:  '#ff2d95',
  wallHi:'#ff9ad5',
  ball:  '#00e5ff',
  ballHi:'#b6faff',
  ballLo:'#007a99',
  text:  '#ffffff',
  accent:'#ffe14d',
  danger:'#ff5a3c',
  dim:   '#6a4b9e'
};

const P = {
  state: 'title',   // title | playing | win | lose
  ball: { x: W/2, y: H-40, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 6 },
  paddle: { x: W/2, w: 46, h: 8, y: H-14, speed: 230 },
  bricks: [],
  score: 0,
  lives: 3,
  level: 1,
  maxLevel: 3,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  message: '',
  messageTimer: 0,
  keys: { left:false, right:false },
  winTimer: 0
};

// build brick rows for a given level (short loop, no long map string)
function buildBricks(level) {
  const bricks = [];
  const cols = 8;
  const bw = 34, bh = 12, gap = 2;
  const totalW = cols*bw + (cols-1)*gap;
  const startX = (W - totalW)/2;
  const rows = 3 + level;                 // more rows each level
  const rowColors = [C.wall, C.accent, C.ball, C.danger, C.wallHi, C.dim];
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      // leave a couple holes at higher levels for challenge
      if (level >= 2 && ((r+c) % 7 === 0)) continue;
      if (level >= 3 && ((r*3+c) % 11 === 0)) continue;
      bricks.push({
        x: startX + c*(bw+gap),
        y: 46 + r*(bh+gap),
        w: bw, h: bh,
        color: rowColors[r % rowColors.length],
        alive: true
      });
    }
  }
  return bricks;
}

function resetBall() {
  const b = P.ball;
  b.x = P.paddle.x;
  b.y = P.paddle.y - b.r - 2;
  const a = (Math.random()*0.6 + 0.4) * -Math.PI/2; // upward spread
  const sp = 150 + P.level*12;
  b.vx = Math.cos(a)*sp;
  b.vy = Math.sin(a)*sp;
}

function startLevel(level) {
  P.level = level;
  P.bricks = buildBricks(level);
  P.paddle.x = W/2;
  resetBall();
  P.state = 'playing';
}

function startGame() {
  P.score = 0;
  P.lives = 3;
  startLevel(1);
}

/* ============================
   INPUT
   ============================ */
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') P.keys.left = true;
  if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') P.keys.right = true;
  if (P.state === 'title') {
    if (k === 'enter' || k === ' ' || k === 'z') startGame();
  } else if (P.state === 'win') {
    if (k === 'enter' || k === ' ') { P.winTimer = 0; startLevel(P.level+1); }
  } else if (P.state === 'lose') {
    if (k === 'enter' || k === ' ' || k === 'z') startGame();
  }
  if (['arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') P.keys.left = false;
  if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') P.keys.right = false;
});
// touch / click to move paddle
function pointerMove(clientX) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * W;
  P.paddle.x = Math.max(P.paddle.w/2, Math.min(W-P.paddle.w/2, x));
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if (P.state==='playing') pointerMove(e.clientX); });
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { if (P.state==='playing'){ pointerMove(e.touches[0].clientX); e.preventDefault(); } }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (P.state==='title') startGame();
  else if (P.state==='lose') startGame();
});

/* ============================
   UPDATE
   ============================ */
function movePaddle(dt) {
  const p = P.paddle;
  if (P.keys.left)  p.x -= p.speed*dt;
  if (P.keys.right) p.x += p.speed*dt;
  p.x = Math.max(p.w/2, Math.min(W-p.w/2, p.x));
}

function bounceBricks() {
  const b = P.ball;
  for (const br of P.bricks) {
    if (!br.alive) continue;
    if (b.x + b.r < br.x || b.x - b.r > br.x + br.w ||
        b.y + b.r < br.y || b.y - b.r > br.y + br.h) continue;
    // determine side of collision
    const overlapX = Math.min(b.x + b.r - br.x, br.x + br.w - (b.x - b.r));
    const overlapY = Math.min(b.y + b.r - br.y, br.y + br.h - (b.y - b.r));
    if (overlapX < overlapY) {
      b.vx = b.x < br.x + br.w/2 ? -Math.abs(b.vx) : Math.abs(b.vx);
      b.x += (b.x < br.x + br.w/2 ? -overlapX : overlapX);
    } else {
      b.vy = b.y < br.y + br.h/2 ? -Math.abs(b.vy) : Math.abs(b.vy);
      b.y += (b.y < br.y + br.h/2 ? -overlapY : overlapY);
    }
    br.alive = false;
    P.score += 10 * P.level;
    P.flash = 0.12;
    P.shake = 3;
    break; // one brick per frame
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  P.time += dt;
  if (P.flash > 0) P.flash -= dt;
  if (P.shake > 0) P.shake = Math.max(0, P.shake - dt*30);
  if (P.messageTimer > 0) P.messageTimer -= dt;

  if (P.state === 'title') return;
  if (P.state === 'win') { P.winTimer += dt; return; }
  if (P.state === 'lose') return;

  movePaddle(dt);

  const b = P.ball;
  b.x += b.vx*dt;
  b.y += b.vy*dt;

  // walls
  if (b.x - b.r < 0)   { b.x = b.r;   b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx); }
  if (b.x + b.r > W)   { b.x = W-b.r; b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx); }
  if (b.y - b.r < 0)   { b.y = b.r;   b.vy = Math.abs(b.vy); }

  // paddle
  const p = P.paddle;
  if (b.vy > 0 &&
      b.y + b.r >= p.y && b.y - b.r <= p.y + p.h &&
      b.x >= p.x - p.w/2 - b.r && b.x <= p.x + p.w/2 + b.r) {
    const hit = (b.x - p.x) / (p.w/2);           // -1..1
    const angle = hit * (Math.PI/3);             // up to 60 deg
    const sp = Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy);
    b.vx = Math.sin(angle)*sp;
    b.vy = -Math.cos(angle)*sp;
    b.y = p.y - b.r - 0.5;
  }

  bounceBricks();

  // lost ball
  if (b.y - b.r > H) {
    P.lives--;
    P.shake = 6;
    if (P.lives <= 0) { P.state = 'lose'; }
    else resetBall();
  }

  // win check
  if (P.bricks.every(x => !x.alive)) {
    if (P.level >= P.maxLevel) { P.state = 'lose'; P.message = 'YOU WIN!'; P.messageTimer = 999; }
    else { P.state = 'win'; P.winTimer = 0; }
  }
}

/* ============================
   DRAW  (chunky pixel style)
   ============================ */
function px(x, y, w, h, color) { ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fillRect(x|0, y|0, w, h); }

function drawBackground() {
  // base
  px(0,0,W,H,C.bg);
  // vertical gradient bands
  for (let i=0;i<6;i++) px(0, i*40, W, 40, i%2? C.bg : C.bg2);
  // star field
  for (let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const sx = (i*53 + 17) % W;
    const sy = (i*37 + 11) % 160;
    const tw = (Math.sin(P.time*3 + i) + 1) / 2;
    px(sx, sy, tw>0.5?2:1, tw>0.5?2:1, tw>0.7? C.ballHi : C.dim);
  }
  // grid floor (bottom half)
  ctx.strokeStyle = C.grid; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x=0;x<=W;x+=20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,150); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for (let y=150;y<=H;y+=16) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke(); }
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const br of P.bricks) {
    if (!br.alive) continue;
    px(br.x, br.y, br.w, br.h, br.color);            // body
    px(br.x, br.y, br.w, 2, C.text);                 // top highlight
    px(br.x, br.y + br.h - 2, br.w, 2, '#000');     // bottom shade
    px(br.x, br.y, 2, br.h, C.text);                // left highlight
    px(br.x + br.w - 2, br.y, 2, br.h, '#000');    // right shade
  }
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const p = P.paddle;
  const x = p.x - p.w/2;
  px(x, p.y, p.w, p.h, C.accent);
  px(x, p.y, p.w, 2, C.text);
  px(x, p.y + p.h - 2, p.w, 2, '#b8860b');
  // little side caps
  px(x, p.y, 3, p.h, C.danger);
  px(x + p.w - 3, p.y, 3, p.h, C.danger);
}

function drawBall() {
  const b = P.ball;
  // body
  px(b.x-b.r, b.y-b.r, b.r*2, b.r*2, C.ball);
  // shading
  px(b.x-b.r, b.y+b.r-3, b.r*2, 3, C.ballLo);
  px(b.x+b.r-3, b.y-b.r, 3, b.r*2, C.ballLo);
  // highlight
  px(b.x-b.r+2, b.y-b.r+2, 3, 3, C.ballHi);
  // trail
  const tx = b.x - b.vx*0.03, ty = b.y - b.vy*0.03;
  px(tx-3, ty-3, 6, 6, C.ballHi);
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = C.text;
  ctx.font = 'bold 9px Courier New';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + String(P.score).padStart(5,'0'), 6, 6);
  ctx.fillText('LVL ' + P.level, W-40, 6);
  // lives as small balls
  for (let i=0;i<P.lives;i++) px(W-24 + i*0, 18, 0,0, C.ball); // placeholder
  for (let i=0;i<P.lives;i++){
    const lx = W-26 - i*12;
    px(lx, 18, 8, 8, C.ball);
    px(lx+1, 19, 2, 2, C.ballHi);
  }
}

function drawCenterText(lines, y, size, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + size + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  lines.forEach((ln,i)=> ctx.fillText(ln, W/2, y + i*(size+6)));
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawTitle() {
  drawBackground();
  // bouncing demo ball in title
  const t = P.time;
  const dx = W/2 + Math.sin(t*1.5)*90;
  const dy = 120 + Math.cos(t*2)*30;
  px(dx-6, dy-6, 12, 12, C.ball);
  px(dx-4, dy-4, 3, 3, C.ballHi);
  drawCenterText(['BOUNCEOIDS'], 60, 26, C.wall);
  drawCenterText(['8-BIT ARCADE'], 92, 10, C.accent);
  if (Math.floor(P.time*2)%2===0)
    drawCenterText(['PRESS ENTER OR TAP TO START'], 170, 10, C.text);
}

function drawWin() {
  drawBackground();
  drawBricks();
  drawPaddle();
  drawHUD();
  drawCenterText(['LEVEL ' + P.level + ' CLEAR!'], 90, 18, C.accent);
  if (P.winTimer>0.6)
    drawCenterText(['PRESS ENTER FOR LEVEL ' + (P.level+1)], 130, 10, C.text);
}

function drawLose() {
  drawBackground();
  drawBricks();
  drawHUD();
  const win = P.message === 'YOU WIN!';
  drawCenterText([win?'YOU WIN!':'GAME OVER'], 90, 22, win? C.accent : C.danger);
  drawCenterText(['FINAL SCORE  ' + P.score], 120, 12, C.text);
  if (Math.floor(P.time*2)%2===0)
    drawCenterText(['PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN'], 150, 10, C.text);
}

function draw() {
  let ox=0, oy=0;
  if (P.shake>0){ ox=(Math.random()*2-1)*P.shake; oy=(Math.random()*2-1)*P.shake; }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(ox|0, oy|0);

  if (P.state==='title') drawTitle();
  else if (P.state==='win') drawWin();
  else if (P.state==='lose') drawLose();
  else {
    drawBackground();
    drawBricks();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawHUD();
    if (P.flash>0){ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(P.flash*3)+')'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============================
   LOOP
   ============================ */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last)/1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;   // clamp big frame gaps
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Sands of Egypt</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;
    background: #1a1208;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    border: 4px solid #d9a441;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #2b1d0e, 0 0 40px #000;
    background: #f2c879;
    width: min(92vw, calc(92vh * 16 / 9));
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    display: block;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="320" height="180"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  // ---- Palette (chunky 8-bit, ~6 solid colors) ----
  const C = {
    sky:   "#f2c879", // warm sand sky
    dune:  "#e0a850",
    dune2: "#c98a35",
    gold:  "#f4c542",
    gold2: "#b8860b",
    dark:  "#2b1d0e",
    red:   "#c0392b",
    white: "#fff4d6",
  };

  const W = 320, H = 180;
  const GROUND = 150;
  const GRAV = 0.45;

  // ---- Game state ----
  let state = "title"; // title | play | win | lose
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let time = 0;
  let shake = 0;

  const player = {
    x: 40, y: GROUND - 20, w: 16, h: 20,
    vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false,
    facing: 1, walk: 0,
    invuln: 0,
  };

  const GOAL_X = 296;
  const GOAL_W = 22;

  let gems = [];
  let enemies = [];
  let obstacles = [];
  let particles = [];
  let floaters = [];

  const keys = {};

  // ---- Build a short, self-contained level ----
  function buildLevel() {
    score = 0;
    time = 0;
    shake = 0;
    player.x = 40; player.y = GROUND - player.h; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = true; player.facing = 1; player.invuln = 0;
    particles = []; floaters = [];

    // Gold gems to collect
    gems = [
      { x: 90,  y: GROUND - 14, got: false },
      { x: 150, y: GROUND - 14, got: false },
      { x: 150, y: GROUND - 46, got: false },
      { x: 210, y: GROUND - 14, got: false },
      { x: 255, y: GROUND - 14, got: false },
    ];

    // Wandering scarab enemies
    enemies = [
      { x: 120, y: GROUND - 12, w: 14, h: 12, dir: 1, speed: 0.5, min: 95, max: 155 },
      { x: 200, y: GROUND - 12, w: 14, h: 12, dir: -1, speed: 0.7, min: 180, max: 240 },
    ];

    // Static rock / tomb obstacles
    obstacles = [
      { x: 178, y: GROUND - 22, w: 18, h: 22 },
      { x: 250, y: GROUND - 16, w: 16, h: 16 },
    ];
  }

  // ---- Input ----
  function addEventListener(name, fn) {
    window.addEventListener(name, fn);
  }

  addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (["arrowleft","arrowright","arrowup"," "].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    if (state === "title" && (k === "enter" || k === " ")) {
      buildLevel(); state = "play";
    } else if ((state === "win" || state === "lose") && (k === "enter" || k === " ")) {
      buildLevel(); state = "play";
    }
  });
  addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

  // ---- Helpers ----
  function overlap(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x &&
           a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
  }

  function spawnBurst(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
        vy: -Math.random() * 3 - 0.5,
        life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
        color,
      });
    }
  }

  function addFloater(x, y, text, color) {
    floaters.push({ x, y, text, color, life: 40 });
  }

  // ---- Update ----
  function update() {
    time++;
    if (shake > 0) shake--;

    if (state !== "play") {
      updateParticles();
      return;
    }

    // Horizontal movement
    let move = 0;
    if (keys["arrowleft"] || keys["a"]) move -= 1;
    if (keys["arrowright"] || keys["d"]) move += 1;
    player.vx = move * 1.7;
    if (move !== 0) { player.facing = move; player.walk += 0.35; }

    // Jump
    if ((keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"] || keys[" "]) && player.onGround) {
      player.vy = -7.2;
      player.onGround = false;
      spawnBurst(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h, C.dune, 6);
    }

    // Gravity
    player.vy += GRAV;
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;

    // Keep in bounds
    if (player.x < 4) player.x = 4;
    if (player.x + player.w > W - 4) player.x = W - 4 - player.w;

    // Ground
    if (player.y + player.h >= GROUND) {
      player.y = GROUND - player.h;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
    } else {
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    // Obstacle collision (solid)
    for (const o of obstacles) {
      if (overlap(player, o)) {
        // push out on the axis of least penetration
        const px = (player.x + player.w / 2) - (o.x + o.w / 2);
        const py = (player.y + player.h / 2) - (o.y + o.h / 2);
        if (Math.abs(px) > Math.abs(py)) {
          player.x += px > 0 ? (o.w / 2 + player.w / 2 - Math.abs(px)) * (px > 0 ? 1 : -1) : 0;
          if (px > 0) player.x = o.x + o.w; else player.x = o.x - player.w;
        } else {
          if (py > 0) { player.y = o.y + o.h; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true; }
          else player.y = o.y - player.h;
        }
      }
    }

    // Gems
    for (const g of gems) {
      if (!g.got) {
        const box = { x: g.x - 6, y: g.y - 6, w: 12, h: 12 };
        if (overlap(player, box)) {
          g.got = true;
          score += 100;
          spawnBurst(g.x, g.y, C.gold, 10);
          addFloater(g.x, g.y - 8, "+100", C.gold);
        }
      }
    }

    // Enemies: wander
    for (const en of enemies) {
      en.x += en.dir * en.speed;
      if (en.x < en.min) { en.x = en.min; en.dir = 1; }
      if (en.x + en.w > en.max) { en.x = en.max - en.w; en.dir = -1; }
      if (overlap(player, en)) {
        if (player.invuln <= 0) {
          // Stomp from above?
          if (player.vy > 0 && (player.y + player.h) < (en.y + en.h / 2)) {
            player.vy = -5;
            en.x = -999; // remove
            score += 200;
            spawnBurst(en.x + en.w / 2, en.y, C.red, 12);
            addFloater(en.x + en.w / 2, en.y, "+200", C.red);
          } else {
            player.invuln = 60;
            shake = 8;
            spawnBurst(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, C.red, 10);
            // lose
            state = "lose";
            if (score > best) best = score;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.x > -500);

    if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln--;

    // Reach the pyramid goal
    if (player.x + player.w > GOAL_X) {
      state = "win";
      score += 500;
      if (score > best) best = score;
      spawnBurst(GOAL_X + GOAL_W / 2, GROUND - 30, C.gold, 24);
    }

    updateParticles();
  }

  function updateParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vy += 0.15; p.life--;
    }
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
    for (const f of floaters) { f.y -= 0.4; f.life--; }
    floaters = floaters.filter(f => f.life > 0);
  }

  // ---- Drawing (chunky fillRect pixel style) ----
  function px(x, y, w, h, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(w), Math.round(h));
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // Sky
    px(0, 0, W, H, C.sky);
    // Sun
    px(250, 20, 24, 24, C.white);
    px(254, 16, 16, 32, C.white);
    px(246, 24, 32, 16, C.white);
    // Distant dunes
    px(0, 96, W, 20, C.dune);
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 16) {
      px(i, 92 + (i % 32 === 0 ? 0 : 4), 16, 8, C.dune);
    }
    // Mid dunes
    px(0, 116, W, 34, C.dune2);
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 20) {
      px(i, 112 + (i % 40 === 0 ? 0 : 5), 20, 8, C.dune2);
    }
    // Ground
    px(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND, C.dune);
    // Ground speckle
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 12) {
      px(i + (i % 24 === 0 ? 3 : 0), GROUND + 6 + (i % 12), 3, 2, C.dune2);
    }
    px(0, GROUND, W, 2, C.dune2); // top edge
  }

  function drawGoal() {
    // Pyramid / temple entrance at the far right
    const x = GOAL_X;
    // Big pyramid
    for (let row = 0; row < 40; row++) {
      const inset = Math.floor(row * 0.45);
      px(x + inset, GROUND - 40 + row, (GOAL_W + 40) - inset * 2, 2, C.gold);
    }
    // outline
    px(x - 2, GROUND - 40, 2, 40, C.gold2);
    px(x + GOAL_W + 2, GROUND - 40, 2, 40, C.gold2);
    // doorway (goal marker)
    px(x + GOAL_W / 2 - 4, GROUND - 18, 8, 18, C.dark);
    px(x + GOAL_W / 2 - 5, GROUND - 19, 10, 2, C.gold2);
    // glow pulse
    if (Math.floor(time / 12) % 2 === 0) {
      px(x + GOAL_W / 2 - 6, GROUND - 20, 12, 2, C.white);
    }
  }

  function drawGems() {
    for (const g of gems) {
      if (g.got) continue;
      const bob = Math.sin((time + g.x) * 0.15) * 2;
      const y = g.y + bob;
      // diamond shape in gold
      px(g.x - 3, y - 5, 6, 2, C.gold);
      px(g.x - 5, y - 3, 10, 2, C.gold);
      px(g.x - 6, y - 1, 12, 2, C.gold2);
      px(g.x - 5, y + 1, 10, 2, C.gold);
      px(g.x - 3, y + 3, 6, 2, C.gold);
      px(g.x - 1, y - 4, 2, 2, C.white); // sparkle
    }
  }

  function drawObstacles() {
    for (const o of obstacles) {
      // rock / tomb block
      px(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, C.dune2);
      px(o.x, o.y, o.w, 3, C.dune);
      px(o.x, o.y + o.h - 3, o.w, 3, C.dark);
      px(o.x + o.w / 2 - 2, o.y + 4, 4, o.h - 8, C.dark); // crack
      px(o.x + 2, o.y + 6, 3, 3, C.dark);
    }
  }

  function drawEnemies() {
    for (const en of enemies) {
      // scarab beetle body
      px(en.x, en.y + 2, en.w, en.h - 4, C.red);
      px(en.x + 2, en.y, en.w - 4, en.h, C.red);
      // shell stripes
      px(en.x + en.w / 2 - 1, en.y + 2, 2, en.h - 4, C.dark);
      px(en.x + 3, en.y + 4, en.w - 6, 2, C.dark);
      // legs
      const t = Math.floor(time / 4) % 2;
      px(en.x - 2, en.y + en.h - 3 + t, 3, 3, C.dark);
      px(en.x + en.w - 1, en.y + en.h - 3 - t, 3, 3, C.dark);
      // eyes
      px(en.x + (en.dir > 0 ? en.w - 4 : 2), en.y + 3, 2, 2, C.white);
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    // blink when invulnerable
    if (p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(p.invuln / 4) % 2 === 0) return;

    const x = Math.round(p.x), y = Math.round(p.y);
    const step = Math.floor(p.walk) % 2;

    // Robe / body (white linen)
    px(x + 2, y + 6, 12, 12, C.white);
    px(x + 1, y + 8, 14, 8, C.white);
    // Belt
    px(x + 2, y + 12, 12, 2, C.gold2);
    // Head
    px(x + 4, y + 1, 8, 6, C.dune);
    // Headband
    px(x + 3, y + 3, 10, 2, C.gold);
    // Eye
    px(x + (p.facing > 0 ? 9 : 5), y + 4, 2, 2, C.dark);
    // Legs (walking)
    if (p.onGround && Math.abs(p.vx) > 0.1) {
      px(x + 3 + step * 2, y + 18, 4, 3, C.white);
      px(x + 9 - step * 2, y + 18, 4, 3, C.white);
    } else {
      px(x + 4, y + 18, 4, 3, C.white);
      px(x + 8, y + 18, 4, 3, C.white);
    }
    // Sandal base
    px(x + 2, y + 20, 12, 1, C.gold2);
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      px(p.x, p.y, 3, 3, p.color);
    }
    for (const f of floaters) {
      ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
      ctx.font = "bold 8px monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(f.text, Math.round(f.x), Math.round(f.y));
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = C.dark;
    ctx.font = "bold 10px monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE " + String(score).padStart(5, "0"), 6, 14);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("BEST " + String(best).padStart(5, "0"), W - 6, 14);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    px(0, 0, W, H, "#2b1d0e");
    // decorative sun
    px(128, 30, 64, 64, C.gold);
    px(118, 50, 84, 24, C.gold);
    px(148, 20, 24, 84, C.gold);
    px(128, 30, 64, 64, C.gold2);
    // pyramid
    for (let r = 0; r < 46; r++) {
      const inset = Math.floor(r * 0.5);
      px(60 + inset, 110 + r, 200 - inset * 2, 2, C.dune);
    }
    px(0, 156, W, 24, C.dune2);

    ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("THE SANDS", W / 2, 90);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.gold;
    ctx.font = "bold 16px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("OF EGYPT", W / 2, 108);

    ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
    ctx.font = "bold 9px monospace";
    if (Math.floor(time / 20) % 2 === 0) ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO START", W / 2, 170);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.dune;
    ctx.font = "8px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("ARROWS / WASD  MOVE  -  UP  JUMP  -  REACH THE PYRAMID", W / 2, 158);
  }

  function drawEnd(win) {
    px(0, 0, W, H, "#2b1d0e");
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = win ? C.gold : C.red;
    ctx.font = "bold 22px monospace";
    ctx.fillText(win ? "VICTORY!" : "DEFEATED", W / 2, 70);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
    ctx.font = "bold 12px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score, W / 2, 100);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.dune;
    ctx.font = "9px monospace";
    if (Math.floor(time / 20) % 2 === 0)
      ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN", W / 2, 130);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }

    if (state === "title") {
      drawTitle();
      ctx.restore();
      return;
    }
    if (state === "win") {
      drawEnd(true);
      ctx.restore();
      return;
    }
    if (state === "lose") {
      drawEnd(false);
      ctx.restore();
      return;
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawGoal();
    drawObstacles();
    drawGems();
    drawEnemies();
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---- Main loop ----
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  buildLevel();
  state = "title";
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ============ CONSTANTS ============
  const W = 320, H = 200;
  const GROUND_Y = 170;

  // 6 main colors
  const C_SKY    = '#5b8cc4';
  const C_GROUND = '#7a5230';
  const C_BIRD   = '#d4a017';
  const C_BIRD_D = '#8b5e00';
  const C_RED    = '#cc3333';
  const C_WHITE  = '#f0f0e0';

  // ============ STATE ============
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  let state = 'title'; // title | playing | gameover
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let bird = { x: 160, y: 30, vx: 0, vy: 0, w: 24, h: 16, angle: 0, flap: 0 };
  let worms = [];
  let obstacles = [];
  let particles = [];
  let clouds = [];
  let speed = 1.2;
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let wormTimer = 0;
  let shake = 0;
  let flash = 0;

  // ============ INPUT ============
  const keys = {};
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'title' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) startGame();
    else if (state === 'gameover' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) startGame();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
    if (state === 'title') startGame();
    else if (state === 'gameover') startGame();
    else if (state === 'playing') flap();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'title') startGame();
    else if (state === 'gameover') startGame();
    else if (state === 'playing') flap();
  });

  function flap() {
    if (state !== 'playing') return;
    bird.vy = -4.5;
    bird.flap = 8;
    // small dust particles
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: bird.x + 4, y: bird.y + bird.h,
        vx: -1 - Math.random(), vy: Math.random() * 0.5,
        life: 15, color: C_WHITE
      });
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    speed = 1.2;
    bird = { x: 80, y: 60, vx: 0, vy: 0, w: 24, h: 16, angle: 0, flap: 0 };
    worms = [];
    obstacles = [];
    particles = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    wormTimer = 0;
    shake = 0;
    flash = 0;
    // pre-place a worm
    spawnWorm();
  }

  function spawnWorm() {
    worms.push({
      x: W + 20,
      y: GROUND_Y - 8 - Math.random() * 40,
      w: 12, h: 6,
      wiggle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  function spawnObstacle() {
    const type = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
    if (type === 0) {
      // vertical pipe
      const h = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
      obstacles.push({ type: 'pipe', x: W + 20, y: GROUND_Y - h, w: 16, h: h });
    } else if (type === 1) {
      // top pipe
      const h = 30 + Math.random() * 35;
      obstacles.push({ type: 'pipe_top', x: W + 20, y: 0, w: 16, h: h });
    } else {
      // rock
      const s = 14 + Math.random() * 10;
      obstacles.push({ type: 'rock', x: W + 20, y: GROUND_Y - s, w: s, h: s });
    }
  }

  function spawnCloud() {
    clouds.push({
      x: W + 30,
      y: 10 + Math.random() * 50,
      w: 30 + Math.random() * 30,
      speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3
    });
  }

  // ============ UPDATE ============
  function update() {
    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // difficulty ramp
    speed = 1.2 + score * 0.03;
    if (speed > 3.5) speed = 3.5;

    // bird physics
    bird.vy += 0.18; // gravity
    bird.y += bird.vy;
    if (bird.flap > 0) bird.flap--;

    // angle based on velocity
    bird.angle = Math.atan2(bird.vy, 3) * 0.6;

    // ground collision
    if (bird.y + bird.h >= GROUND_Y) {
      bird.y = GROUND_Y - bird.h;
      die();
      return;
    }
    // ceiling
    if (bird.y < 0) { bird.y = 0; bird.vy = 0; }

    // move worms
    for (let i = worms.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const w = worms[i];
      w.x -= speed;
      w.wiggle += 0.15;
      if (w.x + w.w < -20) {
        worms.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      // eat check
      if (rectOverlap(bird, w)) {
        score++;
        flash = 6;
        // sparkle particles
        for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
          particles.push({
            x: w.x + w.w/2, y: w.y + w.h/2,
            vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*3, vy: -Math.random()*2,
            life: 20, color: C_RED
          });
        }
        worms.splice(i, 1);
        wormTimer = 0;
      }
    }

    // spawn worms
    wormTimer += speed;
    if (wormTimer > 80 + Math.random()*40) {
      spawnWorm();
      wormTimer = 0;
    }

    // move obstacles
    for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const o = obstacles[i];
      o.x -= speed;
      if (o.x + o.w < -20) {
        obstacles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      // collision
      if (rectOverlap(bird, o)) {
        die();
        return;
      }
    }

    // spawn obstacles
    spawnTimer += speed;
    if (spawnTimer > 120 + Math.random()*60) {
      spawnObstacle();
      spawnTimer = 0;
    }

    // clouds
    for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      clouds[i].x -= clouds[i].speed;
      if (clouds[i].x + clouds[i].w < -10) clouds.splice(i, 1);
    }
    if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnCloud();

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // shake decay
    if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;
    if (flash > 0) flash--;
  }

  function die() {
    state = 'gameover';
    if (score > best) best = score;
    shake = 8;
    // explosion particles
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: bird.x + bird.w/2, y: bird.y + bird.h/2,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*5, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*5 - 1,
        life: 30, color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? C_RED : C_BIRD
      });
    }
  }

  function rectOverlap(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w &&
           a.x + a.w > b.x &&
           a.y < b.y + b.h &&
           a.y + a.h > b.y;
  }

  // ============ DRAW ============
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    // screen shake
    if (shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate(
        (Math.random()-0.5) * shake,

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6a9ad4';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 30, W, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8ab4e4';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 60, W, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a0c8f0';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 90, W, 30);

    // --- SUN ---
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d040';
    ctx.fillRect(270, 15, 20, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e060';
    ctx.fillRect(274, 19, 12, 12);

    // --- CLOUDS ---
    ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
    for (const c of clouds) {
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x), Math.floor(c.y), c.w, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x) + 4, Math.floor(c.y) - 4, c.w - 8, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x) + 8, Math.floor(c.y) + 8, c.w - 16, 4);
    }

    // --- GROUND ---
    ctx.fillStyle = C_GROUND;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);
    // ground texture - darker patches
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6a4220';
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 16) {
      ctx.fillRect(i, GROUND_Y + 4, 8, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(i + 8, GROUND_Y + 12, 6, 2);
    }
    // grass line
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a8030';
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a7020';
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 6) {
      ctx.fillRect(i, GROUND_Y - 2, 2, 3);
    }

    // --- OBSTACLES ---
    for (const o of obstacles) {
      if (o.type === 'pipe') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#408040';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x), Math.floor(o.y), o.w, o.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#50a050';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x) + 2, Math.floor(o.y), o.w - 4, o.h);
        // pipe rim
        ctx.fillStyle = '#306030';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x) - 2, Math.floor(o.y), o.w + 4, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#60b060';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x), Math.floor(o.y) + 2, o.w, 2);
      } else if (o.type === 'pipe_top') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#408040';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x), Math.floor(o.y), o.w, o.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#50a050';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x) + 2, Math.floor(o.y), o.w - 4, o.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#306030';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x) - 2, Math.floor(o.y) + o.h - 4, o.w + 4, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#60b060';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x), Math.floor(o.y) + o.h - 6, o.w, 2);
      } else if (o.type === 'rock') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#707070';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x), Math.floor(o.y), o.w, o.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x) + 2, Math.floor(o.y) + 2, o.w - 4, o.h - 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#606060';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(o.x) + 3, Math.floor(o.y) + o.h - 4, o.w - 6, 3);
      }
    }

    // --- WORMS ---
    for (const w of worms) {
      const wig = Math.sin(w.wiggle) * 2;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#d06080';
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(w.x), Math.floor(w.y + wig), w.w, w.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e08090';
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(w.x) + 2, Math.floor(w.y + wig) + 1, w.w - 4, w.h - 2);
      // worm head
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c04060';
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(w.x), Math.floor(w.y + wig), 4, w.h);
      // eyes
      ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(w.x) + 1, Math.floor(w.y + wig) + 1, 2, 2);
    }

    // --- BIRD ---
    if (state !== 'gameover' || particles.length > 0) {
      drawBird();
    }

    // --- PARTICLES ---
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      const s = Math.max(1, Math.floor(p.life / 8));
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x), Math.floor(p.y), s, s);
    }

    // --- FLASH ---
    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,200,0.3)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    // --- HUD ---
    if (state === 'playing') {
      drawHUD();

    if (state === 'title') {
      drawTitle();

    if (state === 'gameover') {
      drawGameOver();
    }

    ctx.restore();

  function drawBird() {
    const bx = Math.floor(bird.x);
    const by = Math.floor(bird.y);
    const flapUp = bird.flap > 4 ? -3 : (bird.flap > 0 ? 0 : 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bx + bird.w/2, by + bird.h/2);
    ctx.rotate(bird.angle);
    ctx.translate(-(bird.w/2), -(bird.h/2));

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = C_BIRD;
    ctx.fillRect(4, 4, 16, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(2, 6, 20, 6);

    // belly (lighter)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8c030';
    ctx.fillRect(6, 9, 12, 4);

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = C_BIRD;
    ctx.fillRect(16, 2, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8c030';
    ctx.fillRect(18, 5, 5, 4);

    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
    ctx.fillRect(20, 3, 3, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.fillRect(21, 4, 2, 2);

    // beak
    ctx.fillStyle = C_RED;
    ctx.fillRect(24, 5, 4, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e04040';
    ctx.fillRect(25, 5, 3, 2);

    // wing
    ctx.fillStyle = C_BIRD_D;
    if (flapUp < 0) {
      ctx.fillRect(6, 0, 10, 5);
      ctx.fillRect(8, -2, 6, 3);
    } else if (flapUp === 0) {
      ctx.fillRect(6, 4, 10, 6);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(6, 8, 10, 5);
      ctx.fillRect(8, 12, 6, 3);
    }

    // tail
    ctx.fillStyle = C_BIRD_D;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 5, 5, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(0, 6, 3, 4);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.fillRect(4, 4, 80, 18);
    ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 8, 17);

    // best
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.fillRect(W - 84, 4, 80, 18);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d040';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('BEST: ' + best, W - 8, 17);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    // dark overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // title box
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,20,40,0.9)';
    ctx.fillRect(40, 40, 240, 120);
    ctx.strokeStyle = C_RED;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(40, 40, 240, 120);

    // title text
    ctx.fillStyle = C_RED;
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('BUZZARD', W/2, 72);
    ctx.fillStyle = C_BIRD;
    ctx.fillText('BAIT', W/2, 94);

    // bird icon
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W/2, 110);
    ctx.scale(1.5, 1.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = C_BIRD;
    ctx.fillRect(-8, -4, 16, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = C_BIRD_D;
    ctx.fillRect(-12, -2, 5, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
    ctx.fillRect(4, -3, 3, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.fillRect(5, -2, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = C_RED;
    ctx.fillRect(8, -1, 4, 3);
    ctx.restore();

    // instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
    ctx.font = '10px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SPACE / TAP TO FLAP', W/2, 145);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '9px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('EAT WORMS - DODGE OBSTACLES', W/2, 158);

    // blinking prompt
    if (Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d040';
      ctx.font = 'bold 10px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('- PRESS SPACE TO START -', W/2, 172);
    }
  }

  function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,10,10,0.9)';
    ctx.fillRect(50, 50, 220, 100);
    ctx.strokeStyle = C_RED;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(50, 50, 220, 100);

    ctx.fillStyle = C_RED;
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, 80);

    ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
    ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, W/2, 105);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d040';
    ctx.font = '12px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('BEST: ' + best, W/2, 122);

    if (Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = C_WHITE;
      ctx.font = '10px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('- PRESS SPACE TO RETRY -', W/2, 145);
    }
  }

  // ============ MAIN LOOP ============
  let lastTime = 0;
  function loop(time) {
    const dt = Math.min((time - lastTime) / 16.667, 3);
    lastTime = time;

    update();
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
